1798470.name: Toy Kingdom 3
1798470.about_the_game:
Toy Kingdom 3 is a arena-styled FPS about acquiring toys and fighting beside them!

Welcome to Toy Kingdom!


Play as an action figure - you are a toy. Toy Kingdom is in peril—Sir Cuddles has taken reign of the room and all the toys in it. He uses the arena in a way to make entertainment using prisoners. Fight in the arena, build your toy team, and defeat Sir Cuddles.

4 Factions:

Teddy Bears
These characters are the standard civilians in the realm. In the arena there are different types: boxing, pink fire-ball throwing, and ball-launching. Recruit these teddies to join you in the battle against Sir Cuddles.

Dinosaurs
The dinosaurs are the fiercest and fastest in the arena. They fight teeth and claws in the arena to claim status as apex predator.

Robots
The robot toys equipped with beams and bombs live in the child's room near technology. They thrive off battery power, and use their abilities to counteract even the most powerful of foes.

Monsters
The monster faction consists of the most diverse toys. Their estranged differences are the reason they band together, making them one of the most challenging opponents.

Features


12 Unique Characters with Character Evolutions
Each character evolves on your team as they gain experience from battle.


Arena Combat
Fast-Paced battles with ever-changing dynamics based on combatants.


5 Unique Destructible Arenas
Each arena is dedicated to a specific faction with it's own theme


5 Difficulty Ranks
Difficulty naturally progresses, great start, challenging to finish.


25 Levels
Repayable levels with random generation of enemy combatants for variety of gameplay and strategy.

6 Boss Battles
Win each rank in arenas to face the unique bosses to gain access to the ultimate show-down with Sir Cuddles himself...at the Tea Party.

2 Endless Modes
Unlockable modes for continuous replayability and challenge.

1798480.name: Sex Clicker
1798480.about_the_game:
An idle game about making money from sexy girls!

In Sex Clicker you have to demand an absurd amount of money. To help yourself, you can hire a variety of helpers: good girls, selecton dolls, factories and sexy men! Mercilessly click on the girl to earn money, spend it on strange improvements that will bring even more money! You can hire girls who themselves will produce money for you, and the game itself can be minimized and go about your business!

Game Features:
* Sexy heroine, clicking on which she will shake her charms;
* A large number of improvements. Sometimes even very strange and funny;
* Ability to minimize the game, and money will be earned;
* Mathematical calculation. Distribute improvements intelligently;

1798520.name: Froggerty Arcade 2
1798520.about_the_game:
Guide little froggy across a plethora of exciting landscapes in order to find his home sweet lilli pad home avoiding dangers such as cars, boulders, crocodiles and many more. Don't forget jump on those bonuses and whatever you do......remember the clock is ticking!

FEATURING :

_ Highly addictive pick and and play fun
_ Cute cartoon style 3D graphics
_ Multiple beautifully designed landscapes to hop through
_ Get on the leaderboard and show off to your friends
_ Exclusive soundtrack from Tony Longworth
_ Introducing Frog TV!
_ All major game controllers supported


KEYBOARD CONTROLS

Right hand :
Cursor Keys

Left hand -
W/A/S/D

Pause - ‘Space’ or 'P'

If you enjoy playing Froggerty Arcade 2 then please feel free to drop us a review. We welcome all feedback.

1798540.name: Dino Cub
1798540.about_the_game:
After accidentally falling out of the nest, your objective will be to build a safe path for the egg to reach the end of the mountain without breaking it.



  • Build the path your way;

  • Levels with progressive difficulty;
  • Pleasant color palette

1798570.name: Sleepless
1798570.about_the_game:
Sleepless is a multiplayer horror game inspired by the myth "The Russian Sleep Experiment." The game is set in a bunker in present-day Russia. The players' goal is to collect all the evidence items from the bunker that can provide important information about the past experiments. However, this is not an easy task, as the abandoned bunker is difficult to navigate, lack of electricity, and the constant feeling of being watched by the blind experiment victim.


Distract the monster: Find objects in the bunker and use them to create sounds, diverting the attention of the blind monster.


Collect Evidence: Gather randomly placed evidence throughout the bunker to win the game. Be cautious, as finding evidence will gradually increase the monster's aggression.


Control the Gas: Manipulate the gas switches, which are operational only when the generator is powered, to safely navigate through different rooms.
1798570.supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Danish, Russian

1798600.name: Trigo
1798600.about_the_game:
Trigo is a fast-paced, the floor is lava, precision platformer: run, slide, jump, use special boosts and the freeze ability, reach and collect all three cores in each level, and open the final portal. You'll do all of this in first-person perspective in a variety of levels that will test your quick thinking and reflexes. Ignore the timer, play it safe and progress more slowly, or take risks and storm to the top of the leaderboards. It's simple, but it's just the beginning of the battle against the simulation.

Key Features

  • Campaign
    Play a variety of 61 levels that get progressively more difficult.
  • Special Jump Boosts
    Understand your needs and use your special 2x, 3x, 4x jump boosts to progress faster.
  • Freeze Ability
    Freeze time, obstacles and lava to give yourself an advantage or a second chance to get back on track.
  • Worldwide Leaderboards
    Earn your place at the top of the leaderboards by finding the best path through the levels.
  • Visuals
    Low-poly style and eye-friendly colors that allow players to focus on the main objectives.
  • Hard Mode
    A special FREE update that unlocks 10 brand new levels with higher skill requirements.
  • Upcoming Modes
    Expert Mode
    Impossible Mode

1798620.name: Fall in the Rift
1798620.about_the_game:
Fall in the Rift is a turn-based strategic roguelite on PC. In this game, you have to explore the Rift, in a post-apocalyptic world, in order to recover Riftium, a mineral with supernatural properties that can save the world.
Nevertheless, the adventure is far from being without danger and you will have to fight to survive: there are many hidden treasures to be found among the remains of a vanished civilization, as well as some very powerful monsters.

YOUR ADVENTURE

Start your adventure, and fully explore the Rift! Each exploration is unique and lasts about 1 hour. You must choose your path with the help of your map, and fight monsters on the battlefield. The battlefield is composed of squares, like a chess game.
Each adventurer in your team has a unique play style that you can develop by improving their skills. At the end of each exploration, you earn coins and reputation that allow you to unlock new content for future explorations.

1798640.name: Melodier
1798640.about_the_game:
Challenge yourself in this minimalistic puzzle game about musical melodies.

Connect the blocks

Move freely around the scenery and connect the blocks in the form you think will solve the puzzle

Solve the puzzle

Try and connect the blocks in the way described on the level, once you reach the position you completed it!

Discover the Melody

Once you solve the puzzle a piece of melody will be unlocked, do you know them? (Based on over 30 popular melodies)

Enjoy the process!

Move, connect, solve and discover in over 50 hand-crafted levels in an easy and intuitive way



Remember, you can always undo your actions till the beginning of each level



If you like the game, Wishlist now!

1798670.name: Horoscopicus
1798670.about_the_game:
Horoscopicus is a game inspired by 2D platformers from a certain incredibly well known portable console from the 90s!
Play as Horo in this 2D Retro platformer and try your best to collect the 12 zodiac signs (AND PET THE SECRET ANIMALS) so that you may unlock the door to the mysterious 13th zodiac!





  • Explore 12 levels + Special versions, all inspired by their own unique zodiac sign!
  • Choose your own path! The initial 12 levels can be played in any order!
  • 4 Different upgrade types which change character visuals to match!
  • Find and PET 12 DIFFERENT SECRET ANIMALS! :D
  • Several selectable screen borders! (Can you find out how to change them?)
  • Lots of references to other games and media!
  • Simple controls! (A Jump button, an Attack button and directional keys for Movement.)
  • An assist/accessibility mode that can help with those particularly tough sections!
  • An amazingly unique soundtrack made by TheLuzical!
  • One difficulty, tailored to be the intended experience!
  • Speedrun friendly! (Enemies behave under cycles)
  • Total length of the game should be around 3h~, though it highly depends from player to player! :)

Disclaimer:

This is my first big game and it was completed mostly as a solo project.
While I got some help during development, expect a more "traditional indie" quality to the game! :)
Nonetheless, I hope you manage to enjoy it regardless!

1798690.name: Blackjack Avenue
1798690.about_the_game:
Blackjack Avenue is a casual Casino Blackjack Simulation.

Enjoy the experience of being in a casino without the risk of spending real money.

Play Blackjack, also known as "21" by getting cards from the dealer.

The goal is to get a higher hand than the dealer.

But don't get more than 21, or else you will bust and the dealer wins!



Use classic techniques such as Splitting Pairs, Double Down and Insurance.

Experiment with different betting / split strategies and see what works best for you.

The table has a 2K bet maximum.

There are no micro-transactions, or real money and you can play offline.

Use the Color buttons to split chips into smaller denominations if necessary.

Track your progress with the Stats page and improve your Blackjack skills!



You can choose the amount of decks used.

Options for the amont of decks include 1, 2, 4, or 6 decks.

Use the pixel-art ATM for more chips which draw against your profile's digital balance.

It's ok to have a negative balance.

If you feel your balance went too negative, simply reset via profile options and try again.

You're invited to Blackjack Avenue! Where your next BIG WIN is just a click away!

1798720.name: Nora: The Wannabe Alchemist
1798720.about_the_game:
PLEASE NOTE: THE WANNABE ALCHEMIST IS STILL IN EARLY ACCESS AND NOT A COMPLETE GAME. It was released as a full game, which cannot be now changed on Steam. The game should achieve its final form by the end of 2025. Thank you for understanding!


Though a bit clumsy, Nora has a heart full of kindness and the purest intentions. Even though she struggled at Witchcraft School, it doesn't discourage her from pursuing her dream - becoming a world-famous alchemist! Join Nora on her thrilling journey and support her as she proves that she indeed can achieve her ambitious goal!

Start small with simple, basic potions and gradually sharpen your skills to uncover up to 50 new recipes! Each mixture requires different ingredients and preparation, and one of your tasks will be to ensure that their production is smooth and uninterrupted. Fulfill your customers' orders, sell your wares, and advance in the mysterious art of potion-crafting!

This vibrantly illustrated point-and-click game pits klutziness against good intentions – a ticking clock against wilting houseplants. Move into Nora’s cozy-but-cluttered witch’s cottage, brew more than 50 powerful potions and achieve domestic bliss in this truly magical visual novel / time management hybrid.

During your adventure, you are sure to meet many interesting and truly intriguing characters. Take your time to chat with them all and immerse yourself deeper into the magical world of spells, potions and fun. Who knows, maybe some of them will become your friends?


• Brew potions and fulfill orders

• Grow and harvest alchemical plants… or sell them for money!

• Decorate and upgrade rooms of your hut

• Hone and upgrade your abilities

• Collect more than 20 unique ingredients

• Enjoy the cozy and relaxing nature of the game!

1798740.name: TEN - Ten Rooms, Ten Seconds
1798740.about_the_game:
This is gonna hurt.

TEN is a challenging and brutal platformer in which you face a relentless gauntlet of ten-second deathtrap rooms in a desperate struggle to escape your fate... and find out what the hell is going on around here.

Collect tokens, purchase a variety of upgrades and learn how to overcome each floor's onslaught of saw blades, cannon fire, lasers, bizarre monsters and more.

If you're up to the challenge, TEN:
  • Rewards learning through failure and encourages you to die, try, die, and try again.
  • Takes you through multiple floors of ever-evolving threats, challenges and deadly bosses.
  • Doesn't end the way you might expect.
  • Please listen, there isn't much time, we have to warn you before the memory backup fails, you must- SIGNAL LOST.
  • Is accompanied by an unreasonably epic original soundtrack by the legends at dBXY.
  • Seriously, the game doesn't deserve a soundtrack this good.
1798740.supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian

1798750.name: 十三月のふたり姫／The 13th month
1798750.about_the_game:
◆“Sleeping Beauty”？

The fate of the world is bound to a princess lost in an endless sleep… The famous fairy tale “Sleeping Beauty” is completely reimagined and redesigned as Visual Novel… With a demonic imagination and originality, the creators will lead you through a fantastic and illusionary world…



* The image is under development. The finished product will display English text in English mode.

◆Creators

Legendary creators of "Megami Tensei" and "Shin Megami Tensei".
SUZUKI Kazunari : Story and Screenplay

MASUKO Tsukasa : Music and Sound Design


Queen of LIMITS Digital Art Battle
AOGACHOU : Character Design and Art direction

【Story Summary】

The princess was just too beautiful. She was given all the good qualities of this world, such things as beauty, grace, kindness, tolerance, and honesty. It would soon be the princess’ 16th birthday.
On the day of her birthday, a young girl visited the castle. She was a witch.

The witch spoke words of incantation, and the princess fell into an eternal sleep. The days would pass with none but the two girls together in the confines of the princess’ room.
On the 100th year of the princess’ sleep, a brave prince visited her sleeping form. The princes had been told by a wise man that the princess would awaken with a kiss. However, the princess would not awaken, and the prince defeatedly returned home.
Every 100 years a new prince would visit the princess. Heroes from history, legendary figures, people from alternate worlds… Everyone tried to awaken the princess.

The witch, with the desire to protect the princess, would gaze with frigid eyes upon those who wished to awaken her.
What is the motive of this mysterious witch? What secret was entrusted to the princess? All is still unclear.
Let us open the magic door and look quietly in upon the sleeping princess. There we may find the answers to our burning questions.

◆Character Voices

The Princess : Suzuka Morita


Uruzuki (Witch) : ςera➹


Grimalkin (Familiar spirit) : Akio Otsuka


Black Prince : Ryotaro Okiayu


The Queen : Akemi Okamura


The Corpse Princess Ai Kakuma

1798760.name: Wind Of Life
1798760.about_the_game:
The game is about the wind and its freedom. Make your way to a colorful and meditative journey. Go all the path escaping the dangers of an abandoned planet and controlling the wind power.

Recently there have been a lot of people and all of them have adapted to the stressful nature of the planet. However, something has happened. Now you can’t see anybody around there. You have to deal with the wind strength which will mislead you. Hide or escape, jump or fly, solve puzzles and try to go to the end. Explore different areas and make sure whether you're alone on this planet or not.

It is a minimalistic platform game with simple riddles and relaxing flights. Here you are going to explore locations, enjoying the atmosphere and pleasant soundtracks. The game mechanics is based on unpredictable wind. It may have a varying degree of strength and direction. Will you be able to adjust or not?

1798770.name: Blasting Courier
1798770.about_the_game:
You take the role of a medieval courier tasked with the quest of delivering important letters to kings and queens (they usually reside in castles). However, your path is not easy. You have to avoid deadly mines that can blast you to the stars and back.

In Blasting Courier you control a 2D top-down character. You can control that character with the WASD keys or the arrow keys. The primary goal is to reach the unique castle per level. You can also flag the mines, so you can avoid them better.
Compete with friends and see who is the best medieval messenger.
Levels are procedurally generated and only limited by the specs of your computer.

If you have any ideas, please visit our Discord server or our subreddit! We can talk about it and probably get it into the game.
Don't forget to leave a review no matter what the rating is. Constructive criticism goes a long way!
1798770.supported_languages:
English*, Bulgarian*, Turkish*, German*, Spanish - Spain*, Russian*, Simplified Chinese*
*languages with full audio support

1798780.name: Dimension Tripper Neptune: TOP NEP
1798780.about_the_game:
About Dimension Tripper Neptune: TOP NEP

Guide Older Neptune as she takes to the skies with the help of her state-of-the-art Generator Unit! Combat through five unique stages and bosses based on the Gamindustri Nations. Blast through fast-moving obstacles and even fight some familiar Neptunia enemies and bosses! And if you gather enough coins on each stage, a friend will assist you on attacks. Challenge yourself and see what your highest score can be! Now, put on your gaming goggles, Maverick, and ready up for the wildest Neptunia ride of your life!

Key Features

A Familiar Dimension Goes Old School – Older Neptune embarks on a new rail shooter adventure! Play through five different stages inspired by the greatest Nations of Gamindustri. Watch out for the big bosses, including Neptune’s least favorite food, a giant eggplant!

That Makes Cents – Control Older Neptune toward the special coins to fill up your coin gauge. Once filled, the character shown above your coin gauge will appear for a limited time to help you take down some baddies. Unlock all 9 possible friends and use them to take down enemies!

Can You Beat Your High Score? – It’s not a Neptunia game without any challenges! Choose between Normal and Hard difficulty settings and try to get the highest score. Keep a close eye on your HP bar because obstacles, flying bullets, and mischievous enemies can lunge at you at any moment. Hit a game over? Sacrifice some points to keep the game going in Normal mode!

1798810.name: Chefy-Chef
1798810.about_the_game:
Being a cook is a vocation!



Pineapple-radish salad is a favorite dish of the Chef named Chefy. Once again approaching the refrigerator, Chefy magically finds himself in new worlds in which he has to find the ingredients for his favorite dish!



Armed with your culinary skills and ingenuity, embark on this delicious adventure! Collect ingredients as you make your way through dense jungles, snow-capped mountains and a viscous swamp.



Overcome 60 levels full of adventure and fun together with Chefy! Pick up unique cooking tools that will unlock superpowers for you, such as climbing walls with a sharp knife, teleportation with a frying pan and high jumps thanks to a cooking hammer!

1799080.about_the_game:
Prescription Wars is a full-fledged adventure game with a pharmacist as the main character, focusing on the pharmacist's job "checking prescription".
The game pursues the realism of "checking prescription"
If you are a pharmacist, you can hone your skills through this game, and if you are not, you can simulate some of the real work of a pharmacist through the game.

Story

I'm a second-year pharmacist who accidentally wandered into a strange world where AI has developed, and I end up at a large pharmacy that handles a large number of prescriptions in that city.
I was forced to start working there in order to survive, but then I realized that the pharmacy was full of "bag fillers" who could only "dispense as prescribed by the doctor" without questioning the prescriptions brought in by the patients.
As the only pharmacist in the country, I become a prescription inspector at a pharmacy and confront the darkness that has infiltrated the country with the weapon of "checking prescription".

Game System

The setting is a dispensing pharmacy.
When you receive a prescription from a patient, you check to see if the contents of the prescription are correct by looking at references and the medication notebook.
If it is correct, you can dispense the prescription as it is, but if it is not, you need to make an inquiry (choose one of the four options to find out what is wrong).
If you get the answer right, you get credit points, but if you get it wrong, you lose points.
If you get it wrong, you lose points. The game is over when your trust points drop to zero, so audit your prescriptions carefully and quickly!

1799140.name: Detective Agency: Murder at the Manor
1799140.about_the_game:
Welcome to join our QQ group: 519072161 to discuss games together.

Game Introduction

"Detective Master's House" is a real-life detective puzzle game. You will play the role of detective "Henry", shuttle through the murder scenes of various Blizzard Mountains, and investigate each intricate case in depth. In Manor Mystery, you will experience the twists and turns of the murder and find out the ugly truth behind the death of the owner of the Rose Manor in the back room!

Gameplay

  • Search evidence
    In order to gain clues to the case, you will visit the crime scene to search for evidence and solve ingenious puzzles. Don't miss every clue of the scene! Those seemingly ordinary objects, under reasonable logical reasoning, may become irrefutable evidence to lock the real murderer!

  • information
    Is it a confusing lie? Or the unmistakable truth? Carefully examine the confessions of the suspects and capture the keyword information that the case really needs. This is the foundation of a detective!

  • reasoning
    When complex and interrelated fragmented clues are in front of you, how to connect them to form a complete logical chain to make correct inferences? Everything needs to use your strong logical reasoning ability!

  • Destroy the murderer
    You have seen the truth of the case, but the culprit has denied it. Use your ingenious and astonishing reasoning to bring out his irrefutable hard evidence and smash his undisguised lies!

  • Replay
    When the real culprit is reported, this is not the final victory. Step-by-step interpretation of the details of the case, to verify whether your reasoning is accurate, to restore the complicated and confusing truth of the case!

Game Features

  • Immersive detective tour
    Real-life case detection, on-site evidence collection, and trial of suspects... Rich reasoning links, in-depth experience of the whole process of a detective's case detection.

  • Complicated cases
    The logic of the case is rigorous, the case is ups and downs, the classic case of Blizzard Mountain Villa, and experience the original reasoning.

  • Featured reasoning system
    The visualization of the reasoning logic chain can help you clarify your thoughts in the complex clues, and find the real culprit.

About our studio

We are "Ji Xiang Ru Yi", an independent game studio from Chengdu. There are currently four team members, two planners, one program, and one artist.
The inspiration for making this game came from an accidental whim when playing a script to kill. How about turning these evidence-gathering links into actual scenarios? Can you restore every link of the detective's case-solving in a more immersive way?
When I first came up with this idea, every member of the team was very excited. Although everyone had never tried a puzzle-solving game, everyone played Ace Attorney and watched The Kindaichi Case Files grow up.
We spent a lot of time on this product, from project approval to a little bit of implementation, we painfully found that the game we made was quite different from the original imagination. After two or three overthrows and redoes, it finally ended in face is presented before you.
This is not a perfect work, but an exploratory attempt by our studio is an explanation for the small idea at the beginning, the determination to do what it says, and the serious work for so long.
I would like to thank every friend in the studio for their hard work and dedication after countless quarrels; I would like to thank all the classic reasoning games we have played for the inspiration, and I would like to thank all the family members and family members who have helped in the process of making the game. Friends, thanks to all players!

When a sudden earthquake plunges you into the underground darkness where a foreboding mansion lies dormant and waiting, you must navigate the ancient house, discovering its secrets while surviving the malicious inhabitants lurking down every dark corridor and lingering within every room. Separated from your partner, both of you must rely on your communication skills, bravery, and pure wit if you want to escape the mansion and ever see the light of day again.

The game art captures a unique mix of realism and stylization to give players a sense of the uncanny, enveloping them in a dream-like environment and enhancing the nightmarish experience of the mansion.



Challenging Puzzles
Players will face a variety of puzzles on their journey out of the sunken mansion. MALICE provides a mind-bending mix of logical, lateral, and decryption puzzles alongside old-fashioned mazes, all intensified by a two-player co-operative twist. Imagine a real life escape room completely unrestricted by physical constraints!



2 Player Coop

3 Chapters of Gameplay
MALICE will consist of three chapters. Each chapter will provide 1+ hours of gameplay, scares, and puzzles.
Players will be taken to different locations of an ancient Edo era settlement and ending in an unspeakable dimension where something more sinister lies waiting..

1799520.name: The Legend of Pomodoro
1799520.about_the_game:
The Legend of Pomodoro is a pomodoro tool and an RPG game driven by tomatoes.

What Is The Pomodoro Technique?


The Pomodoro Technique is a time management method invented by Francesco Cirillo in the late 1980s. It uses a timer to break work into intervals, traditionally 25 minutes in length, separated by 5 minutes breaks. Each cycle is known as a pomodoro, from the Italian word for tomato.

Why The Legend of Pomodoro?


It is the nature of the human mind to roam about and sneak away from work.

The Legend of Pomodoro (TLOP) implements a pomodoro timer gamified by an idle game environment, it creates a buffer zone between your focus and the outer world to avoid either getting tired or procrastination.

Being different from traditional idle games, TLOP doesn't interrupt you from time to time during a pomodoro cycle. You'll become a legend in the virtual world while being concentrated on your real life tasks.

Does The Legend of Pomodoro Suit Me?


The answer, most likely, is yes. To put it simply, gamification is everywhere. The practice of adding game-like elements to non-gaming environments improves engagement and boosts performance.

Gamification lights up our brains. When you complete things, you get rewarded and win both in the gamified world and in your real life. TLOP is supposed to be a tool to help you to be productive with an entertaining experience. It helps you manage big goals by separating them into iterative and incremental steps. To practice the gamified technique in TLOP, you will:

  1. Decide on the tasks to be done
  2. Set the pomodoro timer
  3. Work on one task
  4. End work when the timer rings and take a rest, then go back to step 2 or pause

TLOP has integrated the following features to keep this progress fun:

  1. Grow and harvest crops to earn in-app revenues when complete tasks
  2. Level up in-app items, characters, etc. with tomatoes, gold, and crystal earned from completed cycles
  3. Progress adventure, unlock new stories, achievements, and other stuff
  4. Be a hero and save the game world

The Aztec realm awaits your command. Will you forge alliances, dominate the ranked ladder, or unravel the mysteries of Smelogs Playground?

1800010.name: Ruin or Victory
1800010.about_the_game:
Ruin or Victory is a modern take and evolution of the classic RTS genre with added detail, continuity, and strategic depth while remaining accessible and well-paced. Devise your strategy, manage and expand your economy, and choose your warriors' equipment and tactics.

Adapt to the map and your opponent each game, where there are no obvious moves or simple counters. Each mechanic is easy to use, but you will need to balance many as well as plan where to focus and how to be efficient. Manage risk and reserve contingencies, as your enemy's strength and the outcome of every battle is uncertain, yet one mistake will not doom you.

Game Modes
  • A Journey mode with a turn-based map layer in which you fight AI tribes for control of a continent. Face strategic, tactical, and economic challenges over many games, as you build the persistent strength of your tribe through technology, units, and resources.
  • A scenario mode against one or more AI with settings for AI personality, difficulty, starting and maximum strength, and teams.
  • A quick battle mode with field, siege, and naval battles against a random AI army.
  • A free-build mode with no opponent and optional tutorial hints. A complete user manual and how-to guide will be accessible in game while paused.

Features
  • Random map generation with different terrain, resources, and starting positions each game. Fight on varied ground from sand to snow, in forests and swamps, and around rivers, lakes, and boulders that create natural chokepoints. Cross the water and expand to islands in the open ocean. Save your own custom map configuration that controls many parameters of map generation.


  • Warriors are equipped with custom sets of equipment that you design. Create armored archers or light spearmen to fend of cavalry. Every piece of a warrior's equipment will impact their speed and combat abilities. Carried items and resources are dropped on death, allowing the victor to loot the battlefield.


  • An organic population growth system that uses real-time food consumption, death due to starvation, and overcrowding factors. You will have to balance your population's growth, food production, military size, and face natural hardships such as disease and crop failure.


  • Build ships to gather fish and fight the enemy. Crew your galleys with the warriors you trained and equipped to defeat your foes in ranged and boarding naval action.
  • An AI that does not cheat, but uses all the same mechanics that the player does. The AI will make decisions based only on what it has spotted and use various strategies and equipment to make each game different. The skirmisher AI builds up its economy dynamically to provide a challenging opponent.
  • An extensive, branching technology tree with new items, buildings, and abstract benefits. Some paths are exclusive to others and offer both advantages and disadvantages that define your strategy and playstyle. The tree starts in the stone age and ends at the early medieval age.
  • Continuity of resources and items presents a new strategy of logistics. All resources gathered and items made are physically present in the game world. Resources must be moved to buildings for construction. Workshops must have resources delivered, and the items must be moved and stored in armories.
  • Humans gain skills that significantly improve their efficiency. Various crafters make high quality items and are a strategic target, while skilled warriors take time to train but are deadly in battle.
  • Lure and tame wild animals into domesticated animals that serve as more efficient farm and transport workers and enable the use of cavalry, but require food and training. Animals can be captured when their previous owners abandon them.
  • Buildings and siege machines require humans to operate, and can be captured if abandoned. Buildings captured from the enemy can be looted, burned, or used like your own buildings.

All of this detail is scaled to the strategic level and streamlined for fluid RTS play. There are no inventory screens, pop-up windows, or right click menus. Resources and items are managed in any quantity with a few button clicks. An order queuing system allows you to chain orders and display them in the game world.

A clear user interface with customization options, intuitive hotkey navigation, and unlimited map zoom with scalable icons, is presented with original, stylized artwork and font.

1800250.name: Void Soul Awakening
1800250.about_the_game:
You play as a wandering soul discarded within an ever-shifting cosmic prison. Your existence is a blank slate until a mysterious woman grants you an immortal body and a singular, absolute command: escape the prison and defeat the entity that rules the prison, the Keeper. Armed with newfound power, you must fight through the distorted architecture of this realm, facing the monstrosities born from the prison's very walls.

As you descend deeper into the shifting layers, the world begins to reveal itself. You aren't just fighting for survival; you are beginning to learn the chilling truth behind the woman’s motives, the Keeper’s true identity, and the reality of why you exist. Every victory peels back the mystery of what this realm was truly meant to contain and why you were the one given the strength to break it.

FEATURES:

Hybrid gameplay of shooter and Hack & Slash

  • The Soul Overload Loop: Using firearms and sorceries rapidly builds up harmful energy. Once you reach a state of Overload, your long range arsenal "jams," forcing you to dive into risky melee combat to dispel the surge and restore balance to your weaponry.

  • Forward Momentum Combat: Survival in the Abyssal Cube is earned through constant engagement. You must stay in the face of the enemy to keep your energy flowing; passivity is a death sentence that leads to stalled abilities and eventual defeat.

  • Lucid Surges & Transformations: Maintaining high combat momentum triggers a Lucid Surge, a state of heightened power. This grants access to devastating Lucid Weapons powerful finishers and transformations based on your chosen Echoes that can finish off the most formidable foes.

  • Boss-Driven Progression & Echoes: Defeating over 30 hand crafted bosses, such as Wardens and Archons, rewards you with Echoes. These fragments of power grant transformative abilities and combat modifiers, which you can swap on the fly via a radial wheel to adapt to escalating threats.

  • Risk-Based Leveling: As you level up during a run, you choose between Blessings straightforward buffs like increased soul energy capacity and Curses, which provide massive, game changing power at the cost of heavy penalties that jeopardize your survival.

Adaptability:

  • 50+ Firearms Discover an arsenal ranging from precision rifles and rapid pistols to cursed launchers that reshape the battlefield. Each weapon offers unique stats and effects.

  • 30+ Sorceries Command the void with devastating abilities summon spectral claws, ignite soul storms, or warp reality itself. Every sorcery changes how you fight.

  • 20+ Echoes (Playstyles) Echoes define your core identity each one alters movement, abilities, and stats, allowing for radically different playstyles.

  • 40+ Melee Weapons Harness melee weapons forged from pure essence each one carrying unique traits, movesets, and elemental affinities that feed your Soul Energy system.

  • Adaptive Styles Manifestations of lost souls that shape your playstyle called Echoes. Each Echo grants unique abilities and passive traits, letting you tailor your combat approach from relentless melee pressure to agile evasion or ranged precision.

  • Master Adaptability Every encounter pushes you to reforge your tactics and embrace the chaos becoming the embodiment of evolution itself.

The Abyssal Cube Hierarchy

  • Four Non-Linear Sectors: The Abyssal Cube is divided into four massive sectors, each containing a collection of procedural and non-procedural dungeons. You can navigate these dungeons in a non-linear fashion as you explore the shifting architecture of the prison.

  • Sector Progression and Archons: Every sector is guarded by an Archon, the ultimate gatekeeper of the nightmare. You must defeat the Archon at the end of your current sector to unlock the path to deeper levels of the Cube.

  • 30+ Intense Boss Battles: Face a roster of over 30 hand-crafted bosses designed to test your mastery of the Soul Overload system.

  • Wardens: These encounters are found within the depths of each sector's dungeons to test your skill and reward you with tactical abilities.

  • Traversal-Based Unlocks: You can acquire Echoes and abilities that grant new movement mechanics, such as wall running and grappling, which allow you to reach previously inaccessible dungeons within each sector.

  • 80+ enemy types: Encounter diverse enemy groups and environmental hazards that evolve as the Cube reacts to your growing power. These corrupted monstrosities strike in escalating waves designed to punish hesitation.

1800470.name: Moonwakers

Eco-points, an innovative system integrated into the gameplay, reward the use of this eco mode by providing you with virtuous in-game currency! This mechanic enhances exploration, encouraging you to interact with the world around you in a more eco-friendly manner. The choice is yours, and you can switch between modes at any time during the game.

1800910.name: Bot Patrol
1800910.about_the_game:
Prepare to dive headfirst into the quirky world of "Bot Patrol," where the daily grind takes on a whole new meaning!
In this bustling asteroid station, life for bots is all about routine — wake up, punch in, push stuff around, and recharge. But one day, you notice something odd. There's a crack in the routine, something is off in all this monotony. And where did all those missing colleague bots vanish off to?

Embark on a truly riddled adventure through mind-bending puzzles spread across three different biomes. Get ready for a roller coaster ride of old-school boulder dash mechanics with a large amount of extra spice. Maneuver through conveyor belt chaos, outsmart spinning guard bots with personalities bigger than their circuits, and dodge off laser barriers like a pro!

But beware! Every misstep could lead to disaster, from triggering contraptions gone haywire to pushing cargo drums just a tad too far. It's a race against mechanical mayhem as you uncover the secrets lurking in the station's walls. Who knew saving the day could be this much fun? There might even be freedom waiting at the end of the journey!

So grab your thinking cap and gear up for a quirky quest unlike any other. "Bot Patrol" is waiting for you to join the ranks of robot revolutionaries in the fight for freedom!


In traditional Sokoban fashion the player has to push all scattered cargo containers onto the right target spots to complete a level. Challenge comes from only being able to push, but not pull the barrels. This means every step has to be thought through to not end up in a scenario, where access to a container or its target is blocked.

Beyond the regular gameplay mechanics, Bot Patrol features an abundance of extended elements, that make achieving the goal a lot trickier. Conveyor belts, cranes, energy barriers and button triggers are added into the mix. Not to forget the evil control bots, that will perish the player upon contact.

And since playing the game is supposed to be a hard but fun puzzle challenge and not rage inducting repetition machine, Bot Patrol comes with a gracious infinite Undo, to take that one step back, that went to far.
Or the one before. Or the one before that...



Bot Patrol has been developed by solo developer a.mighty.dish over the course of 3 years - as a hobby project next to a day job in AAA game development.
It really started as a last big hobby project to finish before the birth of our first offspring. Natures deadlines are quite definite, so when the game was not really finished in time, development came to a halt between milk bottles and baby steps.
Hot fast forward to two years later - with some small sabbatical time at hand - it seemed too much fun of a game to let it wither someone in the abandoned projects folder of ones hard drive and so Bot Patrol eventually saw the light of day!

The dungeons of Nefarium change each time you enter, introducing variety in how you will get to the end. Difficulty rises with each completed floor as monsters start to get stronger. But beware, if you die, you will lose the current floor.

YOU ARE THE BOSS


Everything in the dungeon wants a piece of you, especially the boss awaiting you at the end of a floor. Kill your enemies, collect their souls, level up and unlock powerful abilities.

WIELD STRONG AND UNIQUE EQUIPMENT

FIND YOUR OWN PLAYSTYLE


There isn't a class system in Nefarium, meaning anyone can wear any kind of equipment that they find. Legendary and Corrupted items don't have randomized stats, so you don't have to worry about finding a better version of your dream gear!

Roadmap


As Nefarium is in development, it is missing some of features that will make the game more complex eventually. You can find a small list of all the things that are either in development or are planned below.

Long Term Goals:

  • Way more items with unique properties!
  • Way more abilities!
  • Appearance changer
  • More and better sound effects
  • Music
  • An Endurance Mode where you will be able to start from the very bottom and see just how far you can go without dying.
  • Better animations overall

And more!

If you'd like to keep up to date with Nefarium's progress, don't forget to join my Discord server and add it to your Wishlist to be notified when it's released!

1801060.name: Helix
1801060.about_the_game: Helix is a low-poly multiplayer FPS Hero-Shooter with MOBA-like Mechanics. During gameplay you will play as (currently) one of three characters: Aca, the red sound character specialized in close combat audio-visual attacks, Radon, the green smell character specialized in fast-moving prey-stalking combat through his heightened sense of smell, and Vision, the blue sight character specialized in long-range sniping combat, enhanced thanks to his improved owl-like sight. During a match, you will have to kill your opponents and steal their DNA to unlock and upgrade your abilities which will give you an edge against anyone standing in your way. There are (currently) two main modes, deathmatch, where through the use of your abilities you will have to kill the most amount of players, or team-deathmatch, which starts off as a normal team fight, but later evolves into a king-of-the-hill, where players with the most abilities will be able to unlock an area to capture. Through the unlock and upgrade of skills during the match and a dynamic game mode. Helix is trying to pursue a mix of FPS with MOBA-like mechanics.

1801070.name: Ludicrous Uprising
1801070.about_the_game:
Once, there was peace in these lands. There was tranquility. People were happy with their ordinary lives. They were glad to get by with what they had. Until one day, the most powerful wizard of the realm, Taeippa, not content with being the most powerful, attempts to become a god.

Things couldn’t have gone worse. Not realizing that the ritual he performed to become a God was a trick of the Devil, Taeippa opened a portal to the world from the depths of hell.

Thus began the children of the Devil's thousands of years of chaos reign, who passed through the portal one by one to bring destruction and suffering to the land.
Castles and cities of men fell one by one. Only a few villages that no one cares about remains. Here, a spark for an uprising against the reign of evil, begins in one of these villages, with a villager no one cared about.



Ludicrous Uprising is a side scrolling JRPG with tactical turn-based battles, with awesome pixel art mixed with beautiful hand-drawn battle scenes and a ludicrous story that will crack you up.

Game is in early access and will be regularly updated after the initial release.

Join the (ridiculous) adventure of Kaemill and his allies in the attempt of freeing the lands of Prassa from the hands of evil Taeippa.

1801110.name: BOKURA
1801110.about_the_game:
Are you and I really seeing the world the same way?

An exclusively two-player puzzle adventure game that makes you question your reality.

*Players must communicate with each other to play this game. If you are not playing in the same location, you will need another communication method, such as voice chat. Before buying the game, please keep in mind that the game itself does not provide a separate communication method.

BOKURA is a puzzle adventure game that can only be played with two players. To play the game, two people must play on two separate machines.

While you have to work together, what you see on your game screens is completely different.

Even though the same character should be displayed on both of your screens, to one of you, they might look like an animal out of a picture book, while to the other, they might look like a robot. (The objects you can interact with might move differently for each of you too!)

You will need to talk to each other to find out what you can and cannot see. Work together to solve the puzzles and continue your journey.

You can play online in different locations while talking to each other over a call.

Player 1: A world of animals

Player 2: A world of machines

Gameplay

The game is a side-scrolling co-op puzzle adventure. You will be faced with a number of critical choices throughout the story which will lead your journey in different directions.

You Can't Play Alone

A unique feature of this game is that you cannot play it alone. You cannot play it singleplayer or with a computer as player two. It can only be played with two people—no more, no less.

As such, the very first choice you make in this game takes place before you even start: Who should I play this game with?

The total gameplay time is around three to four hours. While you play, you and the other player will need to talk to each other to understand what is happening, solve problems, and make important decisions together.

Story

Two boys who run away from home encounter a dead deer. The sight of it causes them to faint, but when they wake up, the worlds they see are no longer the same.

One of them sees a world of animals, while the other sees a world of machines. Will the boys be able to find out what has happened to them and return to the world they used to be in?

Creator Profile

tokoronyori

An indie game dev with a distinctive style that fills his games with originality and mystery. He is known for his 2016 hit game Hitoribocchi Wakusei (Lonely Planet). He created the two-player puzzle adventure game BOKURA as a member of the first round of Kodansha's Game Creators' Lab. He specializes in making experiences only possible through games with his characteristic game mechanics.

Creator Comment

Have you ever wondered if the world you see is the same as the world everyone else sees?

BOKURA is a game about two boys whose worlds are no longer the same as everyone else's. When you play, you'll find that what you and the other player see are not the same either. I hope you'll overcome the differences in how you see the world and relive the friendship of your childhood through the story of these two boys.

1801140.name: Guns Undarkness
1801140.about_the_game:
A strategy JRPG helmed by lead developer Shoji Meguro (composer for the Persona and Shin Megami Tensei series’).

Customize your arsenal of unique firearms to dominate the battlefield and forge relationships with your team to bolster your combined abilities during intense turn-based combat.

・A turn-based tactical JRPG inspired by games like Metal Gear Solid and Persona

・A relationship system that boosts the protagonist as you grow closer with your teammates

・A story set in a futuristic world on the verge of global and societal ruin

・A meeting of the minds Shoji Meguro (Persona, Shin Megami Tensei), Ilya Kuvshinov (Ghost in Shell: SAC 2045, The Wonderland), and Lotus Juice (Persona Series)

The year was 2045 and humanity was in a state of abeyance that allowed technology to flourish, but deepened the social divide between the rich and the poor, the Haves and the Have Nots.

Within the ranks of the latter grew a faction who planned the Great Reset–an event steeped in primitivism that would change the course of humanity.

The Thousand Plateaus launched two weapons of mass destruction, triggering a worldwide nuclear war.

And so, the Great Reset was accomplished.

Enter our Protagonist, a rookie member of a private military company tasked with handling the worsening situation.

It is up to you to discover the truth behind love in a world wracked by devastation and whether humanity is capable of being revolutionized.

Guns Undarkness is a futuristic JRPG that combines tactical positioning with turn-based strategy.

On the field, the player will control the Protagonist and up to 3 allies.

Use hand signals to instruct your allies to hide at select spots and then order them to cover you. Once you have the highlighted enemy in your sights, it’s time to open fire!

If your team engages the enemy while totally hidden then you’ll activate an attack bonus. The more you fire during this bonus, the more damage you’ll deal before the battle begins.

Hidden or not, once you fire on the enemy your team will leap into a turn-based battle.

Attacks are basic actions that don’t consume SP, while Skills use SP but pack more punch. Attacking from behind cover? Then unleashing your skills with no cost to your SP!

The affinity of your weapon and that of your target’s TAGS (defense suit) will determine how much damage you deal. Manage to strike your enemy in a weak point and you can deal massive damage, while an enemy’s defense value can also reduce the amount of damage they take.

Hit an enemy’s weak point with a normal attack and you’ll be able to duck into cover. All skills are powerful, but there are also guns with special buff/debuff abilities.

Winning a battle earns your team two types of experience points: Character EXP and Gun EXP. Leveling up boosts a character’s stats and unlocks new skills for guns.

Off the field, you and Alpha Team will spend your downtime outside of missions in the Maroon, an amphibious submarine that the team uses as their hideout. You’ll use the hideout to accept quests or visit shops and other locations on the world map.

You’ll be able to enhance the guns you own by adding parts. You’ll even acquire blueprints and materials that’ll let you build new guns as you progress through the story.

Led by Commander McGovern, the Alpha Team is one of the offensive units that work for BTI, a large American private military group.

The team was originally composed of McGovern, Will and Zach–two men who had been her subordinates back when she was a marine– and Naomi, an advanced combat android. Our story begins with the Alpha Team welcoming in their fifth member – the Protagonist.

The main protagonist, and the player's avatar. After working his way through the ranks of numerous private military groups, he becomes the newest member of the BTI Alpha Team.

Thanks to his exemplary combat ability, he's the only member of Alpha Team kitted out with the latest TAGS equipment -- definitely not something typically gifted to a rookie.

A bright and cheerful 17 year old; she's the only child of the great scientist Dr. Cowen.

Despite her uneasy relationship with her father, she chooses to take over his research in the midst of nuclear war with the hope of creating a brighter future for mankind.

Despite his earnest nature making him seem like a softy, he provides serious support to the Alpha Team when equipped with a shotgun.

He's like a brother to the Protagonist, a former U.S. Marine alongside Zach, and once served under the same superior as Alpha Team Commander McGovern.

A high-performance combat android, she has no problems conveying emotion or communicating with humans.

While Naomi has a gentle, motherly disposition, she’s also a reliable member of the Alpha Team’s offensive, charging across battlefields with her handgun.

A silent mercenary of mystery. In his younger years, he worked as an assassin until General Zhang, leader of the Thousand Plateaus, hired him to do his dirty work. He has superhuman reflexes that he can use to dodge bullets, which are far more powerful than even state-of-the-art TAGS technology.

A far eastern military regime that instigated the nuclear war. Led by General Cho. In the name of primitivism, the idea of abandoning human technology and returning to the primitive ages, they have set the entire world on a path to ruin. Primitivism gained more and more supporters following the start of the war, until looting and pillaging became rampant across the entire globe. As of now, chaos reigns thanks to them.

DEVASTATED CITY

A city with a some technology left where the wealthy settled after the war, subsequently making it a prime target for the primitivists.

WEST COAST VILLAGE

The poor gathered here after the war and formed a group to fight back against primitivist looters.

RESEARCH FACILITY

A large research city once occupied this area before the war. It was abandoned shortly after, but important research materials still remain in the rubble.

・Shoji Meguro (Persona Series, Shin Megami Tensei Series)

・Ilya Kuvshinov (Ghost in Shell: SAC 2045, The Wonderland)

・Lotus Juice (Persona Series)

1801150.name: The Night You'd Wish to Forget
1801150.about_the_game:
A single-player horror game with a variable storyline and multiple endings.

You are an employee of an agency dealing with the protection of various private properties. You are lucky enough to get a contract with one of the richest families in the world to guard one of the hundreds of mansions. Not only has no one lived here for several decades, but the site itself is in some kind of wilderness. In short, the job is calm and well paid. Nevertheless, sometimes the alarm still goes off, which makes you wake up and go to check. Usually, these are teenagers or all sorts of stray animals, but the last time looked strange from the very beginning ...

KEY FEATURES

Eerie atmosphere

No screamers around every turn and musicians sleeping on bass, just a truly eerie atmosphere of a half-abandoned estate.

Interactive story

Take the fate of your hero into your own hands and take him out of the current mess alive ... if possible ...

Extreme puzzles

Sometimes you have to make a choice in a split second. Let's see how you handle this.

Deep story

Fans of exploring the worlds of games down to the millimeter will be able to plunge into an intricate and fascinating story and reveal much more interesting details than with a quick passage.

1801230.name: Cemetery Mary
1801230.about_the_game:
Cemetery Mary is the story about a girl who loves visiting the cemetery.

When rumors of a serial killer start floating around town, she isn't too worried--that is, until her parents go missing. And in the wake of their disappearance, a message from an unknown number leaves Mary to wade through a sea of doubts and questions.

Unknown Number
Your parents are safe. [12:43 AM]
Is the rumored "Blackwood Butcher" playing some sort of sick prank? Or is something even more sinister responsible for their disappearance? Will she be able to find the identity of the mysterious killer, or the whereabouts of her parents?

Or will her meddling threaten to make her a permanent resident of the very cemetery she so admires?

This visual novel consists of 3 different routes, each with a Good Ending and a Bad Ending. There is also a True Ending, which can potentially be unlocked by playing any of the 3 routes.

Average playtime for 1 route is 2-2.5 hours. The True Ending is capable of adding an additional 1-2 hours.

Credits follow the True Ending!

1801270.name: Offworlders
1801270.about_the_game:
Offworlders is a single player survival RPG where you will control a hand-picked team of 4 separate characters; each with their own unique specializations, attributes, and inventories.

Your adventure will begin by waking up from cryosleep aboard Starport Prime, an orbital spaceport owned and operated by Crios Corp. - the largest and most powerful human-owned enterprise in the known Universe whose sole objective is focused on pure capitalism with no boundaries.

There you will create your first character by selecting its appearance, gender animations, class, attributes and perks. You will then decide which of the lesser organizations you belong to and will be able to roam the spaceport. Once you have been released you will need to explore Starport Prime to recruit 3 more contractors which will complete your crew of 4 before venturing down to the planet below.
‍
Once you have assembled your team, you will then be transported down to Kepler-47c; an alien planet rich in resources, undiscovered flora and fauna, and a mysterious race of ancient sentient robots who appeared to have crashed an enormous capital ship thousands of years ago which has scattered unusual relics throughout the land for you to discover and unlock their secrets.
‍
Kepler-47c offers a wide variety of biomes where the player will experience not only the tranquil nature of the grasslands and dense forests but also the punishingly difficult acidlands, volcanic ashlands and mysterious maze-like ruins of the ancient crash site. In order to reach the more difficult biomes where rare resources and frightening creatures reside, you will have to cross the deadly sand dunes where you will need to survive not only the harsh environment but also desert raiders and a wide variety of alien creatures which includes the colossal beasts that lurk below the surface.
Some of the activities will include completing the main quest and branching side quests, prospecting and collecting resources, looting raider camps, trading items with the local scrappers, traders, camps or even Starport Prime for a smaller profit, and of course building the space outpost of your dreams.
‍
Building your outpost will be one of the main focuses in Offworlders and will drive a lot of the long term gameplay. There will be a large variety of options to choose from for customization and there will be a freedom to craft both prefabricated structures as well as custom user-designed ones. Managing your power, waste, food and water supplies, automating your farms and refineries, and prospecting a large variety of resources to harvest will all be an integral part of the experience.
‍
To ensure the best chance of survival in Kepler-47c you will have to level up your characters, manage their vitals and supplies, balance your team's skills and fortify your outpost. While the death of your characters cannot be reversed due to the nature of permadeath, you will be able to scavenge their bodies and recruit new contractors to fill their spot to take on a new role in your organization.
‍
The items in Offworlders will have an RPG style of randomized stats where finding the perfect roll will not only feel like a major achievement but will also help build your own unique play style and classes. You will be able to craft, purchase and loot a large variety of items, weapons and tools.
‍
The list of creatures in Offworlders is extensive and is a huge part of the experience. Each creature will serve a unique purpose in the world and will each pose a separate challenge. One of our development goals is to add domestication of the creatures through a skill-based system where you first must study them and learn from their behaviours then domesticate them based on your discoveries. This could be as simple as gaining trust through feeding a favourite food or as complex as dodging a series of attacks, restraining the beast as it tires, corralling it in your outpost and building its trust over time.
‍
The world of Kepler-47c also contains a large amount of creatures that imposter its environment. The player must take caution when harvesting resources or following a particular luminance at night as it may be a deadly creature baiting its prey.Offworlders is a single player stylized survival RPG where you will play as an organization composed of a hand crafted team of 4 separate characters; each with their own unique specializations, attributes, skill trees and inventories.

1801360.name: Blissful Acres
1801360.about_the_game:
Clean up your farm and start by sewing your first seed. Progress your farm by cleaning it up, working the land and bringing it into the future. Manual labor is slow but with the advances in technology creeping their way into Blissful Acres, you will find yourself automating your farm for maximum output.

Features
  • Farming. Your farm is your life. Strategically build it for efficiency and safety. Animals will destroy your fences, the sun will dry up your crops, deer will eat your crops. Your crops can have randomized traits that can be extracted and added to other plants!
  • Skills. Every node you mine, every tree you cut, every crop you sew and harvest all gain you experience! The more skillful you become, the more you will be able to do!
  • Townsfolk. Blissful Acres is full of interesting townsfolk. Spend some time getting to know them. Maybe they'll give you an item, advice or choose to shop at your store over a competitors!
  • Competition. Its not as simple as just selling your goods. You have to out-sell your competitors! Set your prices, curse your competition and make good relationships with the locals to ensure your old produce stand thrives!
  • Exploration. Explore and battle with enemies in a procedurally generated cave system. The rarest of items exist within these depths and its up to you to explore and find items that will enrich your farm!
  • Enchantment. High quality items are key in everything you do in Blissful Acres. Better armor will save you from the depths. Better tools will allow you to manipulate the landscape quickly and effectively. In Blissful Acres, there is no ceiling! You can infinitely enchant your items!
  • Decoration. Use tiles, decorations and lights to make your farm truly yours. A unique farm for a unique farmer!

1801370.name: Being Ball
1801370.about_the_game:
Play Unique Levels

Complete levels in a beautiful cube world as a rock, leaves or wooden ball!

With 14 unique levels that are ready for you to investigate, solve, complete and explore, with more challenging levels coming soon!

Try to avoid falling and bumping into traps and solve challenging puzzles!

Challenge yourself in hazardous islands scattered in a gorgeous cube world with dozens of puzzles to solve, traps to avoid and mysteries to discover.

Change yourself into a suitable ball and traverse forward through barriers and obstacles, collect some pickups and keys on the way to open doors and clear areas.

Get Some Help

Unlock Bobot's power with he's 4 unique abilities to complete more advanced puzzles!

Score Fast

And don't forget to clean the area from scattered toilet papers.
You can also go slowly and spectate this beautiful world.

1801400.name: Fallen Guns

The passage of time will be slow when Alex (the protagonist) is stationary and will return to normal when he moves again. This dynamic will force the player to look for perfect shots and correct timings when eliminating enemies. This makes eliminating a large swarm of enemies very satisfying and rewarding.

1801410.name: Deadnaut: Signal Lost
1801410.about_the_game:
Deadnaut: Signal Lost is a sci-fi horror turn-based roguelike where loyalty isn't earned - it's installed. As the Handler, you'll remotely control a single Deadnaut, a treasure hunter navigating hazardous settlements, drifting derelicts, and confronting nightmarish creatures, haywire security systems, and dangerous fanatics. But remember: your Deadnaut is not your friend. Either gain their trust or pay them off.

And if those don't work? There's always the failsafe on their puppeting software...


  • 5 playable suits - Security, Energy, Tech, Sensor and Labour - with expansive upgrade trees
  • Procedurally generated levels varying from small scouts and massive, multi-deck cryoships to secluded outposts and spread-out settlements
  • Atmospheric soundtrack and dynamic ambience - listening will save your life
  • Lightweight meta progression via collectible "Sigils" that impart powerful modifiers that change how you play
  • Build trust between the Handler and Deadnaut, based on how well you do. Offer bribes if it gets low, or wipe their memory and puppet them instead
  • Character creator where you can pick a suit, assign stats and import your own portraits
  • Traditional roguelike (permadeath, exploration and replayability) with "on-the-run" progression in the spirit of FTL and Slay the Spire


The cosmos is tearing itself apart. Wrecks are full of horrible, interdimensional creatures, the dead roam surfaces of moons, and you’re being hunted by technically advanced soldiers. Experience the world of Deadnaut up close.


Keep your Deadnaut loyal or force compliance. Pay them off or turn them into a mindless space golem if necessary, but remember: everything comes at a price.


Select from five exosuits, each with dozens of unique skills and abilities. Customise your Deadnaut with weapons, sensors, shields, cloaks and hack tools. Choose from the heavy-duty Labour suit, the ghostly Sensor suit, or the gravity-bending Energy suit, or other playstyles to match your preferences.




Encounter dozens of enemy types, each with their own strengths and weaknesses. Avoid – or exploit – the security system in each level, from the Watchers that roam ships to the malfunctioning security Towers and Sentinels that guard settlements. Stay one step ahead of the Benefactors, advanced supersoldiers in relentless pursuit, determined to stop you from reaching the Rip's source.


Develop your Deadnaut and maximise their potential by discovering powerful synergies among 180+ upgrades, and tailor your weapons and gear to face the challenges that await you. Get started with a premade Deadnaut or create your own unique character. Adjust their stats and even import your own photo to truly make your Deadnaut your own.

1801440.name: Royal Commando
1801440.about_the_game:
Chromis the day Isla fell. It was a wonderfully warm day on Isla, the people were enjoying the nice weather after the stormy season. No one expected what would happen next. The sky flashed red and the ground trembled, next a stampede of wild animals came running from the forest. However, they did not look normal. They started attacking the people, ramming them and biting them. The confused king watched as people ran to their homes, this was completely unlike the animals on Isla. They have all been friendly, after having a wild boar run past the Royal Gate the King saw that the eyes of the boar were not normal. At the same time, the people who were bitten began to change...into something indescribable. They armed themselves when they touched the weapon the weapon even changed. They started to attack people, some would use their weapons others would look to turn more people into the infected. Seeing this the king commanded the Royal Gates to be open and began to fill the area with the people of Isla. The people of Isla were forced to arm themselves and defend their island. The fight lasted days before there was a break and the infected retreated. The people took this time to rest, prepare and wait. They knew this was not over. The king demanded that only the most skilled will join the command to fight the infected. He created the arena where people will be tested. Those in the top 100 will join the Royal Command. This would keep a continuing cycle of young, determined, and skilled fighters The end is near, for who is yet to be determined.

Key Features:


The Dungeon: Select a proxy to control, and make your way through the arenas clearing it of all the horrid creatures. The top 100 will be enlisted into the Royal Commando to defend Isla.

Bigger, Faster, Stronger Many, many enemies to test your skills against. Hopefully, you are prepared.

Fast pace Similar to Enter The Dungeon. You will experience fast pace action with bullets coming from all directions.

Weapons, Weapons, and more weapons There will be over 70+ Weapons in the game and a possibility for even more. Each weapon is different than the next. I wonder which one will get you to the end of the dungeon.

Possibly More..

1801460.name: BEST VRCADE 9000
1801460.about_the_game:

Play solo or with friends as you scavenge for weapons, unlock skills, and see how long you can survive before you become a midnight snack for the living dead! 1801630.name: HIGHBLAST
1801630.about_the_game:
Highblast is now in its 3rd version. Hope you enjoy and thanks for playing if you have! We really appreciate it.

Story Context


HIGHBLAST is set on a planet in a distant solar system. You work for the local star system defence force. They prevent any 1 group of people from completely controlling a planet. You are helping to free a planet from an evil civilisation who want to take all the resources for war against other planets. You must infiltrate enemy bases to perform reconnaissance and weaken the enemy.

Basic Game Mechanics (Not yet complete and coming soon)


Enhance your robot soldiers by equipping various arm mounted or arm replacing weapons. Examples include a anti-drone radar, a flamethrower and a rail-gun!
If a robot is disabled do not worry, you have backups! You will be able to upgrade the number of robots you can deploy in later game versions.
Once all enemies are destroyed you return to the ship and leave for orbit to do repairs and upgrades.

Custom Maps (Unavailable)


You have the freedom to create your own maps and share them with others on the Steam Workshop with Highblast's Level Foundry. The map pieces snap to a grid. And new pieces and fixes are being worked on all the time! We are also considering procedural maps for infinite replayability!

Early Development Disclaimer


Highblast was originally released as a first game and was very very.... Indie in it's lack of everything. But we liked the concept an wanted to make something similar with a lot more content and a cool story. So if it seems far from finished, it is. And we (2 to 3 people in our free time) are constantly working on new stuff and fixes for old stuff.
WE WILL NOT NEGLECT THIS GAME UNTIL IT'S DONE! :)
Please enjoy and watch Highblast grow!

1801640.name: 精神病大王花 Flowering Abyss
1801640.about_the_game:
话题作品《精神病大王花》重制的恋爱文字冒险游戏
「再次为您献上最高级的精神病」



【故事设定】
在残酷的、终焉的世界中选择花朵，展开病娇物语。
永远充满热情爱意茉莉花、想要拼上一切守护的绣球花、扭曲世界中倔强绽放的水仙花、背负沉重命运的常青藤以及向往平凡生活的银莲花，她们各自的终局将由你见证，你的选择将导向不同结局。
让五朵郁娇花朵获得幸福……但这一切真的……是的幸福吗？
经历这些故事，你将获得世界的碎片，当集齐这些碎片后，你将面对的是……

【角色介绍】

「茉莉」
这个永远都是活力十足元气满满的少女，向你发起了猛烈进攻。
但在她的心中却隐藏着无法窥探的深邃黑暗。
这份强烈而炙热的爱，或许只有一方的死亡才能将其熄灭……
让挚爱之花在这里盛开吧！


「美穗实」
这个永远都是天真烂漫惹人怜爱的少女，你发誓会保护她的一切。
但在这双纯真的眼瞳之中却隐藏着撕心裂肺的永恒创伤。
所谓的守护是一份双向的誓约，或许只有一方的背离才能将其击碎……
让剧毒之花在这里盛开吧！


「亚梦」
这个永远都是追逐梦想才华横溢的美女，你认为自己会接纳她的一切。
但这份愚不可及的傲慢会让人在迷茫中迎来最终的毁灭。
可笑的贪婪与无休止的探求心，或许只有被无尽的悔恨填满时才能获得满足……
让猎奇之花在这里盛开吧！


「萌子」
这个永远都是缩在壳里隐藏自身的可怜少女，对你苦苦追求。
但妄想在这个混乱的时代追寻渺茫的幻想与平静的生活真的能被允许吗？
背负着伟大宿命将见证一切的终焉，或许只有在时间的尽头才能实现自己的愿望……
让幸福之花在这里盛开吧！


「宁宁音」
这个永远都是受神宠爱完美无瑕的少女，你想带着她逃离。
但拥有人人羡慕的权利、财富与美貌又怎么可能轻易的全身而退？
也许一切都只是神明的一个玩笑，或许只有在梦境中才能获得幸福与宁静……
让绝望之花在这里盛开吧！

【游戏特色】
通关5条故事线并收集碎片后解锁最终结局
完整通关需4-5个小时
豪华声优带来的全语音体验
完全重置的细腻美术
充满冲击感的震撼故事
完全重制为您带来复活的「强烈残酷的不讲道理的世界」

1802080.name: SGS Operation Hawaii
1802080.about_the_game:
Operation Hawaii

Everyone knows the story of the Japanese surprise attack on the US naval, land and air bases at Pearl Harbor and nearby on the morning of December 7th, 1941. The date marks the entrance of the United States in the Second World War. In the hours that followed the initial attack, there were fears and speculation that it would be followed by an enemy amphibious landing and invasion of Oahu. The eventuality of such an assault had indeed been studied by the Imperial Japanese Navy and rejected as logistically unfeasible. But what-if the case has been different?


This game studies a possible land invasion of Oahu, by a small but well-trained force of Japanese Marines and Army troops, specially trained for the operation and secretly carried to destination in the attack force.
Key decisions as to what the goal of the operation was, where the troops would land, and how long it would last were taken in an ambitious plan. The attack force could not supply or sustain the effort too long, a maximum of 3 or 4 days, so the objective was to wreck as much damage and destruction to the military installations, so that the effects of the air strike would be comforted by the devastation laid on the US ground structures.

Can you, as the commander of the Japanese land force, choose the right place to invade, and then conquer and destroy as much as you can in the allotted time? And, as the surprised American commander of Oahu’s defense, can you block the invader, save the base and possibility turn a disaster into a victory?

The game offers to both side an array of different starting options, each at a cost in victory points. The other side will not be aware of your choice, thereby creating new situations at each start of the game.

  • As the Japanese, the crucial choice is that of the landing site. Close to Pearl Harbor, but under coastal batteries fire. Or north of the island, safe from damage and defense but far away. Or on the eastern shore, a possible good compromise between distance and difficulty. Will you send some surprise group to assault a fort? Or carry with you some artillery? Or let the fleet close in to get some extra gunfire support from the battleships?
  • As the American, can you just stay put, as historically and see what unfolds? Or will you invest in stronger defenses and minefields, or create some quick reaction battlegroups to repel the invaders? Or obtain from the War Department more material, and in particular a better air force component? Will all these be enough?

All those options and gambles are yours to discover. The game's event and cards allow full replay ability thanks to the numerous various situations that they create.

Estimated Playtime: 2h00+.
Favored Side: Japanese.
Hardest to Play: Americans.

1802100.name: Sanity City
1802100.about_the_game:
>> Virtual Reality Avatar Multiplayer Raids
Put on your VR headset and customize your body.
Start your new life in a futuristic cyber world.
Team up with your friends and go on a raid.
Acquire money, equipment and fame.

>> Leave your mark in Sanity City
Explore the urban canyons of your hood in Sanity City.
Browse stores of all kinds along the streets.

Find the next client who will send you on a lucrative mission.
Assemble a team and make sure everyone comes back alive.

Guns and crime rule the streets in the outer districts of Sanity City.
You've become a raider striving for fame and money.
A mercenary for crime syndicates, shady corporations and anyone else who'll pay you.
State-of-the-art gear is expensive and the only way to survive in this high-tech, cut-throat environment.
You will require all the firepower you can muster, but occasionally sneak and hack your way into buildings.

>> Rumors
Someone - something? - is shaking the established order of the criminal underground.
Prominent teams of raiders are taken out one by one.
Survivors are rare, and they tell incredible stories of a single fighter, lightning fast and seemingly invincible.
You don't believe in fairy tales of losers. Nothing exists that can not be killed.
But what if there is something to the rumors about the H.E.R.O.S. project after all?
That secret gear could give you godlike powers and make you king of the underworld in no time...

>> The late 2030s
Sanity City is the Utopian experiment amidst a world of chaos, a shimmering sign of hope for mankind.
During the "turbulent twenties", a decade of global disorder, this ever growing giga-metropolis was designated as a neutral, supranational zone by the remaining nations of the world.
Governed by a highly advanced AI, this is a place where all people are equal. A place for all people to prosper. And a safe harbor for every sane person fleeing from madness, war and disaster. It is a place where all your past sins are forgiven…
So they say.

Scorpion will patrol each island making sure that their plans stay intact. You may hear an ominous sound around New Scorpion Island, one of the newer islands that make up Scorpion Islands! Scorpion is using the rare resources of this massive volcano to produce chemicals and materials for their destructive goals of world domination and to spread fear across the globe.

It's up to you to save the world! You start with a capable helicopter and the finest aircraft carrier for supplies and safety. Your mission is to destroy all of Scorpion's key factories and nuclear weapons before they launch their nuclear strike. Each factory can be repaired after taking damage so make sure you finish bombing it once you start. 1802190.name: Puzzles For Clef
1802190.about_the_game:
Puzzles for Clef is a relaxing adventure game focused on the eponymous heroine. Following a letter from her sister, Cres, our bunny friend Clef journeys to the island of her ancestors, to undertake a treasure hunt... The journey will take her across a land of beauty, magic, and mystery, as she explores each of the island’s regions, solves its countless puzzles, unearths long-forgotten secrets, and rediscovers her family’s legacy.

The treasure hunt is a birthday gift from one sister to another. It’s an invitation to a world full of magic and mystery!

  • Visit nine distinct regions, from a serene bamboo forest to an opulent floating castle.

  • Each region has its own, distinct feel and secrets to discover!

  • Every puzzle found in each zone aims to challenge your wit!

It’s not just Clef and Cres on the island. Many people make their home there, with personal quests they can share with Clef.

  • Meet the Lord of the island and his associates!

  • Many have memorable quests for Clef to accomplish.

  • Find a variety of items dear to the locals throughout Clef’s travels.

The journey to give the bells back their voice is not a linear one. Clef will need your help.

  • Dozens of puzzles and ciphers await to be solved.
