  • No pixel hunts or moon logic: every task is meant to be challenging yet relaxing, not frustrating!

The floating island is a place of mystery, wonder, and endless secrets.

  • With each completion of the treasure hunt steps, secrets of the ancient island will slowly be revealed!

  • Every secret might answer a question - but also unlock even more puzzles to complete.

  • Discover the history of the island and Clef’s ancestry.

By the way, don’t worry about monsters or dangers. Cres would never put her sister’s life in danger.

  • Clef is free to explore and experience the island at her leisure, breaks encouraged!

  • Fret not about death or danger or recycled enemy types.

In an expedition to the ruins of a forgotten civilization, Dr. Valentine and Engineer Agnis discover an Ancient Artifact that is the container of great source of energy. Thanks to this discovery, Valentine And Agnis used the Artifact to create new technologies to improve humanity.

But a Phantom from the past started to move again and generate chaos in the World. From this chaos came a faction that wanted to weaponize the Artifact - the Ocular Force.

1802330.name: INVITATION To FEAR
1802330.about_the_game:
『INVITATION To FEAR』 is a survival horror game for 1 to 4 players.
After receiving one of the invitations, you will wake up in an unfamiliar place.
Before long, you will realize that a terrifying creature is wandering around the building. Don't let "her" find you.

You will need to run, hide, and utilize items in the area in order to survive.
Don't think about defeating the monster head on. Look for the cursed statues scattered around the area. Destroying the cursed statues will lead to your victory.

Features

  • Online co-op play with 1 to 4 players
    You can also play with your friends or play alone.
    If you feel uneasy on your own, you can also send an invitation to your friends. You can even overcome your fears with your friends.
  • Single play mode
    Only you and the monster are in the field. It doesn't get in the way of anyone.
  • Different play experience each time
    Useful items to protect yourself are randomly placed each time.
    Sometimes it's a good item, sometimes it's a bad item. Please use properly according to the situation.
  • Enemies with Abilities
    The enemy will use your abilities to deceive you.
    If the enemy's location changes instantly, it's probably their ability.
  • Be careful of the sound
    Sound is important. You can detect approaching enemies by sound, but you can also attract them by the sound of your own footsteps or the sound of traps operating.
  • Difficulty change
    The movement of the enemy changes depending on the difficulty level. I'm sure it will increase your fear.

Attention

This game contains flashing lights, which may make it unsuitable for people with epilepsy who are sensitive to light. Please be careful of all players.

1802370.name: Dang Darn Island
1802370.about_the_game:
You’ve finally found the mysterious Dang Darn Island! Now the only thing standing between you and the legendary Gold Idol is an ancient temple filled with slithering snakes, pointy spikes, flamethrowers, poison darts, and a grumpy volcano who just might lose his cool at any moment. 

Piece of cake, right?

Search The Island!

Smash pots, unlock chests, and leave no stone unturned in your hunt for valuable items, treasure, and clues.

Dodge Traps!

There are more than a few ways to get caught off guard in this labyrinth of doom. Watch your step and keep your eyes peeled for danger.

Appease The Volcano!

Better stay on Paul Cano’s good side or things will heat up quickly. An offering or two…or three…might help.

Collect Treasure!

The Gold Idol may be your ultimate prize, but don’t forget to grab all the coins you can along the way.

Invite Your Pals!

It’s rough out there for a lonely adventurer. Invite some friends for online or local split screen multiplayer.

1802420.name: Deadwater Saloon Prologue
1802420.about_the_game:
Deadwater Saloon Prologue

This is a free introductory version of the full-game Deadwater Saloon. Play the first month-and-a-half of the in-game time, build your saloon, and watch and interact with the town as it starts to grow.

Create Your Character

Playing as a rich and dynamic character in the old west, you will be able to fully customize your attributes to fit your playstyle, such as Mixology, Seduction, and Sneakiness. You will manage your life as well as your saloon, such as maintaining your reputation and getting married. You will struggle with the effects of disease, aging, sanity, and addictions.

Form Relationships

Provide travellers with a distinct drink parlour, gaining legendary stories to regale and build your legend. Interact with townspeople as they populate the town, forging friendships with blacksmiths, sheriffs, and preachers, romance prospective partners, or blackmail, abduct, and murder those who threaten you.

Build

Build your saloon from the ground up. Expand the walls, build bordellos, opium dens, high stakes gambling rooms, and railed porches. Buy and place spittoons, tables, chairs, handcrafted bars, pianos, chandeliers, and diamond dust mirrors.

Manage

Thrive within a complex economy system, stockpiling booze, food, guns, and opium. Research a diverse array of drinks and foods to serve customers. Hire and manage staff from within the town populace, including barkeeps, cooks, servers, prostitutes, croupiers, pianists and bouncers. Help them reach their full potential, or fire and replace them with those more skilled.

Exist Within A Town

Start with a strip of land and watch as a western town builds up around you, bringing in a myriad of citizens and businesses.

Hundreds Of Events

Face the forces of nature, meddlesome customers, firebrand Preachers, rival outlaw gangs, and much more. At some point, you will be tested by stronger and more formidable nemesis in longer event chains. Whatever you choose, you will face the consequences of your choices. The frontier is an unforgiving place.

1802520.name: Snow Scout
1802520.about_the_game:
"A snowy VR counterpart to Firewatch" - 4players.de

In this exploration adventure on skis you take a well-deserved time out. After everything that happened recently, you figure you really need to take a break and get away from it all. You sign up for a volunteer job with the Snow Scouts, a non-profit organisation that runs some ski resorts high in the mountains. You will be responsible for fixing up an entire valley all by yourself, only being guided by your supervisor via radio. You'll try out and open all the different ski slopes, test the snow cover for any avalanche risk, and if need be, set off a calculated avalanche to ensure safety for others. You'll even come across some rare alpine birds, get a chance to open new paths and get to know your supervisor - and maybe even yourself - a little better through radio conversations. Up here in this pristine mountain environment, with you all alone in nature, nothing can go wrong. Or can it?




FEATURES:

  • Move through a remote alpine valley using an immersive skiing simulation in virtual reality
  • Descent-style skiing as well as cross-country skiing
  • Play in sportsy standing mode and burn up to 400 calories an hour (according to YUR.fit Steam integration) or try the new, relaxed seated mode
  • Complete adventure and job-simulator like tasks based on real-life ski patrols
  • Ride 21 different ski slopes and compete in their online leaderboards
  • Build a relationship with your handler, whom you communicate with via radio
  • Engage in several kinds of optional side tasks
  • Relax in your ski hut after a hard day of work
  • Collect a variety of different Steam achievements
  • Over 2 hours of recorded dialogue, with more to come
  • Contains an unreleased 50-minute documentary about the Serengeti in Africa

Play as Penelope, an abandoned pet rat, who uses her unique sense of smell to navigate the pitfalls of a post apocalyptic city. 1802670.name: Mourn-born
1802670.about_the_game:
Humanoid abominations are taking over a colony on a faraway planet. Are they mutants? Are they genetically modified experiments? Are they victims of a disease? Whatever their mysterious origins are, they are hostile.

•Horde combat:

Destroy varying abominations in strategic order. You are fast and agile, but the strength required to swing your heavy sword leaves you immobile when attacking. Time your attacks carefully to prevent being overwhelmed and cornered.

•Body customization:

Replace body parts with cybernetic implants and enhanced, lab-grown organs to gain special abilities.

•Weapon customization:

Perform four different attacks, which are determined by the way you build your sword.

•Dynamic enemies:

The commonly-encountered base breeds of abominations have set behaviors you can study, but as the game progresses, they gain the ability to merge, birthing horrifying monsters with inherited and enhanced strengths.

•Campaign:

There is a short linear storyline in the start of the game, which serves as an introduction to the world and character objectives. It consists of speaking with characters (no dialogue options; you press a button to get the next line), the player character commenting and speaking outside of conversations (text above the head), memories, item descriptions, and unlockable lore.

A final boss marks the end of the game, with an optional new game plus afterwards. The new game plus makes combat more challenging, but doesn't make changes to the story.

•Setting:

Armed with a strange sword, an unannounced colony guest just joined one of the security teams. Together, they are rescueing survivors. Let's hope the evacuation vessels arrive soon... because something else is also coming.

1802700.name: I Told You So!

This is a short, comedic visual novel spinoff to "Heart of the Woods." Contains spoilers for the base game, so please play the original game first!

"I Told You So!" is the name of Tara Bryck's paranormal investigation webshow, after renaming her hit series "Taranormal." Join Tara and her co-host/girlfriend, Morgan Fischer, as they unravel the mysteries of the supernatural.

ITYS consists of several short, dubiously-canon episodes, with more added every now and then. Many episodes are fully voiced by the original voice cast.



Look. I get it. It's hard to accept the truth of the paranormal nature of the world, especially when it's been right under your nose for years. What a fool I am, you think. How could I have doubted her, when week after week she would present such irrefutable evidence of the existence the strange and the occult? Well, I'm here to tell you that you should ABSOLUTELY feel this way, because I TOLD YOU SO!

That's right! It's Tara here, the world's first ACTUAL! PROVEN! PARANORMAL INVESTIGATOR! WHO FOUND REAL THINGS! AND GOT IT ALL ON TAPE!

Things are gonna change around here. I got big plans, and I can't do them alone, and I'm sure you've already seen my kick-ass new logo so you know there's a new face here on the set of the webshow that changed the world. Watch out!!!! IT'S GONNA BE SO COOL!!!!!!!

1802850.name: Yes My Lord
1802850.about_the_game:
Yes my Lord is an RPG developed by Doubles Core, and published by OTAKU Plan.

STORY

The protagonist was once a famous genius, but now he is poor.
Addicted to alcohol every day, he only complains about his past glory and persecution due to jealousy, so that people around him laughed at him as a "bragging scholar".
One day, he woke up drunk and found himself in an underground cemetery with demons wandering around.
The mysterious girl "Foxy" who met in the cemetery taught him the necromancer magic.
At the same time, he met the undead girl "Kagaribi" who called him master and loyal to him.
A frustrated Ex-genius, an indifferent immortal girl.
Master and servant, owner and tool.
In the constant day and night, the relationship between the two seems to have gradually changed.
With the lost past of Kagalibi and the real purpose of Foxy gradually revealed, the ending of the two has moved towards an unpredictable future.

FEATURES

○Plot
A passionate pure love story.
There are four endings.

○Combat
Based on the turn system of traditional Japanese RPG, the combined skill setting is added.

○Growth system
Attributes grow through battles.
When encountering a strong enemy, you have the opportunity to gain the ability to surpass your opponent and turn the world around.
You can gain soul value after defeating the enemy. Consuming soul can acquire or strengthen skills.
The skills that can be learned will be gradually lifted as the story progresses, and the heroine will get new clothes.

○Equipment
Gems dropped by enemies can not only increase basic attributes, but also may even have a special effect of HP continuous recovery or increasing damage to certain enemies.
Equip it smartly and build your own strategy.

1802880.name: The Devil Within: Satgat
1802880.about_the_game:
THE NIGHTMARE BEGINS

An enormous spiked tower of mysterious origins suddenly appears in the land of Joseon.

The Pure White Oil that oozed from the Radiant Spire instantly revitalized the drying land of Joseon, providing the catalyst for dazzling technological advancements including Dimensional Gates. However, the Royal Court of Joseon yearned for more and continued their reckless research to further harness the power of the Radiant Spire. In the end, they made a dreadful mistake, summoning hellish demons to ravage this land...

TRUST ONLY YOUR SWORDSMANSHIP

In a world decimated by destruction, the majority of its inhabitants have long since been corrupted into demons and roam aimlessly.

With just a sword in hand, assume the role of Kim Rip and cut down the numerous demons that threaten both you and the world at large. Employ the power of the demon that resides within you to break past your limits and utterly shatter your foes.

One thing is for certain: your blade is needed to navigate this desolate world.

FIGHT FIERCE BATTLES

The fate of the world rests on your shoulders as you face off against hordes of malevolent demons. Make full use of your combat prowess, train your body, and execute strategies to eliminating the mighty demons that stand in your way.


Master an array of advanced offensive, defensive, and mobility skills to vanquish the powerful adversaries and rescue a shattered world.

EMBRACE THE POWER OF DEMONS

As you advance through this world, a somber revelation dawns upon you: to defeat the demons, you must become a demon yourself.

With the special abilities granted to you by the demon, eliminate powerful demons lurking in each region to grow stronger and make their power your own. Venture deeper into uncharted territories to uncover clues that will aid you in mastering the demonic power that grows within you.

DISCOVER THE SECRETS OF A DARK WORLD

Due to the influence of the spike, mysterious artifacts have regained their lost powers and have appeared in various regions, waiting for a new owner to utilize them. Whether you decide to seek them out or continue on your way is a decision only you can make.

However, if you become their master, they can provide powers that will allow you to break your limits and make your journey easier. Exercise caution in your search for these potent relics... the search can have some deadly risks.

VAST INTERCONNECTED WORLD

Embark on an epic journey through a meticulously interwoven world, comprising a varied landscape that includes desolate cities, rugged peaks, dense forests, military complexes, and other locales. Certain routes may be obstructed until you have honed your skills and gained the necessary strength. Slay formidable adversaries to survive in this perilous world. Thoroughly scour each location to uncover enhancements and skills that will empower you for the daunting trials that await.

1802900.name: First Light
1802900.about_the_game:
First Light is a first-person survival psychological horror game tinted with body horror, set in a remote cabin in the dead of winter. Explore the cabin and its surroundings, examining items and collecting cassettes to piece together events of the story. Told from two perspectives of the past and the present, you need to know both to survive the powerful forces hunting you.



Play as the SAR officer, Eli, sent to rescue a distress call sent three days ago. Live the past events as Ben, while his fiancee Julia searches for her grandfather, whom she hasn't heard from in weeks. Meanwhile, an ancient creature of famine and gluttony stalks silently in the wind and snow.

The fates of all involved unfold throughout the night, while Eli must prepare to escape at the first touch of dawn.



- Explore the cabin and its surroundings for clues.
- Collect cassettes to tell the story from another view.
- Outwit and outrun the creature hunting you.
- Survive until the first light of dawn.



First Light is heavily influenced by spooky greentext stories, innawoods happenings, and a lifetime of lore and love of creature features. A big special thanks to Chass and his curated content for the spark that led to the creation of the game. Please check him out if you like stories like this, or to get an idea of what First Light's roots are.

1803020.name: AgriLife
1803020.about_the_game:
Put your boots on, we're heading to the fields! Your job: managing farm plots to feed a village that grows surprisingly fast. Plow, seed and harvest your crops, but be careful: all your actions have a real impact on soil. You're going to need some patience and ingenuity to contend with the weather and seasons. Learn to master this interconnected and everchanging environment in a colorful and fantasy world.

You have time

In AgriLife, you decide when to move forward. Week after week, watch your crops grow until harvest. Satisfy their needs thanks to every tool at your disposal. When you've consumed all of your action points, move on to the next week and find out if your choices were the right ones.

A systemic environment…

Your tools allow you to tame nature. But don't forget it has its own rules: the soil is full of life and evolves turn after turn. The weather impacts the ground and varies with the seasons.You will have to analyze the type of land in the map's different regions, and understand how nutrients, humidity, and in the longer term erosion risks, are applicable there.

Your crops are at the center of this ecosystem, interacting with everything else: they draw the necessary resources from the soil, suffer the weather hazards and influence the nearby plants and the land in which they take root.
The needs and interactions are species-specific, and each species belongs to a family.

… and mouths to feed

Population is the crux of AgriLife. If its satisfaction falls to zero, it's over! In order to avoid that, keep an eye on food supplies by continuously selling your crops to the village. But the size of the village will increase at each turn and production will have to keep up! People will also ask for specific types of food. Fulfilling their demands - or not - is up to you.

Become a master farmer

The more the population grows, the more you have to produce. But fortunately, there are many elements to unlock throughout the game. Get new tools and unlock tips on how to use them. Expand your land with new plots to till. Unlock valuable strategy advice in the encyclopedia.

Permadeath

Mother Nature doesn't forgive mistakes easily. If you lose the game, you have to start again from the beginning! But don't panic, you keep everything you‘ve unlocked. You simply start over with new plots and the initial village, ready to go further than before.

It's your choice

The ability to start over again and again allows you to try any strategy you want, without any clear-cut path. But it's also a double-edged sword, because you're not safe from completely depleted soil or bankruptcy due to unnecessary purchases. You face nature alone, and it fights back. Keep your head high and you’ll soon become an amazing farmer!

An immersive sound universe

For the delight of your ears, soundscapes vary according to seasons, weather and time of day. The musical themes follow suit and dynamically adapt, in order to immerse you fully in the world of AgriLife.

1803110.name: ASCENDANT
1803110.about_the_game:
Welcome to ASCENDANT, where you, your squad of unlikely heroes, and four biocores are all that stand between survival and total annihilation.

ASCENDANT is capture-the-flag... on crack. After a thousand-year cryo-nap, you wake up to find the world’s gone to sh*t: mutant wildlife, rogue tech, and rival squads battling for biocores filled with amber that keep your Shade alive. The catch? Every match is different. Thanks to the virtual Game Director, biocore locations, available rooms, and wild events shift with every game, forcing you to adapt... or die. Four teams, four biocores… you do the math.

Every decision matters. Spend power wisely - your team’s collective pool grows as you fight mutant creatures, and how you use it can mean the difference between victory and a humiliating respawn. Unlock weapons and items mid-match to outsmart your enemies. Whether you’re upgrading your gear, setting traps, or going full kamikaze, victory comes down to one thing: adapting fast - because the map’s out to ruin your best-laid plans.

No two matches are ever the same. Dynamic events, from sudden airstrikes to mutated mega-beasts, can flip the game on its head, ruining even the most carefully planned strategy. Lethal creatures and environmental hazards keep the stakes high and the chaos higher.

Build the gun the government warned you about. From grenade-launching sniper rifles to poison-spitting SMGs, ASCENDANT’s weapon customization offers 3 million mod combinations, letting you craft the ultimate overkill machine. But no matter how good your Franken-gun is, someone’s probably built something bigger, badder, and aimed it right at your head.

Fine-tune your character’s abilities and perks to suit your playstyle, whether you’re the ultimate biocore thief or the squad’s chaotic wildcard. Between matches, head to the social lobby, duel frenemies, or gear up for more mayhem. Or, if you’re craving an extra dose of carnage, enter the Thunderdome - a PvP arena where the only goal is to leave in one piece (and with bragging rights). 

It’s brutal. It’s BioPunk. It’s survival with zero hand-holding... but it does have an epic soundtrack ('Final Countdown' anyone?). ASCENDANT keeps the action unpredictable and the stakes as high as your blood pressure. Bring your wits, your best squad, and maybe a will. You’re going to need all three.

Experience a unique cinematic adventure where an animal truly grows up alongside you, bringing invaluable support during your journey through a world of wonder, challenge, and hope.

1803310.name: Incubus - A ghost-hunters tale
1803310.about_the_game:
Are ghosts real?

You are on your first solo ghost hunting case, under the watchful instructions of Bear and Jen from the O.P.G paranormal team. Use real gadgets in a real location, a house investigated by the game developers several times, on the request of three different owners. It is a case worthy of a video game, so welcome to Incubus.

Uncover the reason as to why this house is always empty. Is it cursed? Many have come and gone from the house, citing malevolent forces play within the empty rooms, a sinister hunched figure has been seen in the corner of the eye and the place is a hotspot for paranormal activity. Will you survive the night?

What makes a haunted house? It's no Dracula's Castle to look at, but neither is the house made famous by the Enfield Poltergeist or the scary monk that haunts the seemingly innocent looking 30 East Drive. Keep an open mind, investigate the house, and see and hear what ghosts may linger at 6 Dread Pit Road, in London's 'East End'.



To solve the mystery of 'House 6' you must keep your eyes and ears open, and learn how to use ghost-hunting gadgets to pinpoint activity. There have been many tenants who have lived in 'House 6', none stayed very long and few have anything good to say. Quite the opposite, for over the years 'House 6' has accumulated a lot of eye witness statements and terrified testimonials. Here are a few:

"Coming home, I could hear someone upstairs, an obvious intruder! I snuck next door and phoned the police, who arrived within the hour. By now lights had come on upstairs, as the burglars searched the place. The police had a look around, but found no-one. How's that possible?!!" K. Taylor, 2020

"I awoke in the night, unable to move. Someone was pinning me to the bed. It was dark, but there was a figure, on top of me, like a nightmare. I tried to scream, but nothing came out, just weird! It lasted for about 5 minutes!! I felt the weight on my chest. Then nothing. It was morning, but I know it wasn't a dream." E.Horton, 2007



"Yeah, that house!! I was supposed to decorate the place. Good money, should have been easy. But power issues, accidents, and Kenny falling off the ladder, none of that can be explained. It just isn't worth it. It's got something wrong with it. Bad energies." Chris, 2004

"No, it hasn't sold, but we are keen to make a sale soon. We've heard all the stories, urban legends, and the spooky stuff. It's all nonsense, and here at Hoxton's we don't hire ghost-hunters to help sell a house, and if we did, we certainly wouldn't talk about it." Hoxton's Real Estate Agent 2022



"It needs pulling down. There's something evil inside that house." Barry, 2022

"I saw it! The figure at the window. It was ages ago, but I definitely saw it. Nasty eyes, they seem to catch the light, piercing horrible eyes, staring back at me. Some of us locals say it's the Devil. I've never passed that house since that day. People should stay away." Gary, 1998



"We all witnessed the 'thing'. Hunched, hairy, snarling. It wasn't a person, no way, it moved too quick, and it stank, like wet dog. A dead wet dog! No, there was nothing human about it. We all saw it, and then it disappeared. We didn't wait to see if it came back." Sarah, 1987



Features:
  • A real haunted house, captured in detailed 360 views.
  • Full 360 exploration and soundtrack recorded on location.
  • Interact with ghost-hunting gadgets to investigate.
  • Encounter real-world paranormal activity based on witness statements.
  • Puzzles and ghost identification.
  • Experience a haunting based on eye witness accounts.
  • Completely AI driven phenomena, the ghosts are aware!
  • A complete story, with a satisfying conclusion.

1803410.name: Checkmate Showdown
1803410.about_the_game:
Enter the ultimate arena of cerebral combat, where strategic thinking meets explosive fighting action! In this adrenaline-fueled online multiplayer game, you'll challenge other players to intense battles that fuse the classic game of Chess with heart-pounding fighting game mechanics.

With lightning-fast reflexes and an eagle-eye for strategy, you'll need to outsmart your opponents on the chessboard while unleashing devastating combos and special moves in the arena. Master the roster of fighters, each with their own unique fighting styles and chess piece abilities, all based on traditional fighting game archetypes (zoner, grappler, rushdown, etc).

Are you ready to become the Checkmate Showdown Grandmaster?

The Chess and fighting parts are intimately linked by design; once a piece attacks the opponent, a fight is engaged. The attacker and defender will be able to make use of tag-assist by other pieces in proximity, and the attacker will have an advantage by having their Ultimate ready to rip from the get-go.

Built with the diversity of gamers in mind, Checkmate Showdown will let newcomers have a good time with an approachable control scheme but will feature all of the depth and precision expected by professional FGC players. Easy to pickup, hard to master.

True Test of Strategy & Skill

Checkmate Showdown will require a broad set of skills to become the best. Learn strategies for the board and elaborate combos in fights to make your way to the top. You will have to master every chess piece's skillset to truly become a master!

Tactical Decision-making

Your board placement is KEY for a strong endgame. By strategically placing your pieces on the board, you could benefit both from attackers advantage AND tag-assist(s), depending on how many pieces are within their movement range to support your square. As each chess piece corresponds to a fighting game archetype, the choice of attacking with one or the other will be crucial.

Strong Competition System

Checkmate Showdown is created by a team of hardcore fighting game enthusiasts who understand the importance of competition in fighting games. The game aims to feature the most up-to-date matchmaking technology and balancing to allow for friendly (or not) competition.

Community-driven Development

Based in the heart of Montreal, the development team thrives from its proximity to the local fighting game community. The game is made by fighting game enthusiasts for fighting game enthusiasts. Transparency in how we move forward is key to making this a community-built game. Whatever idea you have to help improve the game, we're ready to listen.

  • Does the game use rollback netcode?
    We built the game using rollback netcode from the get go - we know how important that is and some of us are hardcore fighting game fans so it wasnt even a question.

  • I'm a hardcore fighting game enthusiast, will this game have all the bells and whistles?
    Yes. Checkmate Showdown is made by a team comprising expert FGC players. Expect mixups, traditional strike-defense-throw triad, specials, cancels, combo breakers, guard break, etc.

  • I'm a newcomer to fighting games, but I love Chess. Will I still be able to play?
    Yes! We designed Checkmate Showdown with an 'easy to learn, hard to master' philosophy. Button-mashers will be able to look good on-screen, while pros will find every bit of nuance they could want.

  • Are experienced Chess or fighting game players advantaged?
    While traditional Chess strategies or massive fighting game skills will definitely shine in competitive rankings, one isn't advantaged over the other. An expert Chess player might get to your King fast, but they will have to use different strategies to truly master the game. Fighting game pros could just as well be taken off-guard by Chess-savvy opponents attacking them with an unexpected move, forcing them to use an already damaged piece in a tough fight.

1803530.name: 经典象棋

In addition to the actual combat, the game also provides more than 100 popular folk classic chess scores for you to learn and study, you can automatically play on the board (non-video) or manually watch each step of the chess score. Finally, the game also offers hundreds of chess scraps from simple to complex to wait for you to crack. Believe that through the training of this game, your chess level will be rapid progress! The game uses a points system, and automatically counts the player's game data, including the number of general administration, win-loss number and win-win ratio. 1803550.name: MegaFactory Titan
1803550.about_the_game:
The untouched shores of Saturn's moon Titan yearn for exploitation.

Today, we land on Titan. We can strip mine its precious minerals, manufacture valuable goods to ship off-world, or even sell them to the colonists who are sure to arrive soon after you. And how better to survive Titan's brutal climate than with a sprawling factory to produce everything we need?

And those so-called settlers who claim they were there first? Nonsense. We will be the first, and any who say otherwise are merely pirates and scavengers, soon to fall under the tanks and jets and space warships we manufacture. Will you lead your corporation to claim all of Titan?

Build a factory in seconds, or spend hours designing and optimizing for the perfect layout. Lay down a web of smart maglevs for your logistics. Or use a fleet of cargo trucks, or aircraft instead.

First you must produce enough air, food, and water for your workers to survive. Then, you must face a Crisis Engine which throws at you everything from devastating natural disasters to unrelenting pirate assaults!

What's the point of building a factory without turning a profit? Trade raw resources with settlers or build cities for governments for money. Or sell weapons to rebels or nukes to terrorists to fund your factory!

War and Peace

The more money you make, the more you will attract the attention of Pirates and Scavengers eager to steal your hard earned resources. Set up missile turrets to destroy them as they sneak into your factory, or perhaps simply pay them to look the other way. As you grow even larger, war between other factions may start to spill into your factory too!

Infinite Procedural World

Generate an infinite, procedural worlds in a single click, and explore it endlessly. Each time you play, the world is completely unique. Like the pirates who drive past your gun turrets, they never get old!

7 Unique Factions

Choose from 7 different factions, each with a different playstyle. Try a vehicle-focused faction that starts with cargo speeders to race your goods around. Or perhaps a maglev-heavy faction, with a focus on limitless spaghetti. Or try a faction that starts with rockets from the get go, that can deliver resources to and from space at ease!

Climate Dynamics

Titan's unique atmosphere produces complex wind and weather patterns. As you smelt raw ores, your waste heat and pollution will also heavily affect the climate and wind. A clever engineer can even exploit these heating patterns to generate power from the resulting wind and pollution.

Smart Logistics

No more mindless conveyor belts that get backed up and cause mistakes. Your Maglev Tubes know where to send goods and exactly what quantity is requested, sort across junctions automatically, and handle loops smartly.

Faction Relations

Trade, negotiate, or go to war with over a dozen Allied, Neutral, and Enemy factions also settled on Titan.

Varying Difficulty Levels

Play a casual, relaxing game in a sandbox mode without enemies or challenges, or test your mettle with a brutal, unforgiving gameplay. You can also fully customize all difficulty settings!

Mod Support

Use community-made Build Templates from Steam Workshop, or upload your own. You can also easily make and upload mods directly to Steam Workshop for others to try!

In Windmills you play as the last Crimson Cape, a witch - hunter, on his quest to find his missing father. In this combat - focused metroidvania you will face dangerous monsters and devious wizards that will put your skills to the test. You will unlock new abilities that will help you traverse the world and you will absorb the powers of your enemies, allowing you to use them instead. The story unfolds in a unique way, based on the way you progress through the game. Depending on your actions, areas and enemies can change because the narrator will remember things differently, making each narrative unique. Because what is more important, if the windmills were giants or if the story was worth telling?







The combat system is based on suppressing, deflecting, dodging and parrying. As you progress through the story, more mechanics are unlocked, giving you more options for combat and exploration.


A big part of the mechanics are the reversals. Deflecting at the right time or parrying projectile spells, gives the player extraordinary abilities for a small amount of time. For example you can parry a lightning spell and charge your next attack with the element of lightning.

Restore the magical portals that connect the different areas of the kingdom and see the story to its conclusion, through the eyes of an unreliable narrator.

1804370.name: Airball
1804370.about_the_game:
You play the part of ‘Airball’ as an evil wizard has turned you into a bouncing ball of air with a slow leak! The only way to break the spell is to find the various ingredients and the spell book to break the magic curse!

Work your way through the hundreds of levels of isometric rooms on your quest. Remember on each level if you stay on an ‘inflating station’ for too long it will cause you to burst! You can monitor your air level with the onscreen gauge.

Using the directional controls and the jump button, jump across gaps and weave through obstacles.

Get points by gathering gems during your quest, and ascend stairs by jumping, but watch out for the spikes and other hazards which will burst you!

For some levels you will need to obtain special items to proceed such as candles for dark rooms, but don’t forget you are always up against the clock as you are slowing deflating, so also keep a look out for the random pumps to inflate you and buy you more time but without over pressurising and bursting yourself!

Will you find the ingredients and use the spell book to lift the curse and save yourself before time runs out! Good luck Airball!

History


Originally released in 1987 across multiple formats including MS-DOS, Amiga, Atari and others. This version is the MS-DOS version.

1804440.about_the_game:
Embody a pirate in Trails of Gold Privateers. Sail through waters occupied by mythical creatures and collect as much treasures as possible to become a true legend of the seas !

Trails of Gold is a VR experience that can be played both solo or with 3 friends. Its arcade-oriented gameplay allows you to replay the missions, while discovering more of the game world and gathering treasures to unlock cosmetics for your pirate!

Features

1804470.name: Duel Corp.
1804470.about_the_game:
A Souls-inspired action RPG set in a sandbox open world with an MMO feel and challenging directional combat. Play solo or with up to 3 friends in co-op. Build friendships, master an unrestricted class system, and uncover the cause that darkened all eyes.

Story

The story is not told in a linear fashion. Instead, you experience it naturally as you explore the world, interact with factions, and discover their secrets.

The main plot revolves around an event that darkened everyone's eyes. This event had two far-reaching consequences: it gave all living beings a cursed immortality and resurrected the dead as soulless beings.

As a result, the world fragmented into factions, each with its own ideology on how to deal with this new reality.

Some seek to restore the natural order at any cost. Others believe this state of affairs is a form of evolution or a blessing, but now struggle to control the relentless threat posed by the soulless. Still others seek a way to coexist with or even control the soulless, viewing them as a resource rather than an abomination.

Key Features

  • Character Customization: Use a character editor to customize your avatar's appearance to your liking.

  • Unrestricted Class Sytem: Craft a deep, fully customizable class using a wide variety of weapons, armor, abilities, and talents tailored to your playstyle. A stealthy rogue wielding a great axe and hurling fireballs, anything is possible.

  • Direction-based Combat: Engage in intense, challenging, and fluid directional combat scenarios.

  • Story: The story is not told in a linear fashion. Instead, you experience it naturally as you explore the world, interact with factions, and discover their secrets.

  • MMO Feel: Discover a lively world with MMO feel, where you can meet and interact with other players.

  • Singleplayer: Play solo with up to three companions or in co-op mode with up to four players. Build friendships with your companions, customize their equipment and skills, and tailor their playstyle to suit your strategy.

  • Multiplayer: Easily participate in co-op quests for up to four players or competitive PvP battles (1v1 and 2v2). The matchmaking feature lets you jump right into the action.

  • Shape the Open-World Sandbox: Shape the world through your actions by intercepting caravans to weaken villages, exploiting conflicts between rival factions, and conquering villages and cities to take control and collect taxes.

  • Procedural Encounters: Discover varied, procedurally generated encounters full of secrets, unique items, allies, and challenges. Find your own way to overcome obstacles by creatively using the skills you've acquired.

  • Retro meets modern gaming: Step into a unique pixel-art retro fantasy environment with 2D HD textures in modern and never-before-seen graphics full of surprises, twisted monsters and deadly bosses.

1804500.name: Z-Collapse
1804500.about_the_game:
THEY ARE RISING

Deep within a body, a new virus is born, and it is ready to change the world for the worst. It annihilates its bearer and transforms it. Not yet alive and yet not quite dead, the senseless body answers to a calling, a thirst for blood and flesh.

The dreaded zombies have arrived. They spread, bringing mankind's downfall with them. With rumours and videos on social media, it is no longer possible to remain blind to the problem.





Unlike most other zombie culture stories, Z-Collapse emphasizes the early stages of the pandemic. How will world leaders try to limit contagion, avoid panic, manage refugees, combat hordes, or simply avoid their downfall?

It is up to you to choose among 154 available countries, and answer those questions. Your country depends upon you to survive.

Z-Collapse offers a different rhythm than other strategy games. This is not a game about conquering the world, but a survival game. You will first have to tackle damage control, you will have to learn to take shots and yet stand up. After barricading yourself, and thanks to your planning and advanced technologies, you will be able to regain control of the situation.

FEATURES

  • 154 playable countries. Far from all being equals. The most resilient might not be the most obvious ones.
  • Resource management is necessary to the survival of your population, for base-building, and to develop an army. When they become scarce, you might have to start thinking about “borrowing” from your neighbors.



  • Bandits are rising in great numbers. Their ranks are growing strong with population panic. They will storm your facilities and will be a thorn in your thigh.



  • Refugee management from the exiled populations. You will be tasked to build refugee camps to house and protect the healthy. But do not forget they could just be extra mouths to feed.



  • Develop technologies to shape your country. Choose among multiple domains: military, economy, society, and science.



  • Apply political tactics: Diverting attention, mass screening, general mobilization, etc.



  • Mobilize your army to protect your territory, or to loot resources from your neighboring countries



  • Use Diplomacy and try to cooperate with other nations. Signing Non-aggression treaties, mutual support pacts, or trading resources



  • Use nuclear weapons to fight the invasion. But get ready to face the consequences...



  • Use special units to destabilize neighboring countries: agents to spread panic, or teams to infest new locations



  • Full multiplayer mode until 8 players in cooperation or PVP mode




As the game name has unexpectedly taken a strong symbolic meaning during the last months, I have to clarify that "Z-Collapse" has no relation at all with the current dramatic events in Ukraine (at least in my mind when I chose it, two years ago). The "Z" obviously stands for "Zombies", and the "Collapse" is the game theme. I also obviously hope that all what happening right there now will come to an end soon.

1804530.name: WeWereFriends
1804530.about_the_game:
The goal of We Were Friends is to find a way to have a good time with your friends while playing a video game.


WWF offers two game modes. A Battle Royal mode to finally know who is the best between you and your friends and a Prop Hunt mode to discover or rediscover the best of the caches. So far, only the Battle Royal works. You may select PropHunt in game but that will lead you to an empty map used for test.

Choose the skin that suits you best and invite your friends online!


The health crisis of covid-19 has shown us the importance of social links. The rise of multiplayer party games (Fall Guys, Among us, ... to name a few) has also shown that even if it was not always possible to see each other in person, multiplayer games were an opportunity to get together. The medium is only there to trigger funny or impressive situations on which players can bounce.

However, the genre is sorely lacking in shooting games. Here, We Were Friends brings together two of the most popular game modes of the moment to allow players to choose the atmosphere of their games!

Battle Royal mode :
Start this mode when at least two player are on the server. (Take care that the second player is set as "ready" in his status section (he must have clicked on "OK" when choosing his avatar)

Once players are all ready, the host have to start the game. That will teleport all the players in another map. There you will have a few seconds to wait (it's a security to allow all players in the lobby to join the new map). After 10 secondes, all players will be teleported to a spaceship. Then, all you have to do is jump from the spaceship, find a weapon and be the last standing. A safezone will reduce the map area though the game and water deals TONS of damage so be sure to avoid it. If you get killed by a player, you'll spectate him.

In the game, you may find Gravity guns, rail guns, assaultRifle, pistol, ...


Prop Hunt Mode :
So far the mode ISN'T IN THE GAME. More information coming soon...

The player has to fight zombies, monsters, ghosts and many other enemies, using different weapons that he will find in mystery boxes. The player must reach the highest round possible, but be careful because as higher is the level, more difficult will be to finish it .

1804580.name: Albert and Camille's Little Lille Adventure
1804580.about_the_game:
Albert and Camille’s Little Lille Adventure is an exploration game in which you navigate characters around the city of Little Lille in 1917. Players take the part of or heroes Albert Calmette and Camille Guérin and help them develop the life-saving BCG Vaccine.

It is a simple, 2d top-down adventure, exploration, and problem-solving game similar to classics such as Zelda. There are also elements of stealth as you avoid the guards like in the original run of Metal Gear. There is also a mini-game where you culture bacteria. This is a casual educational game and should only last around 10 minutes to play through.

Explore the city, work with the people of Little Lille, avoid the soldiers, and collect the necessary supplies Albert and Camille need to create the first vaccine to fight tuberculosis. As you progress, you will learn about the methods used to create BCG and how vaccines work.

Who are the games for?:
The game is totally free and can be played or downloaded by anyone with an internet connection. They are specifically targeted at 11 - 14 years old students and designed as a tool for teachers, researchers, and parents looking for a fun way to engage young people with the topics of immunology, vaccines and the history of science.

You can play the game in six languages - English, Chinese, French, Spanish, Hindi, and Portuguese.

treasure

About me and the game

1804610.name: Recollection
1804610.about_the_game:

1804620.name: Grim Road
1804620.about_the_game:
Grim Road is a roguelike with turn-based combat set in a hopeless dark world. The Sun has disappeared, and heroes have to travel through dying lands to slay Archdemons and get a chance for humanity to survive.

It's Gothic, it's Black&White, and has a lot of dithering.

It's all about managing squad members, spells pool, and energy levels.

Journey

Hunger is just one problem they have to deal with - as they have to make tough choices, their mental state and moral compass can be damaged or even broken. But as a guide with a purpose, you can use even this to your advantage, building a team of dark and corrupted half-humans.



Many mysterious inhabitants of the world can share stories or present... unique opportunities to your team.

Misery and failure awaits everyone who dares to walk the Grim Road. But also an eventual triumph and many new, different paths to take.

1804710.name: Spartan
1804710.about_the_game:
A Time Of Gods And Legends…

“Either come back with your shield, or on it.” – A Spartan Mother
Over 2000 years ago there was a city called Sparta. The city had only two purposes – to train for war and to fight the wars she trained for. Over time Sparta became renowned for having the strongest, fastest, bravest and most deadly fighters in the known world. They were the Spartiates and were feared by all. With these warriors Sparta carved out an Empire for itself –‘Lakedaimon’. However, it was soon to find that its reign was not to be unopposed and other great cities were rising to the fore; Athens, Thebes, Corinth, Macedonia and not to forget the threat from the east – the massive Persian Empire.

Spartan is an Empire building turn based strategy game, where the focus is on building an empire through diplomacy, trade, research, and war, but less focus on the battles than you would find in a real-time strategy game. It is designed for people who are interested in the period and those strategy gamers who prefer to have time to think about their decisions.

Can you unite Greece in time to defy the Great King and his mighty Persian Empire?

Designed by wargaming world champion Iain McNeil, Spartan is the prequel to Gates of Troy and part of Slitherine's critically acclaimed series of historically-detailed strategy games.

Spartan comes with three tutorial scenarios as well as a print-ready manual. TCP/IP support is included for multi-player games. Spartan can also be combined with Gates Of Troy scenarios and campaigns, allowing both sets of scenarios and campaigns to be played seamlessly with the Gates Of Troy engine.

1804720.name: Gates of Troy
1804720.about_the_game:
Designed by wargaming world champion Iain McNeil, Gates Of Troy™ is the Slitherine's critically acclaimed series of historically-detailed strategy games. Gates Of Troy™ offers both strategic campaigns and tactical battles. Lead your nation to victory in the ancient world's greatest battles! Capture the romance and adventure that lead over one hundred thousand Greek warriors to the far-flung shore of what is now modern day Turkey, to rescue Helen of Troy.

Control vast empires and fight epic battles in 3D. The 6 exciting campaigns include a recreation of the battle of Thermopylae on a 1 to 1 scale. Take the role of King Leonidas and lead 300 Spartans to immortality. Take control of one of the 19 heroes such as Odysseus, Paris, Hector, or even Achilles and his mighty Myrmidons. Use them tactically to boost the morale of your troops on the field and watch them cut a swathe through your enemies! Build great cities and structures like the Trojan Horse and though leadership, diplomacy, espionage, and the might of your army, write a new history for Greece.

Do you have what it takes to storm the Gates Of Troy? Gates Of Troy™ comes with three tutorial scenarios as well as a full e-book and print ready manual. TCP/IP support is included for multi-player games. Gates Of Troy™ also supports the previous Spartan™ scenarios and campaigns, which can be played seamlessly with the Gates Of Troy™ engine.

1804730.name: DEPRISION
1804730.about_the_game:
A CLASSIFIED EXPERIMENT

DEPRISION is a first-person survival horror game focused on psychological survival within a classified mind manipulation experiment. Trapped in a state of forced consciousness, your mind becomes the only means to move forward and endure.

DISTORTED MEMORIES

Explore environments built from personal memories and experiences, now altered and distorted. Familiar places become hostile spaces you must traverse carefully, paying attention to the surroundings and the threats that inhabit them.

PERSONAL THREATS

The threats you encounter are not foreign or impersonal. They are manifestations deeply tied to your past, designed to provoke emotional distress and constant tension. Your survival will depend on your ability to explore, manage limited resources, avoid danger, and make decisions under pressure.

PSYCHOLOGICAL SURVIVAL HORROR

DEPRISION opts for oppressive, narrative-driven, psychological horror, where atmosphere, sound, and uncertainty are just as important as what you see.

1804820.name: Guide and Throw
1804820.about_the_game:
Game Modes:
  • Over 30 levels where you must protect the magic ball until it reaches the portal.
  • Endless mode in which you must protect the magic ball for as long as possible in a procedurally generated environment.

Gameplay: Move the dots attached to the line using the mouse in order to reach the portal at the end of each level.Push the magic ball with either one of the dots or with the line that connects them by moving the dots towards it.

Challenges and Hazards
  • Collect bonus objects by throwing the magic ball at them.


  • The magic ball can be destroyed if it hits the bottom platform or if it is hit by a projectile.


  • Some areas can be accesed only if one of the dots pushes a button or if enough magic balls are collected in a designated area.


  • If the line intersects a platform its power will disappear and it will no longer be able to push the ball until it doesn't collide with a platform anymore.


  • In split-screen levels interact with the objects at the bottom in order to move the objects at the top.



  • Interact with the environment in order to trigger events.



  • Levels with mutiple lines where you have to move the lines such that the ball will bounce from one to another in order to move through areas that are inaccessible to either one of the lines.
  • Levels which have no magic ball. In these level you have to rely solely on your line to navigate the level however you may interact with other objects in order to reach the portal at the end.
  • Areas in which the line cannot move through but the ball can, so the ball needs to be thrown and reach another line or deactivate the line blocking zone in order to progress in the level.

1804870.name: Dungeon Masters
1804870.about_the_game:
Dungeon Masters is a skill-based dungeon crawler without any random based gameplay mechanics. You can master your favourite dungeon, learn patterns and get better and better by beating your personal records.

Features

  • Rewarding and fun Combat mechanics
  • Different enemy types that require specific strategies to defeat them
  • Built-in maps to beat and master time records
  • Level Editor that allows you to design your own Dungeons and Puzzles
  • Top-down 2D Gameplay with Retro pixel art aesthetics

"By coming here, you have hopes to become the Demon, a Dungeon Monk that slays these nasty and dangerous creatures that settled in these ruins a very long time ago. From now there is no going back." ~ Mirvodh

Puzzles & Traps

While exploring the dungeons, you may encounter numerous traps that will kill you immediately if you are not careful enough. There are also various ancient puzzles that will open additional passages for you if you manage to solve them.

Level Editor

The game includes a powerful in-game level editor using which you can create your own dungeons that will be a challenge by your rules. You can draw each block, design huge and complicated maps with different room configurations and prepare traps or puzzles that will work according to logic programmed by you!
Logic Editor is part of Level Editor and allows you to make connections between interactive blocks in a simple and fast way.
You can export your maps to files or import your friend's map file into your game and play it!

  • Player Levels: Download and play levels created by other players
  • Chill soundtrack by Muddasheep featuring KAON and Veven
  • Character art by Elhyana Guillaume

1804950.name: The Saragossa Manuscript
1804950.about_the_game:
Challenge strangers. Romance mysterious women. Disappoint parents. Die happy.


The Saragossa Manuscript spins an epic tale of love, duels and demonic influences,
reactively weaving stories around encountered NPCs and the heroes' fateful choices,
providing an RPG where the demands of honor, passion and family are at the forefront.

Once Upon a Time in Spain....


After opening a suspicious and picaresque manuscript You quickly find yourself lost in the Sierra Morena mountains of the XVIIIth century Spain - a land of heartache, castes and vanity.

The game is based on the many versions of the famous labyrinthine novel "The Saragossa Manuscript" by Count Jan Potocki, which he kept rewriting throughout his life. In the game you will be able to create your own "director's cut" of the tangled up storylines about cursed travelers who seek out new companions to help them fight of shadows.

On your journeys:


  • Enjoy epic adventures in a bright, swashbuckling setting
  • Lead three unique characters - hasty honorable soldier, shy son of a rich merchant and a thug with a heart of gold
  • Become true of heart, respectable or unstoppably quick-witted - manage the traits of your heroes
  • Face dilemmas that will alter your hero characters' honor codes
  • Cultivate NPC relationships in procedurally generated encounters
  • Easily switch between 3 characters on 3 different story planes
  • Travel Spanish landscapes listening to the radiant soundtrack by Thomas Regin

Alone in the dark


Enjoy the bright sun above while it lasts!
If you won't find a friendly soul before midnight - you'll get an unwanted visit,,,
It'll bring you "gifts" of degradation, madness, or of a hollow, unrelenting heart!

1804970.name: Crimson Waves on the Emerald Sea
1804970.about_the_game:
At the turn of the century, Victorian life carries on with one sharp difference from our world- vampires run amok and are a part of every day life. After having run away from home to search for his best friend, the young Cecil meets Nemo, a pickpocketing vagabond. The two set out together but in order to find what they're searching for, they must first unravel the truth behind a series of brutal vampire attacks from a decade prior.

Crimson Waves on the Emerald Sea is a Victorian-esque character drama visual novel revolving around 4 characters who become entangled in solving an unsolved massacre by a vampire.

Features:

  • A short and intriguing linear character drama set in Victorian times

  • Swapping perspectives between two main characters over 30 chapters

  • Custom watercolor-inspired graphics

1804980.name: Polyfury
1804980.about_the_game:
You thought geometry was difficult? Now it's got a gun!
Face the fury of the Seven Deadly Shapes and blast your way through a barrage of bullets and lasers in this highly accessible bullet hell.



Inspired by the likes of Tempest, Geometry Wars and Just Shapes & Beats, this modern shmup aims to strip back the complex, busy art style of classic shoot-em-ups. The minimalistic art style makes enemy bullet patterns much clearer and easier to focus on, if not easier to actually dodge 😉


🎯 Straightfoward shoot-em-up gameplay - shoot the evil shapes and don't get hit. Use the thumbstick/joystick to position yourself on the ring.

🔝 Leaderboards - compete for high scores and keep track of your own progress.

7️⃣ Hand crafted levels - you'll have plenty to do as the Seven Deadly Shapes use a vast arsenal to get rid of you.

❓ Multiple game modes - Want to take on the whole game at once, or practice a specific section?

🔸 Minimalist art style - a modern art style that's easy on the eyes and runs like a dream on all hardware.

🍕 Discord rewards - competitions, cheat codes, and prizes distributed via Discord!


This game is being made with accessibility at the front and centre:
  • Control your ship with a just a joystick and one optional "fire" button (or automatically fire your laser when you get hit)
  • Adjust the speed of the entire game to suit your reaction speed or the amount of challenge you're up for.
  • High contrast/red-green colourblind friendly by default, with a slew of vision aiding options to suit everyone.
  • Remappable controls

1805040.name: Implements of Hell
1805040.about_the_game:
WARNING:

Epileptic seizures associated with increased sensitivity to light are Possible. Some people may experience seizures when exposed to flashes of light and flashing images that appear in a video game. People who have not previously experienced such attacks may not be aware of their illness. A reasonable restriction of the game audience is recommended.


"Implements of Hell" is a first person psychological horror. The game takes place in 1910 in John's house.


Average time to complete the game: 90 minutes

Environment

The game is set in a realistic house from 1910, where certain unexpected events are continuously occurring. The player will proceed to uncover more of its secrets periodically as they explore it through. This will be an unsettling experience that is on the line between insanity and reality. Are you really alone or are there others out there?


Storyline

This house has a dark past, and an even darker present. Families were killed and sacrificed. Traces of a strange and disturbing cult is found. You will uncover the twisted truth and try to change the outcome. You will be met with a difficult situation where you interact with both our world and another. Death is not the end. Misery and pain are continual.


Gameplay

The player will need to solve puzzles that are extremely unconventional in nature and make difficult choices based on how much they are willing to risk.

1805070.name: Another Day in Paradise
1805070.about_the_game:
Play with 5 characters, find the clues and reveal the mystery of that October 24th.
You will explore the places and survive terrifying rituals, the astral world is waiting for you.
A story that mixes adventure and terror in equal parts.

THE GAME

In "Another Day in Paradise" you will find a third-person adventure where you will play with 5 characters to uncovering the mysterious events that took place that October 24th. For this you will have to explore the different places and collect the clues and valuable objects, which will help you to continue advancing in the story. You will obtain information through the cinematic sequences, the collectible audios in the form of cassettes and the notes (which you can access from your inventory).

THREE GAME SYSTEMS

The game system is developed in three sections, depending on the moment in which the events take place: In "Past" you will play with a more linear game system, with well-defined objectives and with abundant cinematic scenes ; in "Present" the system becomes more open and you will be able to explore with total freedom and add the survival factor; finally in "Future" we will see through a monitor, fragments that will reveal the final mystery about what happened that October 24th. These fragments will be collected throughout the game and are vital to understand the story.

IRREVERSIBLE DECISIONS

During certain points of the game we can decide between several options. These decisions will be irreversible in the short term and we will need to repeat the entire level to change them. It will depend on whether or not you find some of the valuable objects.

INNOVATIVE LEVEL OF DIFFICULTY

The difficulty is present in an innovative way during the levels of the "Present" section. We found three levels, labeled "Easy", "Medium", and "Hard" respectively. This means that you must play all of them (it is recommended sequentially way) if we want to complete the story.

With both the Expo and the city itself on the line, can you uncover who’s behind the dangerous attacks and stop them before it’s too late? 1805110.name: Solarpunk™
1805110.about_the_game:
Solarpunk is a survival game in a technically advanced world of floating islands. Alone or together with your friends, you can construct buildings, grow food, craft gadgets and explore distant islands with your own airship.

Use sunlight, wind and water to create an energy system and automate your processes like gathering resources and watering your plants.

🏠 Build freely

Design your dream home base with a wide range of materials and decorations. You’re free to build cozy spaces, add tiny details, and make your island feel just like home.

These buildings were crafted by our amazing community in the demo!

⚡ Energy system

Generate electricity using wind and solar energy. Weather conditions affect how much energy you produce, so you’ll need to plan ahead. Store energy in batteries and use wireless power to keep your base running smoothly.

👥 Multiplayer

Play solo or with friends. Everyone has their own inventory, and you can decide whether to build something together or create your own little corner in the sky.

🐷 Animals & Farming

In Solarpunk, you live in symbiosis with animals. There is no exploitation, only coexistence. Pigs, for example, will dig up truffles if treated well. Growing fruits and vegetables is your main source of food. Plant seeds in the ground and harvest them once they’re fully grown.

🤖 Automation

Automate your tasks using transport drones to gather resources, giving you more time to build and explore your skybound home.

✈️ Airship

Each player can build their own airship. Use it to travel to surrounding islands and discover new resources.

⠀ 

The characters in Komorebi are brought to life by amazing talent!

Komorebi is a fully voice acted dystopic story taking place in 2041. Set against the backdrop of social revolt, you move to Toronto to start a brand new chapter in your life. Make friends, party, and form bonds and romances that will last a lifetime! While pages turn in your life however, they also turn in the world. As your morals clash with those in power, you and your group may walk an irreversible path in the name of equality and a brighter future.

Enjoy your new life...

1805230.name: A Distant Stabbing
1805230.about_the_game:
Are you stuck in queue, waiting for a match to start? Is your rank too high, and the servers are struggling to find you opponents of equal skill?
Do you want to play something in the meantime that will tilt you before you even get in?
"A Distant Stabbing" was made for exactly that!
A strategic platformer where every arrow you shoot could bring you closer to your target at the top of the tower, or take you all the way back to where you came from. Or worse.
Challenge yourself or others to see how quickly you can reach your goal, while being efficient with how many shots you take to get there.
Shoot, teleport, repeat.

The Game

Using angles and patience, aim each shot to achieve the perfect bounce (or stick) of your arrow to ensure you gain as much height upwards as possible. The longer you charge a shot, the more likely the arrow is to bounce! Once it sticks, your hero will teleport to that location, so you can restart the process.

The Tower

As you work your way up, you might notice something strange going on in this sleepy tower! Explore environmental storytelling that hints at a greater threat than your target at the top. Who knows how deep this story goes?

The Hero

Play as a nameless, voiceless, idle hero who absolutely needs to take out the man who owns this tower. Why? Mostly so that this game can happen. Only time will tell.

Why?

I wanted to make something that would make people angry. I also wanted something to play while I waited for a match to start in other, better games.
It feels great to climb, it feels bad to fall, but it feels even worse to fail right after also losing a ranked match of something else.

Stats

I have included a basic Stat tracker to ensure no achievement is earned without proof. See for yourself, and show your friends, just how many times you beat the tower. Or had "accidents".






"A game designed to upset us ?
I wonder how you came to the conclusion that this would be a good sales pitch."
-A stranger online-

Summer break is finally here!

I'm supposed to help with the pool, meaning I'm some kinda pool boy, I guess?

I've been alone for so long and it's getting to me... I feel like I'm losing my mind..."

1805520.name: 世纪0：寄生之塔 Century 0:Parasitic Tower
1805520.about_the_game:
Plot Description



It is said that there is such a strange tower, the tower of beautiful illusion born in the Victorian era due to the strong desire of peacekeepers for happiness. Although it seems illogical, it really happened.

In the middle ages, punk, the tower God, was popular for some time. How to say, at that time, people enjoyed the happiness brought by an illusory tower. Everything people wanted on that day will appear inside the tower the day after tomorrow. Because of this very powerful and universal function, people flocked to move near the tower and just need to think about what they want next all day. Because people rely too much on it and it is like a God, people call it "tower God".

……

However, the punk period of the tower God will not last too long, because after a short time, the world will be peaceful, and people will live a happy life. The world is peaceful. The tower has no room for human happiness. At that time, more and more people chose to believe in science, and the tower lost its position as the center of people, so it dissipated in the air.

……

The moment when the tower reappears is the moment when the peacemaker it once raised and the later generations of the latter disappear completely! I don't know. After centuries, it reappeared! In an age when people are very peaceful, it destroys all beauty! As it recovers, all colors become so dark, as if they were back centuries ago!



How to play



In this game, you are a redeemed soul. Given by something, you become the host of the body of a condemned prisoner and get the chance to be redeemed, but you need to complete one task: go to the center of the city and destroy the parasitic tower. However, this task is not simple. It is also the main story of the game.

There are three game modes in this game: comprehensive mode, parasitic tower mode and battle mode. The comprehensive mode is compatible with all playing methods. You can enjoy the randomness of roguelike, the interest of the story and the suspense of decryption. Parasitic tower mode is the so-called tower climbing mode. You only need to choose your soul and talent. You can spend time climbing the tower and playing boss. In battle mode, you can choose your character, choose your enemy, and fight in different attributes to master the game operation.

There are 8 kinds of souls in the game, including knight, mage, warrior, Centaur, Archer, mechanical life, assassin and slave. The value of each soul is different and the difficulty is also different. You can choose at your discretion.

At present, there are more than 50 kinds of weapons available in the game. The main types of weapons are knife, sword, dagger, spear, hammer, axe and bow.

The highest level of each class is different, but the highest level is currently level 60.

The battle mode of the game is currently round system, but it may change in the future.



Warning



The game may not be as fun as you think. If the game has shortcomings, welcome to the comment area for discussion. Of course, if it is too unsatisfactory, you can choose to refund.

STOP THE SUMMONING

  • Turn-based strategy

  • Beat the Odds
