    For the solo demon banisher! In this mode, you’ll control all 4 characters and face the cult alone. 

  • Replayability
    With fast and challenging gameplay, each unique playthrough of DEMONS is guaranteed to present interesting and thought-provoking choices that will vary every time. 

  • Unlock rewards
    As you play, you’ll have the opportunity to unlock cosmetic rewards that you can use to customise your game board. Unlockable perk cards are also available - they will enhance your gameplay and give you and your team extra strategic options to help you win.

  • Immerse yourself
    Delve into a unique co-op experience with stunning original art, music and sound effects.

Warning

This game contains flashing lights that may make it unsuitable for people with photosensitive epilepsy or other photosensitive conditions. Player discretion is advised.
1805570.supported_languages: English, Portuguese - Brazil, Turkish, Russian, Simplified Chinese

1805610.name: Castlepoint
1805610.about_the_game:
Are you looking for new base strategy games in which you need to defend your base and attack enemy areas? Or a classic board strategy with 1v1 action-strategy battles and a time limit?

Introducing Castlepoint, an immersive fantasy & medieval strategy game similar to chess and old-style action-based real time strategy games. Conquer enemy areas, without allowing them to enter yours!

🆚PLAY 1VS1
Enjoy this rts game offline in a 1vs1 game against AI opponent. Our quick strategy game soon will also feature multiplayer with 1vs1 and 2vs2 game modes.

⚔️DIFFERENT DIFFICULTY LEVELS AND ERAS
Start this medieval rts game offline and choose from a variety of difficulty levels for a single player. Our medieval rts has 15 hero characters to choose from. Each of them has different stats and skills.

ℹ️HOW TO PLAY
This chess strategy inspired rts game is extremely easy to play. All you need is to:
- pick an era
- choose heroes to spawn
- get 5 heroes to the enemy area with great strategy
- defend the base and prevent 5 enemy heroes from getting into your area

🏯CASTLEPOINT FEATURES:
● 1vs1 game mode (2vs2 and multiplayer modes will soon be announced)
● our defense strategy game has 15 heroes to choose from
● each hero in the combat strategy has different stats and skills
● there is a time limit for added competitiveness
● play in different eras
● choose from different difficulty levels
● medieval inspired soundtrack and graphics
● play this action rts offline

Now it’s time to immerse yourself in the world of Castlepoint.

1805640.name: FAE POPULI
1805640.about_the_game:
FAE POPULI tells the tragic tales of many FAE, and beings alike. Tiny creatures who exist in an enchanted nightmare--the beautiful, yet dangerous world of GAEA.

FAE POPULI is a gift from me to my kid self, even if she will never be able to play it.

1805650.name: My Universe - Doctors & Nurses
1805650.about_the_game:
Start your medical career!

You have the option to play two new recruits who've just arrived. Gradually, you'll realise that your day-to- day existence is going to be anything but restful. Build relationships with the other members of your new team and get to know their funny and moving personalities. But be sure not to get distracted by your rival, Doctor Pierce! Over the course of your adventure, you'll take care of the various patients who present to you at the hospital as the days go by. Listen carefully to them to understand their symptoms and play fun mini-games to treat them. Every day is a new challenge with its fair share of surprises!

-Choose your character and personalise their appearance
-Discover hospital life as part of a team
-Take care of your various patients with different mini-games!
1805650.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Dutch

1805670.name: Cursed Island
1805670.about_the_game:
When the night falls upon the world, darkness gets viscous and prickly, drawing strength and life away from the unwary travelers. The offsprings of darkness hunt for those who cleverly surrounded their lair with light to banish the creatures away into the darkness.

The one who wakes up at dawn surrounded by the floating cursed island's ridges has a complex destiny. Their minutes of life might be numbered. The traveler is now forced to spend these minutes preparing for the upcoming fight against the dark.

Perhaps they can find a way to leave the island.

Research and Riddles

In this game you have to explore a large, hand-crafted world full of secrets, puzzles and traps. To get through the Earth's thickness and find a way to leave the cursed island.

The game offers you 2 types of gameplay: a platformer, with a side view, and a shooter with a top view, placing more emphasis on parkour and battles in different parts of the game, or on exploring mazes, respectively.

Items and crafting

It's up to you to decide exactly how to become stronger in this world. You can either find powerful weapons and equipment in caches around the world, or create it from resources yourself. In any case, the player has more than 80 items at his disposal, among which there are both melee / ranged weapons and unique accessories.

Time is running out

Don't lose your vigilance! Every minute counts. The longer you spend on the island, the more dangerous it becomes. Your goal is to find a balance between research and development, so that you can find a way to leave the cursed island, and not be too weak before the next wave of opponents...
1805670.supported_languages: English, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Spain, Ukrainian

1805680.name: A Contusion
1805680.about_the_game:
You remember being badly injured, but how and why it happened are unanswered questions. You were making your way through the compound to find help. Your mentor's voice guided you through trouble and danger until the twisted reality of something unthinkable erased it. And only horror remained. And shooting. And the escape. And a flash followed by contusion.

Be afraid of the dark and remember that any attack by you or by the enemy can lead to death, serious injury or leave no scratches.
- 16 kinds of bullet weapons, shotguns and melee weapons;
- 6 types of bullets, 4 types of shotgun shells and 7 modifications of melee weapons;
- 15 types of light, medium and heavy body armor;
- Various helmets, shields, grenades and first aid kits;
- More than 70 different perks;
- 20 powerful artifacts;
- 5 enemy factions with different mechanics: heavily armed criminals, mutants with random DNA, bloodthirsty and almost invulnerable undead, robots that improve themselves with armor, sensors, weapons, self-destruct system and even dead human bodies, as well as an ominous black goo.
- 5 types of procedurally generated levels: fights will take place in catacombs, underground bunkers, warehouses, sewers and outdoors.
1805680.supported_languages: English, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Russian, Simplified Chinese

1805700.name: Space Beastz
1805700.about_the_game:
Space Beastz is a cooperative multiplayer music and rhythm game. On a music-playing spaceship, players must time their actions just right to keep multiple instruments running and make the most amazing music the galaxy has ever heard!
About This Game:
In Space Beastz, a player joins the crew of David, an intergalactic music composer on a mission to bring the gift of life-changing music to the galaxy. The spaceship has a collection of out-of-this-world instruments built-in, but they are prone to breaking down at just the wrong moment. They need human players to keep the beats flowing.
A player can attempt the challenge alone or enlist the help of up to three friends in local or online multiplayer modes. The more players get in on the action, the more instruments will malfunction, and frantic action will ensue as players race from one station to the next, trying not to miss a beat!
Each world the players play for has unique problems and preferred music style, and the difficulty ratchets up as the team plays gigs for increasingly powerful planetary rulers. If they succeed in pleasing the hardest of all audiences, they may be able to bring peace to a troubled galaxy.
A fun-filled way to experience the Bible, Space Beastz shares the story of David and how the music he played had a positive impact on the world around him.
Main features:
Frenetic multiplayer fun, great for parties.
Epic music with a retro 80s digital vibe. Each song is a brand-new creation from several unique and talented composers.
Difficulty levels are set individually by each player, from casual to Beast Mode, so players of all skill levels can have fun playing together.
High replayability: Every song can be replayed in the quest for a new top score.
Family-friendly story, so even small children can join the fun.
Completely free, with no ads or other monetization to spoil your peaceful intergalactic vibes.
1805700.supported_languages:
English*, French, Spanish - Latin America, Traditional Chinese
*languages with full audio support

1805720.name: Letters From the Moon
1805720.about_the_game:
Dorothy Chen is the first Chinese-American woman on the moon, but she has a problem: her mission crash landed there. With rescue days away, Dorothy searches for a way to survive and finds a vast underground alien city. The aliens have died log ago, but she finds an educational simulation in the form of a holographic cat, Jiqi, to help her navigate the strange city with all of its dangers. She faces insane robots, mutant canines, starvation, and insanity inside the city of the Anthria. Whether she survives is up to YOU in this pick your own story adventure with over 30 different endings.

This game is an interactive book with additional features such as inventory and achievements.

1805730.about_the_game:
...In a town on the west of the former Russian Empire, bolsheviks are preparing a ceremony of opening the tomb of a saint's relics within their recently proclaimed antireligious campaign. You are a journalist who was sent to write a story about it. When it turns out that the relics were stolen right before the pompous propaganda ceremony, you have to solve the mystery of their disappearance. While making an investigation and collecting the evidence, you spend several days in a post-revolutionary town, torn apart by inner conflicts and still living its everyday life.

The setting of the quest «19|19» is designed by professional historians and based on the study of local periodicals, diaries, memoirs, fiction and nonfiction literature from the late 1910s. Detailed descriptions of objects, well-developed and historically reliable storylines of main characters and realistic sound effects are combined with a good sense of humour and unique visual style.

In the point&click adventure «19|19» you will:
⁃ investigate an intricate story and the world of an ordinary Russian town in the wake of the revolution;
⁃ solve puzzles;
⁃ suggest a reliable hypothesis about the crime;
⁃ accuse one of the persons you’ve met during the game;
⁃ and write a story to be published in a fictional Moscow paper «The Red Case».

1805740.name: Snowstorm of despair
1805740.about_the_game:
In this game you have to survive in a severe winter, while waiting for salvation.

Survive in a snowstorm
You and your team need to keep the flame in the fireplace. Look for firewood and fuel the flame or you will have to put it in again.

Cooperation or betrayal?
Only you can decide which side to choose. Will you work with your team or betray them when you have a chance? Maybe, you are a good orator and want to build a good trustworthy team? Or do you prefer to create tension and distrust? Anyway, it is you who makes the final decision.

Features of survival
Appearing in a cosy home with your unlucky teammates, you have to find a way out and collect wood for the fireplace to get warm (you don’t want to freeze to death, do you?). Also, you’ll come across some useful items such as food and additional clothes. But make sure that you’re not lost while searching the way to other houses.

What is hiding in the forest?
Yes, there are “human-monsters”, but also there are ghosts of darkness, which are also dangerous. You thought it would be easy, didn’t you?

1805750.name: First Men´s Life
1805750.about_the_game:
In the game "FIRST MEN´S LIFE" you wake up on a beautiful open world map in the middle of nowhere. It's practically a matter of surviving yourself. You can create your own house with the integrated building system. Eating is of course also important, which is why you also have to take care of foods such as fruit, vegetables, meat and fish. There are also opponents in the game who can pose a real challenge.



In "FIRST MEN´S LIFE" you start with a stone in your hand. The first thing you have to do is find something to eat so that you don't lose hearts. Once you have done that, you should cut down the first trees in order to be well prepared for the first night. After the first night, you can go on a discovery tour. You discover new biomes, forests, lakes and much more. After a certain time you will meet the first opponents who only want evil. So that you can defeat them, you should be well armed in advance.

What FIRST MEN´S LIFE offers


  • try to survive- Build your own things
  • Produce and cook food yourself
  • many unlockable game objects
  • Eliminate opponents
  • Diversity of biomes
  • Breathtaking graphics

What FIRST MEN´S LIFE doesn't offer


  • Multiplayer
  • Creative Mode
  • Serious violence
  • trade



FIRST MEN'S LIFE is developed by a pupil from Hamburg. I'm in the 12th grade and develop this game as an annual work. Game development has been a hobby of mine for years. In the future I would like to develop other small, complex and high-quality indie / adventure games.

I look forward to constructive feedback of all kinds, so feel free to get in touch! I will do my best to be able to reply to messages as quickly as possible so that I can fix problems in the game quickly.

1805810.name: Winter Dream
1805810.about_the_game:
Winter vacation has come for Caron Duff and he's looking forward to his time out of school. However, his vacation won't be spent at home and he'll be moving in with his uncle who owns a restaurant. Upon arriving in town, he finds the scenery to be way more familiar than it should be. When he gets to his uncle's restaurant, he meets Velda Penn, a very rude girl that works for Daniel. Caron gets some time to look around town and that's when he runs into Gwen Coy, a somewhat shy girl with a bit of a playful side and Rose Sherburn, who cares way more about others than herself.

No matter where he goes, Caron won't be able to avoid talking to any of them. As he spends more time with them, he will learn all kinds of things about them. All three of three of them are feeling some kind of pain from incidents that happened to them in their pasts. While he tries to enjoy his vacation, Caron will learn about what's hurting them and how all three of them are connected to him. There will be plenty of time to do so, since this will be his longest winter vacation.

In this visual novel, there are three main routes, one for each of the girls. Velda, Gwen, and Rose all have both friendship and romance endings. You will be given choices to make throughout their stories, and if you make the wrong ones, you'll get one of their bad endings. When Caron's getting used to town, he can either spend his time alone or try to make some new friends. Getting the good endings for each of the girls isn't where the story ends though. Get at least one happy ending for each of them, and you'll unlock the true route which will tell you the truth behind everything. Caron will have to accept it, no matter how painful it is. No matter what happens, this will be an unforgettable winter break.

1805820.name: Moonhaven
1805820.about_the_game:
Moonhaven combines farming, survival, tower defense, and role-playing genres.

You awake on the beach of a seemingly deserted and definitely haunted island. Hungry and alone, armed with only your wits, you set out to survive and build a life for yourself. Can you make it through the night and fend off the monsters bent on destroying what you worked hard to build? It will not be easy. The once vibrant, nearby town of Moonhaven lies in ruins and now is home only to monsters and the ghosts of the past! With some dedication, you may just be the one to vanquish the monsters and restore the island to its former glory!

Turn the wilderness on the island into a bustling farm! Grow crops, raise animals and craft new items! Build your dream farm anywhere you want in the island's wilderness.

Defend your farm! During full moons, fend off hordes of monsters bent on destroying what you worked so hard to build!

Survive the cold nights! Grow, gather, hunt and fish for the food you need to survive!

Up to 5 Players! Invite 1-4 players to join you on the island online! Players can work together to build their farms, share resources and rebuild the nearby town of Moonhaven!

Level up your skills! Everything you do gains you experience and levels. Each level you get a new skill point you can spend on unlocking new cooking and crafting recipes, and improving your farming, crafting, hunting, fishing and fighting abilities.

Explore a mysterious island! You'll encounter a variety of animals and monsters. Find powerful weapons, raw materials for crafting and mysteries to be uncovered.

Cook delicious foods and craft everything you need! Cook dozens of different recipes to help sustain you and provide you with beneficial effects. Craft tools, weapons, building materials and other useful items to help you build your farm and survive on the island!

Build your base! Build your own farm house, barn and more! Build fences and traps to keep out predators during the night and protect your crops.

1805840.name: KONSUI FIGHTER
1805840.about_the_game:
Inspired by classic fighters from the '90s, KONSUI FIGHTER is a hand-drawn fighting game that puts you in control of ten unique fighters, each representing an aspect of Ayumu's personality as he struggles to wake from a deep coma. Featuring an original story as well as classic arcade, versus, and training modes, KONSUI FIGHTER provides a variety of ways to put your skills to the test!

A FORMIDABLE FOE

Utilizing the power of Circean Studios' own Aeaea Engine, KONSUI FIGHTER debuts with the groundbreaking FORESCORE AI system. CPU fighters will look into the future, forecasting and scoring the predicted outcome of the various actions they can take, enabling them to quickly defend against - or take advantage of your unique fighting style.

THE TOURNAMENT OF THE MIND BEGINS

Trapped within a deep coma, professor Ayumu Tsuburaya struggles to regain his memory of the events that led to his condition. Searching his inner mind, the characters that make up the fabric of his personality emerge, thrust into conflict as their world falls into ruin by an unseen force. Will Ayumu's mind regain order, or will it remain forever lost in chaos?

KONSUI FIGHTER features an original story across nine chapters, each depicted with beautiful hand-drawn illustrations. Learn the secrets of Ayumu's past and take control of each character as they stuggle to save their world from destruction in KONSUI FIGHTER's story mode!

CHALLENGE YOUR FRIENDS

Take on your friends in local network or online versus modes, built from the ground-up with rollback netcode to provide a solid multiplayer experience! KONSUI FIGHTER also features a couch co-op versus mode to go head-to-head with your friends on a shared system.

PLAY ANYWHERE

Aeaea Engine's cross-platform support enables KONSUI FIGHTER to be played on a variety of platforms, including Windows, macOS, Linux, as well as native support for Steam Deck. Enjoy cross-platform multiplayer with your friends via local network and online versus modes across these and the mobile editions of KONSUI FIGHTER!

1805930.name: Pumpkin Eater
1805930.about_the_game:
Peter, Peter pumpkin eater,
Had a wife but couldn't keep her;
He put her in a pumpkin shell
And there he kept her very well.

Pumpkin Eater is a psychological horror visual novel about a family taking care of their pumpkin-headed son. This was originally a submission for the 2021 Spooktober Jam.

Features:

  • A 40 minute kinetic story. Sit back, relax, and watch the insanity unfold
  • Hand drawn illustrations
  • 100% medical accuracy, complete with a glossary and timeline of events
1805930.supported_languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Turkish, Spanish - Spain, Spanish - Latin America
1805930.reviews:
“One of the most unsettling games I’ve ever played[…] Pumpkin Eater is a masterpiece of visual and narrative art. I don’t think they could make it better if they tried. It’s a perfectly succinct and full horror tale unlike any other.”
DreadXP

“The narrative is so riveting that it really pulls you in. The hand drawn visuals are fairly simple, but effective and the descriptions of the son’s decomposing body are both medically accurate and horrifying. Highly recommended.”
Alpha Beta Gamer

1805960.name: Prepare For Warp: Unlimited Edition: Beyond Insanji
1805960.about_the_game:
Help wanted: Intergalactic Data Couriers Needed!

In a universe where FTL interstellar travel exists but FTL communications do not, private couriers play a key role in transporting massive amounts of data between star systems.

Apply and join the ranks of these intrepid and entrepreneurial pilots, but beware - interstellar travel is not for the faint of heart. It's easy going once you enter warp, but building up the kinetic energy needed to activate a warp drive requires careful but fast maneuvering through asteroid-filled hostile space.

  • Visually stimulating sensory experience.
  • Upgrade your ship with essential equipment: Weapons to clear away obstacles, defenses to withstand any bumps you may take, and flight upgrades to boost your speed and maneuverability.
  • Give yourself more of an edge by trading collected Dark Matter in the Subspace Market for mods of questionable legality.
  • Boost your chances with consumable power-ups that can salvage missions from certain failure.
  • Make your fortune while trying to build up the prowess to reach the ultimate, most lucrative, and most dangerous client world of Thend.
  • Retire, earn prestige, and hand off the reins to a new upstart pilot with a unique talent or two, knowing that your accomplishments and long-term investments will make the road to Thend easier for your successors.
  • Challenge yourself with unlockable alternate game modes: Challenge Mode progressively increases a level's difficulty, Timed Mode straps an explosive with timer to your ship, and Infinite Mode lets you go as far as you possibly can in a level.
  • Customize your ship from over 200 million ship part combinations.
  • Experience true achievement overload with over 500 in-game Achievements and 76 Steam Achievements.
  • Fun unlockable extras - Dice, ducks, carrots, eyes, colorful explosions, and horns.
  • Fully remappable game and UI controls. Supports Keyboard, Keyboard/Mouse, or Gamepad.
  • Special advanced feature for improved personal arcade cabinet experience: Moddable control icons

Advisory Information:
  • Contains flashing and strobing lights
1805960.game_link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1805960/Prepare For Warp: Unlimited Edition: Beyond Insanji/

1805970.name: Comixxx Strip
1805970.about_the_game:
Comixxx is a new special series from Sinnera featuring high quality, hot & sexy girls done in comic book style.

Comixxx Strip is a casual game with relaxing atmosphere. Enjoy the classic, "Xonix" style arcade gameplay. Fence off sections of a playfield where balls that the player must avoid bounce around to reveal the girls! Earn all the stars to beat record scores and unlock achievements & bonus level.

  • 15 challenging levels
  • Uncensored content
  • Beat the record times to earn stars
  • Unlock a bonus level after getting all the stars
  • Comic book style art
  • Atmospheric music
  • 32 achievements
  • Display girls from the gallery
  • Easily skip levels - unlock girls if you can't beat a level for more than 10 mins

1805980.name: Comixxx Jixxaw
1805980.about_the_game:
Comixxx is a new special series from Sinnera featuring high quality, hot & sexy girls done in comic book style.

Comixxx Jixxaw is a casual game with relaxing atmosphere. Enjoy the classic Jigsaw puzzle gameplay. Put the pieces together to solve the puzzle and reveal the girls! Earn all the stars to beat record scores and unlock achievements & bonus level.

  • Comic book style art
  • Atmospheric music

1805990.name: External-Dimension: Mainframe
1805990.about_the_game:
Blaze through the world of Mainframe in this fast paced Action-Platformer inspired by the Megaman Zero Series. You play as Frame, a Data Scanner who is tasked with combating the destruction of the world. Use a variety of movement options and weapons to overcome challenges to rid the world of +ERRoR.

Story

A Data Center known as Spectrum-016-88, a region in the norther cluster of Mainframe, has come under attack by an emerging group. Similar attacks have been levied in recent months in other Data Centers. These attacks are lead by a group who call themselves, +ERRoR. A newly founded organization known as Console has taken control of public order and safety in response to the emergence of +ERRoR.


Over time public trust in Console wains as the attacks grow more frequent and destructive as +ERRoR always seems to be one step ahead of them. Despite the efforts of Oracle's Data Scanners, +ERRoR has gained more influence in a short span of time. They are now on equal footing with them and now the public has begun to question their authority as well as their actions. Within Console a growing suspicion looms–a person of great influence must be backing +ERRoR. Frame takes matters into his own hands to put a stop +ERRoR’s assault before all of Mainframe is destroyed.

Mechanics

Data Scanners have a wide array of movement options that allow them to move through Zones quickly.


Data Scanners have access to 2 unique movement mechanics that can be employed to get through Zones.
  • R-Dash, allows Data Scanners to cling to ceilings or the underside of a platform and can be used to bypass large gaps where simply jumping may not be safe
  • W-Trans, allows a Data Scanner to phase or teleport through certain walls of a particular width.


In addition to those movement options, Data Scanners have access to a Secondary Jump, Wall Slide, Wall Jump, Back Dash, Fast Fall, Burst Movement and a number of hidden movement options that only skilled user can make use of.

1806000.name: How To Bathe Your Cat: Drawing
1806000.about_the_game:
You'll have to think a lot to be able to bathe your cat.

To wet the cat you'll have draw the path so that the water reaches it.
After that, use bombs to the destroy the blocks that holds the water.


The same to perfume the cat, but be aware, this time the fluid floats


Make sure that the lava don't touch the cat and use it to destroy some blocks that the bombs can't


Features

  • Bathe the cat using your logical thinking and physic intuition.
  • Draw and uses bombs to channel a fluid so that it reaches the cat.
  • Experience several kind of fluids with different mechanics (Water, Lava, Gas).
  • Draw complex figures and use bombs to make a fluid reach difficult places.
  • 40 unique handmade levels.
  • 4 beautiful scenarios.

1806030.name: Minimal Dungeon RPG
1806030.about_the_game:
Join Our Discord:

Minimal Dungeon RPG is a simplistic dungeon crawler RPG game that takes place in the deep valley of Casa.A beam of light appeared in the night sky, and that's where you were born. You are a fragment of the ancient Demon Lord and your mission is to embark on an adventure to unravel the mystery of your origins.

Your journey won't be easy as you traverse through the continent filled with monsters like stonemen and wolves, all sensing something unusual within you. They want to kill you, but you have weapons to defend yourself. The more monsters you defeat, the more loot you gain, and the stronger you become. Break down numerous barriers and defeat the final boss to become the Lord of the land.

Minimal Dungeon is a brand new RPG that offers classic RPG gameplay. It consists of multiple rooms that are interconnected to form dungeons. Tasks, monsters, and rewards are all simplified into squares in the rooms, making it easy to play and crawl through the dungeons. The game offers an immersive storyline with elements of simulation and strategic dungeon-style games. You can experience the pleasure of classic RPG in this simple, easy, and fun game.

Game features:

* Innovative gameplay with minimalist and simplified dungeon style

* Epic dungeons full of loots and unexpected monsters

* A fascinating, rich storyline with a mystery to unravel

* Side missions and Dreamland to get extra materials and lucky treasure
1806030.supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Korean

1806040.name: Snake Force
1806040.about_the_game:
“Friendly Fire!“
Snake Force is an alternative top-down shooting game inspired by the classic game Snake.
In this game, you’ll rescue your bros and fight along side with them. You and your bros will stand in a line, and shoot at the same point. Keep the shape of your squad, because bullets hurt whatever they hit.
The game includes 5 levels, and a secret mode. The total playing time will be 30~45 minutes.
If the game feels too hard for you, you may try using the Shift key. It could still be fun!

Words by the developers

This game was originally a personal project made for LudumDare40, finished under 48 hours. Recently we happened to have this motivation to refine this work for fun. There isn’t much content in this game. We will probably add more stuff someday when we want to. Hopefully you will enjoy it!
1806040.supported_languages:
English*, Simplified Chinese
*languages with full audio support

1806050.name: Exanimate
1806050.about_the_game:
Exanimate is a 2D pixel-art side scrolling platforming shooter where a players' instinct and will to survive is put to the ultimate test...

ENTER THE ZEDS





How long can you last before you give up and run?

The hordes of Zeds keep coming and coming and coming...

Do you hold your ground and battle to the bitter end?

Upgrade you weapons and manage your defences at the shop and continue the fight?

Or...

Do you run as soon as possible before their numbers overwhelm you and your friends?

END TRANSMISSION


Features

Zombie Horde Destruction!


Fight against over 20 different vicious zombies and learn how to efficiently dispatch each variation.

4-player Mayhem!


Same screen local co-op to ease the pain! Or does it?!

Fully Stocked Shop!


Power yourself every step of the way! Purchase new and unique weapons, buffs, barricades, turrets and more during the heat of the fight!

Bop your head while you explode those zeds!


Enjoy killing the endless onslaught to a retro-style sound track!

1806070.name: 畢業生模擬器
1806070.about_the_game:
This game may contain content that is not suitable for all ages, or may not be suitable for viewing at work.

This game is currently a personal visual novel based on text dialogue plots. AI technology is being used to optimize the graphics. The urban simulation gameplay will not be added until 2.0, and it will be replaced with the UE5 engine for remake at that time.

Since I am optimizing and upgrading the overall picture, please do not buy it for the time being. It is expected to update a new version with improved pictures and dubbing at the end of the year. Since it is a personal independent game work, the development is slow. If you are interested, please consider adding it to the wish list to support it. (2024.8.23)

Due to the outsourcing work in November and December, the progress was stagnant. The dubbing work and the female third line were not completed in time. It is planned to participate in the visual novel festival on March 4, 2025 and launch the optimized version (2025.2.15)

The workload is a bit heavy and I can't catch up. At present, I still need to test and fix bugs and submit the review process. I am very sorry. If you have concerns, you can wait for the subsequent discount (2025.3.3)

The names of the people in the game and the script are all made up and have no relationship with the real people of the same name.

1806120.name: Serena: Dark confessions
1806120.about_the_game:
An erotic visual novel full of meaningful choices mixed with adventure game elements, non-linear story resulting in 9 diverse endings. Multiple narrators and characters you care about. All with 4k visuals, sex animations and awesome cumshots.



Julian and Serena, a happy couple, engaged and soon to be married, ready for a picture-perfect ever after. It was a heartwarming tale of clumsy mistakes flowering into solid romance and the promise of something greater. But promises can be broken, and this one was shattered by Julian, who strayed from his fiancée, and by Nicole, Serena’s best friend, who took her husband to be. And Serena left, and Julian… drifted.

It… wasn’t easy, being the bad guy. Nicole stood by his side, cheerful, vibrating with life and energy as always. He worked in his beloved car workshop, the place where he could feel his skills were worth something. But every day, knowing all that he had, he couldn’t stop thinking about what he no longer did. Self-respect was quite high on that list.

And not knowing what Serena was doing, or with whom? That wasn’t easy. Not even Jade, the girl who should have been his sister-in-law, knew. Julian’s ex was now a mystery, and as much as he missed her sometimes, as much as he wished he could somehow make things better…

But this is all the past, part of a story that’s already been told, that you know. And this game? No, this is the part yet to come. This is the part of the story where lingering embers blaze, where we meet the characters we thought we knew and see new ones step into the limelight. This is where we learn about Serena’s past, the secrets she now guards. This is where Julian chooses. And you with him.

MULTIPLE NARRATORS


Everyone is the hero of their own story, and so, for the first time, we will allow you to see all the different stories hidden in a single game. You will step into Julian’s shoes and choose his actions, yes, but you will also do so with Serena, Jade, and other characters, so that you may experience their tales as they unfold and as they touch one another. Follow all the threads, and step back to look at the tapestry.

VISUAL NOVEL GAMEPLAY


In the past, Julian and Serena’s story has been told as a dating-sim, where you raised the appropriate stats and repeated the available actions till you achieved the desired combination. This time around? No grinding.
The game will play as an alternating mix of visual novel, with interactive scenes whose choices will be felt further down the line, and classic adventure, interacting with the environment until you decide to trigger the next section of the narrative. This doesn’t mean there won’t be room for fun asides: having Nicole model her outfits for no reason whatsoever during an adventure segment is not only possible, but highly recommended.

CHARACTERS YOU CARE ABOUT


Serena, Jade, Nicole… Names you have known for quite a while, stories to continue from old memories - but that is just the tip of the iceberg. There will be new characters, new gorgeous faces and intriguing personalities that will allow you a glimpse into their life. You will have control of all of them, and, once you take the wheel, you will discover… Well, that would be telling, wouldn’t it?

LIVING ORGANISM


There is so much about these characters we want to tell that we couldn’t fit it all into the game - and so we will keep updating it with everything we came up with, for months to come. The new structure we are implementing will allow us to easily add content without disturbing the flow of the original game, so, as long as you want there to be more, there will be.

KEY FEATURES


- stunning 4K visuals with one of the most adorable characters we've ever designed
- over 1500 static images plus almost 50 cumshot sequences, 5 juicy images each
- passionately rendered 118 sex animations with 30 frames each
- beautiful story written with almost 300 000 words
- non-linear story with smart choices leading to 10 different endings
- 100% uncensored and complete experience

1806190.name: Prince Nikolai and the Vampires
1806190.about_the_game:
SUMMARY

Prince Nikolai and the Vampires is a SRPG in the classic style of Shining Force, Fire Emblem, Bahamut Lagoon, Feda the Emblem of Justice and from the same developer team, Princess Daphne and the Orcs.

Play as Prince Nikolai, a powerful priest who can unleash the power of both the sun and the moon, and gather an army of colorful, diverse heroes as he needs to save his kindgom from the threat of a dangerous lord, the arrogant and ambitious vampire Zarius.

Meet friends and foes along the way, manage your units and their inventories, purchase goods and weapons in this enthralling old-school SRPG.

HIGHLIGHTED CHARACTERS

Nikolai

Master of both the sun and the moon, this powerful lord and priest by profession has sworn to hunt down and eliminate the dangerous vampire responsible for the bloodied deaths of many innocent girls.

Despite his profession and healing skill, he can be deadly and cause immense damages to the enemy foes.

Tristana

Her reputation precedes her: Tristana is known as the most powerful witch in the world. As such, Nikolai considers her an asset and even the spearhead of his battle against the vampires. But can she live up to the expectations placed in her?

Undertow

Who exactly is this odd vampire? Undertow wields the power of darkness, can suck out the blood of his victims, but not only. Master of twilight, he is able to turn himself and his allies into blood-thirsty, relentless creatures, launching unparalleled assaults against the enemy side. A key element to strategy - but can you make the most of what he has to offer?

FEATURES

  • 23 exciting battles of increasing complexity and difficulty

  • 11 playable characters with different profiles, strengths and weaknesses

  • A New Game+ offering the ultimate challenge for tactics experts: all characters from the start, more damaging enemies, but you also get more experience boost for completing a battle fast.

  • Skills that evolve to Level 2 and 3 depending on use: choose which skills to favor in battle, resulting in unlimited combinations, strategies and ways of playing

  • Pure tactics and strategy: the troops, both allies and enemies alike, never do a critical and their damage are estimated before an action is decided, plus only a few selected enemies can evade, resulting in no miss most of the times -> pure strategy!

  • Adjustable Battle Animations Speed: 4 different levels for maximum enjoyment!

  • Great Replay Value! While the main quest lasts about 20 hours, you may want to replay this game over and over to refine your strategy and/or discover new ways of playing, not to mention New Game+ or the many DLC.

GAMEPLAY HINTS (must read)

The entire game is controlled by the ENTER and ESC keys (or left and right clicks if you use the mouse).

In battle mode, first pick your character with either the mouse or the directional arrows (by moving the cursor on them), then make them move to the selected position of your choice, and then a menu will appear, allowing you to select an action.

In most cases, it's Attack, Magic, Skill or Wait if you have nothing better to do. If enemies are nearby, you can select the target(s) of your choice - sometimes a skill or a magic can target several enemy at once, and it's your job to position the area of effect as best as possible to make the most of the magic. Even if allies are included in the area of effect, they won't suffer damage from the selected magic.

You need to play all your characters for the character round to automatically end, with the enemy round following, and so on until one side wins (generally by killing all the enemies, or killing the boss, or reaching a given position on the battle map).

USEFUL TIPS

  • Attacking from behind results in 30% extra damage and from the side in 10% extra damage. It is possible to position your character optimally after they have moved by placing the cursor on them and pressing ESC. Use this so they don't show their backs to the enemies, because the 30% also applies to enemy attacks.

  • If you need to navigate from one point to another distant point on a large map, it will be faster to do so with the mouse rather than the directional arrows.

  • Some spells and skills do not consume any turn, such as Undertow's Twilight Assault. This means the character can play again after they have cast the spell in question.

  • Spells improve if you use them enough. All spells can improve twice.

  • Terrain is important. There are three levels of "terrain mastery": can go through difficult terrain, can fly low and/or go through water, can fly and go above everything.

  • Spells that alter movement behavior generally cancel each other. So if you cast a spell that gives +1 move range and the ability to fly, and then cast a spell that only gives the ability to go through difficult terrain, the (better) effect of the first spell will vanish. Pay attention to this when managing your troops.

If you have a question, a remark and/or feel this list of tips is incomplete, please let us know on the forum. We are here to help and make sure you enjoy Prince Nikolai and the Vampires!

CONTROLS

To move characters and the cursor, use the directional buttons on the game pad or the arrow keys on the keyboard.

  • ENTER/SPACE: Confirm, OK, Enter

  • ESC: Cancel, Menu

  • PAGE UP: Previous page

  • PAGE DOWN: Next page

If you're playing with the mouse:

  • LEFT-CLICK: Move characters, Confirm, OK, Enter

  • RIGHT-CLICK: Cancel, Menu

  • ALT+ENTER: Switches between window mode and full-screen mode.

  • ALT+F4: Forcibly exits the game.

  • F12: Forcibly returns to the title screen.

DLC

This game features a total of 7 DLC to enhance your experience. In particular:

  • DLC #1: extra power (NG++) for new strategies and new ways of playing

  • DLC #2: play with the 3 main enemy girls

  • DLC #3: play with the entire enemy side (final boss included, contains major spoilers)

  • DLC #4: play with a brand new character (a knight)

  • DLC #5: play with Princess Daphne and the entire cast of the first game, Princess Daphne and the Orcs

The DLC of your choice can be selected at the beginning of the game before the introduction sequence.

NG+ (different from NG++ available with DLC #1) is only available after the game has been completed once.

As the Alpha Shark you must eat to survive and defend your territory from other sharks who may challenge you. This vibrant coral reef is full of mysteries and places to explore. In these nutrient rich waters, fish are boundless, but after a while you may simply wish to swim in the tranquil water and enjoy the scenery.

Features

  • Grow as you eat and become the biggest shark
  • Starve and shrink when you don't eat enough
  • Eat other sharks
  • Eat fish / sea life

Screensaver mode

In screensaver mode the game will be in single player mode, locked in first-person (shark), the HUD will be disabled, and the sharks movement will become more static allowing the player to move around and create beautiful underwater screensavers.

Wallpaper mode

This mode is similar to screensaver mode except the movement controls are now mouse-click driven in order to support the software called "Wallpaper engine" that players have requested / mentioned in the past.

Multiplayer / Matchmaking

To join a random open lobby simply click "Join" on the main screen

To host your own game, click "Host". Other players will be able to join as described above by clicking "Join"

You can invite and join friends using the Steam overlay.
  1. Press [Esc] on the keyboard
  2. Host clicks "Invite"
  3. Host uses invite dialog to invite other player(s)
  4. Other player(s) start Alpha Shark
  5. Other player(s) press [Shift]+[Tab] to activate the Steam overlay
  6. Other player(s) click "Play Game" in the Steam chat window

Note: You will not be able to join games that have a full lobby.

For transparency, multiplayer is tested with 4 players and bots to emulate large lobbies. The game should support up to 250 players per server. You may find that adjusting the max players can improve or degrade your gameplay experience. There is a built in text chat, but no voice chat. If you wish to work as a team it is suggested that you use Discord or Steam Chat.

Attack: Left-click

Free look: Left-ctrl
Menu: Esc

Attack: Right-trigger

1806860.name: NEW TERRA®
1806860.about_the_game:
Handheld Gaming Community says NEW TERRA is GREAT and gives it an 8.5/10:

NEW TERRA is a multi-directional gravity based space shooter and more specifically, it's a physics strategy game set in outer space, on asteroids, under alien oceans, within mineshafts on distant planets and so on.

You control the ships rotation and forward/reverse thrust, with every thrust use costing you fuel.


The ship is constantly pulled downward by gravity, which you can use to your advantage if you strategize properly, or it will work against you.

Each level has limited fuel and limited power ups, so if you make inefficient decisions, you will often run out of fuel and crash (and die).


You have weapons but you have to sometimes strategize the use of them. (especially around allies or when surrounded by rock, as it will cause rock to fall and land on you or enemies.)


You can't touch anything with your ship or you quickly take damage. Obviously, if you take too much damage you will crash (and die).



Some missions require you to tow heavy objects which makes your fuel burn twice as fast for a quarter of the speed of travel, so physics and decision making come very much into play.



There are 18 unique missions all set on different planets, asteroids or interstellar locations and there is also a "pitch black mode" where it turns the lights out on every single level so you have only your headlamp to rely on for visibility, this ultimately brings 36 unique experiences to you as a player.




It's an extremely challenging but fun game. As a player, you start out with 30 lives. Hidden in each level is an extra life you can claim once.

Keyboard Now Supported!


As requested by a reviewer -- We have added keyboard support.

Note: The game does not have a keyboard layout shown in game because the keyboard needs to be localized into 20 languages.

ESC = menu/back/cancel
Q = activate
watts = thrust
A = left
S = reverse
D = right
Z = Select ability on the left
X = choose the right ability
E = throw object
R = headlight
Enter = Accept

1806970.name: Archero
1806970.about_the_game:
Your feedback is important! Join our Discord channel and spill the beans!



Dear archer hero, it's time to answer the call of the world and complete the necessary challenges to become a god!
Using your skillful archery skills, different arrows and the blessings of the bow gods, you can easily destroy all kinds of enemies and complete a variety of challenges.
Don't forget to defeat your challengers, they don't want you to become a god!

Shoot!

Draw an arrow from your pack, then build up your strength and shoot at the enemy! The greater the force, the faster the arrow and the more damage it will do to the enemy.
A shot that hits an enemy may break their joints and slow them down. There is a chance of a blast effect or even a kill shot!

Enemy armour

Enemies do not always reveal their flesh and blood, but usually wear armour of varying strengths in different torso positions, including light, medium and heavy armour.

Usually some enemies will be able to tell at a glance which type of armour is dominant, while others will need to be tried with an arrow.
Each part of the armour has its own durability value and will protect its owner with a response damage reduction parameter until it is depleted, but some arrows can penetrate directly regardless of the armour.

Types of arrows

When facing enemies without armour, or wearing light, medium or heavy armour, the different types of arrows are more effective and are
Normal arrows - average muzzle velocity, penetrate light armour and dent medium armour, but break when encountering heavy armour
Barbed arrow - higher muzzle velocity, penetrates and deals a lot of damage to unarmored and light armour, breaks on medium and heavy armour
Flat arrow - low muzzle velocity, dents almost all armour and loses a lot of durability
Sharp Arrows - Very high muzzle velocity, can penetrate all armour types including heavy armour, but do less damage
Normal arrows are infinite and you will automatically harvest other arrows from the Bow God on a regular basis, so remember to be flexible!

Growth

You gain experience by hitting enemies. Each time you accumulate a certain amount of experience you can upgrade and choose one of three random growth paths. Feel free to choose your own direction of development!

God Wishes

Wishes will accumulate automatically over time, and each successful shot will accumulate more wishes. When they are full, they unleash powerful aspirations.
These skills last for a while and come in different types: from rapid fire and knockback to charm and disguise, each of which has its own use to help you defeat the enemy.

Divine Rites

Each time you achieve a part of your goal, you will receive a gift from the gods. You can choose from a variety of different rewards, from special passive skills, divine wishes or special arrows.

Bow

Find bows with different attributes from all over the map, or from dead enemies, and use them with a passive skill or a divine wish to achieve outstanding results.

Quests or the Bow God

Complete a series of quests for the Bow God and collect crystal shards to cement your path to godhood. As your strength increases, you can receive various levels and quests such as defence, assault, sneaking and collecting.

Special helpers

Skeletons in tombstones, locked gates, stone throwers for defence, carefully erected stone balls, rickety suspension bridges - the mechanics in each mission will be a great help to you!


Development Plan

DEMO

The Archer Hero DEMO is now available for play. Come and experience the unique dual-stick archery gameplay and tell us what you think to help us iterate!

Feedback

You can give us your feedback via Discord or the Steam community. Have fun!

You start your turn with 8 Action points but spending one grants it to each enemy. The more you act, the more your opponents will react! Thankfully, eliminating your foes also grants you action points, allowing for potentially devastating turns for you…or against you.

You will learn to fear what lurks inside the mind. These vicious manifestations pack an impressive array of ways to kill you. To even the odds you will have to thoughtfully use your environment. From carefully placed explosives to pools of toxic poison, the terrain plays a crucial role in this unforgiving tactical combat.



In Wantless, the fight does not take place on a battlefield, but within the subconscious of your patients. Proceed with caution, safeguard key memories and avoid instability at all costs. Failing to do so will empower the creatures or even modify the whole map.



Use the synapses you've collected during your runs to craft your skills, experimenting with effects, shapes, costs and cooldowns! Combine damage, ailments, buffs, environmental effects, utility and more to create impressive combos. With 100+ synapses available, create a truly personalized build.

Shape Eiris further by navigating the intricate Mind Tree, with more than 170 perks to choose from. However, be mindful of your choices, as the more powerful the nodes, the greater the drawbacks.



Most patients and their traits are randomly generated, leading to endless possibilities. As you progress you may encounter special unique patients, with their distinct story, twists and enemies, pushing your builds to the limit.

1807190.name: Thawed Waters
1807190.about_the_game:
Thawed Waters is a mature emotional story experienced through hardcore boat-poling gameplay when every wrong move leads to losses and each stamina point counts!

Thawed Waters is not another farming sim, nor rogue-like, but pure classic isometric action with a problematic topic that needs to be raised in video games.

It's time to look into the ugliest corner of human life - animal testing.

"Pandemic of the second decade was nothing compared to what global warming melted in the Arctic later, freeing bacteria buried by nature millions of years ago. One of the thawed viruses ruthlessly attacked not only people but also animals of all kinds. Multiple attempts to develop a vaccine before the world plunged into chaos were unsuccessful, and a few remnants scattered across the globe lost all hope of surviving."
Stepan, head of Pukhovka village, 2047



NAVIGATE THE BOAT

Survive the planetary flood in the rusty boat with the pole in your hands! Choose directions wisely and apply force carefully to minimise rocking and tilting and avoid capsizing. Go around obstacles with the surgeon’s precision to keep the boat in one piece. Mistakes cost precious live cargo and materials, and the old man's stamina is a finite resource. Every decision is critical.

RESCUE AND SIT RABBITS

Finding the perfect time to pick rabbits is one side of the problem. How about sitting jumpy animals around the boat to achieve balance? The boat's behaviour depends on it, and therefore your life! Don’t miss a safe zone to release your fellow travellers or drown together and be forgotten.

FIGHT FATIGUE

Mental and physical fatigue are your eternal silent companions, that you have to deal with to survive. Collect and identify Siberian herbs and berries, mix them and brew a cosy cup of tea in safe zones to ease physical fatigue. Or not too cosy and get some unexpected side effects. Live through events of your past as mini-games to reduce or increase mental fatigue when dreaming next to the bonfire.

UPGRADE AND MODIFY

Your only ally, a mysterious prosthetic arm, holds the key to survival. Upgrade it with unique mods, and unleash its potential to travel further, push stronger, and save more lives. The boat barely stays afloat, but natural wit and a bit of luck will get you some cool artefacts increasing the boat’s stability or strength when it is needed the most.

LIVE THROUGH APOCALYPTICAL EVENTS

Fight the forces of nature to save it and give humanity another chance. Find a new meaning in life and watch how the broken old man transforms physically and mentally. Discover all the endings of this unusual story of personal salvation through rescuing the tiniest creatures. Explore the dark and submerged corners of the dying Siberian hinterland with a touch of cyberpunk.

  • 1 tormented priest going against the odds and sometimes the water stream
  • 1 prosthetic arm and 7 unique mods
  • 1 psychopath with a monster dog chasing you along the journey
  • 1 lab animal that changes the history of humanity
  • 8 strange places to visit, like a sunken crematorium and an abandoned grain elevator.

This game uses a turn-based system in which you and your enemy take turns.

1807410.name: Scriptur
1807410.about_the_game:
Scriptur is a kinetic visual novel featuring original artworks, soundtrack, and characters.

The main character woke up on the train, he does not know how he ended up in it and where he was going. On top of that, he has the same strange dream all the time. What does this all mean? What is the secret behind all this? Will it be possible to reveal it and finally restore the lost memories of what happened?

Visual novels are a genre of video games that leans heavily on plot and literature contents, which most resemble that of a book. The kinetic novels are a sub-genre that defines visual novels with little to no choice of the characters' actions, leading to a single-optioned, linear story with a strong narrative direction. Typically, kinetic novels are known to trade variability and replayability values for a stronger and/or more emotional delivery of the plot, following the directorial idea more precisely, although the absence of that is not always the case with the multi-routed player's choice-based type visual novels.

The main gameplay loop of visual novels usually involves the implementation of user controls to ensure the conduction of the player's ability to express their will to continue with the story by clicking or tapping the free space on the game screen and reading the appeared lines of dialogues or author's descriptions. Simultaneously, the game screen may change accordingly with the progression of the plot: background images change, character sprites take turns going out on the stage, the music suits the needs of the moment.

It is not only suitable but also useful to subtract the conventions of the experience and see this kind of media for its origins — theatrical plays — to esteem the possibilities of digital realms in storytelling.

1807430.about_the_game:
Witching Hour is a horror-themed zombie wave shooter.

Zombies will come at you from every angle.
The game features a body cam perspective.
In Witching Hour the player will be able to walk around and sprint, as well as shoot their rifle at different types of entities.
Witching hour also gives the player a flashlight that can be turned on and off.
Witching hour features four different types of entities:
The zombie: slow moving entity that is practically harmless on its own but can be very dangerous in numbers.
The skinwalker: A fast moving entity disguised as a mannequin that only moves when the player cannot see it. This entity drops ammo when killed.
The mutant: A large entity that is harder to kill and is only visible when the flashlight is off.
The speed demon: a small but very fast moving entity that will stop at nothing to kill you.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Diary Entry - November 17th

The world has unraveled into a nightmare, and I find myself scrawling these words in the flickering light of a dwindling flashlight. Today marked the onset of the undead invasion that now engulfs our once-thriving city. The streets, once filled with life, have transformed into a desolate battleground.

Morning brought ominous whispers of chaos as news of the outbreak spread like wildfire. A sense of disbelief clung to the air until the distant moans of the undead grew louder, drowning out the last vestiges of normalcy.

By midday, the city plunged into pandemonium. Sirens wailed in the distance, and the sharp stench of decay hung heavy. I watched from my apartment window as people fled in panic, their screams blending with the haunting groans of the approaching undead.

My instincts kicked in, propelling me to secure my meager supplies and fortify my apartment. The world outside my window became a twisted dance of survival, where each shadow held the potential for danger. The undead roamed the streets, their vacant eyes fixated on a grim objective that only they seemed to comprehend.

As night fell, the city plunged into darkness, broken only by sporadic flashes of gunfire and distant screams. The hollow echoes of footsteps and the occasional crash of breaking glass painted a grim soundscape, reminding me of the encroaching peril.

Now, as I pen down these words, I can't shake the feeling of impending doom. The undead lurk in the shadows, their relentless pursuit fueled by an insatiable hunger. The world as I knew it has crumbled, replaced by a landscape of fear and uncertainty.

I cling to the hope that daylight will bring some respite, a chance to navigate this apocalyptic reality. For now, I fight in the dark, surrounded by the distant moans of the undead, and wonder how long my limited supply of bullets will hold against the relentless tide outside.

Each of us on the team are college graduates who were fortunate enough to receive funding to continue development after graduation in 2021. We were all determined to create an experience that authentically represents Brooklyn, as well as the experience of code-switching. We hope that playing our game helps shed new light on how code-switching may impact your life or the lives of those around you. Thank you!

- Team baconeggandcheese

About the Game

Crown Delights Deli is a visual novel with multiple dialect/language choices. As the cashier at a Brooklyn bodega, choose to talk in English, AAVE, or Spanish to a diverse cast of characters as you try to maintain a five-star rating for your boss.




Code-switch with your bodega customers by selecting choices from three languages/dialects, subtly impacting how they interact with you. Talk in Spanish to the Hipster who is trying to practice their Spanish or chat with your classmate Gian in African American Vernacular English (AAVE).

1807610.name: Skeleton Scramble Deluxe
1807610.about_the_game:
Skeleton Scramble Deluxe is a fast-paced, head-to-head real-time strategy game, with a focus on local multiplayer.

An innovative upgrade system lets you build units on top of one another to create new creatures and buildings, adding strategic depth without adding complexity to the controls.

Controls are simple and easy to learn, allowing new players to jump right into the action! Play one-handed using only the mouse, connect multiple controllers, or play head-to-head with a friend using a shared keyboard! Your army will move and attack autonomously, allowing you to focus on what to build, and when/where to build it. Most games last under 5 minutes, allowing you to experiment with bold new strategies, or rotate between players in group settings. Maps can be generated randomly, allowing for a more chaotic experience.

Planned Launch Features:

  • 2 player local versus with 5 control schemes
  • 10 CPU-controlled bots with a variety of strategies and difficulties
  • Interactive Tutorial
  • Score-based Survival Mode
  • Rogue-lite Gauntlet Mode with stacking player-selected curses

1807740.name: Palliative - Reach for an Angel
1807740.about_the_game:
"A promise made under the petals of the past, kept in the silence of the present."

Palliative - Reach for an Angel is a poignant, linear kinetic Visual Novel that explores the thin line between holding on and letting go. Experience a story about a transfer student, a girl who refused to be defined by her illness, and a football rivalry that became a lifeline.

The Story

Yuu, a transfer student seeking a fresh start, finds himself drawn to the mysterious and gentle Nana at a local 'Halal Mart'. Their bond grows over shared snacks, whispered conversations in the school library, and a solemn Pinky Promise under a legendary sakura tree that blooms later than all the rest.

But as the seasons shift from the warmth of spring to the harsh reality of winter, a devastating secret is revealed. Nana is in palliative care, fighting a terminal battle with Stage 4 Ovarian Cancer.

When the world wants to treat her like a "glass doll," Yuu must learn what it truly means to love someone who is fading: not by mourning them while they are still alive, but by celebrating every "Normal Tuesday" they have left.

Key Features

  • An Emotional Rollercoaster: A carefully crafted Act-based narrative that transitions from a sweet high-school romance into a deep exploration of grief, acceptance, and the "Final Wish."

  • A "Normal" Perspective: Unlike typical tragedies, this story emphasizes the beauty of mundane life—from arguing about football blunders (Go, Manchester Red!) to sneaking into a movie theater just to feel like a teenager again.

  • The "Digital Inheritance": A unique narrative focus on memory. How do we choose to remember those we lose? What do we keep, and what do we delete?

  • Cultural Fusion: Set in a vivid world featuring Indonesian-inspired local spots like the Halal Mart, blending regional warmth with classic Visual Novel aesthetics.

A Message to the Player

This game contains themes of terminal illness and palliative care. It is a story designed to stay with you long after the final petal falls.

Will you keep the promise?

1807810.name: The Axis Unseen
1807810.about_the_game:
The Axis Unseen® is a heavy metal horror game created by one of the developers of Skyrim and Fallout.

Hunt monsters from folklore in a mysterious open world. Discover enhanced sense powers, elemental arrows, magical abilities and journals from people who came to this world before you. Almost all of the UI exists in the world itself.

Beware, the hunter is also the hunted.

Your entire village of Hunters has been slaughtered by the creatures, can you stop them from being unleashed on our world?

Reviews/Accolades

“A knockout indie entry in gaming.” - TechRaptor

“Just Purkey Games has made something special… You’re off the edge of the map. Here be dragons. But if you play it right, the scariest thing in this world might just be you.” -Shacknews

“The Axis Unseen is the most Skyrim-like game I’ve played since Skyrim… stripped back and filtered through the likes of Elden Ring and Praey for the Gods.” - The Escapist

The Axis Unseen is a game with deep combat and hunting mechanics. Follow the tracks and blood trails of the creatures. Pay attention to the wind direction so they can't smell you approaching.

The Axis Unseen can be played both as a stealth game or as an intense action game, depending on your personal style and preference.

For people who want a less hardcore experience, the difficulty can be changed at any time and there is even a pacifist mode where you can take pictures of the creatures to unlock things instead. For an extra challenge, there is a permadeath mode.

The Axis Unseen is a game all about immersion and discovery. Your bow shows important UI elements such as how much noise you are making, how much magic you have left and how visible you are. Creatures will track you with sight, sound and smell and and have specific weaknesses.

You have to check your quiver to see how many arrows you have. Tattoos on your hand light up to show your health and active powers.

Can you uncover the mysteries of this world and how to defeat the creatures?

The Axis Unseen features original music by Clifford Meyer, previously of the legendary post-metal bands ISIS and Red Sparowes. It is a unique blend of heavy metal and primitive instruments. The music dynamically adjusts to what is going on in the game. Sometimes it is atmospheric, other times it is intense metal.

Upgrade your senses with the powers of the creatures. See scent particles. Feel the warmth left behind on their tracks. See colors that no human has ever seen.

Your bow and arrow keeps you alive. Upgrade your bow or even find different arrow types such as fire, wind controlling or time distorting arrows. Experiment to see all the different ways the arrows can interact with each other, such as wind arrows making the fire spread faster.

You have a safe area where all of the monsters, powers, magic, equipment and map sections that you find unlock sculptures and a 3d version of the map to look at to help you navigate the world. You can also use this space to seamlessly fast travel around the world without ever needing to open a menu.

Find out what happened to the Hunters and other visitors to this place who came before you and what secrets they uncovered by finding their journals. Where did this world come from? How do you stop the creatures from escaping into your world? As you explore this world you will also make your own journal entries and drawings about the monsters, powers and equipment that you find.

You are the only one who has a chance to stop these creatures from continuing to escape into our world.

The Axis Unseen® is developed by Nate Purkeypile. Nate Purkeypile has been making games for 22+ years and worked on titles such as Skyrim, Fallout 3/4/76, Starfield, Metroid Prime 3 and BloodRayne 2. He was the Lead Artist on Fallout 76 and the Co-Lead/Lead Artist on the Fallout 3 DLC, Point Lookout.

The 3 maps

  • Normal Maze. Welcome to Obama Maze. This will most likely be your first real course in the game. You will start in a randomly generated brick maze. You must navigate the never seen before generated maze and collect all 7 Obamiums but watch out! You will be chased by none other than former United States President Barack Obama. This maze will not only generate Obamiums but you also will find traps! Traps can be used to slow down Obama so he cannot catch you. Once you collect all of the Obamiums you will hear the maze door opening and it is your job to locate the door and escape the maze.

  • Endless Maze. This maze is similar to the first Normal Maze level however instead of collecting 7 Obamiums there isn't a score limit. 6 Obamiums will be spawned at once so if you cannot find one you surely will find another one.

  • Forest Maze. This maze is unique like the last. Instead of a standard brick maze, you will be navigating a forest. This forest is wide open and dark, you'll easily lose your sense of direction here. Be sure once you collect all 7 Obamiums you head back to the truck which you spawned at.

Once you complete all 3 Mazes you're awarded with self esteem of beating a video game... for now.

Additionally I'd like to warn despite it being a free to play game, that does not mean the system requirements match most other free to play game. You will need a decent computer for this game and if you do not meet or exceed the system requirements you may have a rough time playing the game.

1808150.name: Eggstinct!
1808150.about_the_game:
A Prehistoric Party Gone Wrong

With DOOM LOOMING and the ASTEROID ZOOMING TOWARDS YOU: It is your sacred dino duty to save the eggs from utter Eggstinction! Jump on bounce plants, bounce them off walls, belly slide into the air; create unique trick combinations to increase your score and save the eggs in STYLE.

Play Together, Save Together!

Who said you're the only hero in this story? You're gonna need some help if you want to save as many eggs as you can! Whether it’s flinging eggs across lava flows, bashing through collapsing caves, or soaring over geysers, Eggstinct! thrives on chaotic cooperation. Every run is a comedy of survival—full of triumph, disaster, and laughter as you adapt to unpredictable environments and your friends’ equally unpredictable physics.

Survive Wild, Ever-Changing Worlds

Traverse lush jungles, volcanic islands, storm-tossed beaches, and more! Every biome features randomly generated puzzles, challenges, environmental traps, and unique egg types with surprising properties. You’ll need to adapt, improvise, and evolve your teamwork to bring every egg home intact.

Play Any Way at Any Time!

Whether you're alone, with friends, online, or on the couch with your family; Eggstinct! will feature a way for you to play! Here are some of the ways you can play:

  • Online Multiplayer (Up to 4 Players.. For Now...)

  • Local Splitscreen (Up to 4 Players)

  • Single Player

  • Single Player (with up to 3 Bot Dino Friends!)

Eggciting Gameplay Awaits You!

Eggstinct! will feature a wide-variety of game modes, allowing you to play alone or with friends across a slew of different cooperative, competitive, and unique modes!

  • EGGBALL: Go head to head with your friends to get the most Style Points and score the most eggs in this super competitive versus game mode! Score the egg into your teams nest and prevent the other team from scoring!

  • EGGSPLORE: Fly to a themed island and take on procedural hazards! Explore, take on randomized events, enemies and missions, and save as many eggs as you can before the meteor crashes into the Earth!

  • EGGVENTURE: Navigate through a variety of hand-crafted 3D platformer levels with your friends! Think of this as Spyro or Mario 64 meets Physics-Based Multiplayer Craziness! Complete puzzles, save the eggs, and unlock the secrets as you play through small semi-open worlds!

  • TEAM EGGMATCH: Throw eggs at your opponents to knock them out, and try to become the EGG CHAMPION! Find powerups and try to take home the gold!

A Message From The Creator!

Hello! My name is Jesse Jenkins, and I'm the Founder of Manaforce Studios, and Creator of Eggstinct! Our super small team is the culmination of some incredible talent that has been affected by layoffs across the games industry. It was a direct result of these layoffs that Eggstinct! was born! 

We've all been working in the industry for a long time; we gots a lot of experience!.. But this is our first ever indie title that we're all cooking up from scratch. Eggstinct! is something we knew we could achieve with our resources and talent, and it would be wrong of us to promise something we can't deliver, so guess what, WE'RE DELIVERING! Eggstinct! is a super fun, goofy coop experience that you can play online OR SPLITSCREEN! Toss your friends, smack em' in the head with eggs, and soak up the sunshine until the asteroid comes and obliterates everything! With all of that said, we really appreciate your support in making our first game a reality; we may have experience, but we're a small team, so every bit of your support makes a TREMENDOUS impact!

1808160.name: Demon Spore
1808160.about_the_game:
As a top scientist at a cutting edge genetic research laboratory, you’re racing to solve the problem of feeding an ever growing population. Your team is overstepping ethical boundaries with gene editing in an attempt to breed a new form of livestock that will grow at 100 times the rate of normal animals.

But after an experiment is mysteriously interfered with, it gives birth to a virally spreading mass of tentacles that is consuming everything in its path and evolving into a creature from hell. You must use your scientific experience to learn how the organism behaves, exploit its weaknesses and fight your way to safety.

ENEMY UNKNOWN

An abomination of flesh and tentacles with a taste for organic matter, constantly evolving and adapting, spreading to consume everything in its path. Use any tools you can find to slice through the creature’s tentacles, target its weak spots and stunt the growth. Escape each floor before the growth mutates into something even more horrific.

SURVIVOR TEAM

Team up with friends in local co-op mode where up to 4 players can attempt to escape the lab together. Choose your character and role carefully and watch each others’ backs - you’ll have to work together to survive this tentacle infested hell.

RESOURCEFUL CARNAGE

Use your scientific know-how to re-purpose lab equipment and systems to slow down the growth or create a diversion. Manipulate the lab’s layout to lock doors, create new routes and block the creature’s spread. Cobble together experimental weapons and technology to fight your way to safety in an ever changing environment.

TOUGH CHOICES

Every room reveals new surprises and tough choices. Sneak past the creature before it spots you or set a trap to swing the fight in your favour? Save a scientist to unlock new equipment or cut your losses and race to the exit? But be careful - even your fellow scientists may be unknowingly carrying a dormant growth waiting to release itself…

DYNAMIC ESCAPE ROUTE

Each path has different dangers and different rewards, choose your escape route wisely to stay one step ahead of the creature. Every time you play you face a completely different layout but will learn more of the secrets of the lab and how to use them to your advantage to outsmart your enemy.
