1821600.name: Glyde The Dragon™
1821600.about_the_game:
Free demo available on 10th of JUNE 2024!

Engaging and Epic story!

Witness an epic story as Glyde and Wing set out on an adventure to find out the cause of mysterious corruption that plagues their world! Travel throughout unique regions, heal the land, collect crystals, save other dragons and gain more insight into the story as you progress!

Beautiful and Living World!

Explore many unique and beautiful regions: Travel through green and prosperous forests, swim to the depths of the ocean and beyond. Endure the dry and unwelcoming, desolate deserts and explore mysterious, ancient ruins and caves. Climb harsh and cold, frozen spires as well thundering mountain ranges. Survive molten lands taken by fire and soar among the floating isles high above. These many regions are home to unique elemental factions of dragons, each faction having its own purpose, beliefs, leaderships and their own problems. Different lands, different stories and numerous factions await your arrival!

Fiery and Action-packed Combat System!

Battle both small and large foes, as well as those in-between to protect the world! Experience a deep, challenging and fun combat system! Easy to learn, but hard to master! Use more than 60 powerful elemental abilities unlocked throughout the game! Study the elements in Glyde's arsenal and create your own unique combos in any order you want by mixing and matching various moves on-the-fly! Good timing and strategy is more rewarding than mindless button mashing! Save the world from undead armies and other corrupted creatures threatening the world!

Complete quests, help other dragons, collect crystals, armour and more!

On your journey you will encounter other dragons who need your help! They may offer you quests in exchange for information and/or resources. Help out and you will be rewarded! The world is full of secrets, hidden places, crystals to collect and armour pieces just waiting for you to find them!

Beautiful original soundtrack!

Lose yourself in the epic and melodic music when exploring the world. Listen to a plethora of tracks composed for each of the regions and the many scenarios to capture the grand world of Glyde the Dragon. Epic, legendary and enchanting soundtracks will inspire the dragon within you, from the peaceful forests to the intensity of fiery battles!

Bright, colourful and high quality stylized graphics!

Feast your eyes on beautifully crafted sceneries which aim to deliver unforgettable memories and return to your favourite places whenever you wish! Many graphical options and settings available in the game menu will allow you to enjoy Glyde in the best graphics and performance settings available for your machine!

Interesting and Fully Voiced Characters!

Meet familiar faces and other creatures on your journey while making friendships and sometimes enemies with the inhabitants of the world. Every character you speak to will be fully voiced to make the world feel even more alive!

1821630.name: They Сame From Above
1821630.about_the_game:
They Came From Above is a cute Tower Defense in Lowpoly 3D graphics. Here you have to build an economy and various defense towers to resist hordes of aliens.

To do this, you can choose various strategies, such as abandoning the economy to quickly build up defenses, building up the entire map with simple but cheap towers, or erecting several, but very strong and sturdy improved towers.



When the towers cannot cope with the hordes of UFOs or one cunning alien was able to slip through, then you can use various elemental super-strikes.

In the game you will find many different levels, both in construction and visual, from steppes and glaciers to hell! And also plunge into a pleasant, but sometimes tense atmosphere, accompanied by a cute soundtrack.



Good luck to you earthling to prove to those who came from above that we are not simple and the Earth belongs to us for a reason!

1821670.name: Drachenquell
1821670.about_the_game:
Willkommen in der Welt von Drachenquell, einem epischen Abenteuer, das dich in eine Ära voller Mythen und Legenden entführt. In diesem umfangreichen mittelalterlichen Fantasy-Abenteuer bist du nicht nur ein einfacher Reisender, sondern ein Gestalter deines eigenen Schicksals.

Erkunde die weitläufigen Länder von Drachenquell, wo jede Ecke der Karte mit Leben gefüllt ist. Von den schneebedeckten Bergen, die die Heimat tapferer Zwergenklans sind, über die geheimnisvollen Wälder, in denen Elben ihre uralten Magien weben, bis hin zu den trostlosen Ödlanden, die von gefährlichen Kreaturen und Banditen heimgesucht werden – die Welt von Drachenquell ist reich an Vielfalt und Gefahren.

Stelle dich unzähligen Audgaben, die dich in die dunkelsten Ecken der Welt führen oder dich in die Intrigen der hohen Politik verstricken. Kämpfe gegen furchterregende Kreaturen, untersuche verborgene Dungeon oder enthülle die Geheimnisse längst vergessener Ruinen. In den tiefsten Dungeons warten Schätze auf jene, die mutig genug sind, sich den dort lauernden Schrecken zu stellen.


Jedes Biom in Drachenquell bietet ein einzigartiges Erlebnis und Herausforderungen. Ob du durch die kargen Aschewüsten wanderst, die von Sandstürmen heimgesucht werden, oder dich durch die dichten Dschungel kämpfst, in denen jede Pflanze und jedes Tier eine potenzielle Gefahr darstellt – die Welt ist voller Wunder und Schrecken.

Wähle, ob du als einsamer Wolf in einer selbstgebauten Festung lebst oder ob du dich in das pulsierende Leben einer der Großstädte stürzt. Handwerke, handle und interagiere mit einer Vielzahl von NPCs, die alle ihre eigenen Geschichten und Bedürfnisse haben.

Entscheide dich, für welche Seite du kämpfen willst. Als Verbündeter der Menschen, Elben und Zwerge verteidigst du das Licht und die Ordnung. Oder vielleicht lockt dich die dunkle Seite, und du schließt dich den Untoten, Orks und Dämonen an, um Chaos und Zerstörung über die Lande zu bringen. Jede Fraktion bietet ihre eigenen einzigartigen Fähigkeiten, Waffen und Kulturen.



Bist du bereit, in die Tiefen von Drachenquell einzutauchen und dein eigenes Epos zu schreiben? Das Abenteuer wartet auf dich!

1821680.name: The Adventurer's Domain Online
1821680.about_the_game:
Key Features

TADO features a large shared online world with solo and group content along with third-person action combat. TADO has classless progression system, as you level you gain skill points you can spend to gain access to a wide variety of different skills. Along with combat you can, craft, fish gather and explore both land and sea, and you can do it all together.

Whilst traditional experienced based levelling is important in TADO, you are free to invest the experience you earn in any of the many available statistics giving your character access to different skills, equipment and crafting opportunities.

Want to wield a great sword and cast dark magic? Specialize in the Occult along with Great Weapon fighting and crush your enemies with your power. Perhaps you're more the protector, preferring to keep their friends safe with your heavy armour and shield? Invest your skills into the Protection and Heavy Armour and keep your body between your enemies and those that would harm your friends. Maybe you don't know what you want to be and you just found a rare skill gem that allows you to shapeshift into a great bear to crush your enemies? Well spend your saved points in Druidism, equip your new ability and get right to it!

TADO also offers other more peaceful ways to earn coin and experience including transporting goods, gathering, crafting or even fishing.

TADO features a naval system allowing you to acquire ships and sail the world (with a crew of friends if you have one!) be you a trader buying and selling goods to earn that extra coin or a mighty hunter seeking rare sea creatures for the epic treasures. Playing through the story will see you setup with your first ship and sailing between various locations in the world in no time.

PvP experiences are available and optional, including event based activities you can sign up for and compete for valuable rewards.

TADO isn’t another aimless open world game that just drops you in the open and sends you about your business, there is a core story which you can play through at your own pace, introducing you into the world and setting you up as an adventurer before you make your own mark on the world.

TADO features plenty of solo-friendly content along with some harder dungeons and zones which will require you to bring your party or guild to overcome.

TADO isn’t a huge high budget game with all the edges shaven off in the name of homogeneous balance or maximum engagement, it’s not trying to be. If you’re looking for a place to chill out exploring, crafting rare items, digging up buried treasure, or hitting the seas in search of adventure then look no further.

Your Adventure awaits.

1821690.name: Sakura Sunshine
1821690.about_the_game:
• Rei is having trouble brainstorming ideas for her manga, and is in need of a grand adventure to help inspire her...
  • Join Rei and her pet cat, Koneko, as they explore their beautiful surroundings within Japan. Encounter cute creatures inside Rei's imagination, such as baby birds and goats, or even bonsai trees and rain clouds!
  • Four chapters of unique gameplay await, each with charming landscapes and adorable critters. Every piece of this tale contains secrets to uncover: cutesy new enemies, traps, power-ups, and challenging bosses!
  • With three levels of difficulty, novices and experts alike will find their perfect challenge. Test your abilities further by beating your high-scores in Time Mode!

1821730.name: Nebula Complex Survival
1821730.about_the_game:
Set in the distant Gordon System in the year 3001, Nebula Complex Survival is an open-world, story-driven survival game that plunges you into the hostile environment of Dylan-4. After a catastrophic crash landing in enemy territory, you must harness your wits, skills, and determination to explore, craft, and fight for your very existence until rescue arrives.

Explore the Untamed Wilds

Venture into the diverse and dangerous landscapes of Dylan-4. Gather vital resources, craft essential tools and materials, and adapt to the ever-changing environment. From dense forests to arid deserts, every biome offers unique challenges and opportunities.

Uncover the Secrets of the Past

As you navigate this uncharted world, you’ll come across the remnants of a once-active radio station, the only device powerful enough to send signals through the planet's magnetic field. Repairing and utilizing this station could be key to signaling for help and escaping Dylan-4.

Survive Against All Odds

Dylan-4 is teeming with threats, both natural and artificial. Face off against hostile wildlife, treacherous terrain, and the remnants of enemy forces who may not have entirely abandoned the planet. Craft weapons, build shelters, and use your ingenuity to overcome the myriad dangers that await you.

1821740.name: One More Encounter
1821740.about_the_game:
One More Encounter: The Game That Never Was

On November 17, 1992, a small group of three developers released a video game like no other. Only available for the NEC PC-9801 computer, this was the most ambitious game the industry had ever conceived. Unfortunately, it was a sales failure and was lost in the abyss of time.

More than 30 years later, One More Encounter (a.k.a OME) has been partially revived. One More Encounter was a dungeon crawler where the important thing was not the motif, but the journey itself and the characters we encountered along the way. Unfortunately, only 0.35% of the total game could be saved. That is, of the more than two thousand possible encounters in the game, this version only contains seven.

Be that as it may, this is a look at a world that could have been, an industry that never really took hold, and a type of videogame that, so many years later, we are still struggling to make.

  • Over 6 different characters (there are 8 characters)

  • More than 20 minutes of gameplay (if you're a slow reader)

  • Two or more endings (but you can only get one)

  • Dynamic narrative text (because one letter appears after another)

Disclaimer

Due to problems with the game executable itself, it may have to be restarted several times to complete the game fully. We have tried our best not to do this, but something has prevented us from doing so. We have not been able to find the reason. We hope that, with your help, we can solve this mystery together.

Content Warning

The game has graphic depictions of violence, self-mutilation, and blood. Please, be very careful.

Created by Diego Freire

Art and UI by Fran Segura

SFX and Music by Javier Calderón

1821800.about_the_game:
Stalks Stalks Stalks
Have you ever wanted to make a bunch of money? To get rich by doing nothing? To become wealthy without ever developing a useful skill or trade? What if I told you there was a game that let you live out that fantasy in a pretend world? Well, that game is Stalks Stalks Stalks!

Compete against your friends, strangers, or no one and try and buy and sell stalks to make money. The player with the highest number wins! Everyone else loses! If you get the highest number, congratulations! If you get the lowest number, well, at least you didn't lose anything of real value...

Features

  • Buy stalks
  • Sell stalks
  • Collect dividends
  • Take out loans
  • Pay your loans
  • Default on your loans
  • Go bankrupt
  • Up to 10 players in a game

The game can also be played "single player." Simply create a lobby, ready up, and then click start game to enjoy a nice, relaxing, solo stalks adventure!

A thorough "how to play" write up can be found on itch.io and in the Game Manuals

CardConquest
Also include is the beta of CardConquest, a two player, turn based strategy game where players try and capture their opponent's base or destroy all their units. Choose between the Infantry Commander and Tank Commander and fight for supremacy on your tiny island. There is no luck or RNG involved in winning battles. It is all based on your armies combined power, which is modified by the card each player chooses to modify their attack power. Cards can have special abilities that will alter the outcomes of battles if specified conditions are met. Good luck battling!

Note: This game is in beta. Two player online multiplayer only. No singleplayer version available

Features

  • Turn based strategy
  • Choose between two "commanders" - different numbers of units and different cards
  • Reinforce battles from adjacent tiles - choose wisely!
  • Cards are played to modify battle outcomes
  • Strategically sacrifice cards to maintain higher powered cards
  • Destroy enemy units with your card's attack power (the sword sprite)
  • You can always see what cards your opponent has available before a battle. Plan accordingly!

A thorough "how to play" write up can be found on itch.io and in the Game Manuals.

1821870.name: Rapture - The Beginning
1821870.about_the_game:
Story:

In his endeavor to find the great ancient treasure, he has to overcome the puzzles that are blocking his way. The road to the great treasure is protected by many deadly traps, and he will have to act quickly and use his skills wisely to overcome the obstacles and survive. The big temple walls hide one more deadly secret - the Ancient Guardians.

The Game:
Rapture - The Beginning is a platform adventure game based on solving logical puzzles and avoiding traps while carefully timing your movement and actions

Key Features:
- Player will explore a full 3D constructed world of an ancient desert temple following motives from Egyptian mythology
- Player will face light logical puzzles, as the game progress, the difficulty of the puzzles will gradually increase
- Player will face a different variety of traps, such as arrow projectiles, falling blocks, floor traps, enemies, massive contraptions that destroy everything in their way and much more

1821890.name: The Many Misfortunes of Kyran Pierre Cadenza the First
1821890.about_the_game:
The Many Misfortunes of Kyran Pierre Cadenza the First (and others) is a blend of ‘choose your own adventure’ style storytelling and grid-based strategy combat set within a satirical take on the traditional fantasy setting.

The Many Misfortunes consists of two main types of gameplay, 'Sword' and 'Quill' sequences.

Quill


One-half of the game is set within a tavern long after the events of the story have unfolded. Here, the player takes on the role of the bard, Kyran, telling the tale to an old friend and one of the heroes of the story itself.

Within these sequences, the player will engage with text-based, “choose-your-own-adventure” style scenarios, directly affecting how the story is told as well as which key moments they will get to relive within the 3D “Sword” gameplay.

Sword


The other half of the game unfolds within hand-crafted 3D levels wherein the player relives key moments of the tale being told.

Within our exploration sequences, the player will investigate detailed 3D environments to discover hidden items, interact with a diverse cast of NPCs as well as with various items within the world in order to overcome challenges and progress further into the story.



Within combat sequences, the player finds themselves swept up into tactical, turn-based combat. Here the player will need to use their wits alongside a range of unique character abilities, magical potions, and powerful augments in order to best their foes.

A Tale to Tell


The story itself places you in the shoes of a failed bard turned unpublished author, recounting a tale of past adventure with your companions. As you progress through the tale, you will make choices that influence how the story unfolds and play through key moments shaped by the path you have chosen to walk.

1821980.name: Последний рассвет
1821980.about_the_game:
Действия происходят в альтернативной вселенной.
Вы играете за персонажа, который представляет орден Света, основа, которого это защита людей от темных сил. Персонаж наделен всеми полномочиями, чтобы вершить правосудие над беззаконием, а также сражать силы зла. Герой обвинитель, Судья и Палач. Экзекутор.
Возвращаясь с последней охоты, герой получает послание, в котором сказано, что ему срочно надлежит отправится в некий городок. В письме также говорится, что оттуда давно нет вестей от некого Судьи, отправившегося на поиски одного из еретиков ордена.
Прибыв на место, герой узнает, что на городок обрушиваются полчища нечисти. Жители из последних сил защищают свои дома. Городок наводнили болезни, ужас и страстное желание покинуть это мрачное место.
Где же Судья, где его люди. Почему столько нечисти, зачем им этот городок. Все это Вам и предстоит узнать.

В арсенале героя имеются 3 вида оружия. Каждый из них, можно улучшить или выучить новый. Также, персонаж использует зелья, свитки и другие ингредиенты, для облегчения битвы с врагами. Герой развивает свои навыки с помощью печатей, которые он может получать в процессе игры. Их насчитывается около 6-ти.

В игре предусмотрено развитие городка. Есть основные постройки и дополнительные. Каждые из них можно улучшать и у каждого строения свои функции.
Имеются ресурсы, как камень, дерево, золото, еда, а также сами жители. Население может страдать от различных болезней, что может привести к смерти и его уменьшения. Это не допустимо. Поэтому Вам самим придется выбирать, на какое здание в первую очередь потратить ресурсы, а какое подождет.

Это очень полезные мифические создания. С ними можно заключать контракты, но не бесплатно. Взамен же, они предоставят свои навыки персонажу. Их умения могут как помочь в бою с врагами, так и с развитием городка. Вам уже решать с кем заключать сделку, исходя от своих нужд.

Среди всех невзгод, неудач и поражений, данное событие будет ярким и ободряющим. На ярмарке можно будет приобрести товары, которых не будет в лавке города. Попробовать различные виды блюд, улучшающие на некоторое время параметры персонажа. Сразиться на арене и получить в награду печати. Побывать в локациях, которых нет на карте в поисках особых ингредиентов и так далее. Правда особым видом платежа являются осколки душ, которые герой будет добывать в бою с поверженных врагов.

В процессе игры, герой столкнется с различными событиями, как хорошими так и не очень. Также герою придется делать выбор, за которым могут быть последствия ускоряющие поражение в игре. Персонаж также, после прохождения локации может получать проклятия и болезни. Конечно от них можно избавиться за определенную плату.
Выполняйте дополнительные задания и получайте награду.

Игра находится в разработке. Если стало интересно добавляйте игру в желаемое. Следить за разработкой можно по ссылке

Приятных выходных и до встречи.

1822010.name: Milliopoly - Language Quiz and Learning
1822010.about_the_game:
Become a millionaire by using your language knowledge. Invite your friends and family and practice your own native language or foreign ones! Milliopoly's goal is to assess your knowledge but also for you to have fun while learning. 

Career Mode

Gradually evolve by answering pre-established sets of questions, going through vocabulary, grammar, reading comprehension, and functions. Answer a final test at the end of each unit to test your knowledge and unlock even more challenges. Read explanations, use power-ups, and answer at your own pace. This is the best mode to start your journey through a new language!

Review Mode

Select which languages and which topics of each language you want to practice. Choose how many questions you want to answer. Timed questions will be shown randomly, between 8 and 20 per round. You will see your final result, points, and the coins you earn!

Ranked Mode

Put your knowledge to the test, with limited time for questions, and demonstrate complete mastery of the languages you select. At the end of each round of questions, you will be ranked according to your performance. Become omniscient and compete globally and with your friends.

Secret Word Mode

The best option for visual learners. Look at four images and decipher the hidden word. Do you know how to say it in other languages? Buy a hint or skip a word if it gets too difficult, but don't forget to try it in all 5 available languages, or at least in the easiest version: Polyglot, where you can type the word in any of the game's languages.

Languages available in the game: English, Spanish, Portuguese, French and Italian.

The game is meant for everyone: students in language institutes from around the world, teachers, translators, and anyone who wants to learn, practice, improve or simply have fun with their native language or foreign ones. You should be able to learn and/or practice the differences between Portuguese from Brazil and from Portugal (and from Angola, Mozambique, etc.), the multiple variants of the Spanish language, the English language, and others that get to be added.

A video game classic reimagined

Chances are, you know the drill: You have a paddle to guard your goal. There is a ball. You try your best to bounce that ball into your opponent's goal.

But what if there are not two players, but four? Three balls instead of one? Not to mention items, arena elements – and did you know that the arcade sometimes likes to change? More players! More items! More chaos! More fun!

Up to four players

Invite your friends and have fun in the chaotic arena of Bounce Ball: Neon Party Arcade. Supporting both multiple controllers and all-on-one-keyboard amateur wrestling, you can play it whenever you have friends around. And should your friends not be available, you can play against three different difficulties of AI opponents.

Your friends do have time, but they live too far away? No need to worry, as Bounce Ball: Neon Party Arcade supports Steam Remote Play Together! Only you have to own the game to play with up to three friends via the internet.

Chaos ensues

Do you think four players in one arena is not enough chaos? So do we! That's why we added a bunch of items, both to help you and to hinder your opponents. Make the next goal count twice as much! Switch out the arena elements! Boost your paddle speed!

And if that is not enough, there are the arena elements. They spawn randomly at the start of the game and might reflect your shot in a totally unexpected way. But they might also be perfect to hit your opponent from a different direction. Just be careful to keep an eye out or you will be the one who gets hit!

Multiple game modes to keep things fresh

You think you have mastered the game? Are you beating your friends in every match? Why not change it up by making the paddles smaller or speeding up the ball! You can have multiple balls, turn items on and off and even have the arena change at random. You can also choose between the two radically different modes of Score, where you try to get the most points before a timer runs out, and Survival, where you have a limited amount of lives. But don't worry if your friends are the ones who are always beating you: Even when you have lost all your lives, you will still be able to participate and make their lives harder with well timed items.

1822510.name: Fog & Silver
1822510.about_the_game:
Fog & Silver is set in a fantastic, mystical, and dark reimagined Europe of the late 19th century; with a focus on atmosphere-driven story, powerful items, and in-depth character customization.​​

​Embrace this era of mystery and innovation as a famous person from history or literature, also known as an Exalted. To battle a mysterious foe trying to wipe out Exalted, assemble a highly capable team of fellow Exalted.​




In the world of Fog & Silver, the most advanced technology of the Victorian era and the occult forces from beyond the veil coexist. You experience this wild time of innovation and mystery as an Exalted. One of the most powerful and extraordinary individuals this era has to offer, like Nicola Tesla, Dr. Jekyll, and Mr. Hyde, or Thomas Edison. You are the pinnacle of your field and near untouchable for mere mortals.​

​But there is a deep rift between followers of Technology and the Occult, forcing everyone to pick their side in a struggle for supremacy. Worse even, someone has found a way to threaten the nigh-invincible Exalted themselves. Being an Exalted yourself, you must ensure your own survival by gathering a group of other Exalted and combat this threat before it destroys you and throws the world into chaos.​





The Exalted are humanity’s finest in their fields of expertise; living legends among the common man. Inventors, scientists, scholars, even wielders of supernatural powers.

Gather these paragons of humanity, earn their loyalty and unite against a common enemy.​ They are valuable assets throughout the game and help the player achieve their goals through their unique abilities.​ Cultivating the allegiances of The Exalted unlocks additional player-skills, and branching storylines.​



A fantastic, dark, and magical spin on Europe in the late 19th century serves as the game world, with a focus on location variety.​ The unique locales range from a shipyard in Hamburg, an Egyptian exposition in a Parisian museum, the dungeons of the Tower of London, the Orient Express, a research submarine, the twisted canals of Venice, and an Opera House in Moscow to name but a few.​ Utilizing the Flying Ferdinand, the player traverses the globe, visiting these grim and historical settings, which serve as the backdrop to the world of Fog & Silver.​




The Flying Ferdinand serves as a player hub. It is the living quarters, crafting station, mission deployment area, as well as the epicentre for story progression. In addition, it is the primary mode of transportation for the player.​ Additionally, the Ferdinand’s abilities can be called upon during ground combat allowing players to harness its vast arsenal; potentially turning the tide of a battle.

1822550.name: Microcivilization
1822550.about_the_game:
In Microcivilization you explore, expand, exploit and exterminate all together in a pixel-art strategy-clicker game blend. Start the growth of your population and economical strength while discovering government combinations, hundreds of unique heroes and experimenting with ability builds for combat and construction.

You have many ways to build an obscenely rich and powerful nation. If oppressing your people by furious button smashing is your thing, master the clicker features to your benefit. If faith in your micro-people's good-will and productivity is your style, make use of your workshops and their passive and active abilities. Advancing in technology tree will unlock upgrades, military units, bonuses and new abilities to help you grow and steel yourself for threats to come.

Face hundreds of disasters, wars, diseases, social unrests, invasions and independence declarations that threaten your people. Sometimes you will get beaten, descend into dark ages, famine or ideological mayhem. But have no fear, losing is impossible. In fact, the harder the struggle, the more likely a grand hero emerges from the ashes.

Every crisis you overcome gives you a chance to gain a hero. For your micro-civilization heroes act as inventory items which boost your power. Though you can only have a handful of them equipped at any time, collecting heroes opens endless new effects on your industry, wealth, strength and stability. As you move forward, you will collect higher tiers of heroes, merge them with recipes and form sets to gain absurd powers.

Disasters in this game are no mere random number generator roll. You are in full control of all disaster risks. In fact you know the chance of them happening at any given time so you have chance to mitigate. Uninhabited houses? Chance of fire. Too many people crammed in tight space? Small-pox will probably visit you soon.

Whether by bad luck, or your risk neglect, when a crisis occurs it can be overcome by combat. Fire can be extinguished, disease can be withstood or cured, invasion can be repelled. Regardless of what the problem is, it is always a number of brave micro-people willing to give their lives, who defeat the crisis. In every fight, People are your life, Economy is your strength and Heroes are your weapons. Combine these with workshop abilities and master the combat to become a force to be reckoned with.

History has too many stories to tell in one go. In order to reach the metaphorical stars, you will need to trace back to ancient ages several times, each with a higher purpose. Your Ascension tree contains many challenges organized into Difficulty Tiers each brining new features into the game, more difficult enemies but also access to more powerful heroes, world wonders and ability modifications.

1822560.name: Minabo - A walk through life

Minabo - A walk through life is a social simulation game where you walk the path of life while your turnip grows and thrives (or not) in its social relationships.

Life starts when you sprout, time goes by with every step you take, and you can set your pace at any moment. You live and learn: surround yourself with other turnips and interact with them to forge your personality. Your acquired strengths and weaknesses will affect your future interactions.

Build your social circle by maintaining and caring for the relationships that matter the most to you, and run away from the ones that don't. You can adopt many radish-pets and spend your life with them, start a family and breed little turnips or live fast and die young. There are thousands of ways to live and none is correct! Just live as you wish! (and assume the consequences of your decisions when you rot).

Living and thriving in social relationships is not easy, so Minabo - A walk through life offers collectible hats that produce different effects when worn. Easily falling in love, making everyone hate you, getting an elegance plus or even changing your life expectancy...

1822590.name: Pinni and the Lost Voice

Pinni and the Lost Voice


Pinni and the Lost Voice is a classic adventure platformer with a cute hand-drawn art style. Play as Pinni, a brave little doggy in a mysterious dreamland where the sun and the moon have stopped moving!

The Prologue


Pinni lives on a tiny planet where the day and night cycle are under the control of the Great Great Rooster, a powerful and magical bird that sits atop the highest tower of Hill Village.

The rooster sings every morning to let the sun pass and keep the cycle going.

Until one day, when the Great Great Rooster was ready to perform its daily cock-a-doodle-do, but suddenly it caught a sore throat and lost its beautiful voice! Now the sun and moon are stuck, and the world is split between an endless day and eternal darkness.

You must now embark on a great adventure in order to create a magical cough syrup to cure the Great Great Rooster’s sore throat and save the land from being stuck in time...

Gameplay


Pinni uses powerful barks to stun and parry attacks from the creatures who have been driven wild by the endless night and use his Bark Jump to scale mountains, climb trees, and explore new areas of your strange world.

Your journey will be full of quirky characters, exciting bosses, and many tricky challenges. Along the way, you must collect the necessary magical ingredients to create the mystical cough syrup in the hope of curing the Great Great Rooster's lost voice.

1822640.name: Rogue Dungeon
1822640.about_the_game:
Rogue Dungeon is highly re-playable and dripping with theme. Not very many games let you go from zero to hero in thirty minutes. It's a loot management game at its core and that's where it's charm comes from. You might start the game with a hunk of meat, that you use to charm a wolf, who helps you defeat the zombie who drops a lockpick, which you use to open the safe, where you find the jeweled goblet, which you trade for a lucky shield, which you use to block the Dragon's fire.

Rogue Dungeon is hard and you will DIE! However, experience and skillful play will ensure that veteran Rogues will make it out of the dungeon alive. That's more than you will. You, you're going to end up in a Goblin's belly. Prove us wrong!

Pick your Rogue, grab your starting loot, grab your skills, set your starting stats and enter the dungeon. Choose which room to navigate to via the mini maps. Rooms are divided into the following types....



Traders - Offer you a choice to trade loot or stats for other loot, stats, or henchmen. Some trades involve a stat test or the luck of a die. Loot traders typically trade two items for any one item they offer for trade. They make exceptions for the shiny stuff and will trade any item for a single treasure.



Combat - Most combat rooms draw 1 to 3 monsters from the monster deck equal to the dungeon level. Combat is resolved using your Rogues primary stat and a D10. If the two combined are greater than the monsters combat stat, your Rogue hits the monster. If it's less, the monster hits your Rogue. If equal, both are hit. Damage can be negated by discarding an armor or by playing a skill or magical item. Potions and food can be consumed at any time to increase your health and prevent your death. Some monsters have a weakness to specific thematic loot and are vanquished immediately such as when the Medusa gets a look at her face in the mirror's reflection. Once a monster's health reaches zero, the monster dies and you receive one loot and XP equal to the dungeon level.



Traps - traps litter the dungeon but most can be disarmed or bypassed if you have the appropriate equipment. Even if the gremlins ran off with your rope, there is always a chance you can come out unscathed if you pass an appropriate Strength, Agility or Intelligence test. If successful, tests result in an XP reward and avoiding any potential damage.

All rolls maybe manipulated with the use of the luck stat. Spending one luck will allow you to modify a die result by 1 up or down, or allow for a complete reroll.

Play progresses through 5 dungeon levels separated by a staircase. You may camp at the stairs without the threat of a wandering monster interrupting your siesta. You may level your Rogue at anytime so long as you have the XP. When you get to the final room, draw a boss monster and fight. Many monsters have special abilities activated depending on your attack roll. They can summon additional monsters, drain your level, heal, etc...

1822710.name: Automon

1822760.name: Bleu
1822760.about_the_game:
Sonia was a brilliant artist, always getting lost in her own little world as she painted away at her canvas. But there was something strange about her. Everyone around her felt like she was hiding something... Now she's dead. And you need to figure out who killed her.

Become a detective and solve the mysterious case of Sonia Verninac's murder.

  • A first-person detective adventure unlike any other!
  • Snoop around the crime scene, follow your leads and unravel a fascinating mystery.
  • Take photographs of ANYTHING and use those photos as evidence...
  • Question people of interest. Separate the truth from the lies, and call out people's contradictions.
  • Make an arrest. You can accuse ANYONE... AT ANY TIME.

A CAPTIVATING MYSTERY. Sonia had always seemed like a nice and bright young girl... But it seems she had some secrets that nobody knew about. What was she doing all alone in those abandoned public toilets? Why would someone kill her in such a horrifying way? Dive deep into the mystery and figure out the truth behind her gruesome murder.

A UNIQUE APPROACH TO EVIDENCE. In this game, you will take photos of anything you see. You can take a photo of ANYTHING and EVERYTHING you choose, and you'll use those photos as evidence when you want to make arrests, get search warrants and call others out for lying. Since you can take photos of anything, the possibilities for evidence are endless. This is a detective game that won't hold your hand...

A COLOURFUL CAST OF CHARACTERS. There are a fair few with ties to the victim, some more fishy than others. Everyone has a story of their own. Some may even have something to hide. Question anyone. Ask them about any evidence you've collected. And if you think they're lying at any point, call them out using evidence you've collected.

GO ANYWHERE, AT ANY TIME. You are never limited in where you go. Go anywhere. Follow leads at your pace. Go back to the crime scene. You can't miss anything, as everything is static. This world is a sandbox, and it's yours to investigate and explore as freely as you wish.

YOU MAKE THE ARREST. This isn't some linear narrative. At any point, you can accuse anyone of being the killer. Use the evidence that you've collected, and create a case that proves your suspect is the killer. The killer is somewhere. Don't rule out anyone too easily...

1822770.about_the_game:
Abduction is a singleplayer psychological horror experience, similar to Slender: The Eight Pages. When unexpected visitors arrive in the middle of the night, you must defend your farm in order to take back your land.

Use your flashlight to ward off enemies or stay in the shadows to avoid confrontation. Listen to your surroundings to detect danger and unveil alien landmarks. Discover the source of your enemies power and put an end to their invasion.


Features:


  • Investigate distant noises
  • Avoid being spotted
  • Discover other-worldly technologies
  • Break the seemingly endless cycle



EPILEPSY WARNING

1822880.name: Elon
1822880.about_the_game:
Elon is a Space Survival Craft game where you play as Elon, a normal maintenance person on a space station in the future.
After a mysterious accident you are left are stranded, floating through space on a piece of a the space station. Mine asteroids for materials and build tools to help you craft supplies, stations, cosmetics, and additional Hubs to expand what is now your home.
But be warned space is a dangerous and deadly place where one mistake can mean certain death.
Can you defy the odds and survive stranded in space?

Explore unique and beautiful space-scapes. Mine and gather resources, craft and build customizations and upgrades, and travel through space to amazing destinations. From planets and nebulas to blackholes you never now what you might see.

Elon is being developed by the indie studio MonoBehavior, a small but passionate company bringing a new take to survival craft. Join them as they take us all on an atmospheric and beautiful journey where we are reminded of the very simple fact: space is a dangerous place.

KEY FEATURES

Unique and fun gameplay — Survival in space is hard. You need food, water, and oxygen just for starters. Luckily the universe has everything you need, with the help of a bit of technology. Can you build a home and survive in a place where one mistake can mean a certain and slow death. Did you go to far from the station? Did you ignore the warnings? Now you don't have enough compressed gas to get back? That's life, or rather, death in space.

A Universe of possibilities — The Universe is huge and full of resources. With nothing but the but home out of your reach your free to build and explore. From small hubs to giant planet sized stations the universe is yours to fill.

Co-op Coming Soon — Space can be lonely soon you can invite a friend to join you.

1822890.name: Howling Dusk
1822890.about_the_game:
Howling Dusk is a single-player first-person survival game set in a large open-world island wilderness environment where the player must maintain vitals such as hunger and thirst while avoiding attacks by predators, and extreme weather, and disease. It blends emotional experiences from a peaceful almost meditative natural setting to moments of suspense and fear. The game is targeted at the teen to mature, casual, or hardcore survival game players on a PC platform.

Features
  • Large interactable realistic open-world environment
  • Building and crafting systems using raw materials from the environment
  • Freedom to explore and build
  • Daytime/ nighttime and change of seasons
  • Choice of starting scenarios
  • RPG style leveling and skill-building
  • Realistic Survival experience.
  • Variety of wildlife for players to interact with

1822900.name: Soulflow
1822900.about_the_game:
Soulflow is a 2.5D fantasy-detective game that offers a unique experience with its graphic style. In this story-based role play game, the player must gather information from others during the day and try to solve the murders in the neighborhood to stay free.

For the soul to be free, the body must die. In other words, players have to figure out who is going to die. It does this by "saluting", that is, by changing the body. When the actor who plays the soul greets another character, he takes control of that character and begins to see the world through his eyes. In this way, he can carry out dialogues with different combinations with different people. Thus, new information is obtained through the story and the game is shaped. "Finding the character to die", which is the prerequisite for our freedom, is achieved with the information we have gained in the story. Of course, the story does not progress with dialogue alone. We can get information about the items and characters in different houses.

We can control our clock in the game and learn how much time is left until the end of the day. If we cannot be in the character who will die despite what we have done during the day, the day ends and starts from the beginning, we gather the information we have gained in the spirit book on our bedside and continue the game. The spirit also has the ability to enter different creatures in the neighborhood. The spirit that enters animals can control them: they can run fast, jump, and enter small places that human-sized ones cannot. In this way, he can get different clues. Soulflow is played with a keyboard and mouse. A simple color palette is used. (black and white) There are eight main characters in the game. All of the main characters can be entered and a conversation can take place between that character and the others. The game takes place in a small neighborhood. The neighborhood has several houses, a cafe, a clock tower, and a cemetery.

Bluespy Studio offers you the most unique visuals and gameplay.
1822900.supported_languages: English, Turkish, French, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese

1822910.name: Capybara Spa
1822910.about_the_game:
Receive capybaras & their friends!
Welcome into your spa the animals wandering around the mountain! As you improve your spa, new animals will visit such as turtles, frogs, otters and ducks. Place capybaras in the spa along with other animals... they might even befriend them during their stay!


Grow fruits & craft soaps to care for your visitors!
Plant gardens and harvest snacks such as lemons, oranges, strawberries & blueberries to feed your capybaras! Visitors will also have other requests during their stay at the spa such as towels, flowers and soaps. Make sure to fulfill the requests quickly to keep the animals happy and pampered!


Restore & furnish a mountainside spa!
Improve your spa's popularity to unlock new furniture such as baths, fruits gardens and flower beds. Expand your spa along the mountain and place decorations to design your own capybara spa!


Bring in insects to help you manage the spa!
Run everything smoothly with the help of butterflies, ladybugs, bees and dragonflies! They'll fly around and assist you to fulfill the capybaras' requests as you grow your spa and welcome more visitors!

1822940.name: Sorcerer's Tournament
1822940.about_the_game:
Sorcerer's Tournament is a turn-based RPG with mini-games for training your character, gameplay is focused on growing and improving between each duel.
As you win duels and tournaments you will permanently unlock new spells, modes and difficulties.


Winning Through Sheer Force Is Not The Only Option

In this game's duels you will face opponents that might out-last you rather than out-damage you.



Train Your Student And Manage Your Time Carefully

Use the time you have to train carefully as an extra damage might not be as important as learning that new spell.

Features Include

  • learn unique spells that can fuse with modifiers into 110 spell combinations
  • choose the school and student
  • play challenging mini-games training each major stat
  • unlock special game modes
  • fight magic battles to your heart's content!

1822970.name: Shadowgate VR: The Mines of Mythrok
1822970.about_the_game:
RE-LIVE SHADOWGATE

The first book in the Shadowgate Saga, Shadowgate VR: The Mines of Mythrok brings the hit adventure series to virtual reality! On the 35th anniversary of the original release of Shadowgate, you can now step into the fantasy world of Kal Torlin like never before, immersing yourself completely in this exciting action/adventure game! With Odin the raven as your guide, and four difficulty levels to fit your play style, it's time to discover what secrets await within the Mines of Mythrok!


DELVE DEEP

Launched in 1987 on the Apple Macintosh, Shadowgate is the granddaddy of first-person, fantasy adventure games. Developed by Dave Marsh (founder of Zojoi) and Karl Roelofs, Shadowgate has been redesigned and/or ported it to over 15 platforms. While the beloved game has been critically well-received, it has never achieved the ultimate goal of its creators - actually being inside the fantasy world. That is, until now. Don your headset, unsheath your powerful wand and move through the Dwarven halls of Mythrok, solving puzzles, confronting monsters and fulfilling your destiny!


EXPLORE ANCIENT DUNGEONS

Marvel as you move deep into the Dwarven mountains, through mystic chambers, trap-laden hallways and massive caverns.

SOLVE DEVIOUS PUZZLES

Use your wits to divine magical symbols, disable hidden traps, and decipher ingenious riddles.

WIELD ELEMENTAL MAGIC

Arm yourself with a sorcerer’s wand and impervious shield, perfect for disarming dungeon defenses and incinerating the deadly denizens that lurk in the shadows.


RIDE DWARVEN MINECARTS

Ready your wand, step aboard ancient minecarts and discover what the Dwarves unleashed deep within the mountains.

IMMERSE YOURSELF IN THE SOUND DESIGN

Composer Rich Douglas returns to bring Shadowgate to life with a killer sound design.

EMBRACE YOUR FAMILIAR

Your faithful companion, Odin the Raven, is at your beckon call to show you hidden secrets and provide hints and sarcastic quips in equal measure.


PERSONALIZE YOUR ADVENTURE

Collect gold to customize your wand and shield with new skins. You can even put awesome hats on Odin or completely change his appearance.

CHOOSE YOUR DIFFICULTY LEVEL

Four different difficulty levels are available, accommodating novice players to hardcore adventurers.

UNLOCK ACHIEVEMENTS

Search the dungeons and solve its mysteries if you wish to unlock 11 different achievements.


PLAY YOUR WAY

Personalize your game play experience by taking advantage of our wide range of settings. Arachnophobe? No problem! Our Silly Spider option has you covered!

ADVENTURE AWAITS!

Come experience this classic adventure in a whole new way!
1822970.supported_languages:

1822970.reviews:
“With a shift from stationary puzzling to action-oriented (but still with puzzles!) Shadowgate VR is an important step for the franchise. It preserves the soul of the original, but modernizes it for a whole new audience. This first chapter is a taste of things to come, and I’m excited for it.”
90 – Gaming Trend

“Overall, the first chapter comes together as a wonderfully fun and exciting dungeon crawler. Shadowgate is a superior first VR effort from the Zojoi team. They have struck an engaging balance between the roots of the game, the tropes of the fantasy genre, and the spatial and immersion possibilities that VR offers for gaming. Hopefully, there will be more VR chapters of the Shadowgate saga to enjoy in the future.”
85 – COGconnected

1823020.name: Retro TV Game Collection
1823020.about_the_game:
Retro TV Game Collection is exactly that, a package of four time-honored classics from the dawn of home video games.




Tennis
The one that started it all, known by many names, an instantly recognizable institution of gaming history.

Football
Licensed players and teams? of course not! better to see your friends fall to pieces as you score the last minute winner? Absolutely.

Squash (Practice Mode)
Tired of being humiliated by your friends or the CPU? Practice against nothing but the wall. Hone your reflexes and see how high you can score.

Squash
Put those practice sessions to the test, same wall, new opponent.





It may have taken 50 years but all games now feature these much needed improvements.

  • Paddles no longer vanish off-screen!
  • Steam Remote Play!
  • CPU opponent means a new 1 player mode!
  • A score limit!
  • A pause button!
  • Full controller Support!
  • Stats!
  • Assist Mode!
  • Steam Cloud Saves!
  • Achievements!
  • Unlockables!
  • Co-op mode!





All updates will be FREE, FOREVER!!!!
REALISTIC MODE - Sometimes quality of life updates are just not needed and only the original will do.
AFTER THAT - Let us know, anything else missing? something not quite right? Get in touch.

1823030.name: Cursed Broom
1823030.about_the_game:
Fly, teleport, and wall-jump your way through increasingly difficult levels. With the Broom, the Hat, and the enchanted Shoes, you’ll unlock powers that make every move feel exhilarating. Master the art of flying and discover new ways to outsmart every obstacle. But watch out, because it looks like that broom might not work as intended.

Join Maya as she embarks on a journey of self-discovery after an unexpected encounter with the young witch, Robbyn. Together, they hunt down an enchanted runaway printer, face magical challenges and uncover secrets along the way. Will Maya learn to accept who she truly is?

Every level is packed with secrets and hidden spellbook pages designed to test your skills. You will fail, but with every retry, you’ll get closer to mastering Maya’s powers and claiming every collectable. You enjoy speedruns? Race against the clock! Join our community on Discord to share your best time!

From the grimy depths of the Sewers to the vibrant City streets and the dangers hiding in the Clouds, each level offers a unique atmosphere and thrilling challenges. Every step forward reveals something new to explore! Can you make it to the witch city floating high up in the sky?

1823070.name: Mugen Journey
1823070.about_the_game:
Accompany your mecha ally in this wild 3D platform game. Dodge the crazy storms to survive and manage to slash all the shards through your path to victory.

Be the robot to endure the deserts burning with storms in our stylized game. You need to slash as much shard as possible to obtain the best point. How long are you going to last?

Features:
Single Desert Map
Infinite Gameplay
Stylized Graphics

1823080.name: Dark Invasion VR: Doomsday
1823080.about_the_game:
A captivating, creepy, and brutal VR horror first-person shooter with quests and weapons! Experience the onset of the Dark Invasion and get ready to survive the first episode of "Dark Invasion VR: Doomsday."

"Dark Invasion VR: Doomsday" is a horror VR shooter with a story-driven campaign and quests. Fight your way through a bunker infested with zombies, monsters, mutants, and aliens using melee weapons, handguns, shotguns, and rifles.

You play as John Beggart, a member of a reconstruction team working in an old bunker that survived World War II. John shivers as he enters the bunker, unaware that his world is about to collapse. He reminisces about playing hide and seek with Karen at this cursed place, 20 years ago—she got lost and was never found again.

No one was prepared for what happened next as the city was overrun by zombies, mutants, and aliens. As the apocalypse unfolds, our hero is in the old bunker. He must navigate his way through the underground basement and survive the full force of the violence from the undead army of the Dark Invasion!

Take control of the situation, fight as John in VR, and find a way out of this cursed place.

Quests, zombies, and weapons!

Fast-paced action VR horror shooter
Adventure elements and quests
Combat with melee weapons, ranged weapons, and grenades
Story-driven campaign
Best horror 3D surround sound
Limb dismemberment, violence, and blood
Free locomotion
Room scaling
Be the hero

We plan to develop an episodic player experience:

Episode 1: Bunker Doomsday is included in the current version. We plan to add more maps, quests, bosses, and story elements in the upcoming updates.
Episode 2: The City. We are planning and already working on a city overrun by zombies with various locations and quests.
Episode 3: The Alien Ship. We plan to add Episode 3 soon after completing Episode 2.

We plan to introduce boss fights and mid-boss fights to the game with later updates.

A violent and brutal VR first-person shooter with a creepy story, zombies, guns, and quests.

At a later date we plan to add a skill system and customizable weapons, as well as many other improvements.

1823090.name: Mikoshi: The Lost Crystals
1823090.about_the_game:
Welcome to Mikoshi!

Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of the retro cyberpunk world of Mikoshi!  A unique combination of dynamic gameplay requiring skill and precision, a deep story that reveals the secrets of the world and characters. The vibrant visual style, neon aesthetic and soulful soundtrack create a unique atmosphere of 1990's games. Jump, fight, hack into systems, control various vehicles and drones! Uncover the conspiracy, find the lost crystals of the Mikoshi Temple!

Game Features

  • 1990's cyberpunk platformer

  • High quality graphics

  • Each level is a unique location

  • "Comics"-style game Trailers

  • Bonus levels

  • Epic boss battles

  • Gain XP to open new perks

  • Secrets hidden throughout

  • Hacking enemy drones, control it, driving different vehicles 

  • Interesting story, dialogs, characters

  • Hardcore gameplay challenges

1823100.name: The Pest
1823100.about_the_game:
Johnny is a funny and friendly guy. He is curious, clever and ingenious. And also, he's a virus... Yeah, literally a computer virus, seriously. Like a dangerous computer virus meant to send the world into chaos... Do you think it can be a problem?


Johnny is the unique computer virus designed to adapt to challenges he encounters. So on your way to the Core, you will need all three of Johnny's forms:
  • Standard square form - average speed and jump height but stronger than other forms so is able to move objects
  • Tall form - low speed and high jump height, the best to drop through narrow spaces or get to high places
  • Flat form - high speed and low jump height, can squeeze under a low ceiling and fast enough to avoid dangers
You will need to understand all three forms to help Johnny on his path.


Octagon - is the headquarters of the World Security Organisation, which is responsible for order and control over the world. And now Johnny is on his way to the Core of the global security system. Just imagine what a disaster can be caused by a pest in such a system. But never mind, the system is protected with lasers, traps and unbitable puzzles, and any pest wouldn't be able to squeeze inside. They are sure of it, but with ingenuity and sleight, any system isn't impenetrable ;)


So, as we accompany Johnny on his journey, maybe we should stop him? Possibly destroying the world is a bad idea? But the Programmer created Johnny with a purpose, how can "son" go against his "father"? Why should the world be destroyed?
Oh, so many questions. I have a headache. Please, go and find your own answers in hidden parts of the system's labyrinths and help Johnny make the right decisions.

1823170.name: Cosmos Bit
1823170.about_the_game:
Start playing with the space warrior Stella Mironova and explore levels filled with monsters, traps and puzzles.
In Cosmos Bit you'll discover 8Bit’s charm again in a game structure
that draws inspiration from the first and unforgettable Metroid of 1987.

Features:

  • A tribute to the Metroidvania genre!
  • Retrogaming pixel art style!
  • High level Synth Wave soundtrack signed by Jake D. Bind!
  • Collect minerals and develop your skills!
  • Unlock new skills in order to get stronger!
  • Wide variety of monsters and environments!
  • Puzzles to solve!
  • 4 boss to find and defeat!
  • The challenge level is high but not frustrating!
  • Achievements!
1823170.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Russian

1823190.name: A Violent Revelry
1823190.about_the_game:
Run around hitting people and be rewarded for it! Swing, thrust, dodge, parry, block, push, lead, sneak, cast, burn, freeze, poison, shock, stun, crit, and fail your way through increasingly difficult scenarios as the world adapts to your presence.




Items and spells are hidden throughout the procedurally generated world behind locks, recipes, maps, quests, and puzzles. A chest may require information from a distant library to open, magic may require particular circumstances to learn, and nothing remains where it was in the previous playthrough.




Pray to the gods and gaze into the Qosmic sky to develop your character with over 80 unique stats that range from simple to ridiculous. Build weapons from scratch using the parts you've discovered - each with its own stats to consider - and balance these parts into the weapon's weight, center of gravity, and resource cost to create something unique to your situation.

1823200.name: Jumanji: Wild Adventures
1823200.about_the_game:
Drop into the dangerous game world of Jumanji and start a thrilling adventure, as you search for the stolen jewel, The Jaguar’s Eye, and a way home!

Choose your avatar from heroes Smolder Bravestone, Ruby Roundhouse, Mouse Finbar, and Shelly Oberon, and explore uncharted territories home to fierce predators, warring factions and devious traps that can sweep you off your feet.






Survive the jungle to reach new zones including forgotten villages, icy mountains, dark caves, and fetid swamps. And always be ready for new threats, because the Jumanji drums could strike at any moment!






As you level up your heroes through experience and purchase upgrades with your hard-earned loot, you’ll gain the strength to take on bosses like the cunning Smuggler and vicious Siberian Tiger. You may even discover some of Jumanji’s most secret rooms and lost treasures.






The quest to recover the Jewel of Jumanji has evolved. If you want to get home, go big with adventure! Quest alone or in local multiplayer for up to four explorers.

1823210.name: Breeze in the Clouds
1823210.about_the_game:
Become a force of nature

Before the storm hit, Breeze was just an ordinary dog living an ordinary life with his best friend, Diana. But all that changed one night when freak winds ravaged the town, awakening long-dormant powers within the unsuspecting pup!

Suddenly Breeze finds himself whisked away to Tropolis—a strange world in disarray, where weather is controlled and maintained by a squabbling bureaucracy of natural forces from across the animal kingdom. If he wants to find his way back to Diana, Breeze must harness his newfound abilities, master the elements, and fight the forces of pollution threatening to destroy the world.

                                                  Breezy Brawling Adventure 

Take control of a clever, scrappy, and courageous corgi, and embark on a fast and fluid 2D action-packed adventure. Master the abilities of Wind, Cloud, and more, as you battle against foes in dynamic, combat-heavy sequences. Use the elements to your advantage, unleashing devastating attacks with lightning-fast combos, ferocious finishers, and elemental transformations that bring new tactics to the fight.

                                               Battle The Elements - No, Really! 

Breeze will venture through diverse weather domains ruled by the fiercest natural forces: icy wolves, watergun-slinging platypuses, and sulfur-spitting hyenas. There are over a dozen bosses, each presenting a unique challenge that tests both Breeze’s combat skills and his ability to adapt to their weather-based powers.

                                                           Who’s a Good Boy? 

Join Breeze in uncovering the mystery behind Tropolis' turmoil, take down the corrupt forces controlling the weather, and teach the inhabitants that only by working together can they save their world from destruction. Summon support characters to help you in combat and change the weather in your favor. Converse with a big, colorful cast to gather knowledge, solve problems, and earn items.

                                                     Hip, Smooth, Breezy Groove 

Explore the clouds to the tune of a soundtrack filled with jazz, new jack, swing, samba, and more nostalgic sounds—crafted by musicians with a love for classic genres and the world of video game music.

Breeze in the Clouds is crafted by a team of animation-loving, video-game-enamored artists, designers, and developers from around the world. In bringing Breeze to life, the team worked with a meteorologist to bring elements of real-world weather into the gameplay.

1823250.name: Wingsuit Thrill
1823250.about_the_game:
In this game, you can fly over beautiful landscapes to relax and enjoy the view. Or you can challenge yourself whenever you feel the need to spice up your flight. It's up to you!

Some game features:
  • Choose between a set of landscapes to fly over;
  • Change cameras whenever you feel like (including 1st and 3rd person cameras);
  • Choose between multiples starting points in the landscape;
  • Use your smoke device to draw something in the sky;
  • Use the in-game radio to choose what you want to listen to while flying;
  • Take photos of the views you like;
  • Change the time of the day you wanna fly.

Follow Pixelynt on Twitter and Instagram ( @pixelynt ) to keep up to date with Wingsuit Thrill news!

1823260.name: Gravix
1823260.about_the_game:
Gravix is a challenging single-player, puzzle-style, arcade game where you control the direction of gravity to manipulate both your avatar (represented by a small block) and other objects in the level.

The goal is simple, yet addictively challenging: Search and find the exit portal while safely navigating your avatar through a maze of obstacles where everything is affected by the gravity that you control!

Features

  • Simple controls Control the direction of gravity whereby affecting everything in the level (including you) with 4 keys: up, down, left, and right.
  • Advanced 2D physics Enhanced physics simulation provides challenging and responsive actions and reactions.
  • Community high scores High scores are saved in a community score board.
  • Challenging mechanics and engines With each chapter, new arsenal of challenging mechanics and obstacles are introduced.
  • Engaging soundtrack Gameplay visuals affected by an arcade-style soundtrack.

1823300.name: Untamed Isles
1823300.about_the_game:
On an isle of unlimited possibilities, what path will you choose?

Untamed Isles is a MMORPG that offers a living world for monster tamers to explore.

These untamed islands allow the tamers to follow their own calling and create their own path. So tamer, what is your calling on the island? Explore the isles with other pathfinders? Build the perfect tame? Cement your legacy as the ultimate battler? Whatever journey you choose, you will be undertaking it with a team of loyal tames by your side.



Most tamers will never meet the same tame twice in the isles. Every base tame has 5 different body parts that can be mixed and matched with other tames. There are also 15 unique moods with different perks and aesthetics, further customizing available tames.

With ten base tames, there will be over 1,500,000 possible tame combinations to discover.






Be among the first adventurers to discover the world of Untamed Isles. Explore isles that are constantly evolving, with a unique weather system changing the environment around you. Possible tame encounters are adjusted based on the weather, time of day, and island biome.





Your tames, your team: Venture into the wilderness to encounter your own monster to tame. The possibilities for unique tames are endless, with 15 subtypes known as “moods” and 5 different body parts that can be mixed and matched. With countless combinations, every tame you encounter could result in a unique and powerful find.
Explore open-world isles: The Isles are full of rich experiences that are constantly evolving. The unique weather system means tame encounters are adjusted based on the weather, time of day, and island biome. The Isles are continuously expanding, with new islands rising from the ocean, each of which will have its own mysteries and stories to conquer.
Master your craft: Grow your reputation and unlock exclusive items through professions. Become a master at fishing, fruit catching, rune charging, and bug catching.
Combat: Turn-based combat never felt so good. Set yourself up for success with live spectate combat and master your strategy.
Harness the power of crystals: Tamer, meet crystals. Crystals are one of your best friends in the world of Untamed Isles. Crystals are used to befriend tames and represent your tames while you travel.
Better together: Join forces with friends or battle other tamers aided by our proximity voice chat.

1823320.name: The Voluptuous DEMON QUEEN and our Shoebox Apartment Life
1823320.about_the_game:
Haruhiko Shigiyama—You're a boring office worker who works for a bad company (in office supply retail).
You live alone as an obese virgin in your tiny four-and-a-half mat shoebox of an apartment, which is itself a disused relic of a bygone era.
Your libido is incredible, but with no cash and no credit, you can't afford to clean yourself up, let alone afford the services of the ladies of the night.
Every night, you get home exhausted. You eat, if only for the nourishment, and then collapse to sleep like a pile of mud on the floor. Every morning you wake up, and do it again.
Your room is a mess that you never clean up, a reflection of the desolation in your heart. Still, you never snap: You hold it together, in a twisted subversion of your gentle nature.

One day, things change.
“What cramped, filthy confines. Protists. This is why we call them primitive, I suppose.”
You've just gotten back to your decrepit apartment and slunk your blubber into the futon...
That's when an explosion of light and a flood of sound fill your apartment.
There, like a thunderclap, stands a stranger. You stand stunned.

She's beautiful. Some category past supermodel that you've never even heard of. It's well beyond the level of just a pretty face.
She exudes natural confidence in an aura so strong you can see it. Her sculpted face screams sex with a kind of perfection that not even her disgruntled expression could ever hope to scratch.

And then—then there's her chest. Stunning, voluminous mounds. To put it vulgarly, hot DAMN those are nice tits.
You do a quick double-take. Those things would put any porn actress to shame.
If the rest of her were any less breathtaking, you might not be able to get your eyes off them. Those breasts are enough of a feast for the eyes to satisfy you for a lifetime, on their own.
On top of which, her clothes aren't doing much to hide them. More than half of their curvaceous expanse is right there, exposed, for you to worship.

The game is set in our day and age. You play as our young amnesiac hero, who woke up from a year-long coma into an unknown world. He remembers nothing and recognizes no-one from his former life. What happened to him? That’s for you to find out.

The game is populated by a variety of characters, each with their own distinct personality, background and secrets.
Special attention and care is put into the quality of the images and animations.


GAMEPLAY:


  • More than 2500 images
  • More than 200 animations
  • More than 20 characters
  • Free Roam
  • Many locations to explore in detail
  • Time Cycle
  • Relationship system.
  • A variety of fetishes
  • Task log
  • Phone
  • Achievements
  • Secrets and easter eggs


WHAT’S COMING:


This is how I want the game to look. It is a Free Roam title, with each character having their own schedule and story. The main storyline develops along with the protagonist's relationship to the main characters: Alexandra, Kate and Elena. The basic outline of these relations is a system of 6 levels, with each increasing level allowing for new interactions in Free Roam.

As the main plot develops, the player character will encounter secondary characters (girls). I’ve already written about 10 of these secondary girls, but the idea is to bring this number up into the dozens, with each girl having their own plot and relationship levels (from 0 to 5): each level will bring up hotter and hotter encounters.

EARLY ACCESS:


“Early access” means that you can start playing right now, but you’ll find that some of the game’s features are still to be fully developed. For example, I’m planning to introduce various mini-games which will help in upgrading the player character and advancing the plot. The game features voice acting, but it’s still a ways to go from the level of professionalism that I’d like for each of the animations. I would also like to introduce skills for the main character which will weigh-in on his interactions and make branched scenes according to each player’s particular dialogue choices. Finally, I want to take the post-processing of images and animations to the next level. For this, I will probably need to get a powerful workstation, in order to produce higher resolution images and 60fps animations: all for the sake of perfection!

I also plan to fully develop the plot beats and interactions of supporting characters, but only after the main storyline is finished.
