1823550.name: Bonobros
1823550.about_the_game:
## Un jeu en ligne ##

Bonobros est un jeu de stratégie tour par tour en ligne multijoueur dans lequel plusieurs joueurs s’affrontent sur une grille pour tuer le roi adverse. Créez votre roi selon votre style, faites votre choix parmi les pions inspirés d’influenceurs connus pour construire des compositions et des combos uniques pour remporter la victoire.

## L’échiquier ultime ##

Ce jeu gratuit en ligne propose des combats tactiques au tour par tour simultané pour créer des parties plus dynamiques et de nouveaux styles de stratégies. Il se découpe principalement en deux phases : une phase de préparation où tous les joueurs préparent leur prochain coup et une phase de combat où ils le mettent en pratique.

Une partie se déroule sur une carte quadrillée où chaque pion peut se déplacer de case en case. Chaque joueur est placé dans un coin de la carte et dispose d’un roi et de 5 pions et doit réduire les points de vie du roi adverse à 0 pour remporter la partie.

Aujourd’hui, le jeu est construit sur une base de 2 joueurs qui s’affrontent en duel, mais avec un ajustement de la carte, il est tout à fait possible d’adapter le jeu pour un modèle équipe contre équipe ou chacun pour soi à plusieurs. Étant donné que les tours se font tous en même temps, cela n’allonge pas la durée des tours ou d’inactivités.

Sur cette image, les rois de chaque équipe sont en rouge et les autres couleurs sont des pions.

Pour ce faire, durant chaque tour, le joueur pourra déplacer uniquement 3 pions (roi inclus) pour avancer sur la carte et placer des attaques en anticipant les mouvements des adversaires. Il faudra donc réussir à anticiper et calculer les prochains coups possibles de son adversaire pour parvenir à la victoire.

Durant la première phase de préparation, chaque joueur peut déplacer jusqu’à trois pièces (pions et roi) de son équipe. Chaque pièce déplacée peut ensuite choisir de faire une attaque parmi celles à sa disposition, sachant que cette attaque sera exécutée ensuite dans la phase de combat, après que les 3 pièces adverses ont été déplacées. Il est donc important d’anticiper un potentiel déplacement plutôt que simplement viser les pièces adverses. À ce stade, tout n’est que planification et vous ne voyez pas ce que fait l’adversaire.

Après 30 secondes maximum, où tous les joueurs ont choisi de finir leur tour, la phase de préparation se termine et le tour rentre en phase de combat. Dans cette phase, toutes les actions de préparation sont exécutées dans un ordre d’enchaînement :

-Tous les déplacements planifiés par les deux joueurs sont réalisés. Le déplacement est considéré comme une téléportation du point initial vers la destination, le trajet n’est pas pris en compte.

-Ensuite, les sorts sont lancés à l’endroit où ils étaient prévus lors de la phase 1. D’abord, les sorts de type “support” (spécifiés dans la description du sort) sont réalisés.

-Il peut arriver que 2 pièces se retrouvent au même endroit. Dans ce cas-là, celles-ci combattent jusqu’à la mort et la pièce avec le plus haut “score de duel” gagne le combat. Bien sûr, il est possible que les deux pièces s’entretuent si le score de duel est identique. Si les 2 pions meurent, l’énergie reste sur la case et peut être ramassée par les 2 joueurs.

-Puis les sorts normaux. Les sorts de dégâts ne peuvent pas toucher les pièces d’une même équipe à moins que ce ne soit spécifié dans le sort.

-Si un sort tue une pièce, celle-ci meurt et disparaît. Elle devient injouable ensuite.

À noter qu’un sort “dégât” tue forcément la pièce et n’est pas lié au score de duel. Il existe plusieurs types de sorts :

-Les sorts de type “dégât” sont destinés à éliminer des pions adverses ou à atteindre le roi ennemi pour remporter la partie. Par exemple, un tir de sniper qui touche un ennemi à une distance de 6 cases est un sort de ce type.

-Les sorts de type “contrôle”. Ils permettent d’infliger un contrôle à un ennemi ou une zone. Par exemple, un sort qui gèle 4 cases et empêche de jouer tous les pions ennemis qui se retrouvent dans cette zone est un sort de ce type.

-Les sorts de type “support” sont joués avant les autres sorts. Ils permettent, dans la majorité des cas, d’appliquer un buff ou un soin sur des pièces alliées. Ils peuvent aussi appliquer des malus aux ennemis.

De plus, un système de monnaie “in-game” appelé “énergie”, qui est unique à chaque partie (il est lié à la partie et se perd après celle-ci), rajoute un peu de profondeur de jeu et accélère aussi la partie. Cet argent est obtenu de plusieurs manières :

-Disponible aléatoirement (ou selon un pattern, à définir) sur la carte que n’importe quel pion peut ramasser. Le premier pion sur la case ramasse la pièce. Dans le cas où deux pions arrivent en même temps, c’est le pion qui survit qui obtient les énergies. Si aucun des pions ne survit, les énergies restent sur le plateau.

-Recueillir en tuant les pions de l’adversaire.

Ces énergies récoltées durant la partie auront plusieurs intérêts ensuite :

-Le roi peut choisir de consommer des énergies pour ressusciter un pion qui est mort durant la partie. Il a ensuite la possibilité de le faire revivre sur un emplacement libre autour de lui. Cette action est considérée comme un déplacement pour la pièce revenue à la vie.

Le roi peut aussi choisir de consommer des énergies pour faire évoluer un pion sur le terrain. Un pion ne peut évoluer que 2 fois au maximum. Son niveau d’évolution est visible par le nombre d’étoiles sur le pion (niveau 1 = 1 étoile bronze, niveau 2 = 2 étoiles argentées et niveau 3 = 3 étoiles dorées). Chaque palier est de plus en plus cher en énergie pour évoluer mais améliore les statistiques du personnage (portée, déplacement voire débloquer un 2ème / 3ème sort).

Pour terrasser vos adversaires, il vous faudra acquérir une expertise sur les stratégies possibles dans le jeu. Par exemple, en fonçant sur une pièce ennemie, vous le forcez à se déplacer s’il ne veut pas être attaqué et avec vos 2 autres déplacements, vous pouvez prédire la zone où il va atterrir, ainsi qu’avec les différentes attaques disponibles, et créer d’unique combos en construisant votre équipe de pions.

Il est possible de proposer une égalité à son adversaire qu’il devra accepter. Dans ce cas-là, aucun des 2 ne perd. Cette solution peut être envisageable lorsque le gameplay ne permet à aucun des 2 joueurs de tuer son adversaire. On peut envisager que ça soit proposé par l’ordinateur après X tours sans actions / dégâts entre les équipes.

## Ce personnage me dit quelque chose ##

Une particularité de Bonobros est que les personnages, appelés pions, sont tous inspirés d’influenceurs célèbres. Pour commencer, ils sont principalement inspirés de streamers Twitch.
Chaque pion est équipé de deux sorts uniques. Dans la plupart des cas, ils disposent respectivement d’un sort d’attaque, qui permet de faire des dégâts dans une zone prédéfinie à ses adversaires et d’un sort de soutien pour améliorer, soigner ou protéger ses coéquipiers. De plus, un pion dispose de sa propre mobilité, certains étant plus mobiles - peuvent se déplacer plus loin plus vite - que d’autres.
Lorsqu’une partie démarre, chaque joueur dispose de tous les pions qu’il a acquis dans sa bibliothèque de pions. Il doit ensuite placer 5 de ces pions sur le plateau aux endroits prévus à cet effet pendant la phase de “draft”. La draft se construit de la manière suivante : tous les joueurs ont 10 secondes pour placer un premier pion dans les 5 emplacements possibles. Au bout des 10 secondes (ou avant si tous les joueurs ont validé leur choix), le pion est révélé à tout le monde et 10 nouvelles secondes s’enchaînent pour placer le prochain pion jusqu’à ce que les 5 pions de tout le monde soient placés et révélés. À noter que les choix des pions des joueurs se font en même temps, ainsi que la révélation du pion choisi. Ce système de préparation de partie permet aux joueurs d’anticiper et de prévoir certaines stratégies que vos adversaires souhaitent mettre en place et ainsi, construire sa propre défense.

Bien sûr, il existe plus que 5 pions au total, il faudra donc faire un choix pour n’en retenir que 5 pour une partie. Chaque pion est unique et l’association de plusieurs pions peut permettre des combos qui vous assureront la victoire ! Il y a plusieurs ensembles de pions qui, bien qu’ayant des sorts uniques, vont pouvoir être placés dans des catégories de gameplay :

-L’assassin est une classe qui est vouée à détruire le roi adverse. Souvent grâce à sa fourberie, il bénéficie d’un avantage de mobilité pour surprendre l’adversaire et éliminer le roi adverse, ou d’autres pions rapidement.

-La classe tireur est une classe peu mobile mais qui peut attaquer d’assez loin pour surprendre l’adversaire en tuant des pions à distance.

-Les tanks sont là pour protéger les pions de son équipe et peuvent être durs à tomber en obtenant des points de bouclier. Un point de bouclier se consomme lorsque le pion subit des dégâts (hors duel sur la même case), permettant de survivre une fois de plus. Ces pions disposent souvent de peu de mobilité mais sont idéaux pour se rendre sur les cases dangereuses (avec ressources) sur la carte.

-Les piègeurs ont une mobilité correcte et permettent de poser des sorts sur la classe qui vont pouvoir rester plusieurs tours. Les pièges ne sont visibles qu’une fois activés.

-Les combattants ressemblent un peu aux assassins mais ont une moins grande mobilité pour plus d’attaques de zones proches d’eux. Ils sont surtout utilisés pour attaquer les pions ennemis, mais n’ont pas la même force que l’assassin face au roi.

-Les supports ont une mobilité correcte mais très faible en combat. En revanche, ils vont pouvoir booster / appliquer des malus sur la carte.

-Les invocateurs sont les seuls pions à pouvoir faire apparaître d’autres pions. Très utiles pour gagner du territoire ou pour jauger le terrain.

-Les mages sont une classe fragile et peu mobile. Cependant, ils disposent de larges sorts de contrôle ou de dégâts pouvant faire avancer votre équipe ou au contraire, paralyser l’adversaire.

-Le fermier est une classe faible pour le combat mais va obtenir plus de ressources. Il peut extraire des ressources sur la carte pour obtenir plus d’énergie que la normale.

## Le roi, c’est vous... ##

Comme aux échecs, la pièce importante de son jeu est le roi car s’il meurt, la partie s’arrête et vous avez perdu. Comme c’est votre pièce maîtresse, il est important que vous puissiez personnaliser cette pièce avec vos goûts et votre avancée sur le jeu. C’est pour cela qu’il est possible de customiser l’esthétique du pion, avec des assets que vous allez débloquer en jouant mais aussi des assets uniques et stylés que vous pourrez acheter dans la boutique du jeu. Par exemple, customiser votre roi aux couleurs de votre équipe e-sport préférée (Solary, KCorp, ...).

Après chaque partie, votre roi va obtenir de l’expérience. Il en obtient un peu plus si vous gagnez la partie. Plus vous gagnez de l’expérience, plus votre pion va monter en niveau et débloquer de nouvelles compétences. Bien sûr, votre roi ne peut avoir que 2 sorts donc il faudra choisir parmi votre collection de sorts, lesquels vous souhaitez emmener avec vous durant vos parties.

## Maman, j’suis en tournoi et je peux pas sauvegarder ##

Un autre point important dans le jeu est l’aspect compétitif. En effet, Bonobros propose plusieurs modes de jeu classés, similaires aux échecs, qui permettent d’obtenir des points de rang ou d’en perdre en affrontant des adversaires du même niveau que vous.

Concrètement, tous les joueurs commencent avec un score de 1000 points de grade (GP). À chaque victoire, le joueur gagne +5 GP et en cas de défaite, il perd -5 GP contre un joueur du même niveau (1000 GP).

En cas de victoire contre un adversaire avec un score de GP supérieur, vous gagnerez plus de GP que la normale et vous en perdrez moins en cas de défaite.

Dans le cas d’une victoire contre un adversaire avec moins de GP que vous, vous gagnerez moins de GP que la normale et vous en perdrez plus en cas de défaite.

De plus, Bonobros peut proposer des tournois sur des plateformes externes où les gens s’affrontent et peuvent obtenir des récompenses à la fin. Ces tournois peuvent être sponsorisés ou organisés par des tiers (exemple : des influenceurs).

## Communauté et récompenses ##

Comme le jeu repose beaucoup sur les influenceurs et sa communauté, l’aspect social est très important dans Bonobros. Tout d’abord, un chat est disponible dans chaque partie pour communiquer entre tous les joueurs de la même partie. Ensuite, au sein du client (dans les menus), il est possible d’ajouter des amis et d’envoyer des messages privés à ceux-ci.
De plus, pour améliorer la rejouabilité et gagner un peu plus d’expérience pour mieux personnaliser son roi, des défis sont disponibles à réaliser pendant les parties.

## Modèle économique ##

Bonobros est un jeu "Free to Play" où le joueur gagne une monnaie virtuelle qui lui permet de débloquer gratuitement des pions, des accessoires pour son roi, ou d'autres éléments de personnalisation tels qu'un skin pour le plateau, des emotes, ...
Bien sûr, il existe aussi une monnaie à dépenser avec de l'argent réel. Cela permet d'obtenir les mêmes accessoires plus rapidement ainsi que des boosts d'XP, par exemple.
Enfin, le jeu comporte aussi un "battle pass" où, en jouant des parties, le battle pass se complète échelon par échelon. Certains échelons sont disponibles uniquement si on a acheté le battle pass premium, mais il est aussi possible d'obtenir des éléments gratuitement.

1823600.name: Power & Revolution 2022 Edition
1823600.about_the_game:
2022: Worldwide Chaos and Devastation!



With the war in the Ukraine, the planet is in chaos and nothing will ever be the same again. What's more, there is the threat of global warming, the lingering Covid epidemic along with the risk of new variants, inflation and increased prices on the planet's key resources.

Alongside the base game mode, which allows you to play as any head of state or opposition leader in the world controlling one or multiple nations, the 2022 Edition offers multiple scenarios.

In the Ukraine scenario, save the country by playing as the Ukraine and one or more NATO countries, by resisting the advance of Russian tanks, by supporting the Ukrainian army, by urging financial sanctions against Russia, by accepting refugees, by making the Russian president unpopular in the eyes of the people or by influencing China to officially oppose the conflict, all while avoiding escalation.

The scenario on global warming involves adjusting your goals for reducing CO2 emissions. Climate Change Conferences (COP) have been added. You can also influence other countries to go further in their goals, with the artificial intelligence of leaders simulating their behavior on the subject, ultimately allowing you to see the real development of worldwide climate change up to the year 2100.

In the "Animal Welfare" scenario, your objective is to become one of the most honorable countries in the world regarding animal rights. To do this, you will have a specific budget and an arsenal of legislation on hunting, animal rights and various other regulations (bullfighting, production of foie gras, battery farming...).

The "French Elections" scenario allows you to play as any candidate in the French election in April 2022.


Besides these scenarios, the game also has new features including: simulating the appearance and development of conspiracy theories with new budgets and actions on the internet and social media, inclusion of fake news with the possibility of combating them or creating them, the development of secret services abroad along with the manipulation of social media and improvements allowing the overthrow of a foreign head of state, management of Covid in 2022 with vaccine boosters and the simulation of new variants, the development of garbage recycling along with a new tax on the use of plastic packaging, the addition of military battle robots, new SMR nuclear power plants, new music awards (Eurovision, Grammy Awards) and sports (eSports, MMA) and numerous improvements on the God'n'Spy add on, including the detailed calculation of the level of dictatorship in a country.

NEW CONTENTS FOR 2022



• Ukrainian Crisis

In the Ukrainian conflict scenario, the player can play as the Ukraine and one or more NATO countries by resisting the advance of Russian tanks, by supporting the Ukrainian army, by urging financial sanctions against Russia, by accepting refugees, by making the Russian president unpopular in the eyes of the people or by influencing China to officially oppose the conflict.
The simulation of the conflict required the development of new features and expansion of various aspects: access to allies' bases, providing weapons, calculating the losses and costs of the war, a peace treaty with the division of the conquered regions, impact of the loss of soldiers on popularity, the behavior of AI countries in wartime conditions (NATO's decisions, decisions for general mobilization, decisions to enter or leave a conflict...), better inclusion of economic embargoes and their impact on prices, implementing financial sanctions and their consequences and the possibility of influencing AI leaders so that they also implement them, accepting refugees, exclusion and boycotts of sports or cultural events...

In normal game mode, all countries are playable, beginning with the same military context military and events as in the real world.


• Conspiracy Theories and Fake News

Various conspiracy theories can appear in a country depending on numerous factors, especially the level of control of social media. The player can launch information campaigns and deconstruction campaigns to destroy them, to try to influence public figures who are passing along these theories to abandon them, or to take more drastic action on controlling the internet.
With secret services, the player as head of state can act abroad, disseminating theories in enemy countries, and act at home, instigating fake news about characters deemed hostile.


• Climate Objectives and Conferences

In the 2022 Edition, the player will be able to truly contribute to the fight against global warming.
With the simulation of the Climate Change Conferences (COP), it will be possible to modify goals for the reduction of CO2, participate in deciding on the Green Climate Fund, intended to help developing countries, and most of all, influence other countries to do more in their efforts with an AI system setting the objectives to reach for all countries and the actions and legislation to implement. Finally, the player will be able to follow the global warming trends in a precise and detailed manner up to the year 2100.


• Animal Welfare

All the countries of the world are now rated according to their efforts in animal rights. A dedicated budget and an arsenal of legislation are available to the player to advance their country: regulation on hunting, recognition of animal rights, position regarding bullfighting, the production of foie gras, battery farming, whale hunting, the testing of cosmetics on animals, possessing marine mammals at aquariums or wild animals at circuses, dog fighting, raising animals for fur...
A specific scenario allows the player to become one of the most honorable countries in the world in regard to animal rights.


• Other Scenarios

"Baden's Challenge: Three Years to Succeed": this scenario puts you in the shoes of the American president with the goal of implementing all the reforms you promised by the end of your term.

The "French Elections" scenario allows you to play as any candidate at the start of an official campaign in the French election in April 2022.

OTHER ADDITIONS



• Development of secret services: new budget and management screen with records on specific countries and the possibility of multiple objectives per spy network, stronger impact on the popularity of foreign heads of state (who could be overthrown or trigger new elections) and manipulation of social media.
• Recycling of garbage: addition of a new global threat, the increase in garbage and the integration of a tax on the use of plastic packaging.
• Management of Covid in2022 with vaccination boosters and simulating new variants
• Display on the rate of popularity for AI heads of state
• Battle Robots: Development of this new highly sophisticated weapon. These autonomous or controllable robots can lead ground operations without risking the loss of soldiers.
• SMR Nuclear Power Plants: addition of these small power plants at a lower cost provides an alternative to "decarbonate" electricity with the possibility of construction contracts (buying or selling) with foreign countries.
• God'n'spy: a detailed chart on the level of democracy/dictatorship of countries, the possibility of deleting a played country, controlling inflation, expediting the recruitment of personnel, eliminating the limitation of construction tied to the available workforce.
• The possibility of renaming places on the map
• Construction: fixing a maximum number of constructible buildings depending on the available workforce and the possibility of automatically starting new construction projects once previous ones have been completed
• Expansion of choices when changing a political party: regionalist, ecologist, anti-globalization and religious parties or parties not existing in the country.
• Addition of musical awards: Grammy Awards and Eurovision Song Contest
• New types of sports: eSports and MMA
• New achievements

DATA UPDATED AS OF 01/01/2022



• Budgetary, economic and social data...
• Political and geopolitical data: new governments, creation of new parliaments, diplomatic relations between countries ...
• Environmental data, including countries' objectives in terms of CO2 emissions reduction and carbon neutrality
• Military data (including ranking based on strength) and conflict maps, current city battles and status of opposing forces.
• Terrorist organizations: members, prospects, resources.
• Updated city populations and the addition of new cities
• New commercial organizations: RCEP and the Foundation for the Protection of Animals
• New characters with new faces: heads of state or government and new ministers and party leaders (Germany, Italy, Japan...), candidates in the French presidential election.

1823700.name: Brawler Bro's
1823700.about_the_game:
Brawler Bro’s is an arcade kickboxing beat em up title which is taking inspiration from the famous “Fight Night™” series made by EA. As a player you’ll encounter challenging fights against Ai or human opponents based on simple to learn but hard to master fighting mechanics. Tactics and resource management are important aspects as each fighters stats are dynamically adapting to the situation of the fight which lead to variable encounters that feel challenging but always leave room for a comeback story of the underdog.



Brawler Bro’s is currently developed by just two people going by the name “PHOS digital”. The proof of concept demo was developed in just two months during 2021 using the popular Unity 3D engine.

Since it will be a while till we can release the full game, we have setup an early demo build for you to try out. The demo is a very early version and not the full game yet. Be assured to encounter bugs, glitches and faulty balancing. Progression is not really implemented yet and the available content is limit. The game is using flickstick controls - therefore playing with a controller is mandatory at the moment.

The current demo is meant to be viewed as a technical proof of concept version and does not reflect the full quality or content quantity of the final product.

1823740.name: Drawize - Draw and Guess
1823740.about_the_game:
Drawize is a fun online multiplayer drawing game where players draw and guess words. One player is the artist - when their turn starts, they get 3 words to choose from, then they have to draw the chosen word. The other players try to guess what the artist is drawing. The game is played in several rounds; points from each round are summed to create a rank list and determine a winner.

Public and Private rooms

You can play this drawing game online in public rooms with random people worldwide whenever you want - there is always someone online! Also, you can play in a private room with your friends. The private room option is great whenever you and your friends want to play remote but together, it makes an excellent party game. There is also a Teams mode in the private room - it is great for big groups (up to 100 players!) that can be divided into teams and play in the co-op mode (team members collect points together and compete with other teams).

Quick Draw and Quick Guess

There are two single-player modes when you want to play on your own. Choose Quick Draw to choose a word and start drawing for practice, or Quick Guess to practice guessing drawings other players have made in previous games.

Daily Challenge

There's one special word every day, known as the Daily Challenge! Draw it and compete with other players to earn the artist of the day title. The winner is determined by the number of votes that each drawing gets from other players (you must be level 3 or higher to vote).

1823750.name: NECROTOPIA

Story

Struck by lightning in a stormy night, a monster awoke. "Who am I? Why was I born?" The monster begins to walk in search of the answers.

Overview

NECROTOPIA is an exploratory action game, in which a player character is a monster, who woke up in a stormy night by lightning. Fighting againt enemies, he/she go through the various areas (cave, graveyard etc.) to meet his/her creator.

His/Her bodies are patchworked. He/She obtains weapons on the spot by picking up junks or snatching up weapons/bodies of enemies, and sewing them on his/her body. Because of the fragility of weapons, you have to use various types of weapons as the situation demands.

Features

  • Unique NPCs
  • Different actions for each weapon type (sword, hammer, spear etc.)

1823760.name: Fighting Mad Lads
1823760.about_the_game:
Fighting Mad Lads is a fast-paced party game, for two to four local players set in “Neo-City” where the rules are changing each round. It’s time to fight! Keep up with the fast pace and adapt yourself to the rules of each mini-game. Choose your street hero and destroy your friends in each game to become the King in the Streets.




1) Start a game with your friends.
2) When the game starts, elbow your friends.
3) In the middle of the game, stand in front of the screen to stop them from playing.
4) That’s it! You won!

We promise you a 100% win but we are not responsible for the loss of friendships.

Also, do not forget : No holds barred in the street.




- Local Multiplayer : Play as one of the street heroes and dive into fun and dynamic couch games in free-for-all or pair up fights in 2v2 in the streets of Neo City.
- Lots of mini games : 5 exciting mini-games alternating each round! You’ll have to adapt yourself constantly to the new rules. Will you manage to take the coin and put it in your bank in the arcade arena or will you take cover in area overload ?
- Blow up your friends : Mixing party games and fighting, don’t forget to punch your friends and jump into the action.
- Easy-to-Learn : FML is a game mixing party game and fighting mechanics but with very simple controls in a fast-paced rhythm.
- Set in a cyberpunk 3D universe mixing street art and cartoon style.

1823810.name: NAHKA
1823810.about_the_game:
NAHKA is a cry for help for those who can’t speak for themselves. NAHKA is a Finnish word that stands for leather, fur, hide, skin, and pelt.

NAHKA is a game that stands for ecological values, animal rights, provoking story, engaging gameplay, and real-life horror.





This game shows the impact of fur farming from the perspective of animals.

Inspired by titles such as Limbo, Inside & Little Nightmares, NAHKA is the ultimate feel-bad game about fur farming, an arcane, brutal, and unethical industry which should not exist today.





NAHKA is a 2,5D puzzle platformer with heavy emphasis on atmosphere. The game explores the relationship between humans and animals by switching their roles. The protagonist of the game is a guard dog which is tasked to hunt down a white fox that has escaped from a fur farm.





During the game the dog is reintegrated to nature, and when he returns to the farm, he sees the world differently. The dog must rise against the masters.





NAHKA takes place in the intersection between nature and agriculture. The game explores the differences and similarities of a dog and a fox. One is the man’s best friend, other an animal bred for its fur. Horror elements are focused on fur farming and the effects man has on nature.

Although the game focuses on agriculture, NAHKA also explores other themes related to environmental abuse, such as deforestation, pollution, and extinction. Each of these themes are portrayed from a viewpoint of animals.





The controls of NAHKA have been designed maximum accessibility in mind. The game introduces a very versatile control layout. The game can be played with one hand, either left or right.

The game has zero lines of text, as all the narrative is visual.

1823830.name: Basault VR
1823830.about_the_game:
BASAULT VR is a virtual reality movement shooter. Run, jump, swing around on your grappling hook and shoot with a variety of complex yet familiar firearms. Use those tools to survive and reach the end of this roguelite!

*WARNING: do not play if you are prone to motion sickness*



WAIT... WHAT AM I SUPPOSED TO BE DOING?

This game is a roguelite. Your goal is to survive a series of hand designed arenas against tough ennemies with your mobility and weaponry and reach the end of the cycle to unlock new Etheral Weapons!

_________________________________________________________________________________________________________


...ETHERAL WEAPON? WHAT'S THAT?

An Etheral Weapon is a special type of gun that you can always spawn from behind your hips. Whether your gun is empty, you dropped it off a cliff or you just want to dual wield because that's the kind of cool dude you are, you can pull out these single magazine weapons to get you out of a bind!

_________________________________________________________________________________________________________


18 UNIQUE ARENAS...

...made for the sole purpose of shooting, running and swinging around in.

_________________________________________________________________________________________________________


10 UNIQUE GUNS...

...and more to come. Enjoy the entirely physical reloading and handling!

_________________________________________________________________________________________________________


THANK YOU

Making this game alone would be quasi-impossible if it wasn't for the help of these people and ressources. Please look them up and give them some love by clicking on "Visit the website" on the sidebar :)

1823840.name: Illusion Lands
1823840.about_the_game:
ILLUSION LANDS is an immersive RPG set in a highly detailed world that combines the genres of dark fantasy and science fiction. An interesting and exciting story awaits you, which will appeal to both fans of deep story games and fans of the gameplay aspect of games.

GENERAL INFORMATION:

Illusion Lands - tells a fascinating and tragic story about Erwin, a hunter for the Devourers, who were created by powerful deities. His mission is to follow the will of the deities, awaken and destroy the Devourers in order to rid humanity from their oppression. However, Erwin turns against his creators as soon as he learns of their true goals.

GAME PROCESS:


Go hunting against Devourers in large and colorful locations. The player's goal is to solve riddles on his way, find and destroy the Devourers. As a result of victory, your character becomes stronger, receiving experience and various loot for killing the Devourer: resources, equipment.

KEY FEATURES OF THE GAME:

- brutal design of the combat system with colorful visual and sound effects, with combo attacks and finishing moves;
- powerful storytelling with interesting dialogues, events and memorable characters;
- ability to use atypical tactics of fighting, using different types of weapons and skills;
- a unique system of magic abilities: each individual skill is self-sufficient and weighty;
- high pace of gameplay: the features of the mechanical movement of the character and the battle with giant opponents give the player the experience of a very dynamic gameplay;
- very detailed game world with beautiful, modern 3D graphics.

──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

BIOMES:


The world of Illusion Lands is replete with various habitats - from desert gorges to picturesque green plains. The events of the game take place in a variety of locations, which will not let the player get bored and will allow you to enjoy the beautiful, well-developed ecosystem of this world.

ARMORY:


There are several types of weapons at your disposal, each of which will create a unique experience of the gameplay. You can use melee or ranged weapons, depending on the situation and the specific one. Each weapon has its own characteristics and its own pace.

SPECIAL MEANS OF MOVEMENT:


Large gaming arenas and huge enemies necessitate dynamic movement across the location and the availability of vertical gameplay opportunities. Erwin possesses a number of skills that allow him to perform the tasks of a Devourer-hunter.

DRAGON RIDER:

1823910.name: Mondrian Squares
1823910.about_the_game:
Overview

Mondrian Squares is a colourful, abstract puzzle game with random, procedurally generated levels so you never play the same game twice. Progressive difficulty with no upper limit ensures that you will always have a new challenge to face.

Throw in a chillout jazz soundtrack and a visual theme inspired by the works of Piet Mondrian and you have the perfect game to immerse yourself in whenever you have a little spare time.

Gameplay

Mondrian Squares is delightfully simple to learn, but fiendishly difficult to master.

The object of the game is to merge the coloured squares by clicking on the white spaces in between them until only one coloured square remains. If this coloured square is in the centre "goal" square you win and progress to the next level.

You begin with a puzzle that can be solved with a single move, but each level adds a new layer of difficulty and you will soon find yourself having to think dozens of moves ahead.

Your challenge awaits...

1823940.name: Defenders Glory
1823940.about_the_game:
Defenders Glory returns to the basics of the Tower Defense genre to redefine them: Simplicity and complexity merge to form a very intuitive and deep gameplay experience, where you can find suitable challenges at any skill level, with very different playstyles.

When playing Defenders Glory, beginners will find themselves trying out new things and learning as they go, whereas veterans can find some of the most strategically profound gameplay experiences in a Tower Defense while trying to beat the harder difficulty levels, all while playing as your preferred Class Race. Each of the Races provides a unique way to play and strategize, allowing for vastly different ways for anyone to play each of the many stages of the game.

The Class Races range from Elven Archers to the Chaos Legion, having not only unique playstyles but being unique in their presentation as well. The stages are also of varying scenery, starting on simple plains, up to dangerous Volcanoes and the shadowy Underworld, each of them presenting specific tracks that test different types of defense strategy, not only having multiple different pathways each, but also exclusive waves per stage, meaning that each and every level of the game is handcrafted to fit its own theme, difficulty and type of challenge.


The CLASS RACES:



Elven Archers:

The Elven Archers come from the Forests, Hills and Plains, ready to defend their kingdom. Lately, that Kingdom has been overrun with monsters, and they have taken it personally to repel such creatures back from where they came from.

Specializing in Long Range and Piercing, they easily deal with long tracks and lined-up enemies, but suffer against groups that are too great in quantity, having to rely on their towers being well placed and positioned, so that their abilities may be taken full advantage of.



Elementals:

Since ancient times, the Elementals have maintained the very basis of the world. They are not only living in Nature, as they are essentially Nature itself, alive: The elements which make it, who felt life's breath, and are pretty disturbed by the ruckus happening in the mainlands.

The members of the Elemental faction, Fire, Ice, Water, Lightning, Earth and Magma, are each a Specialist in their own aspect, but seriously lack versatility. Which means Elementals are pretty good at dealing with simple but intense problems, but must find a way around when faced with multiple, simultaneous, lighter problems. Also, if anything, they excel at dealing with hordes, having the best Collateral Damage in the entirety of Defenders Glory, but suffer with range.



Wizards:

Hailing from the distant Sky Mountains, the Wizards practice their Arcane arts in the hopes of never using them... But it seems the time forever dreaded has come, and they must stop the Monster Invasion.

Being thirsty for knowledge, the Wizards are always eager to learn and improve, persevering through the tough times of being a beginner. Which means that, even though all of them may seem weak at first glance, with upgrades they become absolute masters of what they do. Most of the Wizard Faction specializes in utility spells, with a few of the Mages focusing on pure damage, each of them brings to the table a special way to improve all the others' powers, and that sums up to make an incredibly strong synergy combo.



Chaos:

The Chaos Legion is the Supreme Ruler of the Underworld... Or at least they used to be! The insubordinate rebels who escaped their grasp shall pay for their transgression, so they departed from their unholy lair to crush each and every one that fled from their mighty hands!

Not only they have some of the most powerful creatures at their command, the Chaos Legion also gambles with fate, being empowered by critical strikes, damage multipliers and many other benefits of luck. Although, that very same thing may become their own demise, or perhaps their lack of reach shall suffice for that end.




The DIFFICULTY MODES:

Each difficulty mode is handcrafted to each player skill. We spent thousands of hours balancing and finding the very best difficulty curve for each mode, so that all players can have a good time playing Defenders Glory. Even within each mode, there's many ways to play the game: You can try and beat the game simply, or avoid the Gold Miner and try to get 3 stars in every stage, perhaps with various different classes (since each is a completely different gameplay experience) or only with your favorite one, or maybe you wanna shoot for the stars and try to reach the highest wave imaginable in Infinite Mode by optimizing your Gold Miners... It doesn't matter HOW you play, but Defenders Glory was carefully crafted to catter to your needs. Let's take a look at each difficulty level and see what they look like!


Normal: Made for beginners, this game mode is really forgiving and allows you to make and focus on almost any strategy, anywhere, as long as it holds some logic, it works. This allows for players to try out new combinations, and prepare and reach far into infinite mode!

Hard: Beginners will need to tighten up their game to beat this one! The Hard Mode does not allow for most simplistic strategies, punishing them accordingly, and making the Infinite Mode harder by having only half the maximum amount of Gold Miners, which means the game can become quite challenging!

Very Hard: A truly challenging game mode, where not even veterans will have an easy time beating. It requires very tight strategy and planning, punishing most suboptimal strategies, requiring that the player truly understands each stage and class to beat them. Recommended only for those who really know their way around Defenders Glory or Tower Defense games in general.

Impossible: This is as hard as it gets. To beat it with 3 stars, it seems like no class race can get through the entire game without frequently finding themselves in super tight situations, that only the most optimal of all strategies can beat. The Archers must fight hard to deal with the hordes, the Elementals may breeze through the hordes but they can never seem to cover all ends, The Wizards may become complete absolute masters of their craft, but it never seems possible to reach that point before losing health (but it is), and the Chaos Legion will find themselves hoping so hard for that one critical hit, that one stun, and never seem to get it. This is for the absolute masters only. Even the Tower Defense Masters can't beat this with ease, surely not all stage / races combinations. In fact, our tests show that it usually take close to literal hundreds of hours to do just that, and even with only one chosen class race it can take nearly the hundreds. It's truly a test of knowledge, optimization, and Mastery of Defenders Glory and Tower Defenses in general.



Access our website (www.defendersglory.com) to find out more about the game, learn new strategies, and get to know your favorite class race!

1823950.name: Laysara: Summit Kingdom
1823950.about_the_game:
Laysara: Summit Kingdom is a challenging city builder which tasks you with creating a new home for your people forced out of the lowlands. During a campaign or sandbox playthrough, you will establish multiple towns, each on a unique mountain with its own traits. All your towns co-exist in symbiosis, creating a trading network, which you can then adjust to your needs by revisiting already developed settlements. The Kingdom of Laysara has to be rebuilt!

BUILD ON A MOUNTAIN

Each mountain comes with a new set of challenges. Mounts differ in shapes, vegetation zone layouts, resource availability and weather conditions. Sometimes you will have plenty of room for farming in green lowlands, sometimes you will need to rely on breeding and extracting valuable minerals from regions dangerously close to peak glaciers. If you find yourself in dire need of a certain resource, you can always try to establish a trading route with another town.

DEAL WITH AVALANCHES

One of the ever-present dangers you will have to deal with are mighty avalanches. You can’t stop them, but you can take precautions and be prepared. Afforest the key areas to create natural barriers, build artificial ones to redirect rushing masses of snow, or trigger the avalanche early, while it’s still manageable. Create a deliberate and reliable strategy and you might even be able to use the power of snow to your advantage; fail to do so and find your city buried and devastated!

CRAFT A TRANSPORT NETWORK

So, transporting goods is easy, right? Well, not if your destination lies on the other side of the mountain, a few hundred meters higher, behind cliffs, ridges, canyons and rivers. You will need to create a vast, complex transport network consisting of roads, bridges and shafts to ensure reliable delivery chains. As demand for resources will grow alongside the town’s population, always look for opportunities to optimise your transportation network, be it by building paved roads, using more advanced lifting constructions, or aiding your carriers with glamorous yaks.

RAISE A SUMMIT TEMPLE

If you manage to endure all mountain dangers, build a network of efficient production chains and satisfy all needs of your people, there is only one more thing to be done: conquering the mountain peak! To succeed in this great endeavour you’ll need to reach the summit and establish safe routes for your carriers to bring in enormous amounts of building resources, but beware! Weather at this height is as deadly as ever. The final effect is well worth the effort though, as raising the summit temple is an act of total triumph of human courage (and your logistics skills!) over the elements.

Final note: the game is a pure city building experience solely focused on the economy, resource management and surviving despite the inhospitable environment. Therefore, the game doesn’t feature combat or any other military aspects.

So What's the Special Sauce?


- Badass Protagonist: We're bringing back the sassy, witty one-liners like Duke Nukem mixed with the rotten charisma of Frankenstein's monster.
- Use your Spectral Shovel to get around quickly and confuse enemies.
- Collect Tarot Cards to significantly boost your power level and combat options.
- Upgrade your weapons to unlock additional fire modes and synergies.
- Make your own levels with the integrated Level Editor! (This will officially come out with the full release of the game.)

Badass Protagonist


Queedo the Gravedigger, dumb as hell but as strong as an ox, sets out to avenge his father while using his trusty Total Uber Shovel to beat the living crap out of his enemies and give them a first-class ticket to the underworld.



Big boy has opinions: Queedo comments on what's going on with his typical sense of rotten humor and Cockney accent.



Comic book cutscenes fill in the blanks and drive the story forward.



Find and collect comic book pages to learn more about the world and the backstory.



See Queedo's face react to events and get smashed to a pulp when you're getting your ass handed to you!

Spectral Shovel


Use your Spectral Shovel to cover great distances in an instant.



Overcome seemingly unbeatable obstacles and hazards.



Enable shortcuts to previously discovered parts of a level.

Tarot Cards


Collect magical Tarot Cards that empower you in various ways.



Because only a few can be equipped at a time, you’ll be faced with a difficult choice!

Find the combination that best fits your playstyle.

Discover synergies with weapons & alt fire modes.

Weapons & Upgrades


Choose from an array of meaningful weapons.



Use the best weapon for any given situation, or just rely on your favorite -- both ways are viable!

Upgrade your weapons to unlock a second, powerful fire mode.

Discover synergies between weapons and their fire modes to create maximum carnage!

Level Editor




Use our integrated level editor to make your own levels and episodes, right within the game. It's the same tool we use ourselves.

Instantly playtest your level from wherever you are in the editor. The transition between the editor and the game is quick and seamless.



Script the level to your liking, from simple monster closets to complicated overarching puzzles.

Tools, such as automatic texture hotspotting, intuitive geometry tweaking & cutting, and more, will make it a breeze to build a level of your dreams very quickly.

If you got all the way down here, you have proven you are a true boomer shooter fan and that Gravelord is just for you!

Thank you and have fun!

Embarque numa jornada pelo Reino de Caldia e descubra uma trama envolvente neste primeiro capítulo de uma trilogia de fantasia medieval. Descubra com eles os mistérios de uma antiga guerra que pode estar prestes a se repetir.

Características

Aventure-se em uma história de um amor impossível entre um homem e uma estrela, traição e uma guerra entre deuses que definirá o destino das pessoas e do Reino de Caldia.

Combates Clássicos por turnos, nada de tempo real. Tome seu tempo para: pensar, planejar e executar. Ícones auxiliares estarão presentes durante o combate para ajudar a identificar o que está ocorrendo durante a batalha.

Uma protagonista, 8 heróis e 8 classes. Amigos hoje e inimigos amanhã? Junte-se a Crystal e conheça outros 7 heróis que irão dividir a primeira parte desta aventura com você. Cada um com sua própria classe, golpes únicos, atributos, resistências e ambições.

Isso é ferrugem? Cuidado ao pegar armas deixadas por monstros, sabe-se lá quando ela foi usada por último. Armas enferrujadas ou tortas podem trazer penalidades ao equipamento e acabam sendo piores do que se estivesse usando os punhos. No entanto, se tiver sorte pode encontrar algo brilhante ou ainda mágico! Isso pode fazer com que aquele espólio que você encontre se torne mesmo um tesouro tão raro que não é encontrado em nenhuma loja.

História

Quatro reinos dividiam fronteiras e possuíam relações harmoniosas entre si. Mas tudo mudou com uma guerra entre os deuses que ninguém poderia ter previsto que iria acontecer.

As quatro nações sucumbiram inevitavelmente e um novo reino nasceu em seu lugar: Caldia. O único herói sobrevivente se tornou o rei dessa nova nação e seus descendentes, os sucessores ao trono.

Muitos anos se passaram, mas as ameaças permanecem. Há aqueles que tramam em suas prisões para serem libertos, outros tramam a queda de seus inimigos enquanto já infiltrados nas forças destes e há sempre aqueles que querem conquistar e lutar em nome de um bem maior.

Nossa heroína descende daqueles que lutaram e perderam, mas somente ela pode escolher o caminho que vai trilhar.

Descubra um pouco deste universo no primeiro capítulo da trilogia - A Noite Sem Fim: Sombras da Guerra.

Gameplay

Fortemente influenciado pelos jogos chrono trigger e final fantasy, nossa aventura conta com batalhas por turnos, itens consumíveis, condições de estado, buffs e debuffs simples e um sistema de equipamento de fácil uso que trará a nostalgia dos clássicos novamente. Ao mesmo tempo que construímos uma imersão em um universo novo com uma história inspirada nos conflitos da corte das crônicas de gelo e fogo.

1824260.name: Scholar
1824260.about_the_game:
Scholar is a spelling game with RPG elements. Level up your hero as you spell words and unlock new skills. Fight powerful bosses at the end of each level and get that loot.

Flow
In Scholar, Flow is your both energy and health. Casting a word, as well as taking damage reduces your flow. Use your skills, equipment and upgrades to reduce flow costs or completely neglect them. In some cases even regenerate and fill your entire flow with one special word.

Three Skill Trees to Explore
Choose your way between path of Flow, Experience and Guardian. Will you focus solely on your exp gains or will you maximize your damage output? Mix them to your liking to enjoy your journey. Reset them any time and try out new strategies.

Loot
After you complete every run enjoy your new loot. Try harder difficulty runs to obtain better quality ones. Common, rare,legendary and set items all await you! Use multiple items of the same set to unlock special abilities. Finishing higher difficulty runs will also give you better rolled items. Look out for glitched items which roll with extra stats. Even a common item can be an exciting addition to your armory if you can find a glitched one!


Augments
As you spell words you'll start to run into augmented letters. These letters can give you various bonuses such as; XP, Flow, Damage or free shuffling. Sometimes they might carry harmful effects, yet even those can come in handy with the right skills.


Runes
Spelling words, using augmented letters, defeating guardians will all earn you different kinds of runes. Use these runes to upgrade your board size, XP and gain advantages against the guardians. In addition to your skills and equipment, upgrades will also aid you in your journey.


Difficulty curated to your enjoyment
It's up-to you to decide whether you want a purely relaxing experience or a hardcore spelling journey, When you are in the mood crank the difficulty to gain extra XP and loot. Apart from the general difficulty setting, your runs also scale from 1 to level 200. You can decide to farm lower levels in a fast manner or go higher for the better rewards.


Skills and Items on full display.
Any item that provides you a unique ability, or a skill that boosts your XP, Damage or Flow will always be shown in the corresponding section of your info box. Simply mouse over them to remind yourself of their names. Anytime a legendary or a set item triggers it's effect a short animation will be shown, allowing you to decide if they are useful enough for you or perhaps it's time to change up your gear.

Features:

  • 9+ Levels:

  • 4 Unique Abilities:
  • Defeat your foes with 1 of 4 timed abilities. Keep track of your power bar to figure out when you need to return to a statue to recharge.
  • 13 Enemy Types:
  • Each enemy has different attributes of speed, health, and damage. Some even have special abilities.
  • 1 Boss:
  • Defeat the World boss to discover your destiny.
  • Infinite lives:
  • Lose all your hearts? No worries, you have infinite lives.
  • Level progression saves:

  • Procedural level generation:
  • Replay (or reload) the 2nd to last level to have it generate in a different configuration with a different combination of enemies.
  • Replay any level:
  • Use the Level Selection menu to replay you're favorite levels again.

1824800.name: Fast Fruit
1824800.about_the_game:
Panda is hungry and fancies some of his favorite snacks: Fruit! - Help him collect his fruit as quickly as possible.

In this arcade-like speed-game, it is your task to satisfy your Red Panda by collecting his snacks in the fastest time possible.
Not happy with your time? Try again! You might even try and set a world record!

Calculate the directions of the flying snacks and get used to the mechanics to shave off these crucial seconds in your battle against time.

1824830.name: Setr's Auto Battler
1824830.about_the_game:
Build your team!


Build your own fantasy team and try them out in the arena!

Use this time wisely, buy and sell units, find the best synergies.

Fight in the arena!

1824840.name: 魔能纪元
1824840.about_the_game:
This game is an RPG game for placing and hanging up produced by an independent small team. It has a very interesting equipment drop mechanism, and you can experience the infinite fun of brushing equipment without taking time.

When the character is fighting, there will be a set of AI system to assist the player to operate and fight automatically. When you need to control, you can also manually control the character to move and release skills.

For the control of this game, we pay more attention to the matching strategy of the character's equipment and skills, which is suitable for players who are not quick to respond but have strong strategy. Therefore, you don't need to spend too much energy on character control. The game process is very casual.

The equipment in the game is divided into ordinary, excellent, perfect, epic, dark gold, legend and other qualities. Higher quality has more personalized random attributes.

Equipment can be obtained randomly by playing monsters. When you exit the game, you will not stop playing monsters. The character will continue to play monsters in the game. You can get a lot of equipment and various material rewards when you go online next time.

In this game, there are different classes, including warrior, mage, Archer and assassin, but the skills are common to all classes. Players can choose to match them from the skill pool to form their own unique playing method.

1824910.name: Magic Disc Golf
1824910.about_the_game:
Play Disc Golf by taking control of your disc and steer it towards the basket. You will have to plan your route carefully, navigate challenging terrain and use your limited booster ability sparingly.

Main features:
  • Three 18-hole courses and one 6-hole tutorial/practice course.
  • Up to four players playing on the same computer.
  • Three disc types (Driver, Midrange and Putter) with varying range, handling, and stability.
  • Challenging terrain and obstacles.
  • Wind that will affect your disc’s range and handling.
  • Highly customizable play settings:
    • Customizable courses: select a course and then select which holes you want to play.
    • Four game modes: Stroke Play, Match Play, Speed Play and Speed Match Play. In Stroke Play and Match play you need to reach the basket in as few throws as possible. In Speed Play and Speed Match Play you need to get to the basket as fast as possible.
    • Disc steering. Enable disc steering and guide your disc towards the basket, or disable it for a more realistic experience.
    • Disc boosting. Enable it to collect boost energy and use it to cover more ground, or leave it disabled for more challenging gameplay.
    • Three time-of-day settings: Afternoon, evening and night.
    • A minimap to help you plan your hole. Can be disabled for more challenging gameplay.

Minor features:
  • Discs come equipped with flashlights (naturally).
  • High score tables.
  • Manuals describing the game modes and game play features in detail.

1824960.name: Propagation: Paradise Hotel
1824960.about_the_game:
From the creators of the free experience Propagation VR, comes the first chapter of a thrilling new story.

Trapped inside the Paradise Hotel, where a strange illness has turned people into savage creatures, you are desperate to find your sister. Play as Emily Diaz, explore dark surroundings, gather resources, and survive terrifying encounters. This intense single-player VR survival horror game with great storytelling will get your adrenaline pumping.

IMMERSIVE STORY

Emily's journey will take you through extreme emotions and intense phases of stealth, exploration or action. Meet allies and learn how to survive your enemies.

HORROR ATMOSPHERE

Enter the incredibly terrifying atmosphere of Propagation. The sound design, lighting, and visuals all combine to create a truly immersive experience that will keep you on edge.

GAME MECHANICS

You will need all your skills and your wits to progress:

  • Gather resources

  • Solve puzzles

  • Use tools from your inventory

  • Choose to avoid or confront enemies

  • Reload your gun under stress

  • Free movement and teleportation locomotion support.

Stay in touch with the game development! Follow and Wishlist on Steam, and check out WanadevStudio and PropagationVR on social media.

1824970.name: Escape from Cronos X
1824970.about_the_game:
ESCAPE FROM CRONOS X is a top-down action RPG that takes place in the year 2491 on the uncharted planet Cronos X.

Explore the planet, where you will encounter hordes of hostile creatures and powerful enemies, as you try to find a means of rescue.

Explore a vast planet


Explore tombs, vast wastelands, uncharted outposts, and abandoned research bases as you try to find a way to escape from Cronos.

Fight


Fight the hordes of corrupted creatures roaming Cronos. From the Death walkers and reavers to behemoths and giant arachnids. You will face many, many enemies throughout the game.

Create your character


Choose from four different races and four different classes and origin stories. Make the character you want to be.

Uncover Cronos’ dark history


Cronos has a dark secret. Something happened on the planet to make it into a deadly world. Uncover the mysteries of the planet and perhaps a way to undo the evil.

Evolve


Choose how your character evolves. Earn experience through combat, completing missions and exploration.

Trade


You will find lots of loot on your journey. Some you want to keep, but much can be sold to the vendors residing on the planet.

Craft upgrades and equipment


Learn how to craft upgrades and vital equipment to increase your chance for survival.

Steam achievements

Earn Steam achievements as you advance through the game, solving missions and learning about Cronos.

The story

Humans have explored many star systems and made countless colonies in the bordering star systems. You are drafted by the USN (United Sol Nation) to rescue a group of scientists that has disappeared on Cronos X. As you approach the planet, you are plunged into action when your ship gets shot down.


Instead of rescuing the scientists, you now must fight to survive the harsh wilderness of Cronos and search for a way to escape the planet.

1825030.name: Daomei Village
1825030.about_the_game:
Daomei Village





Daomei Village is a charming, pixel art game set in a quaint environment that stimulates creativity!


By order of the Emperor, you have been transferred to Daomei Village and tasked with restoring it to its splendor. Remember that nothing will escape the attention of the tax collector, who will demand the tributes claimable by the Emperor. Therefore, you have to take care of the farm, cultivate the fields, and breed the animals to generate income. It won't be easy at first, as you will only have a few simple tools, 100 yuan, some rice seeds, and some tea. However, don't give up! An amazing adventure awaits you. You will meet friends who, like you, were sent to the Unlucky Village for their crimes.




Changes in the seasons affect the possibility of growing vegetables and flowers. Each species of animal requires a dedicated space. Go ahead, create the place of your dreams - fields, buildings, surroundings. You can create and improve it all. Introduce crop automation technology and beautify the area.




Activities for the Village will bring you happiness and recognition. The reassured Emperor will allow you to go to the lands of the enemies occupied by the imperial army. Thanks to this, you will obtain information about new technologies, as well as get new raw materials, tools and seeds. The more difficult the terrain, the greater the chance of unique achievements.However, the risk of a fight also increases. Everything you get during the expeditions is yours and can be used to build your Village. You decide on the pace of its development. You are its leader.




In Daomei Village, everyone has committed a crime of some sort. When interacting with the townspeople, you will receive tasks that will help you gain their trust. Moreover, you will learn the reason behind their crime.


Daomei Village is an absolutely unique and magical place. You will come across the traces of previous dynasties, learn about the unique Chinese folklore and demonology. You will celebrate feasts accordingQ to the Chinese calendar, as well as the birthdays of the residents. You cannot miss it!

1825110.name: Castle of Secrets
1825110.about_the_game:
The ancient Tranton family curse has forced young Miss Susan to embark on a perilous journey—one that will take her deep into the realm of the dead. Along the way, she will encounter ghostly inhabitants, forge unexpected alliances, face formidable enemies, and, most importantly, uncover the answer to the most haunting question of all: Who is truly responsible for the massacre of her entire family?

One day, in the grand halls of the Tranton family castle, a loving couple welcomed a daughter into the world—her name was Miss Susan.

Her father, Mr. Grinn was a man of remarkable charm and influence, deeply adored by his wife and daughter. But tragedy struck when he met a mysterious and untimely death.

Grief consumed Susan’s mother, Miss Agatha, who found herself lost in sorrow, wandering the castle like a shadow, unable to bear the weight of her loss. Those around her, hoping to bring her solace, arranged for her to remarry. Her new husband, Mr. Austin was a rich and intelligent gentleman. This union brought a small sense of order back into the family.

Yet this fragile peace was nothing more than an illusion.

Like a black cat prowling in the night, misfortune slinked through the halls, leaving whispers of curses and sins in its wake…

Castle of Secrets is a story-line based psychological mystery adventure game, immersing players in a hauntingly beautiful atmospheric 3D environment with intricately hand-drawn 2D characters. 

The game cleverly weaves puzzle-solving into the narrative, offering a range of challenges that will test your intelligence and logical thinking. Every puzzle is more than just an obstacle; it is a crucial piece of the mystery, with solutions that directly impact the course of the story.

3D Point-and-Click Exploration – Freedom and interaction are at the heart of the experience. Examine, collect, and manipulate objects, and explore every hidden corner of the castle utilizing a unique interactive scene camera. 

Every item you collect may hold the key to a deeper truth – pay close attention, analyze, and combine objects to progress in your quest to uncover the sinister secrets buried within these ancient walls.

Meet 30+ Unpredictable Characters – Every encounter matters. Some residents may help you, others may deceive you, and all of them have their own agendas.

Branching Narrative with Multiple Endings–Your choices shape Miss Susan’s fate.How far will you go to uncover the truth?

Beautiful Hand-Drawn Original Art – Experience a uniquely crafted world where every detail is an original piece of art. From meticulously designed 3D environments to stunning hand-drawn 2D characters, every scene is brought to life with an evocative, atmospheric style that enhances the mystery and immersion of the game.

1825150.name: Cells of Immunity
1825150.about_the_game:
Overview of the story


Play as a young Thymocyte, training to become one of the primary white blood cells that protect the human body. Meet other cells in training, and find out who is talented enough to become a white blood cell and the fate of the failures. As the story progresses, you'll have the ability to control multiple types of white blood cells, such as T-Killer cells, Macrophages and neutrophils. Each with its unique strengths and weaknesses, command them correctly to overcome all obstacles caused by invading pathogens. Use the correct types of attacks against your enemies in Real-Time action-bar combat in order to defeat your enemies. To serve and protect the human body at all costs.

Game Features

  • 1-2 Hours of Gameplay
  • 3 Acts of Story
  • 3+ Playable Characthers
  • 3+ Different Classes
  • Dozens of Items, Weapon and Gear to collect!
  • Over 10 types of encounters!
  • Over 20 different areas to explore!
  • Many types of attacks, elements and status conditions.

Details about the game


This game is an educational Role-Playing-Game, all about the human immune system. You will experience the lives of many cells involved in the immune system. Learn about the objectives of different cell types involved in the immune response, and fight against invading pathogens.

Many factors in this game, such as appearances and interactions between cells, have been altered, to fit better into a game and a good story. Despite the alterations, all events and characters in this game are based upon how the human immune system works in real life, and as a result, we aim to teach everyone who plays our game a bit more about the immune system than they knew before. Furthermore, students in medical or biological areas may find this game useful to visualize the interactions within the human body. Although some amount of scientific accuracy has been lost, this makes a much easier to understand.

This game has been developed by University of Warwick students, and the story has been fact-checked by Professors of Warwick, to stay relatively accurate to the actual science behind it. The development of this game has been funded by IATL of Warwick, making it accessible for everyone to play and learn from it.

1825160.name: The Backrooms
1825160.about_the_game:
The Backrooms is a survival horror game set in one of the most terrifying environments of the human psyche. Navigate through to backrooms of an old office complex and remember the terror you experienced as a child.
.
A single player horror survival game that places you in a maze of rooms and hallways with terrifying creatures. Run through a dozen unique rooms to stay alive as long as possible... and maybe even escape. Keep your camcorder ready to capture some of the horrors of The Backrooms. Maybe the next unfortunate soul will find the recordings... for better or worse.

1825180.name: Auro The Bunny
1825180.about_the_game:
Auro The Bunny is a charming 2D platformer where you control Auro, a fearless rabbit, who must collect all the fruits scattered across the levels. This task will require a lot of patience and precision from the player, and the game can get dark pretty quickly... Get ready to face various obstacles and challenges!

Challenges
Face numerous challenges that will test your dexterity, reflexes, and most likely your sanity...



Challenging Obstacles
Avoid a variety of dangerous obstacles that stand in your way. Use your wits to overcome these adversities.



Three Distinct Scenarios
Traverse different environments while tackling challenges with Auro the bunny.



Enchanting Soundtrack
Enjoy a beautiful soundtrack as you accompany Auro on his journey.

1825200.name: The Open League
1825200.about_the_game:
The Open League (TOL) is a text-based football/soccer manager game with significant integration with the Discord platform. Key features include:

Nightly matches, 3-week season
Full 90-minute matches are simulated nightly with play-by-play text updates streamed in our Discord server.

Each universe features 30 teams organized in three leagues. Top three teams are promoted to a higher league. Bottom three get relegated. A season lasts three weeks.

Youth camp
During the off-season, teams attend Youth Camp with the hope to find the nexg legendary player. Camp lasts a weekend. During that time, managers use scouting reports to decide which players to bid on. Most team dynasties in TOL were built on succesful youth camp campaigns.

Friendly matches
Managers also have the ability to organize friendly matches against other managers. They often use the off-season to organize tournaments against other teams.

Persistent teams and players
At the end of the season, managers keep their teams. Players develop and decay season after season. Transfer timing is everything.

Simple team management
We’ve simplified club management so you don’t need to play 100s of hours to get familiar with our platform. Managers can choose between six formations, three effort levels and three different mindsets. Simple does not mean easy, beware…

Negotiate transfers against humans
Transfers are negotiated against human managers over Discord before deals are formalized using the TOL application. Astute dealmakers thrive in TOL.

Browser-ready
Our web app allows you to access your club portal from any browser (including from your phone), in case you have to make some changes from a different computer…

Bots
TOL uses a few friendly bots in Discord to help you manage your team. For example, you can DM your assistant Chris to ask him to send out a press release to all other clubs about your latest victorious match!

Multi-timezone support
The Open League supports two timezones (US PST and GMT) at the moment. This means matches are played at 7:00pm PST if you are in our US server or 7:00pm GMT if you are in our European server.

1825210.name: DESTRUCTURE: Among Debris
1825210.about_the_game:
In DESTRUCTURE: Among Debris you use the power of (very totally realistic) physics to destroy the world around you. Following a devastating, apocalyptic event, the world is filled with garbage, abandoned structures and angry robot turrets and it is your mission to clean it from this dusty mess.

The gameplay revolves around the player-controlled Round Thingy of Destruction that you have a full 360-degree control over, making smashing the iron ball so much more satisfying. But you must remember not to lose your ball. Behind you there’s a metal grinder in each level ready to consume all of the balls (stop giggling, Gregg) you are too slow to repel.

But DESTRUCTURE is no ordinary arkanoid-like game, because the levels fight back! Destroy enough structures and you will alert some bloodthirsty turrets, and trust us, they are definitely not happy to see you. Using all your finesse, you must dodge their bullets, missiles, lasers and other looming dangers and the more you destroy, the more you have to dodge. Bullet hell aficionados rejoice!

If you’re lucky you might stumble upon mighty weapons and power ups to use in the spur of the moment. It’s like finding a nickel on the side-walk, but the nickel is a rocket launcher or a laser gun and the side-walk is the debris of a structure that once had some semblance of purpose.

Progressing through the world of DESTRUCTURE is a tough and unforgiving job. For one, there are evil robots trying to murder you and the environments are filled with various hazards. That’s why your benefactors have provided you with a wide array of unlockable tools, upgrades and perks that should provide enough leverage to give you a fighting chance. They’re not free though, so remember to collect Blue Stuff (whatever it is) that your benefactors will use for very important deeds no one really knows or indeed cares about. You’d be best suited collecting as much as you possibly can. That is, if you don’t get shot while you’re at it!

With this Blue Stuff you can purchase exciting new toys like “Zeus’ Blessing”, “Suicidal Turrets“ or just some good old “Napalm Rain“ to ascend the ranks of ordinary, trash-fighting Round Thingys of Destruction! and become the ultimate destroyer of what remains of the dusty, barren worlds of DESTRUCTURE.
1825210.supported_languages: English, Italian, Ukrainian, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Polish, Japanese

1825220.name: The Mirst
1825220.about_the_game:
The Mirst is a horror game, you will be unleashed in front of your house where bizarre events are going to happen to you to find the origin of it all.

The Mirst is an original indie Horror game inspired by the real and past facts of the game's creator. Relive one of the stories in this first-person game, analyze every detail of this house that's what's hidden there. You will be cowardly in this house at your own risk, to seek and find the origin of the various events in this house.

Every element and object can be inspected, doors to open with keys to hide or paintings to move, concentrate or flee this house.

Inspectable Item

Each Object of this house will be possible to look at them more closely which is what this house hides as a secret .....

Paranormal Event

Live a new paranormal experience, which is what awaits you in this house. Don't worry, it's everywhere .....

Solo

No need for a friend to help you in this solo adventure live alone as the character in the game

Story

Live a Story inspired by real feelings, live the story as the character will have lived it

Immersion

A particular point has been put on the design of a simple and sober interface with realistic graphics and 3D Audios in order to offer you a better immersion.

OMG STUDIO 2021

1825250.name: Touhou Lensed Night Sky, Kaseigai
1825250.about_the_game:
- THE GAME -

Touhou Lensed Night Sky, Kaseigai is a nontraditional bullet hell that focuses on a fully modular loadout. The player's own attacks and special effects can be exchanged midway through runs as the situation demands, or simply for fun.

There are a lot of ways to approach the game, with three playable characters, four major difficulty options, and a myriad of challenges and difficulty-lowering options that can be enabled or disabled at will.

- TOUHOU PROJECT -

This game is a fanwork of Touhou Project, a multimedia series that takes place in a hidden country called Gensokyo. The characters and setting in this game are the same as those in the official releases. However, some time has passed for them. Maybe everyone is not exactly as you recall?

If you're not familiar with the Touhou Project series, don't worry! Touhou Lensed Night Sky, Kaseigai is relatively self-explanatory and doesn't demand additional knowledge in order to be played.

- FEATURES -

  • Over three hundred items!

  • Over a bazillion bullets!

  • A bunch of achievements!

  • A bunch of challenges to make the game universally easier or harder!

  • A ton of marketable plushies, and one absolutely unmarketable one!

  • One hundred and fifty thousand lines of code! (Most people don't care about this one)

  • Music!

  • Art!

  • Touhou!

  • And 60 bad endings uniquely written for every possible loss! Never a run wasted if there's a new dumb joke at the end!
1825250.reviews:
“this game, unfortunately, every single box ticked. fuck. that's like, the best review you're ever going to get in your fucking life.”
