“I love this game, but [...] total nightmare [...] optimization [...] paradox [...] it's better than [...] Angry Video Game Nerd”
Drillimation Systems

“Yooo let's make a Touhou game haha, how long could that even take lol?”
Fire Land (before knowing)

1825290.name: Vnesis
1825290.about_the_game:
Dive into the neon glow of VNESIS, an adrenaline-fueled homage to the golden era of arcade gaming. It's the '80s reimagined – a 2D side-scrolling adventure wrapped in a 3D world that's as vivid as your most vibrant retro dreams. With over 16 levels, each a labyrinth of nostalgia and challenge, VNESIS doesn't just beckon you to play; it dares you. This is where heart-pounding action meets razor-sharp responsiveness, creating a symphony of arcade excitement. Get ready to blast through a universe that's been crafted with a love for the classics and a passion for the pulse of adventure. VNESIS isn’t just a game; it’s a portal to a time when pixels were king and every jump, shot, and dash was a leap of faith into the spectacular unknown.





Unleash powerful abilities to dominate the leaderboard - summon allies for that much-needed backup or deploy an impenetrable shield to safeguard your craft. Ready your reflexes, embrace the retro-futuristic vibe, and dive into the action – VNESIS is the ultimate playground for the ace pilot in you!
1825290.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Traditional Chinese

1825310.name: Lupa
1825310.about_the_game:
From an aspiring indie game developer comes Lupa. A beautiful stylized polygon 3rd-person exploration game. With a semi-open world and the story inspired by Roman mythology. Lupa is a She-Wolf and she is the mother of two little cubs. As the winter is about over she wakes up in her cave and can't seem to find her entire pack! She goes looking for them. This is where you as a player come in. You accompany Lupa in this beautiful world full of Vegetation and Life. Help Lupa find her missing pack and her two little cubs. And uncover secrets along the way...

Key features:

  • For people who like Journey, The First Tree, Spirit of the North, and Lost Ember.
  • A relaxing story-based game with a semi-open world.
  • Colorful biomes, forests, snow, and roaming wildlife.
  • Short game (About an hour) depends on how much you explore the world

There is sadly no controller support.

1825350.name: Haunted Hotel: Silent Waters Collector's Edition
1825350.about_the_game:
Elephant Games proudly present the next installment of the Haunted Hotel series!

You've woken up in an eerie hotel. You don’t know how you got there, or what's waiting for you. What starts as a simple search for a way out quickly takes a dark turn as your attempts are thwarted by a malevolent spirit! It's up to you to save yourself and the people trapped with you. Can you uncover the hotel's secrets and escape before it's too late? Find out in this gripping hidden-object puzzle adventure!

This is a special Collector's Edition release full of exclusive extras you won't find in the standard version. The Collector's Edition includes:

• Unlock the mysterious Secret Room.
• Earn achievements to show off your skills!
• Enjoy the game's wallpapers, soundtrack, and more.

This is a Hidden Object Puzzle Adventure game, meaning a specific genre of story-driven, point & click adventures. Throughout the game, players are tasked to find a list of objects hidden within a particular scene, and to occasionally complete various mini-games/puzzles.

1825380.name: Maroon Berets: 2030
1825380.about_the_game:
Narrative

Maroon Berets: 2030 is FPS, TPS, Action-RPG; which simulates the units of Turmenkay special forces in the war, the game is set in the Agriri, Turmenkay as well as some provinces of Arartiah. The rising tensions between counties named Arartiah and Turmenkay lead to a war where special forces of Turmenkay named Maroon Berets are called to the duty to fight against Arartiah. At the same time, Maroon Berets face another threat - the rebels. Witness the adventure of special forces and overcome the challenges for the country and its people!

Gameplay


  • Experience 10+ highly detailed levels with realistic environments.
  • Realistic gun recoil and muzzle flash system.
  • Eliminate enemies and gain XP to unlock new weapons!
  • Change the mouse and keyboard settings as you wish!

1825390.name: MadMan
1825390.about_the_game:
Trapped inside an abandoned mental asylum with a psychopathic killer lurking about, you are forced to explore the facility armed with only your wits to survive. With a blood hungry madman on your trail you are never safe, every move could be your last. Will you escape to tell the tale or become another victim?

Synopsis

You find yourself lost inside a creepy abandoned asylum, you have no form of self defense and must find your way through the asylum while being hunted by a brutal serial killer. Once a former doctor at the facility now a blood hungry madman, he will stop at nothing to get his hands on you. Use your wits to outsmart the doctor or hide and pray he doesn't find you. MadMan is a first person indie horror game built for tension.

Gameplay



- Genre: Walking simulator
- You will explore a dark, creepy asylum oozing with atmosphere.
- You will find notes that will help you uncover the story of what happened at the asylum.
- You must pay attention to sound to interpret the doctor's whereabouts.
- You will run or hide from the doctor to survive.
- There are no jump scares, the game uses tension to scare the player.

The Doctor



- The doctor is always exploring the asylum looking for you, he will attack you on sight and players can use sound to distract him.

- There are some traps the doctor has set up to notify him where you are, be sure to find hidden clues to prevent him from getting alerted to your location.

MadMan is a true survival horror experience, you are no combat veteran and must avoid the horrors that lurk about to survive.

Features

  • Run and Hide - combat is no skill of yours, you can only avoid the horror that lurks within by running / hiding
  • Realistic Graphics - AAA graphics to produce the ultimate horror atmospheric experience
  • Sound based gameplay - Use the sound of footsteps to interpret the doctor's whereabouts, or perhaps make noise to distract him to reach your goal

Future Updates

While the game is fully released there will still be frequent updates to improve the game.

AVERAGE PLAY TIME : 30 MINUTES

Warning

MadMan contains intense gore and violence, do enjoy yourself.

1825440.name: Cupid Story: First Date
1825440.about_the_game:
Cupid Story is an RPG / dating sim in the Cupid Island universe.
The cupid Noelia has a mission: get the human Daniel a girlfriend in 14 days. Too bad he's got no talent at all to make her job easier.

FEATURES

  • Classical turn-based RPG battle system
  • Stronger relationships make for stronger characters
  • Unlock new skills as the story progresses
  • Dates are battles
  • Choose the right girlfriend for Daniel from 3 unique girls

This game is a prologue, it features the first episode of the complete Cupid Story .
1825440.supported_languages:
English*, Portuguese - Brazil*
*languages with full audio support

1825460.name: PC Virtual LAB
1825460.about_the_game:
PC Virtual Lab is a video game to improve learning in basic computer concepts.

Its main objectives are:

  • Improve learning in basic computer science concepts
  • To complement the theory seen in the classroom with an educational game that serves to fix these concepts.
  • To provide the student with a tool that allows him/her to deepen this knowledge outside the classroom in an autonomous way.
  • An environment where to practice and fail without risk that allows unlimited repetition.

1825480.name: Rendezvous: Shadows of the Past
1825480.about_the_game:
I can't remember the last time we smiled and laughed together.
After our parents died, you went one way and I went another.
Is this really how you want to see this through? To end up like them and hope we reunite?
I just wish for once that you'd stop running, stop lying, and look me in the eyes and say you missed me.
Is it really that hard to do Setyo?
Can you do that, for us
For what's left of our family?



Rendezvous: Shadows of the Past is the prologue to the upcoming 2.5D Cyber-Noir pixel art puzzle-action adventure game by Pendopo Studios. This free adventure takes place in Bay City, following security guard Setyo starting another day of his mundane job — until a familiar face from his past resurfaces.


A stunning combination of 2D hand-drawn pixel art in a 2.5D world, melded with modern effects such as dynamic lighting and bloom to bring depth and life to the city around you.



Multiple paths lead to items, objects of interest, and tools that help you find your sister — and many secrets along the way!



Gather clues and use everything you know to solve challenges that stand on your path to redemption.



For the risk-averse, sneak around threats... or directly confront them with the (sometimes improvised) weapons available.
1825480.supported_languages:
English*, Indonesian
*languages with full audio support
1825480.reviews:
“Indonesian Game ‘Rendezvous’ Takes Place in a Cyberpunk Version of Surabaya”
IGN SEA

1825510.name: Resurrection of mind
1825510.about_the_game:
The game takes place on Earth in the distant future. The familiar world is threatened by a threat from the past. As it turned out, an ancient race of highly intelligent beings owned this world long before people. They called themselves "The Firstborn". But a few million years ago, a meteorite hit the Earth, destroying 90% of life on the planet and making it almost uninhabitable. To save their species, the originals had to go to sleep, hibernating their city for years to come.

Kirk Hussl, a former Special Forces soldier and now a thief, received an order from an anonymous author for an interesting artifact hidden in the ocean. Having sailed to the coordinates indicated by the anonymous, he discovered an unusual crystal. Removing it with the bathyscaphe's manipulator, he provoked an explosion that damaged the power supply system of the hibernation pods in the city of the originals. From the explosion, Kirk falls in the bathyscaphe and hits his head, losing consciousness, but before that, having time to order the system to ascend. Kirk regains consciousness while in a local prison.

A young girl, Zendaya, an antiquities hunter, goes to the ruins in search of "artifacts" that will pay well. Ancient treasure hunter. By nature, she is an adventurer, often looking for adventure in very dangerous places. Green-eyed brunette. Smart, well-built, she travels the world in search of various artifacts, she decides to explore the city of the originals that arose on the site of the ruins of Wilmington.

An archeology student named Yoko leads his own personal investigation into the causes of the cataclysm. Everything that was dear to him, everyone he loved, died in this tragedy. He returned to the city to find out the truth about what happened and visit his ruined house. A typical nerd, somewhat naive and funny.

Meanwhile, the ancient city of the first-born people, "Gentem", has risen from the abyss and ascended into the skies to find a new location on land, splashing out a wave of energy in the process that destroyed part of the east coast of the United States. The release was the result of a failed battery in one of the life support systems of the ancient city. The city of Wilmington fell into ruins, many people died, and the rest lost their homes. The ruined city became the new foundation for Gentem. The Originals decide to start a process of controlled terraforming of the Earth in order to bring the climate to a state suitable for them. This threatens the disappearance of all mankind from the face of the earth.


Hussl breaks out of prison, and the ruins of Wilmington become the only place to hide. Meanwhile, Yoko is sent to investigate the scene of the tragedy, and Zendaya, the city itself. Chance brings all three heroes together. They learn about the plans of the originals and try to stop them.

- The ruins of the city are waiting for you, in place of which there is now a completely different city - the City of the Firstborn who rose from the depths of the ocean; - Three characters whose story you have to reveal;
- Dynamic battles with many unique abilities of all three characters;
- The game world in the genre of metroidvania divided into 6 zones;
- Memorable enemies;
- Dynamic, fast-paced plot;
- Ability to create items;
- Heroes have unique skills of their own;
- A variety of missions with intricate goals!
- Very cool music!

1825530.name: Little Sparks
1825530.about_the_game:
Little Sparks is a casual game where you're trying to capture more fireflies of different colors than your AI opponent does. It's a thinky turn-based game in which you get three actions per turn and use them to lay and destroy electric walls hoping to catch the different fireflies and add them to your jar. It's not about having the most fireflies overall but the most of the most different colors.

Each type of fly rewards the player who caught it with different special abilities: extra actions, bubble freeze, lanterns, and bringing in the love bug. These bonuses must be strategically used at the right times to capture the most bugs.

1825540.name: Superposition
1825540.about_the_game:
Superposition is a simple sokoban style puzzle game about duplication. By splitting yourself into multiple copies you have to maneuver onto all goal tiles simultaneously to progress.

The goal with this game was to iterate on a few novel mechanics in a sokoban world, and play with the consequences to discover interesting scenarios. The game contains 50 puzzles that intend to explore those mechanics.

1825550.name: Acceptance
1825550.about_the_game:
A story-driven psychological thriller about the horrific consequences of a loved one's suicide.

After the tragedy of his wife's suicide, an office worker must process the horrific events surrounding the incident. Experience haunting characterizations of five stages of grief – denial, anger, bargaining, depression and finally acceptance in this atmospheric 2D psychological thriller. The story focuses on the social issue of suicide and explores relationships with people who are at risk.

Features
  • Story-driven psychological thriller
  • Focus on suicide and people at risk
  • Immersive story and detailed characters.
  • Original graphics and soundtrack.
1825550.supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian

1825620.name: Blank Frame
1825620.about_the_game:
In the small town of Dim River, Henri wakes up in the middle of the night to a sudden and loud noise. A strange metal cabinet has fallen through the ceiling from the apartment above, effectively blocking his front door. The night life of the town goes on, oblivious to Henri's struggles as he tries to solve his predicament, perhaps not completely on his own.

The night is going to be long and peculiar...

Blank Frame focuses on atmosphere and story instead of constantly startling the player with cheap and unnecessary jump scares. Blank Frame is meant mainly for fans of slow paced surreal/psychological horror games and films.




The night will take the average player about an hour and a half to two hours to play through on your first attempt and is meant to be played entirely in one sitting. Two different endings can be achieved depending on how you go through the game.




Game play is a combination of point and click and walking simulators with a dark and psychological tone. However, it is possible to die in this game. Thankfully chances to die are rare and can be avoided fairly easily so deaths do not feel cheap.



In Blank Frame you will...

    Experience a dark and winding story line, always unsure of what is coming next.
    Solve various puzzles that Henri faces to find his way out of predicaments.
    Face one of two endings based on your choices during this 1 1/2 to 2 hour long experience.

The team behind Blank Frame:
Riku Lempiäinen - Creator & Designer
Robbert van Bruggen & Johann Hackl (Gazers) - Soundtrack


Join ThroughTunnel Discord Channel!

1825650.name: Human Apocalypse: Prologue
1825650.about_the_game:
WARNING: This game contains heavy material that might make players/audience uncomfortable.
An unknown deadly virus has suddenly spread. It turns people into brain eating zombies, the whole world goes into chaos, etc. You know the rest.

However, in this game, a cure has been found. All the infected people have been treated and are now normal, functioning, harmless humans again. Except for one thing, the cured people’s skin color is still green. Play as a Green man.

Human Apocalypse Prologue is a game set in a post-POST-apocalyptic world focusing on story, characters, decisions, and exploration. The dark, bizarre world of this game has a deep thought-provoking story, full of interesting characters to meet, a city to freely roam and explore, tough decisions to make, an original soundtrack, beautiful visuals, lots of secrets to uncover.
1825650.supported_languages:
English*, German*, Spanish - Spain*, Arabic*, Korean*, Polish*, Portuguese - Brazil*, Russian*, Simplified Chinese*, Turkish*, Japanese*, Portuguese - Portugal*, Spanish - Latin America*
*languages with full audio support

1825670.name: Santa's Slippery Slope (Ski Stunts)
1825670.about_the_game:
A skiing experience like no other with a unique control system and purely physics driven gameplay. Join Santa in this exciting physics-based journey on the slopes to get back all of the lost presents and save Christmas before its too late!

FEATURES:
• Tons of levels each with multiple unique challenges to conquer, supplying hours upon hours of gameplay and loads of replay value!


• Open over-world with non-linear level progression, struggling on one level? Simply go try another and come back later!


• Excellent graphics and optimized performance allowing the game to look great and still run on low end devices with integrated graphics!

• Realistic physics give you precise control over skiing Santa!

• Intuitive controls allow anyone to pick up and play, but require dedication to master!


• Hilarious rag-doll bails, funny sounds, and goofy physics!

• Challenging but rewarding gameplay. The road ahead wont be easy, but it feels great when you conquer each level!


• Unique level design, with challenging hills, jumps, loops and physics based obstacles!

• Packed with holiday cheer, winter vibes, and seasonal excitement!

1825690.name: Starship Wars
1825690.about_the_game:
Add to your wish list!!

A great power war is going on, fight for victory!!



Game features

  • Play in 3 different game modes, an Infinite Mode to challenge your abilities, an Adventure Mode with 35 levels to challenge your skills and a Survival Mode to challenge your stamina.
  • Defeat several different bosses and enemies.
  • Extremely accurate controls.
  • Use over 80 different shots to defeat your enemies.
  • Buy powerful ships, special shots and mini ships to help you in battle and get a high score.



Gameplay - Move in all four directions to dodge enemies and enemy shots, destroy all bosses, enemies and everything you see ahead, collect crystals to spend in the store, grab upgrades to strengthen your shots and mini ships to help you in battle.

1825700.name: Push Battle
1825700.about_the_game:
Push Battle is a casual multiplayer action game.
Push Battle is an action game that you can enjoy with simple operations.
"Smash", in which the character Tackles with his ass vigorously, is an exhilarating action.
The game rules are simple and it is a game that you can easily enjoy.
Also, the character "Kepplin" is very cute and attractive.

Use your butt to blow your opponent away!

1825740.name: Fat Baby
1825740.about_the_game:
In Fat baby multiple babies battle it out to get as fat as they can by eating and destroying everything around them. Traverse around a destructible environment while trying to avoid danger. Search for things to stuff your face with so you can increase your size and tower over the other babies. Use your fat to buy abilities and use your abilities to wreak havoc on everything in your path!

The babies objective is to find things to eat around the map so he can fend off the dangers that the environment and the other players pose. Consume everything from cupcakes to cars, and much more! Become fat enough to decimate the entire landscape or hunt smaller babies and steal their fat.

1825760.name: ENDURA
1825760.about_the_game:
ENDURA is hack-n-slash action adventure game that is inspired by air traversal of Spiderman mixed with big monsters reminisce to Monster Hunter.

Embark on an epic journey as Jack Jr, an ex-convict who is being offered a chance to turn his life around by an organization. He needs to brave his way through monsters and grapples his way around to delivers important packages to the survivors of broken world of Yagra.

FEATURES


  • Hack-N-Slash Action Adventure - Play as Jack Jr as he traverse the realm of Yagra, engaging with monsters in high paced action combat.
  • Air Parkour - Utilize the grapple to move quickly in the air to make your journey easier.
  • Stylized Art Style - Experience the beauty of Realm of Yagra that is powered by Unreal Engine 4.
  • Asian Inspired Bunian - Implemented into the character design with some influence from Malaysian arts and culture.

1825850.name: Pixel Game Maker Series MEDIUM-NAUT
1825850.about_the_game:
An exploratory sci-fi horror action game by Naramura Takumi of LA-MULANA!


【STORY】
The space pioneer ship Ostracida has crashed on an uncharted planet, but the survey team that went to rescue the survivors was unable to enter the ship and return.
They were unable to enter the ship due to psychic phenomena.
So they ask a psychic medium, "Yumi Kisara spiritist" to investigate the crashed ship.
The objective is to recover the ID chips of the passengers and investigate the ship, but it seems that there is "something" lurking that cannot be easily solved.
Fingers crossed for consideration!


【SYSTEM】
By acquiring various items on the ship, you can change your attack methods and expand your range of action.

However, in order to acquire items, you must give up your HP (physical strength) as compensation.
If you proceed without thinking, your HP will quickly dwindle and you will be killed by the slightest enemy attack.
Play the game repeatedly and make choices that suit your style.


【INVESTIGATION】
The souls of the crew are still on board.
By talking to them, you can obtain items and collect ID chips, and by obtaining ID chips, you can enter their private rooms.
There are also reports from Dr. Simon and personal records of the crew, so you can investigate what happened on the ship.


"Pixel Game Maker Series" is a series where you can enjoy games created using the action game production software " Pixel Game Maker MV".

1825880.name: 作死吧！UP主！
1825880.about_the_game:
用生命在整活！

你是一位直播up主，公司为了让你涨粉涨人气，逼你去叙利亚战场、核辐射区域、丧尸围城的城市等种种危险地方，开始真人生存直播！在开始生存游戏前，你要拿着公司给的一点点可怜的预算资金，自己调配购买需要的生存物资，雇佣其他有不同技能和特性的up主，跟你一起工（zuo）作（si）...总之，流量就是一切！不但要一边整活、完成公司给的涨粉涨流量KPI，还要一边在残酷的环境中活下来！太强了！我愿称你为最强UP主！

游戏要素

■多个危险而奇异的直播场景：资本家的公司嘛，当然要你去观众最希望看到的地方直播！包括叙利亚战场、辐射区域的避难所、丧尸围城的城市等等，你在那里直播，肯定可以吸引很多很多的流量！当然，你的生命安全是不在公司考虑范围之内的，没了你，后面还有一大堆up主排着队求公司呢！你不干有的是人干！


■ 各种突发随机事件：在这种奇葩的工作之中，随时会有奇葩的随机事件！观众骂人、莫名掉粉、怪物入侵、暴风雪、资源紧缺、意外收获等等，都让你的真人生存直播之旅充满未知！

■ 多个不同特性的Up主：你不是孤军奋战！还可以雇佣多个拥有不同技能、不同特性的up主来帮助你一起直播！他们可能在关键时刻挽救你！——或者扯你后腿...

这是个奇怪的小游戏，希望您玩得开心！：）

1825900.name: Blink Planets
1825900.about_the_game:
Have you ever dreamed of becoming a pioneer of the universe and developing a whole new planet?
Blink Planets is a strategy puzzle game based on the idea of ​​adding planet terraforming to a hexagonal board game.

The main task of the game is to efficiently place blocks representing different resources,
so that people can successfully settle on strange planets in space.

The colorful Base symbolizes the resources needed to develop a planet.
Water, energy, greenery, weather, and gold mines... they don't seem to have anything to do with each other,
but the Bases and Blocks are all intertwined to form a habitable planet.

Every time, the planets change into a new appearance.
Create your own planet by connecting each resource effectively within a limited time.
What will your planet look like?

Key Features

  • Explore the unknown planets in the mysterious universe, and enjoy the charm of terrains.
  • There is no right answer in making a planet. Use the random Base resources to explore new planets with each time.
  • At the crossroads of choice, pick a module according to your feelings and have fun of growing in an unexpected direction.
  • If you need a moment to think, just press the pause button and consider. Your planet will be more beautiful.
  • Unlock new terrain and achievements as you master the game.
  • Send your own planet into GIF and share it with your friends.

1825930.name: 孤岛海妖 The Sea-demon
1825930.about_the_game:
登场人物

麻婆豆腐侦探团：【麻辣侦探】邬娅，
【密室侦探】上官千儿，【阿宅侦探】朱里葉，
【筋肉侦探】李丽思，【透明侦探】小莹。
工作人员：【船长】黄连，【管家】常安奕，【厨师】伽玛。

剧情

我是一个普通的推理爱好者，受到章鱼岛主人的邀请，与其他四人组成侦探小队，对六年前的海妖悬案发起挑战。我们需要在二十四小时内完成调查，并各自提交一份答案。怎料事情的发展超乎寻常，案件也越发扑朔迷离。经过七种解答的轮番洗礼，真相是否能浮出水面？

玩法

这是一款文字冒险游戏，以剧情为主，包含少量玩法。
玩家需要协助侦探团，在岛上进行调查取证，然后在各位侦探推理的时候选择合适的证据。
当然，最重要的是……活下去！

说明

文本量21万，预计时长6-8小时。
本游戏/系列与七人杀阵和六阶谜题（数字系列）为同一世界观，剧情和人物与前作存在关联，但可独立游玩，没玩过前作不影响对游戏主体的理解。
有任何问题和建议，请发送邮件，或加入官方群（757384080）。

已知BUG

（1）.用高分辨率显示器（4K以上）全屏游玩时，可能出现闪退（尤其是ED2字幕部分），暂无修复方法，请退出全屏，尝试最大化/窗口化进行游戏。
（2）.【1.0.2修复】选择证据和选项的时候闪退，是由于未知原因导致的系统存档损坏，解决方法是进入标题页点击“初次上岛”，然后再读取存档继续游戏

1826080.name: Galactic Defense: Automation
1826080.about_the_game:
Target Audience

For players who enjoy complex games and like to observe, but don't like tedious operations. Players focus on strategy and the details of the game are automated on their behalf.

Intro

"Galactic Defense: Automation" is a Placement, Automated Battle, Real-Time Strategy game. Players can place construction plans, observe automated construction, automated battles, and unlock new technologies. Players pass the level after collecting tech points through activities.

Massive Battles with Minimal Controls

The game features an astonishing number of units on the screen, with nearly 100 units initially and up to 500 units in the later stages. Players only need to make a few clicks. They simply need to place construction plans, and the game's AI takes care of the rest. The game also offers a pause and resume function, allowing players to give orders to units while paused.


Galactic Defense: Automation

In this game, you take on the role of a commander on the galactic frontier defense line, under human rule. Your task is to command and organize the development and expansion of military and civilian activities. Meanwhile, the indigenous alien species in the universe, known as the "Cleansers," stand in opposition to humanity. For them, human expansion is a threat to the universe, a pollution of the cosmos. Therefore, they have decided to eliminate humanity and protect the universe.

Players primarily strengthen themselves by collecting resources, planning construction, building and producing, and recycling resources. The "Cleansers," on the other hand, follow a completely different logic. They are wary of humans but gradually test and slowly harass them until they are provoked!

Respects Players' Time

Each game session lasts approximately 30 minutes.

Ecological Cycle

All units in the game have their own production, development, death, and recycling cycles, which occur automatically without player intervention.

Full Automation Mode

After completing the game, you can try the "Full Automation Mode." In this mode, players load a previous completed save file, and all the previous construction plans from the previous game are reproduced at specific time intervals. This means players can complete the game without any further actions or interventions.

Core Gameplay

  • Players need to destroy all enemy bases to achieve victory.
  • Periodically, waves of attacking enemies will emerge from the enemy bases.
  • By withstanding enemy attacks, destroying key enemy facilities, and eradicating their main stronghold, players earn "Merit" points.
  • Use "Merit" points to plan and construct projects.

Contact

Any contacts, bug reports, requests, suggestions, please don't hesitate to send me Email: jacksonxiegames@gmail.com
More gameplay videos on Tiktok:
Join Bitty Engine Discord to contact author:

1826120.name: Hive Defender

Attention!

Hive Defender has recently undergone a massive expansion of scope, thanks to the success of a demo released as part of steam next fest, but progress has simultaneously slowed down due to a heavy work load towards the end of my PhD and moving into a post-doc.

Join the discord if you want to vote on development decisions, try out the latest builds for free, etc :

---

Hive Defender is an co-op and PvE focused RTS which aims to hit that "easy to pick up, impossible to master" sweet spot, where the game is made to be enjoyable at all skill levels by offering accessible, but rewarding depth of gameplay.

There are only 4 unit types : Warrior and Supporter - and - Miner and Builder. But each one is designed to be used together for maximum effectiveness, and each of which offers unique skills that you can customize and upgrade throughout the match as you level up! Do you turn your miner into an aggressive explosives specialist to accompany the warrior in battle, or into a hyper-productive resource gather, protected by the builder's turrets? It's up to you and the re-rollable powerups you unlock as you advance in rank!

Oh -- and did I mention it all takes place inside of a procedurally generated, fully destructible labyrinth and that you play as the aliens? :)

If any of this sounds interesting to you, Wishlist Hive Defender today!

1826300.name: SOTANO - Mystery Escape Room Adventure
1826300.about_the_game:
SOTANO - Mystery Escape Room Adventure


Driving home from the airport you glance at your fuel gauge and notice the needle is hitting the red line. Starting to feel tired you decide to take a little known short cut through a quiet village, the shorter drive will save fuel rather than stopping to fill up.

“It’ll be fine, I just want to get home” you say to yourself.

Passing some of the large old houses the car begins to make some strange noises and you realise you have pushed your luck, rolling slowly to a halt in front of one of the largest houses on the street. How embarrassing.
You decide to swallow your pride and knock the door for help.

“Maybe a house this size might keep fuel for sit on mowers and generators.” You think, hopefully, to yourself.

Moments after knocking on the door your world turns black and you find yourself waking up in the basement, reading a note left by the owner:

I’m sorry you have found yourself waking up here but you were snooping on my property and I was alerted to your presence.

I will be back shortly.



You will find the door to your room locked. Don’t be alarmed, this is for your own safety as my home has many unconventional contraptions that might otherwise ‘confuse’ you.

Feel free to look around, although I apologise for the rather limited decor.



ABOUT

Sotano is a first person 3d escape room puzzle adventure, similar to games you may have played in the ’90’s or similar to a virtual escape rooms you may have played. An indoor immersive world that you explore and an inventory where you can collect and use items you find along the way to solve puzzles and escape the rooms.

Explore areas, collect hidden objects and take in your surroundings. You will need all of your puzzle solving skills to put together a plan to make your way through the house, solving riddles and through the many rooms to escape the house of Sotano.

How you tackle the puzzles is down to you. Each puzzle has a logical solution, so take your time, there is no rush and enjoy the process of understanding what you have to do.



FEATURES
• Explore an immersive indoor environment, solving puzzles and collecting items
• Use the inventory to collect and use objects
• Beautiful all original adventure 3D graphics, environments and atmosphere to explore
• Immersive backing soundtrack and effects to pull you into the adventure
• Full save system with load slots, manage all controls and sound levels to your preference.

CONTROLS:
Movement: WASD + Mouse
Inventory: I
Menu: ESC

HINTS & TIPS
If you need a hint or clue while playing Sotano then please reach out over email or social media (contact links can be found on my website) and I will be more than happy to help you.



SMALL PRINT
Sotano was created from the imagination of a solo indie developer.

“I am always excited to hear people playing my games and their experience along the way. Adventure gaming is my passion and your feedback helps my games get better.“

Sotano is compatible with most modern PC's and has been designed to be as resource efficient as possible to allow play on many different devices. With that said, if you do run into any difficulties please email so I can provide updates that help everyone enjoy the adventure.

1826400.name: CRAVE
1826400.about_the_game:
Untie the Fabrics of a Forgotten Realm


Built between engulfing arms of whispering seas and upon overambitious dreams, the isle realm of Foghorn now lies in ruin. Devoid of it's crown, land is clogged in filth, vanity and petrifying fear.

Crave is a classically styled 2D action adventure through a vast interconnected world. Explore gnarled alleys and corners of a decaying realm by utilizing your carnivores arsenal.



Game Features


  • Classic 2D side scrolling action adventure.
  • Tightly refined controls for challenging combat and platforming action.
  • Explore mossy bathhouses, cabaret theatre or a moldy greenhouse within a vast interconnected world.
  • Rediscover and utilize your carnivore abilities assisting you in both combat and exploration.
  • Devour your adversaries, whether they're men or beasts. Utilize their abilities in combat.



  • Chart the layout of the kingdom using your acute sense of smell and urination of claimed territories.
  • Equip various trinkets and talismans for a further customization of your playstyle.
  • Hand drawn 2D traditional animation style.
  • Original and evocative soundtrack, composed by Sky To Speak.




Supported using public funding by Slovak Arts Council





Join our Discord!

1826410.name: Runnyk
1826410.about_the_game:
Runnyk, is a 2D mini action RPG, which tells the story about a brave viking called Runnyk, who travels through cold lands inhabited by many evil creatures, trying to find the Four Magical Runes for the chance to save his beloved.

Play as Runnyk, who was a quite lonely viking, until he met a very special person. But suddenly one day, she gets sick from an unknown disease. Runnyk try everything but with no success, he prays to Odin everyday to help find the cure, but Odin does not respond. A sorceress then say to Runnyk that he needs be prepared to sacrifice his own life in order to find the Four Magical Runes, so he can met Odin himself in the Untouched Lands and ask for help.

During Runnyk's journey, he will face many powerful creatures and will find some friends too, who will help him on his quest. Also the more Runnyk face his enemies, the more he become strong so he can defeat the Ancient creatures who guards the Magical Runes!

FEATURES
- Visit four different winter themed scenarios;
- Some Norse Mythology References;
- Colorful 8-bit style graphics;
- Four Magical Rune Powers;
- Many useful Items to find;
- Simplified leveling system;
- Open World with many alternative paths.

1826420.name: CarX Drift Racing Online 2
1826420.about_the_game:
A new entry in the CarX Drift Racing series features a real competition format and a judging system of modern drift championships. The new realistic physics and tire model are a perfect fit for steering wheel setups and other game controllers. To prepare for multiplayer tournaments, you will progress from a beginner drift racer to a professional pilot, competing in world drift series.

Multiplayer

Duels, TOP 32 and freeride in online rooms. Skill-based matchmaking and a rating system in online events for your comfortable experience.

For us, drift is primarily a sport. To launch a series of esport tournaments around the world is the primary goal of this project.

Customization

An advanced tuning system and customization. Suspension, gearbox, ECU, and other important parts of a racecar are upgradeable, tunable, and finely customizable.

The damage system adds an extra layer of realism and immersion. Losing a bumper during a close call or leaving dents in a leader’s door is now possible!

Locations

The game features laser-scanned licenced tracks: Ebisu Circuit & Fuji Speedway in Japan, Nürburgring Nordschleife in Germany, Dominion Raceway in USA and ADM Raceway in Russia.

Career

You will start your drifting career in the drift school, learning the basics and mastering advanced drift control.

In Career mode, you’ll rise through the ranks - from local street contests to elite world championships. Compete in racing series, dominate championships, secure sponsorships, and fine-tune your cars to meet regulations. Most importantly, prepare yourself for the ultimate challenge - drifting online!

Controllers

We support most of steering wheels, gear shifters, gamepads, and other common controllers, available on the market, but we can always add more, the work’s not done yet.

1826450.name: Idling Idol
1826450.about_the_game:
◆Raise up idols by idling!
The basis of the game rule is Idling!
Idols grow up over time.
Time resource management simulation.

① Let's decide the name of the idol group!
② Let's choose an idol at the audition!


③ Start training and work with the whole group!
Collect fans and earn money.
When an event occurs, the idol's ability will increase.
And it is also important to take a rest when idls are tired!


④ Use the money you earn to buy health recovery items and strengthen your training facilities.
A fulfilling training environment is indispensable for raising top idols!


⑤ A live concert will be held when the funds are saved!
The way customers enter depends on the number of fans in the entire group.
Let's aim to hold the idol's dream, "Dome Live"!


⑥ Training is completed in 4 seasons of spring, summer, autumn and winter, and 1 year of activity!
The idol rank is determined by the funds earned by the group!


⑦ And to the next training ...!
There is no end to idol group development!


◆The one and only idols
Idols have random names, appearances, stats, and personalities.
It is automatically generated by AI during the audition.
Is the criterion for selecting members of the group your favorite appearance or ability score?
Choose the one and only idol and raise it to become a top idol!


◆Gameplay where the same thing never happens again
Depending on the random element, you can enjoy different developments each time you play.
・ All idol appearances and stats are random
・ Randomly generate advantageous training effects for each season
・ Events that fluctuate idol stats and physical strength occur randomly

There is no absolute answer for idol training.
As a producer, always be flexible!

◆language
Supports Japanese and English
You can switch from the config button on the title page.

1826460.name: Shopping Mall Renovator
1826460.about_the_game:
Buy, clean up, renovate and decorate shopping malls in this fun and engaging renovator
game. Look for buildings that can be refurbished into shopping centers, buy them at a fair
price, watch your vision come to life and make money by selling your projects to local
businessmen or by running them yourself!


Clean up the space! Most of the halls will be abandoned and will desperately need
restoration. You will have to collect all the trash, clean the walls, clean the rust, install new
windows, doors, and a lot more!


There are plenty of floor patterns and paints that you can put on the walls. Match them with
the decoration and the type of the shop you desire to build! You can renovate old furniture or
buy new one. The wide variety of options makes building every shop a unique experience.


You decide which shops will end up in the renovated mall! You may choose to build small
boutiques that offer unique experiences for the rich or two-storey giant chain-stores where
everybody can find something for themselves. You are the heart, the brain and the soul
behind the entire project!

1826480.name: Escape Master
1826480.about_the_game:
This is a completely free jailbreak adventure casual game. You can pass the level after completing the designated tasks, but be careful with the guards on patrol. After the character is upgraded, you can improve your own attributes, such as movement, stamina, intelligence, etc., as well as various fun props and blessing systems. Come and try the challenge!

-The latest update (12.24):
1. Now supports joystick operation! It is recommended to use a joystick.
2. Add Christmas theme style displays and items.

-Achievement system
Complete challenges to get achievement rewards

-Blessing
Rescue the hostages and get blessing rewards

-Prop use
Use items to obtain corresponding effects

-Character style
Choose different character styles

-Character attribute points
Get attribute points for character upgrades, and customize character attributes

-Shop
In the game, a mystery shop will appear every few levels to buy your favorite items

1826490.name: Marco & Polo Go Round
1826490.about_the_game:
“Marco & Polo Go Round” is a virtual-reality short that defies the laws of gravity.

On the morning of his birthday, Marco joins his girlfriend Polo in the kitchen but something strange is going on. The chairs are battened to the floor and the cupboard and fridge doors are taped shut. Polo doesn’t seem to notice. She’s just excited to present him with the cake she has just made.

Little by little, the couple’s areas of disagreement come to the surface and the joyful atmosphere soon turns to shock as various objects come loose and start to fly around them.
“Marco & Polo Go Round” plunges the viewer into a young couple’s intimate relationship and invites them to physically experience the crisis they are going through as they navigate this distorted, topsy-turvy world.

This film uses several real-time approaches and technologies such as volumetric capture to preserve the glances and movements of the actors (Léane Labrèche-Dor and Emmanuel Schwartz).

MARCO & POLO GO ROUND:
- A film with an intimate, surreal screenplay that deals with love and its fragile nature
- An innovative approach based on volumetric capture and special effects to produce an immersive experience.
- An extraordinary visual universe in which the viewer moves around as if in a living painting.
- A 14-minute sensory and narrative experience.
- Selected for the Tribeca, Cannes XR and Annecy festivals and winner of the Kaohsiung XR Dreamland Festival

© ITEM 7 - BELGA PRODUCTIONS - ARTE FRANCE

1826530.name: Forsaken
1826530.about_the_game:
A Vast Fantasy Realm filled with Excitement

Get ready to embark upon an expedition to explore the murky and mystical world brimming with mysteries, adventures and thrill.
Employ your mastery to crush your enemies as you advance towards diverse extraordinary realms through various intense situations and risks that await you.
Experience the joy after accomplishing the ultimate triumph for the good and winning the title of the supreme warrior.

Melee Combat Your Way To The Fantasyland

Create your own destiny. Embody strength and vigor, and sail through the challenges with mythical weapons and armor, fighting and thwarting your foes with swords that give you the satisfaction of victory. Pave your path, combating and battling the evil to receive greater glory.

Lore: An exceptional drama emerged from a moralistic idea

An exceptional story revolving around the moral concept of 'victory of truth and doom of evil', and bringing to reality, the figment of a perfect fantasy kingdom where the heroic soul takes off his crusade of defeating all the enemies, annihilating every evil element and establishing the regime of absolute truth.

Types of enemies on the way

The mysterious world consists of an abundance of diverse enemies such as the fire exhaling beast, the sword combat rival, the jump raider, and the phantom that bring fierce challenges on your way. Fight and conquer the dreadful situations. You've got to use your skills and intellect to win the battles fulfilling your greatest mission.

1826540.name: No Haste
1826540.about_the_game:
No Haste is a survival horror game (Coming soon online cooperative from 1 to 4 players). Sneak into a mall to steal, be discreet and smart, and don't get caught by the Rist creature!



In 'No Haste' you will walk between the dark rays of a shopping mall where you will be chased by a fast and inconspicuous creature. You will have to recover the 10 objects with the help of clues and run away. Be stealthy, throw items to ward off the monster, and work together to survive.

Single Player Mode: With different gameplay and aimed at hardcore gamers.
Immersive Experience: Realistic graphics and immersive sound design in an oppressive place.

1826570.name: First Class Escape 2: Head in the Clouds
1826570.about_the_game:
"First Class Escape 2: Head in the Clouds” is a co-operative escape-room-style puzzle game, where you need to solve various puzzles as you try to uncover the mysteries of a luxury airship.

You must make good use of your wits if you are to overcome the various challenges you will encounter.

Solve Puzzles

Plenty of different kinds of puzzles await you on the airship. Ranging from simple devices to complicated logic puzzles, they will be sure to test your wit and skills.

Explore and Discover

You will get to explore the various rooms of the luxury airship, as you try to uncover its secrets. There are a lot of hidden collectibles for you to find as you make your way through the airship.

Work Together

Play solo or work together with friends, in up to 5-player multiplayer.

First Class Escape Series

Each game in the "First Class Escape" -series is a standalone story; they don't need to be played in order.
1826570.game_link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1826570/First Class Escape 2: Head in the Clouds/

1826590.name: Incoming War
1826590.about_the_game:
Incoming War is a vehicle simulator combining elements of a builder and real-time strategy where you become the commander for one of two belligerent robotic factions. As the main supervisor of their forces and the one in charge of a base known as "Nexus 44", you'll be fighting, collecting resources, exploring, and of course taking control of vehicles manufactured in facilities of our own making – all of this set in post-apocalyptic times.



Incoming War takes place in a very distant feature where humanity had been decimated long before and cybernetic lifeforms took over as the rulers of Earth. In the first days of the war it was man who first faced off against machine, but after humanity's defeat, the robots began to fight amongst themselves.



Your main goal is the development of your base and the production of combat units that will allow you to defend your city and in turn assault the enemy's compound. The game starts with several basic structures, i.e.:
The Nexus – your headquarters and the heart of your base,
Barracks – increases population,
Defense turrets – targets aerial and ground hostiles,
Refinery – extracts resources needed for assembling additional units.
These buildings will be the foundation for further development of your base and the choice of producing units to be controlled in TPP. You'll mainly use turrets to defend your base while the offensive will make use of various mobile battle vehicles, capable of long-range travel.



Another important matter is the production and management of automatons responsible for collecting the parts of destroyed machines and constructing new buildings from available materials. These units will essentially serve as the lifeblood of your entire operation and their number will always be under your control via the Nexus.



Aside from building up your base, the main goal of the game will be to vanquish the enemy Nexus which constitutes a threat to your faction. In this time of incredible threat, will you be capable of triggering the right survival instincts to bring out your best sense of logistics and piloting deadly machines? You'll find out soon enough because an all-out war is on its way!

1826640.name: Wall to Wall
1826640.about_the_game:
Wall to Wall is an arcade scoring game.
The ball hits from one wall flying off into another and you need to keep the ball in the air by pressing LMB so that it falls into the space between the spikes on the wall.
For each bounce of the ball off the wall, you get a point, and the spikes change their position. Over time, the pace of the game accelerates and you will have to try to set a new record.

1826650.name: Ahhnalog 112
1826650.about_the_game:
Gameplay
--------
This is a classic visual novel where you sit back & enjoy reading the story, making choices at key moments to navigate the branching narrative

Features
--------
- Fully animated 3D characters
- 3D environments
- 4 different girls you can interact with
- 11 different endings
- Adjustable text speed
- Text pacing simulates reading cadence

The protagonist
---------------
Takashi was always very clear about his great passion: spacecraft. Being a fighter pilot in the interspace navy had always been his dream.
But things didn't turn out exactly as he would have wished: he failed the entrance courses due to focusing all his attention on his other great passion: beautiful women.
He was expelled from the navy academy for his dismal results, leaving his pilot's license valid for commercial purposes only.
After years of working for exploiters who didn't even pay him the interplanetary minimum wage, he currently works as a freelance pilot while still dreaming of intergalactic battles.

The story
-----------
On one of his routine flights, Takashi receives a mysterious distress message over a disused radio channel.
Who, and why, is calling for help like this instead of using official channels?
Is it true?
Is it a trap?
The voice calling for help is female, so Takashi can't resist and answers the call like a gentleman.

Put yourself in Takashi's shoes and find out what's going on, help him decide at key moments and discover the 11 different endings of this science fiction story with some notes of erotic humor.


The girls
----------
- Nozomi: Always attentive and willing to please others, but doesn't take kindly to things not going her way.
- Emica: Brutally honest, straight to the point, no beating around the bush. If you don't like being dominated, don't go near her.
- Hinata: Shy and reserved, but eager to try new experiences.
- Etsuko: Friendly and approachable, she immediately gets along with anyone.

1826660.name: Crystal Goddess
1826660.about_the_game:
Azura, the guardian goddess of the Emerald Grove is having a bad day. Her magical crystals have been stolen by the forces of evil! Help Azura get the crystals back and defeat the demon hordes!

Crystal Goddess is an action adventure where you step into the boots of Azura, a guardian goddess with magical powers. Unlock 5 different crystals that each have unique attacks and special abilities such as levitation, protective shield and phase shifting. By helping the local girls, who are in sticky situations with the attacking demons, you can receive special items which you can use to upgrade your crystals.

Journey through 5 worlds and battle 18 different types of enemies to restore peace to the world!

1826680.name: Halberd Black
1826680.about_the_game: Halberd Black is an action-adventure JRPG set thousands of years into the future of our galaxy, where you play as a Stark, a genetically engineered human being caught in a struggle to survive and protect those he holds most dear from those who'd wish him harm. Explore the rich story of the Halberd Black universe and explore the beautiful landscapes, and dense city streets and enjoy combat reminiscent of the JRPGs of old ( With a Modern Twist ). Fight a wide variety of enemies using a dynamic turn-based combat system. Explore new environments as you seek strength to fight back against the powerful megacorporation that is after you and your friends. Only through grit and determination will you be able to fight against the threats that are coming your way. The only question is, do you have what it takes?

1826690.name: Shrines of Power
1826690.about_the_game:
Embark on an enchanting journey with Shrines of Power, a captivating first-person shooter meticulously crafted on the cutting-edge Unreal Engine 5. Immerse yourself in the heart of fast-paced shrine protection, where strategic brilliance, rapid target acquisition, and magical prowess are your keys to success.

As the guardian of your sacred home base, employ your mystical abilities and tactical finesse to thwart the relentless advances of opposing forces. Safeguard your shrines and power-generating pools, all while orchestrating calculated offensives to dismantle your adversaries. Engage in exhilarating back-and-forths across uniquely designed maps, ensuring each match keeps you on the edge of your seat.

'Shrines of Power' offers a spellbinding blend of intense action and strategic depth, promising an unparalleled gaming experience that will leave you craving more. Are you ready to embrace the challenge and become the master of magical combat?

1826710.name: Creature Keeper
1826710.about_the_game:
Assemble your dream team by befriending a variety of unique Creatures to fight alongside you in real time. Choose your Creatures wisely to best handle any challenge that stands in your way!

Create powerful, diverse, and stylish playstyles through gameplay-altering skill gems, perks, weapons and more while looking the part with tons of hats to dress your Creatures up in.

Use your Pocket Garden to grow food and create helpful Connection Bonuses for your Creatures in an engaging organization mini-game.

Fill out your Bestiary on the fifty unique Creatures in Thera to unlock powerful buffs and items for your party.

Explore the vast world of Thera and all its secrets as you take on your quest of destiny.
1826710.supported_languages: English, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil

1826760.name: Among the zombies
1826760.about_the_game:
Among the zombies - you have to play as a survivor in a city filled with zombies. These creatures were once ordinary people like you, but because of the virus, they turned into terrible monsters, seeking to destroy everything in their path. Do everything to survive and get out of this city! Use whatever you can get your hands on and fight back these creatures!

Peculiarities:
- Play a small campaign in single player mode.
- Explore a new hostile world.
- Go on an exciting journey!
- Interesting levels!

1826770.name: Alice is Dead: Hearts and Diamonds
1826770.about_the_game:
Noir Mystery

Alice is Dead is a grim, and twisted fantasy set in Wonderland. Unravel the secrets of this noir mystery to discover: who you are, who killed Alice, as well as how to get out with your hide in tact...

Visual Novel

Investigate the seedy corners of a dark and gritty Wonderland. Interrogate dark and unseemly interpretations of familiar characters in visual novel like interactions. Extract the information you need by any means necessary.

Point & Click

Explore the world through point and click interactions. The puzzles of this game are unapologetically hard. And the game is littered with added details and secrets for those willing to dig deeper.

REMAKE DETAILS

A complete HD remake, and retelling of the classic Alice is Dead Flash game trilogy, brought back to life by the series' original creators! ‘Hearts and Diamonds’ will be the definitive version of these stories, lacing together the lore and details that were previously crafted without the larger continuity in mind. We want to bring the game up to the high standard it lives on through in the minds of our fans!
1826770.reviews:
“What the game has in spades (or hearts, if you're playing from a royal deck) is atmosphere. There are no scares or loud surprises, but Alice is Dead can send shivers up your spine from the first few screens.”
4.5/5 – JayIsGames

1826820.name: John's Tombstone
1826820.about_the_game:
A Digital Eulogy


John's Tombstone is a narrative game with 3 chapters each one completely different from the other. You will be driving a car in a dream, walking around on the afterlife and talking with angels to unravel a story of acceptance, sci-fi and emotional strength. The chapters here within will resonate more if you've lost someone dear to you.

Three Stories


  • A sci-fi, mindbending, emotional experience.
  • 3 stories tied by one unique arc
  • A mix of 3D and 2D with different mechanics on each chapter
  • A walking simulator experience, lots of dialogues written with wit and love
  • Discover the afterlife, the realm of dreams and much more!

Don't miss our demo!


Want to take a glimpse before the dive? Check out our free demo! It includes the Prologue and Chapter 1.

Something different


This game is the digital eulogy to my dad, a man whose name was not John. Each chapter will tell you a bit of how people fight with grief while giving you some good sci-fi, a thing that John really loved.

1826830.name: Nova Squadron
1826830.about_the_game:
Dive straight into Jupiter's atmosphere and take down vast flying fortresses from within in fast-paced, arcade flight combat. Losing your plane is just a setback - return with an upgraded replacement and take back lost territory in Nova Squadron's roguelite campaign.

THE BEST THE 23RD CENTURY HAS TO OFFER

Equip yourself and your AI wingmen with a range of high-tech weapons from missiles to lasers and lightning guns. Complete missions to obtain powerful parts that boost your squadron's capabilities, but be careful! If you're shot down, your parts and upgrades will be destroyed. Earn renown in the air force to secure new aircraft and weapons to sortie with, or research improvements to the base models of your favourite planes.

ONE SQUADRON AGAINST AN ARMY

Sortie in a fighter to intercept bombers and interplanetary missiles, or load up your bomber with cluster bombs and railguns to dismantle flying fortresses. Team up with the allied fleet to launch a combined assault on deadly superweapons and the swarms of drones protecting them. The stronger your foes, the stronger your allies - no matter the difficulty of the mission, they'll always have your back.

CUSTOMISE THE MAYHEM

Tweak every component of the game's difficulty individually to fine-tune your roguelite experience. Want the greatest challenge the game can offer? Turn the individual parameters up past the hardest difficulty setting. New to flight controls? Use the Simplified control scheme and unmap controls to have the game automate them for you.

1826860.name: Sewer Rave
1826860.about_the_game:
Hey there buddy, you've been cordially invited to the sewer for the biggest rat party ever hosted.

We've got cheese, fruit, sewer water, and danger.

Wander the sewer and find messed up rats, old food, and maybe buried treasure(?).

Come along and make a friend or two.



SEWER RAVE is a surreal randomized exploration game where you crawl around a rat infested sewer during a giant rave. Search the labyrinthine sewers to discover games, secrets, and wisdoms meant only for rodents. Grab a cup of sludge and meet some rats!

SEWER RAVE was originally released in 2018 and the classic rat game is finally here on Steam, with a whole whopping one new feature: a genuine Steam Achievement.

SEWER RAVE is the kind of game that wants to confuse you. What's going on? Am I a rat or a human? Was that a bug or a feature? Is there a reason I'm down here? What am I collecting fruit for? If you like to be confused in a loud place and unsure what is going on, maybe it's the game for you. Maybe it isn't. I'd be curious if I were you. But I like weird games.



SEWER RAVE has items to collect and NPCs to trade with. Maybe you can find them all? Oh yeah and there's fruit and cheese all over the place and you can pick it up. There's also platforming challenges. There's also creatures to get into fights with. Sometimes minigames. I don't remember. Have fun okay? Stay safe? Text me when you get home.

Important note: currently, the Twitch integration is not functional. Sorry for those who enjoyed that.

1826880.name: Vicious Growth
1826880.about_the_game:
Action RPG Roguelike. Evolve your abilities and push yourself through a procedurally generated level.
Think hard about your choices, itemize well and use your skills to reach the end.



Start with a few basic abilities and fight your way through increasingly difficult enemies to upgrade your abilities and loot gear.
Pick your favourite ability combinations and create unique builds with items that you find along the way.



Your upgradable abilities consist of:
* Spell (default attack)
* Dash
* AOE Nova



What type of player do you want to be? Will you dash into a big group of mobs, praying that your raw damage will save you? Do you build movement speed and choose crowd control upgrades to strategically kite mobs around the room?

It's up to you, there are no wrong ways to play the game.
Well... Perhaps a few.

1826900.name: RECURSOR
1826900.about_the_game:
Take control of the RECURSOR robot and traverse through a randomly generated labyrinth of trials. Enhance your build by installing a wide variety of upgrades. How far can you go?

RECURSOR's mechanics that take inspiration from the platform fighter genre for both movement and combat. This combined with randomized levels and upgrades of the rogue-lite genre multiplies the depth and replayability.



RECURSOR has an extensive moveset allowing you complete freedom of movement! For the speedrunners and labbers, RECURSOR comes with a debug mode to move frame by frame, view your current state, see hitboxes and more!

RECURSOR's artstyle takes the classic pixel art charm and makes use of modern graphics technology to give it a fresh look. Most evidently is the lighting system that casts soft shadows and uses normal maps to create the illusion of 3d.

Inspired by the scifi films and anime of the 80s and 90s, RECURSOR frames the game within a computer terminal / CCTV station that grants the user the ability to monitor and control the RECURSOR robot.

1826910.name: Please Subscribe: Streamer Career
1826910.about_the_game:
Please Subscribe is the sequel to Gamer Career Tycoon from 2018. Develop your own livestream channel from the ground up. Find popular games to stream or develop your own features to your channel. Who will you be? Play your career and story. Can you become the most famous broadcaster in the world? Be whoever you want with the character system. From a skilled aimer to the charismatic smoothtalker, you can choose from many attributes and perks to develop your own playstyle.

Rise from a small beginner streamer to a worldwide famous influencer or a huge media company. Hire the most legendary video editors, artists, programmers, voice actors, sound artists or music composers. Broadcast your content and influence millions of gamers.

Key Features:


  • Create your streamer and develop your own playstyle.
  • Broadcast your content and gain worldwide fans.
  • Research new options and tools for your channel.
  • Learn how to develop your own stream assets.
  • Gain new insights in game trends or genre trends to gain hype.
  • Increase your relationship status to make deals with platform networks.
  • Buy new games, software and hardware in the shop.
  • Find work in your local town to earn money on a daily basis
  • Build and manage your own media studio and hire professional staff.

1826920.name: Sex Girlfriend Simulator
1826920.about_the_game:
Have you ever thought about being the perfect girlfriend? Now your dreams will come true!

In this girlfriend simulator, you will have complete control over the relationship. Pick one girl you can spend your time with (maybe forever).

First of all, you will need to make money with fun mini-games in order to support your girlfriend. Buys her food and trinkets. Feel the real experience of owning a girl!

Game features:
* A large number of characteristics that you will need to take care of;
* Ability to customize the character;
* The character will react with emotions to your actions or inaction;
* A large number of different items, each of which affects the character in its own way;
* 2 mini-games with which you will earn money;
* If you do not enter the game for a long time, then the character's needs will fall and he will eventually die and the game will start from the beginning;

highlighted.localized_name: It won't be boring with you
highlighted.name: It won't be boring with you

1826980.name: FreestyleFootball R
1826980.about_the_game:
《Freestyle Football》 is an online soccer game developed by JOYCITY, a well-known Korean online sports game company. The game adopts a fashionable and flamboyant visual style, incorporating elements of street art and soccer art. In 《Freestyle Football》 you can show your individuality and charm, and also enjoy the fun of teamwork.


In《Freestyle Football》your mini team will consist of 5 characters including a goalkeeper. Each player will control one character to participate in the game.

There are 3 game modes in Freestyle Football:
1.4V4 mode with fast-pace.

1827180.name: Toram Online

Toram Online, the popular smartphone game, is now available on Steam!

【Story Setting】

Decades ago, the world was hit by a devastating catastrophe, crumbling the ground into pieces. The gods quickly gathered the pieces scattered in all directions and hurriedly put them together. The result, a bizarre looking world resembling a mosaic.

The nation that was originally there had ceased to exist. As a result of repeated clashes of principles and interests among the 4 tribes, the people split into 4 factions.

1827260.name: The Lawyer - Episode 1: The White Bag
1827260.about_the_game:
See also game

The Lawyer - Episode 1: The White Bag

is the first part of an episodic adventure game which combines gripping crime story with classic courtroom drama. Immerse yourself into a world set in early 90’s in which you gather (or fabricate!) evidence, deduct and run fierce courtroom battles. Would you choose to be a lawful attorney or rather an underhanded rogue who uses all his means to win the cases no matter the cost?

Story


Follow the story of Mark Ferry, a fallen attorney-at-law, who has just left rehab to start his life and career from the beginning. A lot of time and effort will be needed to regain his former position and trust among acquaintances. Meet also Hector Diaz who works for Mark as his private eye and helps him during investigation and evidence gathering.

Choices


Each episode is a separate case with ground-breaking decisions which will have both short and long-lasting consequences, having an impact on further parts of the story and eventually the grand finale.

Investigation


The gameplay is split into two parts: the investigation and the courtroom battle. During the first part you get to know about next case and run your independent investigation. It is your decision how will you handle your possible witnesses and found evidence or cooperate with the police and the district attorney. You will visit the crime scene and other locations to check possible clues, interrogate witnesses, examine potential evidence and decide what to do with it, prepare your client for the trial and eventually prepare your line of defence. During this part you will be switching between two playable characters: Mark Ferry and Hector Diaz, who both have their own flaws and strong sides, having different impact during dealing certain situtations.

Courtroom


During the courtroom battle you will use all your knowledge about the case and previously-formed conclusions during evidence analysis, listen to testimonies and cross-examinate potential witnesses. However, the district attorney will try to undermine all your efforts to win jury’s favor. The result of the trial is strictly related to your previous decisions and performance during the trial.



So, what would you do to win the case?

Key features:


  • deep and engaging storyline set in early 90s when pagers were still widely used rather than cellphones,
  • ground-breaking decisions affecting not only the current case, but also further events in later episodes,
  • different ways of handling the case,
  • two playable characters with their own traits: Mark Ferry (an attorney), Hector Diaz (a private eye),
  • form different conclusions basing on your approach to presented evidence, testimonies and other leads,
  • real-time reaction to testimonies and cross-examinations at the court,
  • win jury’s favor, restore your reputation.

1827440.name: Sailors: Age of Corsairs
1827440.about_the_game:
Become a merchant, pirate, or privateer in the 17th century Caribbean! Join colonial powers or fight for gold and glory in this epic sandbox crew simulator!



You are the captain of a 17th-century ship on its maiden voyage to the Caribbean Sea. Once you arrive there it is completely up to you which path you take, but know that every decision you make is going to have repercussions.

  • You can become a fearless pirate, the terror of the seas. It is a quick route to wealth, for sure, but a perilous one.
  • You can be a merchant—buy low, sell high is the strategy of yours, but beware the pirates and other merchants.
  • Finally, you can choose to join one of the colonial powers - France, Spain, England, and the Netherlands, and fight their cause for their gold!



Sailors: Age of Corsairs is a game focused on sandbox elements and a crew simulation. You are the captain and it is your responsibility to lead and take care of your crew. Be sure to pay attention to their morale or your career will be a short-lived one. Keep your officers and key crew members loyal to you, watch for scurvy and other diseases, punish traitors, but most importantly - keep a loaded pistol always close to you.

This game is set to simulate the harsh realities of a seaman's life. It is often not the pirates, nor enemy factions that are the bane of sailors, but the diseases, bad conditions, revolts, and extreme weather. As the captain, it will be your duty to make often tough, but necessary decisions.



Set sail! Sailors: Age of Corsairs is all about freedom of choice and sandbox experience. Within the game setting, you can sail wherever you want, make new allies and enemies, recruit crew members, trade with colonies, or ambush other merchant ships. Possibilities are endless and the game is going to spice things up with a plethora of random events that may occur on the sea.



Forge your destiny in blood, gold, and sweat! Become a pirate lord, a merchant prince, or even an admiral of the entire armada. Once you get filthy rich and famous you can start thinking about building your fleet or even starting a colony. Conspire with other pirate lords and create your own version of Nassau, build a trade empire across the Caribbean Sea and influence local politics, or lead a colonial power to total victory! This game does not slow down and the more powerful you become the more visible you become in the eyes of your opponents!

A highly interactable environment awaits with many hidden gems to find.

The democratic government of the planet Velraterra has fallen to the fascist forces, and you've been hired to scavenge and compete with rival mercenary groups. To survive, you will go on operations, engage in fierce combat, and defend your forward operating base from attackers.

FEATURES:

  • Strategic Deckbuilding: In order to survive and complete your mission, craft a powerful deck from a growing collection of cards.
  • Multiple Playable Characters: Try out different cards and ways of playing by playing as one of three unique playable characters, with more to come!
  • Fight Enemy Mercs: Fight 15+ different enemy dinosaur mercenaries, including Merc Killers, elite enemies that will test your limits.
  • High Score Chaser: The game's infinite nature and arcade style of play allows for ever-escalating levels of power and challenge.
  • Missions: Want a shorter, more focused play session? Missions are for you! Go on a mission and complete the objective while building a powerful deck and fighting enemy mercs.

1827650.name: Star Knightess Aura
1827650.about_the_game:
Summary

Follow Aura's adventure as she is thrust into the fantasy world of Roya. What she initially believed to follow the conventional plotline of a "summoned to another world"-story quickly turns into her worst nightmare. Cursed by the Demon King, Aura must now struggle every night to track down her nemesis and ultimately strike him down.

But her enemies don't just lurk in Roya. Having entered her mind through the Demon King's curse, another enemy attempts to brainwash and corrupt Aura from the inside. Faced with a two-pronged attack against her body and mind, can Aura finish off her worst enemy without losing herself?

Gameplay

Each ingame day is structured into 3 parts.

  • The player controls Aura and can explore the world of Roya to track down and kill the Demon King. In order to become stronger, acquire funds, and advance her search, she can rely on her own powers or ask people for help. However, not everybody means well with Aura. Performing lewd acts and compromising on Aura's ideals by allowing innocents to suffer causes Aura to gain corruption.

  • The player controls Alicia, who uses Aura's corruption to change her psyche. This includes changing her interests, increasing her interest in fashion, changing her appearance (including hair style/color changes), changing her values (making Aura more selfish), and ultimately changing her sexual desire and love interests.

  • The player watches cutscenes displaying Aura's real self changing over time due to mental corruption. The cutscenes are told from varying character perspectives (Aura, her best friend Rose, her boyfriend George, and so on).

Key Features

  • Strategic Combat with limited resources - All resources, including time, money, and items, must be used with care to get the most out of them in Aura's journey!

  • Semi-Open World - Explore the vast world of Roya! Hunt for rare materials to infuse into Aura's armor, slay demons, and help our heroine rise from zero in an unfair world!

  • Challenging and creative boss fights - Battles are set up as puzzles that test your understanding of the combat system. Exploit hidden weaknesses, disable environmental effects, and teach Aura skills that allow her to counter whatever her enemies throw at her. Most encounters may seem impossible at first, but a solution will always reveal itself to those who don't give up thinking!

  • Balance corruption and progress - Give in to temptation to make your life easier, and it might cause the curse to progress to the point where Aura's personality changes towards evil... However, clinging too firmly to your ideals can slow down your progress, and Aura might become a victim of the curse nonetheless. Balance is key!

  • Collar Removal - In exchange for damaging her soul and gaining corruption, Aura can forcefully overcome her curse and temporarily regain her powers as a Hero - Smash any encounter and obstacle to pieces! However, using this power accelerates the curse...

  • 5 Difficulty Modes - Don't like the time pressure from the ever-advancing curse? Reducing the difficulty to one of the lower difficulties allows you to take it easy or enjoy the story. Or ramp the difficulty up all the way to Nightmare to get the full masochistic experience of a cursed heroine (Only recommended for veteran gamers).

Stats

  • Estimated play time - 35-55h

  • Word Count: 878k

  • Earth World Scenes: 325

  • Epilogue Scenes: 30

    枝江人气歌星“凯若”，或者三年前，她更广为流传的那个身份：女团A-SOUL成员珈乐。她拥有天使一般的歌喉和一如既往温柔的目光，却生活在隐形的“木偶线”之下，处处不得意。当美好的过去再一次撬动她的心房，梦想与现实，成为了她不得不面对的抉择。



    生日：3月7日

CHEMISTS: Dead Zone - RE-RELEASE NOW AVAILABLE

Chemists: Area of infection

A third-person shooter set in an alternate reality. A year after a global catastrophe, you wake up in a hospital with no memory of anything. You must not only find out what happened but also try to survive in this harsh, dangerous world.

Experience

You'll have to rely entirely on your navigation skills and memorize almost everything—where you've been and where you need to go—to survive and avoid getting lost.

Exploration

The game world is vast and requires special attention to detail, as you can encounter unexplained phenomena, encounter swarms of mutants, or become trapped by anomalies.

Survival

The game plunges you into a dangerous and harsh world where danger can lurk at every turn. You'll need to manage not only thirst and satiety, but also stamina and other environmental hazards that directly impact your survival.

Battle

You'll have to fight for resources against bandits and mercenaries, as well as for your life against monsters and mutants, using a variety of combat methods. Different weapons will allow you to accurately assess your strength against different types of enemies.

What awaits you:

  • Survival to the fullest

1827720.name: Sabotris
1827720.about_the_game:
Sabotris is a strategic, competitive, 3D block stacking game, but with a twist: you can sabotage your opponents, but be careful; you can also end up sabotaging yourself! Choose to play either by yourself to beat your own high score, against your friends or other players, or even against computer AI!


Competitive? Yes. Casual? Also yes. You choose the level of difficulty that suits your play style. Have a relaxing game against your own score, or group up with your friends or strangers and see who can get the highest score! Though warning in advance, only play against the computer AI on the highest difficulty at your own risk...




It's not just about being the fastest at the game, power ups allow you to sabotage or assist your opponents. This takes the competitive edge to the next level, where you can intentionally sabotage a single player every time, or if you find Sabotris too easy, sabotage yourself!




Spectating other people can be boring, so Sabotris doesn't make you do that when you lose. Instead, you get to roam the world as a miniature cube with your other friends that also lost. You can even pretend you're in another mini-game avoiding shapes being dropped by the ones that are still playing!




Whether you're a fiend of playing with others or just want to relax with your friends, multiplayer lobbies are a must. Sabotris makes lobbying with friends or strangers seamlessly simple. Just host a game, and watch people join!
