In a colorful platform world, your goal is to be the first bunny to reach the finish line. You can take a boost to run faster, or try to find the shortest path to the goal. With 8 different levels to choose from, there's always something new to explore.

But don't forget to collect those carrots along the way! They'll help you get a higher score and come out on top. And with keyboard and mouse support, as well as gamepad support, you can play however you like. But for the ultimate bunny-bouncing experience, we recommend using a controller.

And don't forget - you can even host your own server and invite your friends to join in on the fun. So gather your bunny buddies and let the race begin!

8 levels for multiplayer fun

Carrot and power boost pickups to help you along the way

1827820.name: KAILA
1827820.about_the_game:
The city of Kaila. A city for the outcasts, for those who seek comfort in a place far away from the rest of civilization. Now, prey to the most vicious of evils, its inhabitants have turned into unrelenting aberrations, and the dream of comfort has turned into a nightmare.

Prepare to be brutalized by aberrant creatures in this horror-driven adventure. Take care of your party members or watch them descend into madness or perish into permanent death. Experience a slow burn into chaos or be mad enough to overcome it.

Kaila is a story-driven RPG set in the dark depths of the fall of a prosperous civilization, from the point of view of a god-forsaken party composed by opportunistic fugitives.




Delve into an unforgiving world, where supplies are needed to survive, wounds take time to heal and death is an irreversible fate. Every decision can lead to your doom in this harsh, cursed place.
Kaila features a mix between action and survival elements, and blend them together to deliver a complete experience. Fighting smartly is not only rewarded but mandatory, and so is strategically retreating and taking care of the group.



Take control of a different breed of heroes. Lead a party of 4 unique outcasts and use their exclusive abilities to survive. Customize them to fit your needs and develop an unparalleled synergy.
During the adventure you will be able to switch between characters seamlessly, taking advantage of their attributes and abilities. Each character fulfills their role differently, so it will be up to you to make the best of each one; but be wary, as they can be damaged or get tired on their own.



Resources are scarce, and as the party progresses you will need to take the right decisions. Focus on crafting, combat training, keeping a good morale or make a balanced approach.
As you progress through the journey you will be able to develop several plans to enhance your survival, but to carry them out you will also need to count with a strong team. The party's power can be further improved by training or crafting gear, for which you will need time, and for that you will need supplies. Bear in mind that while in time you may get stronger, so will your enemies.



No experience points nor levels; characters progress by your choices through time, and they can adapt to your current needs. Every progress choice is reversible, but will you survive long enough to reshape them?
Every party member features a unique skill tree providing them with more abilities and enhancements. The decision is yours to specialize them and to what extent, as every hour destined to that is an hour less in other activities like crafting.



Every gameplay element is there to tell the story of these 4 survivors. Learn who they are, their motives and what made Kaila City wither and become a living hell. Make choices through your characters personalities and help them carve their path in this unforgiving world.
Since death is an irreversible fate, character's choices are a resource on their own, and their demise will limit the paths you can take.

Welcome to our dark future, where the top of the world is run by greedy corporations and the bottom of the world is run by wild underground gangs.

1827910.name: 星の欠片の物語。しかけ版
1827910.about_the_game:
Story

A lone girl stands abandoned on a broken star.
With the star deprived of its power, she can neither use it to escape nor inform others of her plight.
However, there exists a point on this star that intersects with another world.
The player, by standing on this convergence point and wearing the Otherworld-Viewing Device (VR unit), can enter the parallel world and communicate with the girl.
Together, they cooperate to solve the puzzle of restoring the star's power so she may be able to leave.

Character



Game Concept

Although sight is highly intuitive in VR, the same cannot be said for most other aspects, leading to irritation from clumsy controls.
We designed this game around directing a character through glances to circumvent this and change that annoyance into a game element.

How to play.

Match the red dot in the center of the screen to the object you are interested in, and its outline will be circled.
The girl will then examine and move the object for the player.
Through trial and error, you can solve the mystery and lead the girl to escape from the planet.

Operation.

Can be played with HMD only, no controller.
Hold down the SHIFT key to start the game to set the resolution/quality.


Controller operation




Keyboard Operation Options

　　Skip previous action: SHIFT

1827940.name: Last Lovers 绿洲之爱
1827940.about_the_game:
This is a Chinese game，a visual novel game with doomsday theme.

If you want to know more information about Last Lovers, you can join Last Lovers QQ group 532157072 to participate in related discussions.

STORY：
Twenty eight years ago, zombie virus broke out on the planet where human beings live, showing an apocalyptic state.
The surviving human beings huddled together for warmth, and large refuge areas - oases have been established all over the world.
Overlooking the metal city, human survivors hide in the shadow.
The new social component - "mercenary regiment" - replaced the original social order maintainer.

I am a member of the black bear mercenary regiment, an ordinary search team mercenary, who travels between the oasis and the wilderness every day.
The boring life makes me numb and lonely.
I transformed an intelligent robot exactly like my late sister-Alice.

The ideal is very plump, but the reality is that the difference between Alice and her sister is so big that I have more and more headaches.
People around us also cast friendly or malicious eyes on us.
The life under the last world continues. What else can I pursue except living and working?

SYSTEM：
Players click the mouse to read the plot text and make branch choices to continue the development of the story.

The text box is accompanied by a function button for auxiliary reading.
You can save and read progress at any time, automatically read articles and quickly skip chapters.

Players can also watch the plot record repeatedly through the mouse wheel, which is convenient for reading.
{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/jietu2.jpg
You can modify the function settings at any time to make them conform to your reading habits.


CHARACTER：

Azo Hsiang
A gray haired baby faced youth. The appearance looks old-fashioned and gloomy, the eyes are deep and indifferent, and the mind is active inside.
Calm and steady, strong action force and many cruel words. In terms of emotion, I am casual, but I live my duty freely.


Alice Hsiang (CV Feng Cha Ruo dance)
The maid robot based on the transformation of domestic robot is close to azo's late sister in appearance and character.
A little clumsy. The language ability is rigid, and the thinking logic is different from human beings.
Take care of azo's daily life with due diligence every day, and have no complaints about the daily work arranged by the mercenary regiment base.
In theory, cooking is very good, but what I'm good at is running and fighting.


Cheerful female mercenaries are usually careless and even demonic.
A little virgin, love to educate people, actually very timid and weak .
Love reading and have a deep longing for cultural knowledge. Collect printed matter from time to time.
The original oasis was captured by zombies and fled to the oasis where azo was located.


A gentle and determined female mercenary, belonging to the flying dragon mercenary regiment.
Open and straightforward, naive, fond of fantasy, not good at lying.
Abandoned by his teammates, he became depressed and had a slight hostility to azzo who broke into his territory.

1827950.name: Golden Axe Idol

1827980.name: Idle Spiral
1827980.about_the_game:
What's Idle Spiral?

This is a beautiful "Idle", "Incremental" game based on spirals and mathematics. Your goal is to make the spiral grow longer and longer. The game is very simple, but it is very deep and can be enjoyed for a long time.

How to play

By buying upgrades, you can grow your spiral more efficiently. There will be a lot of mathematical equations, but don't be afraid. The upgrades themselves are not that strategic and you hardly need to understand this formula. However, as you continue to play, you will gradually come to understand the mechanics.

Layered prestige mechanics

The game has various reset mechanisms called Prestige (as seen in many Idle games!). Prestige resets much of the game's progression, but allow you to progress further and faster than before.

Battle Spiral

In Battle Spiral, your spiral is used as a weapon to fight various designs of spirals; to gain an advantage in Battle Spiral, it is important to consider what rewards to choose and in what order to fight the enemies. An extremely powerful boss with a very complex shape awaits you in the second half of the game!

Challenges

Challenges aim to achieve a specific goal under strong constraints. In challenges you will face debuffs, constraints, and fundamental gameplay changes while trying to achieve a certain goal. After reaching the goal, the challenge is completed and you receive big rewards.

Endless Content

Tornado Prestige is just the beginning of this game. It will take some time to progress through the game, but more content is waiting for you!

Music by AKIYAMA HIROKAZU from H/MIX GALLERY

1828010.name: Deadly Nightmare
1828010.about_the_game:
Deadly Nightmare is an exciting and engaging Horror/Survival game where you play the role of a boy living in a big manor. You need to use all the tools at your disposal in order to explore the world, find mysteries and explore a variety of challenging, scary and supernatural locations. Do you have what it takes to uncover the truth? Only you know that, so go ahead and enjoy this frightening, yet exciting and eye-opening story!



Exciting story
In Deadly Nightmare, the grandmother of our main character died and she writes in her will that some curses are tied to their family. After they died, the curses go into her body. It’s up to us, the boy to break the family curses. You have 6 hours to stay alive and survive, then the curse will go into the maid’s body, and then into the boy. We need to explore the game world as much as possible in order to find the book of curses.



Powerful, rewarding gameplay
What we need to do is to explore the manor and find the book of curses. Once we do that, we need to make spells and curses in order to protect ourselves from the evil’s power. We also need to finish our main mission, which is “The Gate of Curses”. That means finding the right materials that we need in order to make the curse and open the gate of curses. In doing so, we will find and try to defeat the queen of curses. It’s a challenging, yet great adventure that you can be a part of today.



Experiment with various spells
Some of the Deadly Nightmare spells are actually available in real-life, they were used as an inspiration for the game. But most of them are fictional spells that fit into the story and provide that unique, exciting and interesting appeal you would expect.



Find and use tools and materials
These are very helpful and you will need them in order to move onward into the story. It’s exciting and rewarding, fun and also easy to get into. However, you can also find some poisons that you can use to get supernatural powers as well.
The manor itself is very scary, and it comes with its fair share of challenges. Do you have what it takes to explore it and solve this once and for all? Try out Deadly Nightmare today!



Features:
Explore the manor and remove the curse
Create curses and spells with cool effects
Grab materials and tools
Use poisons to get supernatural powers

1828030.name: Save the Llama
1828030.about_the_game:
Assemble advanced towers from old farm equipment, mechanize the landscape, and erect an impenetrable perimeter to defend your herd. Construct your towers on moving platforms and orchestrate their position and timing to defeat waves of alien UFOs. Craft the perfect defense and save your llamas from the alien menace!

Features

  • An assortment of moving mechanisms for you to experiment with to your strategic delight.
  • Six unique upgrade-able towers to build your defenses from.
  • 10 enemy types with different abilities to defeat.
  • Perks to improve and specialize your play style.
  • 16 unique levels to master.
  • Playful acapella sound effects and voice acting.
  • Full save and load, never lose progress when you need to step away.
  • Fast forward, slow, and pause time as you see fit.

1828040.name: Dream/strung - Blossoming Love
1828040.about_the_game:
Synopsis: A beautiful young woman who keeps being abducted meets another feminine figure. Little does she know, their fates are intertwined. Follow the adventure of our two protagonists as they get into and away from many unusual situations; slowly nurturing their love for each other.

The adventure is about two characters meeting for the first time, getting to know one another as they grow an unusual relationship.

The whole game features:
- 24 scenes.
- 64 CG.
- Live2D animated sprites.
- BDSM-related fetishes (mainly bondage.)

1828070.name: Jester Street : Card Counting Trainer
1828070.about_the_game:
Ever wondered if you could Count Cards? I did too, so I created this game to assist; by providing ALL the data you would need, at runtime.

Take control of the Game: Pause, Resume, see all Previous Cards, their Card Count Value, the Running & True Count; all in order to 'keep the count' -providing an advantage to the Player, when to bet BIGGER!.

The game of Blackjack will (generally) consist of various Decks, & knowing the current Running Count will enable you to calculate these better strategic betting points. See Utilities below for more info.

  • Advanced Play's (Deviations) Chart (Illuminated Play, based on current hand)

The Simulator 2100;


Run hundreds, if not thousands of Blackjack games;

  • Set Custom Bet Amounts, Per True Count (-1 to +17)
  • Set Custom Deals Per Hour/Hours Played

1828080.name: Legend of Tai gong
1828080.about_the_game:
Is it to save the master or to save the living?

The God-forging War has just ended, and there is a new shock in the three worlds...

The world's supreme deity, Yuan Shi Tian Zun, who is in charge of the world order, has suddenly changed his temperament. As a disciple of Yuan Shi Tian Zun and in charge of the God Sealing List and the God Beating Whip, Jiang Zi Ya finds something wrong and is ready to confront Yuan Shi Tian Zun on Mount Kunlun. However, the crisis of the three worlds gradually approaching, he had to gather his friends, together against this not quite right Yuan Shi Tianzun.

With the help of many immortals, Yuan Shi Tian Zun, who fought against the immortals by himself, was lost, while Jiang Ziya lived a reclusive life with a baby in his arms in the middle of the war. The great war produced a large amount of aura due to the uncontrollable and leaked to the three worlds, the three worlds began a new turmoil, humans have more possibilities to become immortal, and evil demons have come out, disturbing the order of the three worlds, this world is the world of Yuanxu.

Sixteen years later, the three worlds had stabilized, and even though there were great demons in charge everywhere, and people were living in the midst of fire and water, many cultivators were born to punish evil and promote good, to maintain this weak balance as much as possible. However, one day, the breath of Yuan Shi Tian Zun reappeared in the world of Yuan Xu, has been living in seclusion, Jiang Zi Ya disappeared one night, leaving only you who was raised by him and a letter, in the dark you feel that this is also a little related to yourself, carrying this letter, you decided to embark on the journey of immortality, to find their master Jiang Zi Ya.

Main game features

  • Super random events and access to props, test your luck and test your guts at the same time.
  • Hundreds of Fabao, Dan and talismans have their own characteristics and are very unique.
  • Hundreds of random events to test your luck and guts at all times.
  • Hundreds of feats with various styles of play, and various effects that never repeat.
  • Hundreds of secret events in which you can gain a lot.
  • Whether you become a virtuous immortal or a wicked demon is up to you.
  • Fast-paced game, get rid of the boring and repetitive brush brush brush.
  • Help others and you will get a chance to exchange for the equipment you need.
  • Help others and get the chance to get the equipment you need.
    • Attend the Immortal Gate Conference to defend Jiang Tai Gong's reputation; attend the Alchemy Conference to become the master alchemist in the three worlds;
    • There are many sets and many ways to play, and once you start, there is no way to stop.
    • Challenge yourself as well as others, and compete together in the rankings for strength and weakness.
    • The game is casual and easy to play, no liver and no mandatory tasks, you can play as you like.

    If you encounter game problems or do not understand the place, you can join our QQ group: 810530980

1828090.name: Krypt
1828090.about_the_game:
Krypt is an old-school text adventure filled with excitement and peril. Fight monsters, make choices, and travel through forests and mountains to defeat the evil King Krypt in this epic fantasy tale. But watch out as you try to discover all the paths, because not every choice ends in victory.

Key Features include turn-based combat, riddles, and a thrilling story that will keep you reading until the very end.

(Currently the game does have some bugs, as it was developed by two novice coders. These bugs likely won't be resolved soon; however, we hope this doesn't limit your enjoyment of the game.)

1828100.name: Hacker Simulator: Free Trial
1828100.about_the_game:
Important note about this Trial version

This version of Hacker Simulator is a trial version and will give you access to the tutorial and the first contracts. To access the rest of the content, please go to the full version available here:


Important note: Please note that Hacker Simulator is not a realistic 1:1 hacking simulation and that the mechanics are only inspired by real-life hacking methods.

With Hacker Simulator, I wanted to bring a fun and immersive experience on the theme of hacking so that you can have a better vision of some of its aspects (being alone, I certainly can't cover all of them).



In order to keep your business running, you need to stay anonymous regularly by hiding behind various wifi networks. To do this, you will learn how to use the famous suite of tools called Aircrack-ng!



A lot of research has been done to bring you a simplified and enjoyable version of real-life hacking methods such as bruteforce, exploits, phishing and more!



You will learn a lot during your adventure, but you will also learn that hacking is not without risk. The networks you will explore will be secured and the wifi connections will be monitored, requiring a high level of attention.

1828140.name: 末世天醒
1828140.about_the_game:
*This is a third person zombie shooting game

*The game has two level maps, a town and a city. Each level is set with a task system. The town is the first level. Players need to complete the collection task before they can be included in the next level

*Because the character uses a robot, the game has an energy bar in addition to a health bar. When the game runs, the energy will be consumed automatically. When it returns to zero, the character will be judged dead. Therefore, the player needs to find the material box to supplement energy and ammunition before the energy is exhausted, and enter the next level before the energy is exhausted, The difficulty of the game is to complete the task before the energy is exhausted

*As a shooting game, the game adds two guns, assault rifles and sniper guns. When using assault rifles, grenades can also be used to destroy zombies. When zombies gather together, grenades have a good killing effect

*In terms of the operation method of the game, the setting of the key position controlling the basic movement is the same as that of other types of shooting games, and some are added on the basis, such as key positions 1 and 2: switching firearms, key position 4: grenade launch, key position M: opening the map, and the item pickup is automatic

*As for some other functions and playing methods of the game, players need to develop them themselves

*Of course, you should not expect too much from the game. The game is just a graduation project of your own. Due to technical and knowledge constraints, there will be many bugs in the game. Maybe players have a lot of problems when playing, but please forgive me. After all, this is only a graduation project, which is certainly not comparable to other games and will encounter bugs. If you are interested, I hope you can support the game

1828160.name: Umille
1828160.about_the_game:
Basta che un gioco sia difficile o che ci sia la possibilità di rotolare per farlo etichettare come souls-like, noi la pensiamo diversamente. Per noi la caratteristica più importante di un souls like deve essere quella di saperti imprimere una storia nella mente senza raccontartela. Umille vuole fare proprio questo, ovvero raccontarti una storia velata e interpretabile, in poche righe di dialogo, sfruttando l'ambiente e le descrizioni degli oggetti.

La Storia
Sei un avventuriero che decidere di sottoporsi a un test per diventare idoneo a essere il prossimo Re di Umille. Se vuoi sapere il resto, giocaci!

Rigiocabilità
Il punto di forza di questo progetto è senz'altro la rigiocabilità, 4 finali diversi, svariate scelte da fare per ottenerli.

Personalizzazione del personaggio
E' possibile scegliere sesso e classe iniziale del personaggio, la classe iniziale serve solo a determinare l'equipaggiamento di partenza.

Il combattimento
Il combattimento è a turni ma abbiamo fatto del nostro meglio per diminuire i limiti parametrici. Se si impara la sequenza delle mosse nemiche è possibile vincere anche con statistiche inferiori.

Libertà
La mappa è piccola e puoi andare ad affrontare il boss finale appena inizi il gioco se fai le scelte giuste.

1828180.name: RATOMON 2
1828180.about_the_game:
RATOMON 2 is a continuation of medieval top-down adventure to stop the Plague. Investigate random generated dungeons, eliminate rat hordes and other villains, who stand behind the disease.

Our hero moves to the next continent suffering from the Plague. Every second the disease spreads, and the rat population grows. No time to waste!

Each dungeon is procedurally generated and have a lot of enemies willing to end your quest prematurely. Fighting them takes skill and proper use of available weapons and equipment.

1828220.name: Walk with the Living
1828220.about_the_game:
Grief leads a swordswoman and a necromancer to raise an infamous knight from his grave. Follow the trio's intimate quest for vengeance and make choices that impact their relationships with one another and those they meet.

-Enjoy beautiful sprite art and character illustrations.

-Consider space and terrain in creative ways to survive fast-paced, player-phase-focused tactical battles.

-Meet complex characters and form relationships, both platonic and romantic, between them to gain in-battle benefits.

-Make choices that impact the narrative and the relationships between various characters. All choices have consequences, both positive and negative.

-Replay and make different choices to discover dozens of secret endings and character epilogues. Weapons, items, and gold carry over with new game plus.

-Characters die permanently, but there are always more stories to be told; when a character dies, new narrative branches, relationships, and recruitments become available.

-Focus on narrative without worrying about battlefield character deaths in Story mode.

-There's a cat!

Rowan

Raised from the dead against his will to bring vengeance against his former employer, he struggles to cope with existing among the living in a body that feels dead.

Aoife

An unwilling leader of a growing movement to exact justice on the mercenary company raiding villages of the countryside, she harbors doubts about whether her mission to avenge her sister has meaning in the wake of her sister’s death.

Keir

After achieving what seemed impossible by raising Rowan from the dead, he accompanies Aoife on her quest of vengeance while holding onto regrets about his late lover, Niall.
1828220.reviews:
“[The] realistic depiction of the pain these characters are holding makes it easy to want them to find some happiness. Unlike the ‘which one will I choose?’ dating sim mechanics of recent Fire Emblem games, in Walk with the Living you get to play cupid, gradually encouraging dispossessed and traumatized characters to open up to each other and (maybe) start to see their future together. . . Perhaps best of all, it's a believably hopeful story about queer people.”
Gamers with Glasses

1828270.name: Total Anarchy: Pavilion City
1828270.about_the_game:
Welcome to the late ’90s. Pavilion City is consumed by corruption and violence. There are three warring factions trying to take control. The anarchic hooligans, the devious guerrillas and the far-right legion.

Everybody seems to want you dead.



With your friends lost in the chaos, it’s now up to you to stay safe, make quick money and claim the city for yourself – using whatever methods you feel are necessary.



Hijack cars, steal drugs, trash hotel rooms, murder citizens, blow up boats, listen to the 9 radio stations, set people on fire, throw bricks & rocks, shoot rockets and otherwise behave like a terrible person much like you can in other open world games.



This game features a vast and vibrant city rendered in top down 3D. It includes nearly a hundred unique vehicles, 26 different weapons & 2 hours of exclusive in-game radio. Feel free to explore the place and cause havoc!



Everything in this game is a work of fiction and is not made to represent or identify any particular individual, company or organization. Any similarities in any events, speech or other things shown in this game are coincidental. Fionn and Behemoth do not endorse any of the behavior depicted in this game.
1828270.reviews:
“It’s an excellent game that plays like a true spiritual successor to GTA 1 and 2, taking the top-down open world mayhem of Rockstar’s classics and updating it for a modern gaming audience… …Total Anarchy is perfect for anyone hankering for a bit of good old fashioned top-down citywide crime, carnage and chaos. Highly recommended.”
Alpha Beta Gamer

1828280.name: Infinity Girl
1828280.about_the_game:
Speed. Rhythm. Flow.

Infinity Girl is a fast-paced rhythm/racer/roguelite where everything — every action, every enemy and every spectacular world you encounter — is driven by the beat of the music. Each run is unique, with procedural levels that test your skills as you grind, drift, boost and leap to the rhythm. Get into a flow and blast through levels at incredible speeds, gaining game-changing abilities along the way.

Features:

  • Tight, expressive controls tied to every beat
  • A hypnotic and procedurally generated electronic soundtrack
  • Vibrant cel-shaded art and surreal, music-driven visuals
  • Dodge obstacles and take down enemies that move to the rhythm
  • Powerful abilities and upgrades that transform every run
  • Pick up items that slow time, turn you into a wrecking ball or give you the power of flight
  • Challenge modes and achievements that reward mastery and make the game highly replayable
  • Race to The Orb™ before time runs out (and this world is destroyed)
1828280.reviews:
“Holy sh** this is so sick. It's like hyper speed monkey ball on steroids.”
William 'LordOvLoot' Pate

“Infinity Girl is a mix between an endless runner, a roguelike, a racer, and a rhythm game all at once. Needless to say, this is a very ambitious project.”
1Up Infinite

1828310.name: Skate or Don't!
1828310.about_the_game:
Skate or Don't! is a massively multiplayer online arcade skateboarding game. With support for over 1000 players in one game you can play with all of your friends and probably your whole twitch community. Featuring procedurally-generated courses and advanced fixed-point physics, every run is a different experience.

-Over 1000 players
-Join a server or host your own game
-Customize your skater and skateboard
-Learn flips and tricks
-Works with gamepad or keyboard

1828320.name: Super Life: Franchise Lord
1828320.about_the_game:
Super Life Franchise Lord is an incremental franchise management sim set in the world of Super Life RPG with an idle game progression system.

Disclaimer: This game was designed for mobile devices and is best experienced on Android or iOS


1. Little Zeus 2. Slimmy Sam's 3. Taco Box 4. Angus McBangus

Not actual gameplay.


Start small and grow by upgrading equipment and researching new menu items to increase profitability!

Complete customer orders yourself or hire employees and make them do all the work. They will still look to you to deal with customer complaints and handle workplace accidents.

Purchase employee perks to hire better employees, increase employee levels to allow you to run your franchises more hands off.



Raise animals for slaughter at the farm, or buy fresh ingredients from vendors at the farmers market!



Buy (or steal) AmaZone boxes to collect items that help keep your franchises running smoothly or sway conversations in your favor.



The Money Tree is back and serves as one of multiple daily reward systems in the game. You can also collect free coins from your coin miner and complete daily tasks for additional rewards!

1828380.name: Anxious Suffering in the Forest
1828380.about_the_game:
A quirky, self-aware, fourth-wall-breaking visual novel with multiple paths, many endings (some paths MUCH shorter than others, where one wrong move leads to an an untimely demise!)

Meet a time-bending witch. Befriend a mysterious, eccentric, yet disarmingly cute artist. Push the boundaries of possibilities with humour that doesn't conform to reality.

A few examples of possible adventures:

- Irritate a character so much that they explode
- Unlock a playable dinosaur character and eat characters instead of talking to them
- Inadvertently break the logic of the universe and cause an essential main character to burst into flames
- Set up a water park and become rich, before continuing on your adventure
- Hugely misinterpret a line in the game's dialogue and discuss it with the game's backstage crew to resolve it
- Get thrown by a tree on its (alleged) birthday

...and more!



Can you unlock a dozen or so endings and save yourself from eternal servitude at the hands of the evil time-bending cookie witch? Let's hope so!

1828400.name: Ghoul Dungeon
1828400.about_the_game:
Ghoul Dungeon is a level-based adventure.

As you make your way, you will encounter monsters you must fight off. You'll only be able to hit them up close, so make use of the ability to dash in order to avoid getting hit. In addition, you will be able to use power slashes to deal additional damage. Make sure you're aware of your cooldowns!

You'll also encounter capsules to to heal you or provide attack boosts. Make use of these to power through!

Note: Ghoul Dungeon was a personal project I made in high school, when I was still learning game dev, and I'm no longer working on the game. Still, I hope you guys enjoy it!

Current number of levels available: 4

Additional notes:

- Ghoul Dungeon is playable with a controller, however this is implemented only for experimental purposes (suggested method to play is with keyboard and mouse)

- Currently, enemies can only attack at a close range however in a future update a ranged variant will be added

1828410.name: Survive The Island
1828410.about_the_game:
survive the island you survive from skeletons and humans

you can build and mine and level up your stats you can build whatever you want

you can raid enemies you can mine and cut down trees and you have to hunt for your own food

and you can grow your own crops and you can craft weapons and building supplies to take the fight to the skeletons and humans

and to explore the open world and you can pick flowers this game is RPG SURVIVAL CRAFTING BUILDING OPEN-WORLD

and you can unlock magic to kill the skeletons and humans is a fireball you can get bananas and health regen to breathe underwater to called down a meteor

and you can harvest crops

1828450.name: Squirrel Knight
1828450.about_the_game:
A classic platformer
Embark on a magical journey as Squirrel Knight on his quest to save the forest. Squirrel Knight is an action-platformer game with upgradable abilities, time trials and challenging bosses.



Battle powerful bosses
Fight in Boss Rush mode and overcome powered up foes.



Race against the clock
Aim to be the fastest in Time Trial mode.



Power up your hero
Upgrade your abilities by collecting coins and unlocking powerful relics.



Save the Kingdom!
Uncover the mystery of the darkness corrupting the Squirrel Knights, and save the kingdom.

Community
Want to learn more about Squirrel Knight? Join our discord!

1828490.name: Gomu
1828490.about_the_game:
Meet Gomu ! A 2D platformer game with several environments. Grab, swing and go to an adventure in order to get back the stars Gomu made fall and put it back in the sky

His rubber body will allow him to go throw levels easily. It's up to you to master his abilities to beat the 25 levels efficiently. If you perfectlymaster them, you may even claim a top place in the world of speedrun

Gomu will have help or problems from animals living in his world. Use each of them to fulfill your quest

1828510.name: Childlike(차일드라이크)
1828510.about_the_game:
'Childlike' is a journey to follow the innocence of childhood.
Play as the child facing adventurous moments, the player should think like a child to overcome fear and obstacles ahead.

In the kids' imagination, kids encounter many obstacles anywhere around the house, and outside, and of course, the school.
They think of floor and road as things they must not step on, otherwise, they think they're gonna fall down.
And their school becomes the scariest place at night and dolls are alive, move around.

As a puzzle genre game, players need various abilities to move next.
Comprehension of the game - Players should look around to find items, and think about what to do to deal with the obstacles. They can grab and throw, step on the objects not to step on the floor, just like "The floor is lava".
Being alert - Players should always be careful and check if their footsteps or turning on the lights make any attraction to villains. If they find the players, something terrible will happen. And it will make the players not let their hair down.
Rapid reaction - Players should concentrate on what is chasing them and how to deal with it quickly to survive. If they act late, there is no next.

Through this game, the player can recall innocent minds as a child.

*There are some English interfaces but all of the subtitles are Korean.

1828540.name: 九州风流
1828540.about_the_game:
开发者致词：
本工作室三名爱好者自给自研，旨在全力为玩家提供一个丰富，公平，多元的武侠世界
让大家既可以单独博弈对战，又可以与好友组队打怪、PK，还可以帮派整体对抗
即可以休闲跑商赚钱，又可以大杀四方
即可以体验国风武侠文化剧情，又能携手心仪女神风流九州的一个独立游戏
目前已打好了底层框架，由于人手紧缺，实现的内容还在加紧逐步完善
请予以一定的耐心，与我们携手共建，重现一个潇洒风流的九州武侠世界。
有任何问题请留言、加QQ群：1025488443 ，我们会尽力评估解决一切玩家需求。

《九州风流》是一款武侠题材的多人对战公平竞技游戏，一次性买断，无任何影响平衡性的消费。
拥有全新的博弈玩法和特色的武功招式和宝物系统
游戏背景是在末世武林，因一场权利内斗，稀世珍宝散落九州
六大门派因地盘之争互不相让，而你的轮回转世必将创造并改变世局
目前0.1测试版完成内容：
1.收集六大门派招式、武功和宝物：少林，武当，丐帮，明教，逍遥，五毒
剑法,枪法,棍法,拳法,身法,掌法,心法.目前已制作300+的武功招式和100+的各色宝物装备
2.战斗博弈玩法：招式属性相生相克，如何收集、磨炼、搭配你的武功招式成为重中之重
3.吸收(缝合)了自走棋类，roguelike，以及传统对战卡牌的部分游戏乐趣
4.剧情系统：形形色色的江湖任务，见证大侠外传故事，领略民间奇闻趣事
5.跑商系统：在各州之间倒卖稀缺商品也可以富甲一方
6.地盘玩法：为帮派抢占地盘，占领稀缺物资产区，获得荣誉和强大道具
7.后宫系统：捏脸，抢妹子，传宗接代，轮回转世

开发中内容：
1.多人PVP PVE：多人组队摆阵对抗大boss或帮派多人PK
2.妹子侍寝系统：动态的妹子互动系统
3.世界事件，战斗：南蛮，东夷，北寇，西匪入侵九州
各大门派能否暂时放下嫌隙，共同抵抗强大的外敌
4.更多的门派，招式类型. 海量的招式，宝物，物品药品，各式各样的女侠陪你闯荡武林
5.快速对战系统，自动出招，重在招式搭配的战前策略

1828630.name: 幻想枝魂 Soul Fantasy
1828630.about_the_game:
This work is an A-SOUL's secondary creation of the same work.

Plot Outline

Red sky, flames ruthlessly devour everything in front of us.
A huge white body leads an army like a wave to crush all good things.
Some say it is God's depication; some say it is the embodiment of hell; none of the forces that try to resist it can fall well.
Over time, people gave up resistance, it ruled the Zhijiang River, the reign of the Magic King let people shudder.
No one dared to resist the mighty demons until the presence of the five girls broke the deadlock.
And our story, from the first hundred years of the reign of the Demon King of Zhijiang...

Game Introduction

This game is an A-SOUL peer-to-RPG fantasy pixel game.
The mechanism used in this game is round warfare.
The game has multiple story branch selections, and your choices will change the direction of follow-up tasks, NPC communication, and plot direction.
In the game, you can unlock a variety of CG, music.
In the game, we have set up a lot of hidden collectibles, waiting for your discovery and exploration.

1828650.name: The Silent Kingdom
1828650.about_the_game:
The Silent Kingdom is a story-driven, otome RPG developed by a single dev, where player's choices and interactions with other characters set the narrative.

If you like dark fables and meaningful decision-making games, you'll enjoy this adventure in which you can shape the fate of the protagonist.

Place yourself in the role of Princess Erinys, whose kingdom has fallen under the yoke of a sorrowful curse. In order to save everything you have ever known and loved, you’ll have to stand against the entire world - and even defy the Goddess herself.

How much weight will a withered kingdom burden your soul? As a princess, will you be loved or hated, betrayer or betrayed? Will you seek comfort in the companionship of others, or will the demise of your kingdom seal your heart away forever?

A path of thorns is waiting. The manner in which you walk it is up to you.

  • A main character that's defined, yet mouldable to your taste.
    Princess Erinys is an established protagonist with both a background and a personality of her own, yet it's up to you to decide how she'll evolve and relate to the other characters. You can also select your own preferred name for her.

  • Roleplay experience.
    Apart from the most impactful decisions in the story, many dialogue interactions will also contain choices that merely focus on immersion. One answer is not necessarily better than another; it just offers different ways of interacting with others.

  • Romance.
    If you wish, you can explore romantic bonds with the two accompanying characters. Although not required in order to see the story to its completion, the relationships you forge with other characters will influence its development.

  • Turn-based battle system.
    While the story remains the most important element, combat will be indispensable to progress. The turn-based combat system offers three distinct and fully hand-animated characters.

  • Dark and emotional story.
    Will the princess question her own morality? Will narcissism and lust for power replace faithful bonds to become her most loyal companions? And from what prism will she judge the sins of others?

  • In English and Spanish (EU). Choose the language from the options menu.

1828660.name: Worst World
1828660.about_the_game:
Worst World is a Hardcore zombie multiplayer survival game. Survive in a post apocalyptic world, collect resources and set up camps. Make friends or join a micro society of survivors. The World does not give you a gift. No crosshair, menu, life bar. You can be happy to breathe and to have spent the night every day.
In this game you have the posibility to create bases and customize them, steal cars and motorbikes in order to move around the map more quickly. Collect weapons to face the zombies, Collect food, care as well as tools like a pickaxe, an ax is a knife. For example the knife will be very useful to you to recover zombie skins and not to be spotted by them. In addition the game contains a crafting system allowing you to combine objects and obtain new items, Create your own weapons like a bat with a nail! So dreadful ... Beware of illness and cold that can make you fall ill, it's up to you to learn how to cure them or how to slow down certain death.
But above all there is a danger. The others, indeed hunger will push players to kill you for your resources or for the craziest, to devour you.

In the current version (V4), you will be able to find zombies, weapons, the first maps of the game, the first builds, character physics, blood and injuries, weather and seasons as well as the day / night cycle, the inventory and the various loot (clothes, food, tools, weapons ect). The animation system (to make emotes), cars and motorcycles, and of course the possibility of joining you online via discord or steam ! You can now explore the casing, find resources, invite your friends, and survive several nights with luck! The latest update added the much anticipated quality change system which allowed access to weaker computer configuration!

So good luck and try to support you instead of fighting you.

1828690.name: Security Booth: Director's Cut
1828690.about_the_game:
The year is 1996 and you’re employed by a science lab called Nova Nexus.
You work as a security guard at the front gate to the lab, inside a guard booth.
However, tonight it seems something important is happening inside of Nova Nexus and things are... well... a little strange.



Your job is simple. you must make sure that only the right authorized personnel are getting into the facility.
To do this, when a car arrives at the gates, it is your job to go and talk with the driver and check their license plate. Make sure that the person is on the employee register by finding the license plate on the register.



If the person is not on the register you must tell them to leave.
Make sure to only open the gates to employees and keep the gate closed at all times.



The Director's Cut Edition of Security Booth comes with many new features and changes from the original version.

Randomized Cars

Cars will now be randomized, this means each play-though will be different. However, key events will still happen the same way.

Widescreen Mode

Aspect ratio is unlocked, no more black side bars!

New Endings

Security Booth: Director's Cut has a total of 7 endings.

Nexus Archives Tapes

There are 3 tapes that are extra content which extra story/lore. To view them you will need to unlock the first 3 main endings.

Compatible With Controller

You asked for it! You can now use a controller to play Security Booth: Director's Cut.

1828700.name: Celestial Project
1828700.about_the_game:
Join Discord:

Roguelike, WarChess & SCI-Cartoon

"Celestial Project" is a Roguelike WarChess game. It is the first game of the story "Celestial".

In 2069, unknown alien creatures from space suddenly attacked the Earth, killing more than half of the population of major cities in the world within seven days. The governments and giant technology companies of various countries on the earth have decided to invest all human resources to build five giant starships that can propagate civilization before the human population is extinct, so as to spread the human kind of fire into the universe.

Command the role to defend the starship

Players choose to command the special operations forces of the Human Revolutionary Federation, the White Bear Heavy Industry and the UNION. There are currently a total of 9 different roles, forming a three-person team. Take the shuttle to fight the alien creatures on the earth and destroy them before the alien creatures destroy the built starship! Defend the completion of five giant starships and set sail. Every battle takes place on a 9x9 war chess map. Commanding roles make full use of terrain obstacles and equipment characteristics to complete battles that win more with less.

More than 24 types of equipment

The game contains four different types of weapons, including sharpness, skill, reloading, and science, as well as general props and equipment, with a total of more than 24 types. There are also hidden weapons produced by capturing alien creatures.

Each character can carry two weapons into battle, and arm the squad through a reasonable combination.

More than 81 chips and skills

Three chips can be inserted into each weapon, and some rare chips provide powerful capabilities that the weapon itself does not have. The right role is matched with the right weapon, and the powerful chip combination can raise the combat effectiveness to a higher dimension.

Scene and starship

The shapes and construction methods of the five starships are completely different. One directly transform urban buildings as part of the interior of the starship, with a large number of facilities. One directly use ice and frozen soil as the hull of the spacecraft on the snow-capped mountains, latitude launch saves energy, and at the same time comes with a lot of fresh water. One use the energy of lava on the side of volcanoes for construction and energy storage. Different starships and scenes have different styles of alien enemies and loot rewards.

The hidden earth forces and its undisclosed sixth starship under construction are waiting to be discovered by the commander.

1828710.name: Tumble
1828710.about_the_game:
YOU ARE THE ONLY HOPE

Tumble is an action-platformer set in the near future, where constant thunderstorms have forced humanity to escape underground. You start your adventure as Volt- a nomad cyborg on the search for his long lost wife. After entering an abandoned lab, you soon discover that things may not go as smoothly as you hoped...

Features:

  • Adrenaline Pumping Action: Fight enemies of all shapes and sizes in challenging, fast paced combat
  • Vast Exploration: Secrets, challenges and obstacles await you in many levels of increasing difficulty
  • Mysterious Lore: Discover hints scattered around the world to put together a deep storyline
  • Memorable Heroes: Unlock characters with unique skillsets and attributes and find the one to fit your playstyle

Tumble provides you with an exciting array of enemies, bosses and hurdles to overcome as you navigate your way down the tight corridors. Use your abilities and rapid movement to fight back, even when the odds aren't in your favor. Feel that extra bit of adrenaline once you finally beat that one tough level.

The only limit to as far you will go are your skills. Bumped into a saw? Try again. Fell into a pool of acid? Try again. Got stabbed by a fish piloting a drone?

Try again.

1828720.name: Animal Sanctuary
1828720.about_the_game:
Build a home for a whole bunch of furry friends, from the largest elephant to the tiny meerkats.



Rebuild this old decayed Sanctuary to temp the Animals to return. Plant trees and flowers to make the place cozy, give them their favourite food and some shelter for those cold nights and maybe the occasional belly rub to keep them happier than ever. Of course you could just sit back and relax while they go for a swim or chase the beachballs, as well as each other, around!



With 40+ species of animal to look after, and each one having their own minor needs to cater for, keeping them all happy should prove a small challenge. Some have favourite foods and areas of the map, others need a few extra belly rubs than most to truly feel loved. Others are more playful and would rather belly flop from the waterfall or pop some balloons to keep themselves amused.

Look after them, they need a helping hand!

1828740.name: My Nemesis and Hero - Slice of Life Boys Love (BL) Visual Novel
1828740.about_the_game:
Join Kai, the super dense MC, in his daily life as he slowly figures out that his childhood friends might have crushes on him...?

NEMESIS GAVIN
Kai has been picked on by Gavin ever since they were kids.
Due to being constantly mocked by his nemesis, he's tried his best to change his appearance to be more intimidating.
Gavin's only motive is to get Kai's attention, but instead, he's now hated by his crush.

HERO PERCY
Percy, on the other hand, is always there at the right time to defend Kai.
His kind, yet over-protective title led him to become Kai's best friend.
For all these years, Percy has yearned to be something more than friends, but his attempts so far have been futile.

Both Gavin and Percy act the way they do because they're absolutely smitten with Kai. Unfortunately, Kai is too dense to notice their affection!
He just wants to fall in love with someone... But will he ever consider dating his best friend or rival?


- SFW. Pure Fluff and Comedy to make you smile!
- Your choices decide which Love Interest you interact with!
- 30K words
- 3 routes/endings and 18 CGs to unlock!
- Go on dates
- Send text messages
- Partake in silly banter

1828750.name: They Came From Below
1828750.about_the_game:
They Came From Below is a cute Tower Defense in Lowpoly 3D graphics. Here you have to build an economy and various defense towers to resist hordes of skeletons.

To do this, you can choose various strategies, such as abandoning the economy to quickly build defenses, building up the entire map with simple but cheap towers, or building several, but very strong and strong improved towers.



When the towers cannot cope with the hordes of the rebels, or some cunning necromancer was able to slip through, then you can use various elemental super-strikes.

In the game you will find many different levels, both in construction and visual, from steppes and glaciers to hell! And also plunge into a pleasant, but sometimes tense atmosphere, accompanied by a cute soundtrack.



Good luck to you, to prove to the rebels from the earth that we do not just live above them!

1828770.name: Perfect Balance
1828770.about_the_game:
Jump into this hypercasual physics game and keep the disk balanced. You'll encounter different sizes and shapes of weights, and earn upgrades to assist you along the way. A streamlined gameplay loop gets you into the fun in the blink of an eye. Find out who the best balancer is with the in-game leaderboards!

There is a rogue-like upgrade system that lets the game get easier as you put more time into it. These upgrades can help you survive longer and longer into a round, but be ready, things really start to ramp up. New weights will begin to spawn just as you think you've gotten the hang of it, and the spawn rate is always speeding up!

The game was born during the 49th Ludum Dare game jam around the theme of "unstable". After seeing how many people had a blast and wanted to play it again, we turned it into a full game.

1828780.name: Midnight Stories 4
1828780.about_the_game:

This VISUAL NOVEL continues the life of Cindy, that takes 33% of the game and the rest is full of side stories with various people and hot scenes. This way you can explore all kind of kinks and pleasures and topics.

1828800.name: Arksync
1828800.about_the_game:
🔻Arksync is a fast-paced sci-fi action game where a small robot teddy bear hijacks a powerful war robot, and sets out across the Trash Moon in search of their lost owner.

Scavenge weapons, fight hostile machines, and uncover the secrets buried beneath humanity's discarded refuge. Every step across the Trash Moon brings the toy bear closer to finding their friend.

🔻Key Features

  • Explore 12 Levels within the Trash moon and beyond

  • Fight 13+ Enemy Types including drones, mechs, and zombies

  • Survive 11 Boss Fights

  • Wield 10 Weapons, and 9 Utilities with unique tactical combinations

  •  Discover hidden Mini-games and unexpected gameplay twists

🔻Explore the Trash Moon

The Trash Moon has become a massive dumping ground for abandoned machines and failed corporate experiments.

Explore dangerous facilities, ruined infrastructure, and strange anomalies scattered across the moon as you search for Encryption Disks (E-Disks) needed to unlock deeper sectors.

Repair broken systems like excavation elevators, tram stations, and ancient machinery to open new levels throughout the world.

🔻Combat with an Arsenal of Weapons and Utilities
Face corrupted drones, rogue machines, and strange infected entities lurking within the scrap.

Master a wide variety of weapons and utilities. Loadouts encourage different play styles, and strategies.

🔻Fast Movement and Reactive Combat
You were built for confrontation.

Use jump thrusters, dodge boosts, and rapid movement to survive ambushes and navigate dangerous environments.

Stay mobile, adapt quickly, and turn the battlefield in your favor.

🔻Persistent Death System
Your android body is linked to a Reboot Terminal.

If destroyed, you are rebuilt — but everything you carried is lost.

Every expedition becomes a calculated risk.

🔻Customize Your Loadout
Weapons can be modified with unique Mod Schematics, allowing players to experiment with powerful combinations.
Visit Dispensers and Depots to resupply ammunition, shields, and new equipment before heading back into the scrap.
Preparation is the difference between survival and destruction.

🔻Recover the Encryption Disks
Deep within the Trash Moon lie the E-Disks required to unlock restricted areas and uncover the secrets of the Trash Moon.

Each discovery brings you closer to returning the robot teddy bear to the human they call friend.

1828830.name: The Beresford family
1828830.about_the_game:
Robert Beresford lived happily in his family mansion, alongside his daughters Elizabeth, Charlotte, Anne, Matilda, and Victoria, the butler Zachary, and the housekeeper Theresa. His businesses were thriving, and peace and joy filled the house.

However, the night of July 20, 1824, everything changed for the Beresford family.

Robert woke from his sleep, restless and fearful of a looming sense of dread.

In the stillness of the night, beneath the shimmering stars, footsteps echoed through the corridors, voices and whispers in the darkness, followed by bursts of fire and screams of agony. Robert rushed out of his room, determined to discover what had shattered the peace of his tranquil family mansion, but his soul was not prepared for all he would encounter on that tragic night.

But what really happened?

Alongside Sheriff Cooper, Robert Beresford will investigate the events of those cursed hours, tracing the steps of each inhabitant of the mansion and uncovering the terrible truth hidden within the darkness of the night.

The resurgence of an ancient curse whose echoes resonate to this day.



Enjoy a mystery and horror novel in which you'll have to investigate and interrogate all its inhabitants to uncover the truth.

1828870.name: Tavern Crawl
1828870.about_the_game:
Tavern Crawl is a student-made, 3rd-person adventure starring Fish, a young countryside mouse who dreams of adventure. His kingdom uses alcohol collected from the city they live below as currency, fuel for fires, and resources to craft delicious and useful cocktails. When the alcohol mysteriously dries up, Fish volunteers to leave his home and investigate where the precious resource has gone.

Fast Paced Combat
Use your needle sword and bottlecap shield to fight those that would keep you from your destiny.

Crafting Cocktails
Use the alcohol collected from fallen enemies to craft cocktails with all sorts of useful effects.

Explore the Sewers
Explore the rich world of the sewers, filled with a host of characters and secrets for you to discover.

1828900.name: Stickit
1828900.about_the_game:
Now with Online Multiplayer and Online Leaderboards
If you're wondering how your friends are able to beat the map, why not play with them and have a look yourself (using the Spectator Mode!)! Stickit can now be played online, both on the main level and on custom user created levels, together with your friends! Furthermore scores are submitted to online Steam Leaderboards, both for the main level and for user created levels! See who can beat levels the fastest!

Now with Level Editor and Steam Workshop integration
If the difficulty of the main level isn't quite to your liking, try your hand at making your entirely own levels with the provided in-game Level Editor, or download community created levels directly from the Steam Workshop!

Stickit is a brutal first person platforming game about climbing higher and higher to reach your ultimate goal, The Golden Stick. At your disposal is the very simple mechanic of sticking to walls and ceilings, no complex control schemes or wonky physics, so how hard can it be?

Whilst the only way forward is up, the way up isn't always obvious. The level contains multiple routes, and for those technically gifted players you will likely be able to find skips around obstacles entirely. Be careful however, because once you fall and are unable to find your footing on the platforms below you, the only way back up is the very same path you came...

But it's simple really, just jump and stick it.

Features
  • Tight and satisfying controls, Stick to walls and ceilings by dashing
  • Hard to master, whilst sticking to surfaces might seem simple, there's a hidden mechanic to it that will allow you to find new paths.
  • In-game Level Editor and Steam Workshop integration, if the main level isn't your thing then try creating your own levels and share them with others on the Steam Workshop!
  • Steam Leaderboards, times for the main level and user created levels are submitted on stored on Steam Leaderboards, see who's the fastest!
  • Online Multiplayer, play online with your friends and find the way forward together! You can even play together on user created levels!
  • A massive level, many many hours to beat it, if you're even able to.
  • Non-linear level, there's almost always more than one way up, which one will suit you? And for those in a rush, finding new paths entirely to skip obstacles is very much encouraged.
  • Heatmap of player mistakes, every single of your failures is stored for you to see
  • Speedrunner friendly, both speedrunning split timer and a segment practice mode is in the game. Furthermore the nature of the game lends itself perfectly to speedrunning. Find alternate paths and climb even faster.
  • Steam Achievements (Compare how far you've gotten compared to others by checking their achievements)
  • Steam Cloud integration. New computer? Don't worry, all your mistakes are stored in the Steam Cloud

1828910.name: Viy: Retold Story

1829000.name: Puputan Legend VR

1829010.name: World of Cube
1829010.about_the_game:
World of Cube is a first-person puzzle game. Players can explore and solve puzzles and proceed to the next area. Simple puzzle mechanics and minimalist world design. Although the mechanics are simple, each area has its unique puzzle and its unique solution. There is no time limit, players can take their time to solve the puzzles.

There are various types of cube. Some types of cubes that can be interacted by player with are as follows:
  • Movable Cube. A movable cube that can be moved on one fixed axis. It can be used to fill a gap of 2 cubes, so the player could walk through.
  • Resizable Cube. A cube can be extended into a beam, but it cannot be moved. It also can be used to fill gaps in cubes.
  • Pushable Cube. A movable cube, but it moved by pushing from one side and dealt damage when it hit certain objects.
  • Detonatable Cube. A non-movable cube, just will explode when interacted by the player and deal damage to certain nearby objects.
  • Advanced Movable Cube. Another movable cube, but its moving axis can be changed.

There are various objects which are attached to a movable cube and can be moved as moving any other movable cube. World of Cube also combined with a various of other puzzle mechanics, such as:
  • Laser mechanic. A laser where it could unlock some stuff or deal damage when it hit a certain object. There is also a laser redirector, it could help the laser reach a farther spot. Some laser shooters and redirectors are attached to a movable cube, so the player can move them as moving any other movable cube.
  • Match-3 mechanic. Some movable cube has a different design, like a plain cube with each different color. When it touches another cube with the same color, they will collapse.

Beware of enemies, avoid their attacks. Players could use surrounding objects to block their attacks, like cubes or shields. In some areas, players could fight them using surrounding objects, like a pushable cube.

Armed and Armoured is a historical action & strategy RPG. The game dedicates to recreate the most realistic ancient sword fighting battles, with an immersive army organizing simulation system. The story background is based on the late Ming dynasty of China (late 16th Century), when Japanese piracy was at its peak. Free exploration and hidden story line will be in the best balance in this game.

1. Extremely Immersive Army Organizing Simulation System:
Free exploration and storylines with hidden plot are included in this game. A player can join any side and start playing as a soldier. Or he can try to establish his own gang in the chaotic late Ming dynasty, develop his business, recruit troops, and gradually expand his gang from nothing into a major local power. Whether the player throw himself into the Ming Dynasty to turn the tide, or sitting on a thousand sails to become a pirate giant who dominates the East China Sea, or any other choice he made, it is all within the player’s hands. The game will be featured with a large strategic map mode and a local battlefield mode

2. Extremely Realistic Melee Combat System
Armors and weapons’ collisions are calculated by physics engine. 3. Complete formation strategy system
A player can form his army into different formations based on different tactics. He needs to win the battle more strategically, other than charging with blindness hacking and slashing.

1829120.name: Carrier Commander
1829120.about_the_game:
Carrier Commander is a real-time strategy game which allows you choose the intensity of your gameplay. You can just manage your Aircraft Carrier Operations against incoming attacks or intensify your game play by directly engaging the enemy by controlling your own Jets, Destroyer's, Rescue Helicopters and more. Move up through the Military Ranks and unlock Special Operation Missions as you climb the the ladder of success. The choice is yours Commander!

Carrier Operations:
> Purchase - Configure - Launch - Land - Refuel: Your F/A-18C Fighters into the skies to battle against incoming Enemy Aircraft, Ships and Submarines.
> Upgrade your AA Defenses to Fire Multiple Shells or Increase Reloading Speed but choose wisely as upgrades do not come cheap.
> Configure your Destroyer's with various Deck Cannons, Torpedo's, AA rockets, Short Range Sonar & Radar.
> Launch your Hawkeye Aircraft to provide Long Range Sonar and Radar for visual warnings on enemy advancements.
> Launch your 0H-58D attack helicopters to engage in close encounters with approaching enemies.
> Manage your assets properly to survive or pay the ultimate price!

F18 and Destroyer Operations:
> Intensify your engagement against the enemy by Flying your own F18 fighter or take control of your Destroyer's and annihilate incoming threats.
> Launch your F18 into the skies using guns, unguided and guided rockets, bombs and destroy incoming planes, ships and submarines.
> Take Control of your destroyer to search and destroy incoming submarines, destroyer's, battleships and enemy jets.

The money you earn each Level is used as your starting funds for the next round of challenges. Therefore, limiting your purchasing of Fighter Jets and Upgrades greatly improves your starting funds for the next level.

Random AI generators ensure No two games are the same when playing CARRIER COMMANDER

1829270.name: RoadOut
1829270.about_the_game:
RoadOut is a post-apocalyptic action RPG that combines top-down, twin stick combat with rubber-burning driving mechanics. Explore a vast, desolate world in your car, then battle your way through puzzle-filled dungeons on foot. With inspirations from The Legend of Zelda, GTA and Rock'n Roll Racing, RoadOut is a story-driven adventure full of gangs, cybernetics and rip-roaring races.

After a great cataclysm, what's left is a post-apocalyptic world dominated by an A.I. with rebel groups that take refuge in a desert area known as The Dead Zone.

Claire survives in this world by executing black market contracts for local leaders involving delivery, sabotage and murder. The Dead Zone, now not so dead, is occupied by three rival factions: The Wasteheads, The SaibaKuran, and Order of the New Code.

While investigating her past, Claire uncovers strange evidence that links her existence to the origin of the A.I…

Explore the World on Wheels

The world is no longer the same. All that remains is The Dead Zone, a large artificial biome created to sustain a new era of humanity. Drive through The Dead Zone doing jobs, getting paid and running roughshod over the scum guarding the secrets of the world. Join factions, fight rival gangs, barter items and take up quests to earn clout while progressing Claire’s story.

Twin Stick Combat and Dungeon Exploration

Exit your ride and explore locations in the world of RoadOut on foot. Crush bandits with short and long range attacks, block with your shield, and recover using drugs that you’ve crafted on the way. Solve puzzles using fully rotatable stack sprite perspectives that look 2D, but are actually 3D.

Body Mods and Cybernetics

Craft new moves, weapons and drugs to survive. You can customize Claire with body mods, cybernetics and an intricate skill tree system. Upgrade her car to traverse different terrain and withstand the effects of weather, night and day.

Battle in Your Bitchin' Ride

Equipped with weapons and other tech, Claire’s car is your best friend against dangers in The Dead Zone. Hungry animals are ready to rip you apart. Murderous bandits will rob your lifeless corpse. Prepare for the worst with your car and its arsenal of weapons.

Race for Glory

The world may have come to an end, but who said we can't have fun? Ride or die in red-hot races to be the best on the post apocalyptic circuit. 10 tracks in multiple biomes, innumerable races, all of them equal measures deadly and glorious. Indulge in extra game modes such as destruction derby-style racing and twisted battle arena, all while roading out to a thumping synthwave soundtrack.

1829500.name: QuizPoker: Mix of Quiz and Poker
1829500.about_the_game:
Put your knowledge of various topics to the test or bluff your way to victory!

QuizPoker combines poker and quiz elements. Unlike poker, however, QuizPoker does not deal cards, but asks guessing questions to which each player gives an answer.
The rules are based on Texas Holdem Poker, but are still easy to understand even for beginners.
Chips can be bet in a total of four betting rounds. The player whose answer is closest to the correct answer wins.

Thrilling questions and hints!
QuizPoker offers you a variety of questions and hints around topics such as sports, pop culture, history and many more. In addition, we are constantly working on expanding the questions to provide variety and excitement during the game.

Get the win!
Compete with your opponents in exciting question rounds and win their chips to decide the game in your favor. In doing so, you can convince with your knowledge or cleverly outplay other players if you can't guess the answer to the question at all.

Customize your game.
In order to provide all players with the most individual game experience possible, you have the option to customize some of the game settings.
Decide for yourself how many players you are competing against or what difficulty level offline opponents have.

Find out more.
Wondering how many chips you've won or how many times you've answered a guessing question perfectly?
Check out your personal stats and share them with your friends.

Online Multiplayer.
Even more excitement in multiplayer mode! Invite your friends to a QuizPoker session or compete against other players from the community by creating your own session or joining an already created game.

How it works.
A question round in a QuizPoker game might look like this:

All players are asked a guessing question.
For example:
"In what year was the musician Elton John born?"

You enter your guess in the input field. Let's assume your guess is 1949.
Now the first betting round follows:

Since you are unsure how good your guess is, you, just like your opponents, do not bet any chips. Therefore, the first hint to the answer is now given.

1st hint:
"His big break came in 1970 with the album Elton John."

Your guess doesn't seem so bad, so you raise.
Your opponents call.

2nd hint:
"Elton John was born shortly after the end of World War II."

Things are looking good for you! You raise again, so one opponent folds. Now the correct answer is shown.

Answer:
"1947"

You are only 2 years away from the correct answer. If there is no Elton John fan at the table, your chances are not bad. You raise again.

Now the players reveal their guesses.
Player 1 has already left the game after the second clue. Player 2 guesses the year of birth to be 1952.
You are closest and win all the chips of the entire question round!

When the game starts, each player is first dealt a hand of five cards with hands and feet for some reason, and six ability tiles. In addition to "draw one card from the opponent's hand," the ability tiles also contain special effects that are not found in the regular Old Maid, such as "increase the opponent's hand" and "discard your hand.
The player must use this Ability Tile to eliminate his or her own hand, as in the Bubba Draw, in order to win.

One of the characteristics of an Ability Tile is that it has a fixed maximum number of tiles that can appear on the field. For example, one player can monopolize one Ability Tile, and while that player is monopolized, no other player can draw that Ability Tile until that player uses the Ability Tile they are monopolizing.

The game is characterized by the fact that both players can read each other's ability tiles as well as the opponent's hand, which creates a deeper gameplay than in ordinary Old Maid.

Rift-Warp through time and space in search of your prey. Ever-changing vibrant galaxies and randomized waves of enemies means an endless exploration of deep space. No two runs are the same.

1830040.name: False Skies
1830040.about_the_game:
It has been 2000 years since the stars fell from the night sky.
To see them in this place... what does this mean for us?

_____________



The throne room of a long-forgotten ruin lies ransacked. Communication is lost, monsters run rampant across the land, and ships that leave the safety of the shore are quickly sunk. And among all this, rumors of a group of strange horned people, hailing from a city that vanished millennia ago, are quickly spreading...

_____________


False Skies is a classic RPG with fast-paced, turn-based battles and an involved class system.

Features:


  • Create a party with any combination of 8 distinct classes.
  • ...and, when the time comes, layer on new classes! Each of the four tiers has its own set of 8 classes to choose from, with no restrictions on what classes can be chosen.
  • No equipment restrictions! Go put that sword on your mage - but be aware that it might not be the best idea to do so.
  • Explore well over a dozen dungeons, encounter over 300 types of enemies, and associate with a varied cast of characters as you travel the world.
  • Enjoy many quality of life features, such as reduced penalties for falling in battle and obsolete skills being replaced.

The Battle System



False Skies employs a simple, traditional, and fast battle system. With clever and effective skill selection, your foes shall fall fast - but you'll sustain heavy damage in return if you're not careful, especially if you hit with attacks that are readily countered by whatever you're facing.

The Class System



At certain points throughout your journey, you'll get the chance for your party members to change class. Each class comes with its own unique traits, whether it be what skills they learn, how strong their stat growths are, or equipment they can use effectively. Furthermore, each new class layers onto your older ones, with your party members keeping all their old skills and stats intact.

While a few classes will be available for you to change into immediately, data on most of them are scattered around the world. Go off the beaten path, and you shall be rewarded...

1830050.name: September 28 Pizza
1830050.about_the_game:
It's always September at September 28 Pizza

Put yourself in Chad Jones' shoes by delivering pizza as a zombie apocalypse unfolds!

You are a delivery man who suspiciously does not know how to drive a motorcycle and customers are waiting for their pizzas, locked up safely inside their homes as you roam the uncomfortably deserted streets. You fear that at any moment a zombie will smell the delicious and seductive smell of food... We're talking about you, of course - their favorite meal! Fortunately, you never walk alone without your "own-safety" pistol.

Good luck surviving zombies and angry customers rating you zero stars...

Key Features

- 3D Top-Down Shooter

- Zombies to kill and escape from
- Health and stamina system
- Different types of guns
- Simple house-looting system
- Linear narrative with a good sense of humor
- Lots of zombies to explode

1830100.name: Space Survival
1830100.about_the_game: You are on a routine mission harvesting ice from asteroids, when suddenly your ship is hit by a high speed one and destroyed! Luckily you were outside of the ship when it happened.. Or was that luck? Now you are stranded in space alone! How long can you survive? You do have your grenade launcher and ice collecting gear and you can use the ice to power your life support, maybe you can even find some power ups from pieces of your old ship.. Just watch out for black holes!

1830110.name: THE SIGNAL: Stranded on Sirenis
1830110.about_the_game:
The Signal is a survival crafter like no other. Your desperate search to find a missing loved one has crash-landed you on a planet. You learn this planet is most unusual, and find yourself trapped. Scavenge, build, extract and survive your way through a complex world as you reveal the true intentions of this sentient planet -- and why it has brought you here.

UNRAVEL THE MYSTERY

Can you uncover the unknown forces that power the planet? Will you escape from its clutches? Why did it draw you here in the first place? Explore and discover the signal source, find your lost brother, and get out alive.

EXPLORE AND SURVIVE

To explore and survive on this strange planet, you’ll need to scavenge resources, craft useful items and upgrade your gear. Adapting to various environments requires the proper loadout, so prepare yourself as you investigate the strange ruins and crash sites scattered across the planet. Could there be other survivors here? Survival-craft your way to safety, as you learn about new technologies and resources.

EXTRACT AND ADAPT

Uncover clues about the powerful relationship between the planet and the forces that drive it. Relics with unusual properties will need to be found and returned to their original locations, but restoring balance to this planet is a treacherous task. Every ancient relic you discover can cause unforeseen consequences. Adapt to your surroundings to safely extract the resources and items you need.

RESEARCH AND CUSTOMIZE

Learn about the planet and its inhabitants to expand your arsenal of options. Through research, you’ll uncover more build and craft options, more recipes, more tools, equipment, and weapons.

CUSTOM VEHICLES

You must traverse and plan your travels across multiple worlds, ranging from tranquil glades, dense marsh, scorched rifts, and frozen tundras. Customize your vehicle to improve your chances of safe passage across this treacherous world.

ABOUT GOOSE BYTE

We’re a small team that’s committed to creating worlds and memorable experiences for players. Our studio was founded in Montreal, Canada in September 2021 and became fully independent in July 2023. The Signal is the first game we are making together as a team and we look forward to sharing this sci-fi journey with you.
