1830150.name: 三極姬 4 天華繚亂 天命之戀繪卷( Sanoku Hime 4~Tenka Ryouran Tenmei no Koi Emaki
1830150.about_the_game:
Sanoku Hime 4~Tenka Ryouran Tenmei no Koi Emaki is a SLG game made by SystemSoft Alplha. Sanoku Hime 4 set the story back to the era of The Three Kingdoms.Sanoku Hime 4 Changed all of the heroes' appearances into beautiful female warriors. In this fantasy Three Kingdom troubled times, players will experience the new story developed from the “Romance of the Three Kingdoms”. On one hand, players can map out the best strategies to fight for power. On the other hand, players can also start a love relationship with beautiful female warriors. You will choose your future, guide your country, and fall in love.



The game has two main parts:
Soldiers and warriors recruitment, expanding power as a goal are SLG part of the game。
The conversation with characters, the process of taking over the world as a goal with beautiful girls are the second parts.

How the game proceeds:
You will first experience reading and conversation with characters. You will get inside the story, develop relationships.
When it comes to action, the game will be divided into 4 seasons, one season as one round. Each round contains 5 phases: Update, Army preparation, Strategy, Operation, Battle.



Each phase you will manage your territory, and prepare for battle.
Update phase：This is an important phase. You can see main events happening, such as natural disasters and income displays or volunteers. You can gain the CP you need to move the troops.

Army Preparation phase : This is the phase that you choose a warlord and soldiers. You can hire new warlords or move yours from one castle to another. Manage your CP and command your troops.

Strategy phase : It’s the phase that you strengthen your national power. Your income increases when you enhance your country. You can recruit more soldiers, build stronger walls around your castle. Enjoy the fun of building structures. And having interesting conversation with your military commanders

Operation phase : It’s a phase where you choose to go in or out, cutting off enemies power. In this phase you will know every status. Making sure you make wise decision.

Battle phase : This is where you order to strike and engage in battle. Find out the best warlord combo to win.



In Sanoku Hime 4~Tenka Ryouran Tenmei no Koi Emaki. The new character “Xiaoren '' was released. Even though his character is ordinary, but with unbelievable power, he will write a new Sangokuhime with 61 other characters.

Background story

What kind of future will his existence bring to this chaotic world eventually? This will rely on the player's discovery.

1830160.name: Reloader: subject_alpha
1830160.about_the_game:
Reloader: subject_alpha is a tactical action game built around the core concept of “Bullet Counting · Reload Action.”
You play as an agent with legendary marksmanship who has lost all memory of how to reload, deployed into intense close-quarters combat (CQB) scenarios.

In this game, accuracy is not what keeps you alive.
Inserting magazines, racking the slide, checking the chamber, remembering your remaining rounds, and choosing the right moment to reload — the tension begins not with the trigger, but with the reload.

Inspired by gun action films and the Greatest indie game Receiver, the game combines realistic firearm manipulation with cinematic intensity.

Features

  • Full Manual Firearm Operation

    Manually perform every step: insert magazines, rack the slide, and chamber a round yourself.

  • Weapon Reliability System

    Low-condition firearms can malfunction unexpectedly. Identify the failure type and execute the correct clearance procedure under pressure.

  • True Bullet Counting

    No HUD will tell you how many rounds remain. Keep track mentally and decide when to reload.

  • Realistic Stopping Power

    Combat is built around practical ballistic impact and lethality rather than exaggerated health systems, encouraging tactical engagement.

  • Retro × Futuristic Visual Style

    A distinctive aesthetic that blends detailed pixel art characters with dynamic, modern lighting effects.

Synopsis

You were a legendary agent who fell into a coma after an unexpected accident. Fortunately, you regained consciousness due to the efforts of the doctors. In the process, the trauma left you without most of your memories. All that is left are your shooting and aiming skills.

There are still many tasks left that only a legendary agent can solve. Reclaim your memory and skills by completing countless missions!

1830170.name: Cosmic Security
1830170.about_the_game:
This game is a puzzle game where you aim to reach the goal by disarming the security devices placed in the field. The security devices include three colors of magic flares and two types of barriers. Magic flares can be extinguished by using orbs of the same color. The barriers can be removed by stepping on the witches on the floor. If you use the wrong order when using the orb to remove the magic flare, you may get stuck. The key to the game is to know where to use the orbs.

There is no violence or tragic scenes in this game. It's a refreshing dip for the mind tired of adventure and survival in other games. Enjoy a relaxing time while listening to the fantastic background music!

Story
Schwarz Dohkai, a doctor of space engineering, was working on a warp engine. Just as he was about to complete the project, a portal suddenly appeared in his laboratory.Dohkai is sucked into the portal and is transported to another world. He found himself in the center of a certain kingdom. Then a voice echoed in his head.
"You have to get out of there. I'll be waiting for you outside the kingdom."
There was nothing Dohkai could do about it, he had to follow the voice.

Dohkai has unexpectedly become a trespasser in another world.
Will he be able to break through the tightly-laid security system and return to his world?

1830180.name: Louny Balloony
1830180.about_the_game:
Louny Balloony is a high-flying side-scrolling platforming adventure! Take control of a young balloonist-in-training as you leap, bound, and flutter your way across a variety of environments navigating against various obstacles and enemies that stand in your way! Collect balloons and feathers you find on your journey to bolster your flying abilities in order to overcome increasingly challenging, yet also increasingly enchanting, levels!

***FEATURES***

  • Vibrant, unique levels -- Multiple levels, each containing a unique environment, music, and obstacles!
  • Forgiving gameplay -- A non-traditional hitpoint system allows you keep playing no matter how often you're hit. As long as you can stay in the air, you can't lose!
  • Hidden treasures -- Secret collectables can be found by exploring! Find special balloons to access challenge stages in order to find even more exclusive treasures!
  • Surprises abound -- Beware a variety of different threats hidden throughout the skies including powerful boss enemies that challenge your reflexes and puzzle-solving capabilities!

1830210.name: The Tribulation Entanglement
1830210.about_the_game:
An extinction event rendered a life-bearing planet to still silence. Millennia later, deep beneath the planet's surface something is stirring....







Born into a nightmarish fever dream, the Entangled One must fight its way through diverse, visually striking environments from a blasted wasteland beneath an eternal eclipse, to mutant filled crevices, and the putrid guts of the underworld.



Not all things that are strange are hostile...





And yet the Entangled One must slay to survive...



Motivated by survival. Pulled ever forward by something beyond understanding. The Entangled One must slay the godlike Primordials to reach the source of it all: The Primordial Mass....



Disclaimer: The Tribulation Entanglement is an artistic visual representation of the developer's struggle with chronic pain, health issues, and disabilities. Player's discretion is advised.

Gameplay Features:

  • Experience a strange horrific world unlike any other.
  • Overcome levels filled with challenging combat and platforming.
  • 25+ insane enemy types to engage in combat.

  • A unique and vibrant grayscale visual aesthetic.

1830240.name: Slums of Tetsoidea
1830240.about_the_game:
Slums of Tetsoidea is an RPG about 4 women who need each others aid to save the world from a few evil plots. It is about 2-4 hours long, and has an interesting turn based combat system where you need
to plan out your close and long ranged attacks in advance. You need to get out of the slums and return the main character to her home village. It's a turn based RPG with over 50 maps to explore, a traditional JRPG game in a sci-fi setting.

1830260.name: Mystical Riddles: Snowy Peak Hotel Collector's Edition

Your friend, journalist Kate Turner, has an important task: she is to solve the mysteries of the Snowy Peak hotel. Missing guests, terrified staff, ghosts, a suspicious hotel owner… Something isn’t right. The thing is that no one likes curious journalists, especially if they have something to hide. Kate goes missing. You are to find your friend and reveal the secrets of the haunted hotel along the way. Unfortunately, the truth is hidden somewhere beyond this world, so you may need all your knowledge of the supernatural. Are you sure you can handle this? Then… What are you waiting for?

Face the world of the unknown!

1830270.name: Vanildo's Journey
1830270.about_the_game:
Vanildo's Journey is a playful adventure game, focused on humorous characters, comic events and exploration elements with touches of suspense and mystery. The game tells a story full of twists, unique and charismatic characters, secrets hidden by the map and a simple and intuitive turn-based combat.

In addition to offering a casual and pleasant environment, RPG brings a rewarding game style for curious players who seek to explore everything and "replay" more than once, seeking to make different choices and paths, and may even find different endings in the same scene. Players must enter with a clean and open mind, looking for a dynamic and pleasant game, thus, they will achieve a satisfying experience that mixes gallows humor with a tense and dismal environment.

1830280.name: Super Company
1830280.about_the_game:
Super Company is a strategic management game that simulates the development of enterprises. You will play an entrepreneur in the 1990s, running your own company in a poor small town, producing all kinds of goods needed by small town residents, from food to cars; It can also build houses and schools to provide residential and educational services for citizens; It can also carry out international trade through ports and earn foreign exchange for industrial upgrading. You should choose appropriate development strategies, plan various development routes, and strive to develop the company into a super enterprise with extensive business.

Earn Your First Pot Of Gold



You will start from agriculture, establish a planting farm or a breeding farm, and sell milk, fruit and meat to small town residents. You will get the first cash income; Some raw materials, such as leather, corn, cotton and so on, cannot be sold directly to small town residents. You can export them through the port, and you will get the first foreign exchange income; Of course, you can also set up various factories and process them into food, clothing, etc. required by the residents of the factories.

Diversified Operation



Your goal is to develop the company into a super enterprise, so diversification is essential.

There will be 9 types of subsidiaries in the game, including agriculture, food industry, mining industry, energy and chemical industry, clothing industry, household goods industry, electronics industry, automobile industry and real estate industry.

There will be 88 kinds of goods, 43 kinds of consumer goods needed by small town residents, 45 kinds of raw materials and semi-finished products in the game.

Multiple Development Strategies



How do you decide the development priorities of different subsidiaries?

How do you plan the transportation route between factories?

How do you spend every foreign exchange income? Buy patents to develop new industries or train more highly educated talents to improve factory efficiency?

The population of a small town will affect the demand for goods. How will you attract more people? Can we produce enough goods? Or reduce the rent?

Do you have the potential to be an excellent entrepreneur? Can the company succeed under your leadership? Come and have a try!!!

1830290.name: Fall of an Empire
1830290.about_the_game:
The empire is dying. You’ve seized the throne. Survival is victory. Seize control of an ailing empire, clinging to echoes of its former glory. Unlike traditional grand strategy games of expansion and conquest, Fall of an Empire challenges you to manage an empire on the brink of collapse. Face invading barbarian hordes, manage internal revolts, and engage in relentless political intrigue.

Your rule will not last forever. How long can you defy history and halt its decline?

Command an Empire in Decline

You have seized power in a violent coup, crowning yourself Emperor of a crumbling realm. Millions await your orders, but your legions are stretched thin, your coffers are empty, and your provinces are rife with unrest. 

It is up to you to defy history and extend the life of your empire through iron will, cunning politics, and brilliant strategy.

Master Treacherous Politics & Intrigue

Manage a living world filled with unique, simulated characters—senators, generals, governors, and spies. Each character has their own evolving traits, personal ambitions, and loyalties.

1830700.name: ScreenPlay CCG
1830700.about_the_game:
A comedy-fueled collectible card game where movie tropes come to life—and run the studio too.

ScreenPlay CCG is a digital card game set in a delightfully absurd universe where the characters from your favorite genres aren’t just starring in films—they’re the ones calling the shots. Literally. These eccentric directors produce, direct, and even sabotage each other’s blockbusters in the most chaotic filmmaking process ever committed to cardboard… or, well, digital cardboard.

Build decks using genre-savvy characters, absurd plot twists, and iconic film tropes to outwit your rivals in a game that rewards strategy, timing, and a healthy appreciation for how ridiculous cinema can be.

🎞 CCG Meets Fighting Game Strategy

Outthink, outplay, out-direct.

Unlike traditional CCGs that rely on slow turns and predictable patterns, ScreenPlay borrows from fighting game mechanics. You and your opponent plan your moves at the same time, then watch the result unfold like you’re watching a classic masterpiece in the making. Whether you’re pulling off a perfect dodge, reading an attack two scenes ahead, or throwing down a plot twist that makes everything go off the rails, victory comes from reading your opponent as much as your deck.

Want to bluff your way through a thriller? Go full ham in a melodrama? You can do that. This is a game of mind games and movie magic.

⏱ Simultaneous Turns

No waiting, no stalling—just pure, unpredictable chaos.

In ScreenPlay, both players secretly script their scenes (i.e., their turns) in advance. Once you've locked in your decisions, the game cuts straight to the action, playing both turns out simultaneously. The result? A fast-paced, brainy experience where timing and prediction are everything—and there's no room to pause for popcorn.

Every scene is a gamble. Did your Horror Lead strike when your opponent adventurously dodged? Did they perform a dramatic scene while you expected an action movie-style assault? You won’t know until the camera rolls.

🏆 Win by Telling a Better Story

Victory isn’t about HP bars—it’s about completing your character arcs .

Every Lead character has a distinct narrative journey. Over the course of a match, you’ll earn Narrative Points by playing synergistic cards and making smart choices. Complete the arcs of any two of your three Leads, and you win the game. No explosions required—though those help too.

This mechanic rewards clever deck construction, genre mastery, and good ol’ fashioned timing. It’s a game of stories within a story, where every match feels like a mini movie—even if the script makes no sense and half the cast is mysteriously missing in act two.

Just remember: knowing your opponent’s Leads and their story goals can help you sabotage their arcs before they reach their big finale.

🎭 Lead the Cast with Genre-Bending Characters

With over 22 unique Leads available at launch and many more in development, ScreenPlay is packed with genre-hopping personalities ready for the spotlight.

Each Lead comes from a different cinematic tradition and brings a signature set of abilities and cards. Whether you're leaning into the brooding mystery of Richard Spade, the razor-sharp wit of Roast Comic Frog, the righteous vengeance of Maximus, or the pure chaos of the Illuminati Lizard, every character changes how you build your deck and approach the game.

And with the ability to mix and match any three Leads, the combinations are practically limitless—well, not actually limitless, this is still an indie game. But you get the idea.

📚 Every Game is Its Own Movie

Deckbuilding isn't just strategy—it's screenwriting.

You’ll start each game by choosing three Leads and constructing a 40-card deck tailored to their unique arcs. Some cards represent their strengths. Others exploit genre clichés or set up over-the-top payoffs. Want to lean into a character’s Plot Armor? Go for it. Here, “lazy writing” is just another path to brilliance.

The result is a game where every match feels like a short film that spirals out of control in the best possible way. Build tension. Subvert expectations. And maybe—just maybe—pull off a finale worthy of a standing ovation.

🎬 Solo Play for Aspiring Auteurs

Not ready for the festival circuit? No problem.

Start off with a guided tutorial and a pre-built deck to ease you into the chaotic world of ScreenPlay. Then, grow your collection by completing daily and weekly challenges, or by taking on boss bots in a rotating lineup of single-player game modes. There’s always something new to do—even if your cast is constantly forgetting their lines.

Future updates will bring full-blown movie campaign modes, letting you explore the bizarre backstories, rivalries, and plot holes of your favorite Leads. Just pray they don’t go on strike before then. The devs writing the scripts themselves? Terrifying.

🌐 Multiplayer Mayhem

Challenge filmmakers around the world in a battle for box office supremacy.

Jump into competitive ladder matches against players of your skill level or explore alternate multiplayer formats for chaotic genre mashups. Want to make a romantic horror musical with a sci-fi twist and a noir detective lead? That’s not just possible—it’s encouraged.

Show off your deckbuilding brilliance, master the meta, or just enjoy the ride. Because in ScreenPlay, even the worst movie can still win Best Picture if you play your cards right.

Oh, and don’t forget to join the community on Discord—weekly tournaments, bonus prizes, and the occasional pun war await.

🧰 Craft Your Own Blockbuster

Build your collection your way—whether through grind or glamour.

Earn cards by completing missions, opening booster packs, or climbing the competitive ladder. Got extras? Use the in-game crafting system to recycle duplicates into the cards you actually want.

Feeling like a silver spoon-fed producer? You can also buy cards directly. We get it—not everyone wants to hustle in the editing bay. No judgment (well, maybe a little).

🎬 Expansions, Sequels & Spin-Offs

New content, every quarter. New drama, every time.

Every three months, ScreenPlay gets a fresh injection of content—new Leads, new cards, new movies, and new ways to play. These expansions keep the meta fresh and the production mayhem rolling, giving you endless ways to reinvent your cinematic masterpieces.

It’s like rebooting your favorite franchise, only on purpose. And with fewer angry fans.

🎤 Why ScreenPlay CCG Stands Out

  • 🤺 Simultaneous turns for fast-paced, mind-game-rich strategy

  • 🎭 Over 22 Lead characters across a wild spectrum of movie genres

  • 📚 Story arc-based win conditions for narrative-driven gameplay

  • 🧠 Deep deckbuilding with real strategic variety

  • 🎮 Single-player and multiplayer modes with evolving content

  • 😂 A comedic, self-aware tone that softens the sting of even the most dramatic defeats

So—ready to make your directorial debut?

ScreenPlay CCG is your all-access pass to a world where genres collide, characters clash, and every match is a chance to create the worst great movie ever made.

1830980.name: VRkanoid - Brick Breaking Game
1830980.about_the_game:
In this game you have the opportunity to swing your racket to your heart's content, hit the ball with all your might, and smash the tiles on the walls to pieces. Modest but pleasant graphics in a futuristic style are waiting for you. And you will definitely like the physics of interaction between rackets and balls!

Several dozen different levels are waiting for you. Each of them gives you a goal, for example:
- destroy all bricks
- don't miss too many balls

When you destroy a brick, you have a chance to knock some bonus out of it. For example:
- extra ball
- a protective field that will not allow you to lose the ball
- changed direction of gravity (you will never see this in real life)
- turning your ball into a fireball
- time dilation (slowmo)

For a variety of play, you can change the appearance of your ball and rackets. You will experience very different sensations when playing with different racquets. This is not just a change in visual appearance, but a change in the gaming experience.

In addition, the game has perks. Some perks just make your life easier, for example:
- racket in the second hand
- extra ball at the start
- auto-destruction of the last brick
And some radically change the game, for example:
- complete disabling of gravity
- disable bonuses

Afterword from the creator of the game:
I believe that every game device should have its own brick breaking game. This rule has been true since the days of the zx spectrum, the NES, SNES and the first IBM personal computers. New virtual reality technology should be no different. But I have not found a suitable VR game in this genre that I would like. So I decided to make it myself. And I think I did it. This simple game with uncomplicated but addictive gameplay will help you stretch, turn off all thoughts and have a good rest.

Our Goal and Road Map of Updates: (AD2022.10.6)

Four Classes

  • Axeman (Design Progress: 70%)
    Primary class, which guides players through basic mechanics and concepts that includes:
    Basic attack: Different from casting card spells.
    Summon elements: Different from minions in MTG and Hearthstone, elements in our game die after attacking once.
    Weapon: Triggers special effects when launching basic attacks.
    Shield: Triggers special effects when Hero’s armor is attacked.
    Besides, details of the design progress of Axeman: Elemental Troop (90%), Elemental Combo (90%), Pure Attacker (60%)
  • Archer (Design Progress: 40%)
    Equipped with an op “Artifact”, the Quiver, at the beginning of the game, which reduces the cost of cards in your hand every turn. Therefore, for Archer, the cost of cards equals their CD.
    This design will change the gaming experience players will have when playing as the Archer.
    Besides, details of the design progress of Archer: Combo Main (40%), Cards Accumulating (40%)
  • Wizard (Primary Design Phase)
    The energy system of Wizard is different from that of the other classes—Wizard needs to obtain mana of three colors by using “Mana Cards” first and then he can use cards of the corresponding color.
  • Swordsman (Primary Design Phase)
    Swordsman is an excellent commander and can enroll NPCs that are willing to follow him.

General System

The core system of the game is basically finished. There are other systems that have been listed:
  • Difficulty
    Higher Difficulty levels will be unlocked after playthroughs under lower ones. Besides, the current Difficulty level is a bit too low so we'll adjust it.
  • Blessings
    A growth system that improves characters outside of battles.

Others

More enemies, artifacts, equipment, and items.

Planning But No Guarantee

1831320.name: Rescue Team: Power Eaters

The Rescue Team is on standby when it starts receiving reports of strange phenomenon taking place around the globe. As you tackle this exhilarating quest, you'll plan out the best path through each level and the race to gather resources, repair damage, save victims and defeat an ever-growing variety of bizarre robots.

1831350.name: Carta Marina
1831350.about_the_game:
Carta Marina is a map of Scandinavia drawn by the Swedish pastor Olaus Magnus (1490-1557).

We are starting an attempt to reconstruct this map and turn it into a simulation game.
The objective of the game is to complete the map by adventuring through the nine parts of the Carta Marina.
All the information in the game is based on the 16th century, so you will be able to learn the values of Scandinavia at that time.

StoryThe main character is staring at a large map in a university laboratory.
Carta Marina" is a mysterious map that exists in this world. The existence of the map itself has been questioned for many years, but recently one of the nine maps has been discovered.
As I looked at the map, a fog gradually began to roll in. I blinked...
The scene in the map of Carta Marina was spread out in front of me.

The protagonist realizes that the number of maps in reality increases as the number of areas explored in Carta Marina increases.
The protagonist enters the map again and again, sometimes expanding the area of exploration.
Complete the complete map with 9 pieces of the real Carta Marina by your own hands.

Objective of the gameThe objective of the player is to go back and forth between the world of Carta Marina and reality, and make a complete map of Carta Marina appear in reality.

As you explore the map (ships on the sea, horses on the land), the area of the map, which is only one map in reality, will expand.
When you get stuck in the 16th century, you will be presented with a solution to your problem, and when you implement the solution, the obstacle will be removed and you will be able to go to a new area to explore.
All solutions are based on 16th century Scandinavian culture.

The screen changes depending on the actions taken by the player.
Not exploredThe area around your island, ship, or other location is covered by a thin fog and cannot be recognized.
However, the fog is enough to let the player know that something is out there, which stimulates the player's desire to explore.

After the searchThe map is clearly displayed.
On the map, there are several objects that can be recorded in the picture book by examining them.
When you click on an object that has already been recorded in the book, the details of the object will be displayed, and your book will be filled up.


We are making this game in honor of Olaus Magnus, who left us a wonderful map and book.

1831370.name: PolyShot
1831370.about_the_game:
PolyShot takes place between two opposing teams. E-Girls group was born as anti-male groups came together. This cute but wild girl group aims to take over the BoyZ clan and create chaos across Polylandia to enforce their will. The Boys Government formed the specially trained Anti-Girls team, BoyZ, to thwart the activities of violent groups called E-Girls and destroy the group. Take your place in the relentless and fun fight between these two teams in PolyShot.

Players fight in PvP matches dominated by score. There are a maximum of 8 players on each side.

1831400.name: CBS: Desolation
1831400.about_the_game:
Build, defend your sanctum, gather resources and survive in this post apocalyptic simulated survival game.

Plot

Just as you finally find a means to survive, you are enveloped by the events of the disasters and city's champions and villains' destructive conflicts threatening your very presence. Join the descendants of the dogmatic in defense of the local area against wicked and the vile. This may take much more than you might think, both within and outside your sanctum.

Game Features:

  • Build your sanctum from scratch, start with little water and other resources

  • Gather resources, run scouting and otherwise expeditions to nearing zones

  • Build, upgrade your shelter, house migrating survivors of the disasters

  • Build an inventory, upgrade and enhance your population

  • Select one of 4 paragon types, bringing bonuses to your settlement

  • House select paragons to further upgrade your settlement and enhance your population for further success

  • Perform and defend raids in simulated single-player environment

  • Perform other encounters and trade with nearing settlements

  • Defend and dominate against ai world settlements

  • Play through a refined story that composes your own settlement

  • Gather inventory from relic hunts, equip your settlers with them.

  • Skirmish through your best settlement possible by the 100th day.

1831410.name: Poly Vita
1831410.about_the_game:
Poly Vita is a thought-provoking isometric puzzle game with turn-based elements, that takes you on a journey through various worlds. The game is about a lost wanderer named Maya, who has been stuck inside her dreams for a long time in search of the missing fragments of her soul. Throughout the game, you will help Maya restore the pieces of her soul, allowing her to finally awaken. If you love challenging puzzle games then Poly Vita is a game for you! At the same time, the games relaxing atmosphere with no timers means you can take your time to solve each puzzle.

Gameplay

The gameplay consists of picking up and placing tiles one by one, in available spaces, to form pathways for Maya to walk on. A pathway must connect the tile Maya is standing on to a walkable node. Once a valid pathway is made, Maya will be able to walk to the connected node. In each level, you will need to get Maya to collect each of her soul fragments. Once they're collected, the light in her home will turn on, allowing you to complete the level. Build a final pathway home and the level will be complete!

As the game progresses, you will need carefully plan out complex pathways while avoiding dangerous obstacles. Certain gameplay elements are turn-based, such as Spiders, that move one tile over every time Maya makes a move, blocking certain pathways. Enjoy the increasingly difficult level progression of Poly Vita, and see if you can solve all of the 30 lovingly crafted puzzles.


Can you solve all of Poly Vita's challenges and help Maya awaken?

◆ 30 Beautifully Designed Levels
◆ Mind-Bending Puzzles
◆ Unique Puzzle Mechanics
◆ Original Soundtrack
◆ A Game Crafted With Love By 1 Person

1831460.name: Hyper Rush

  • Compete with other players as you race against their ghosts: see how you fare against the competition and learn from the paths they take. Secure the top spots to increase your HYPER RANK. 

  • Optimize your times across dozens of multi-layered, multi-pathed, replayable tracks, while earning medals to unlock new leagues, Ballers, and abilities. Watch replays of leaderboard champions to learn their strats.

  • Create and develop clans: cooperate with other players, post buildings on a closed clan exhibition and participate in battles with your clan members;
  • Freedom of tactics in battle: Act by any means, the main thing is to destroy enemies!

1831530.name: PC Creator - PC Building Simulator
1831530.about_the_game:
PC Creator is a simulator game, where you can try yourself as a PC builder!
Complete different PC building and PC repair orders to upgrade your business: build a PC from nothing, install popular OS, upgrade computers, install different programs and games, fix PC parts, and much more.
In addition to this, you have a special opportunity to create your mining farm to mine the cryptocurrency and to set up your own computer shop.

User-friendly interface
Despite the fact that our gaming setup has a lot of functions, we made our best to develop a stylish, modern, and comfortable interface for managing all game's processes:
★ animated controls
★ tip pop-ups
★ user-friendly and plain positioning of buttons

All, mentioned above, you can see in the virtual world of the PC Creator!

Build your PC from zero
You can build the PC of your dream in our game. In the shop, you can choose and buy a motherboard, a processor, a video card and other parts. Then you have to install the operating system, drivers, favorite programs, and games. And all these you can do in one game!

Wide choice of accessories
There are a lot of modern PC parts in the game: motherboards, processors, video cards (PS express, etc.), random access memory, power units for all tastes, CPU, GPU. Moreover, you can boost these parts to the top and enjoy their productivity even more.

How to improve your repair service center
By finishing clients' orders, you receive the experience points and the virtual coins. You can purchase a new room for your service center with earned money. Moreover, there is an opportunity to replace the equipment with a more powerful and modern one.

Learn how to improve your PC
You will learn how to fix up personal computers while playing our game, replacing or repairing parts with better ones. In addition to this, you will notice that not all parts comply with other ones of your PC. Our simulator will teach you, how to choose details correctly, in case to make the most of your computer for gamers, stores, or individual orders. You'll have to make different construction sets to improve your professional skills!

Install popular operating systems
PC Creator gives you an opportunity to install virtual operating system simulations: Linux, macOS, Windows. The process of installing is very close to realistic, so it is a good time to learn how to install or fix different OS.

Apps Simulation
There is the built-in PC simulator, with help of which you can install different programs, apps, games and test them without leaving the game. Play your favorite games right here! What could be better?

Community
Things don't work out? Ask for some advice in the official chat of the game in discord, where players share their knowledge, experience and just communicate with each other on different topics. There are contests and promotions there too. You will be pleasantly surprised because the job of our community is to make simulator games better!

1831540.name: USS Tempest: Spaceship Simulator

In the first-person single-player game USS Tempest: Spaceship Simulator you take a journey through the stars and experience the ultimate mission of leading the fate of the spaceship and the crew. 1831550.name: Aim God

1831560.name: Sprite Hunter

1831580.name: Bathtime Toys
1831580.about_the_game:
Bathtime Toys is a casual playground for kids, that sparks imagination and creative gameplay. Did you ever wonder how children have the power to bring their toys to life?



Assemble simple, but cute 3d puzzle toys, and express yourself by coloring them. Drop them in your custom decorated bathtub, and let the fun begin!

Explore them all, and invent infinite funny challenges, in a way that only kids can do!

1831610.name: ASTRAL - Dream Or Reality
1831610.about_the_game:
Experience the ultimate survival horror adventure with ASTRAL - Dream Or Reality! Step into the shoes of Adam and immerse yourself in a world full of puzzles and dangers.



Survive in a world teeming with obstacles and perils by not only managing your stamina but also keeping an eye on your psyche.

Prepare yourself for a gripping narrative that will keep you captivated until the end.
As Adam, you will start with an ordinary evening that quickly turns into a true horror trip.
Will you uncover the truth and solve the mystery surrounding Kara and the enigmatic house, or will you venture down the wrong path, sealing your own fate?

Do you dare to embark on this adventure?

1831650.name: Doggo

Follow Doggo on his quest to find his Human so he can finally go back to sleep.
In this light-hearted platforming adventure you will play as "Doggo", a Jack Russel whose only passion in life is to eat and sleep.
Doggo's life gets completely turned upside down when his "Human" misteriously disappears.

1831670.name: Eldorado FPS
1831670.about_the_game:
Welcome to the exhilarating world of "Eldorado FPS," where the pulse of first-person shooter excitement meets endless possibilities for strategy and competition. Designed for those who thrive in the heat of battle, Eldorado FPS is a playground for both casual players and hardcore FPS enthusiasts.



Diverse Game Modes for Every Play Style:
Eldorado FPS isn’t just a game; it’s a collection of thrilling experiences. Jump into Gun Mode for weapon-centric gameplay, where your choice of arms shapes your strategy. Test your tactical acumen in Capture the Flag and dominate the map to claim victory. For players who crave the classic FPS experience, Deathmatch and Team Deathmatch offer intense, fast-paced action.

Zombie Survival - A Fight for Existence:
But the heart-pounding excitement doesn't stop there. Our Zombie Survival Mode is a standout feature where horror meets heroism. Team up with friends or brave it alone as you face off against hordes of relentless zombies. Your survival will depend not only on your shooting skills but also on your ability to adapt and strategize under pressure.



Personalized Loadouts and Customization:
Eldorado FPS takes customization to new heights. Personalize your gameplay with an extensive loadout system. Choose from a vast arsenal of guns, each with unique attributes and customizable skins. Adapt your character's appearance and role, making every match a unique expression of your style and strategy.

Global Leaderboard - A Stage for the Elite:
For those who relish competition, the global leaderboard awaits. Here, every match, every kill, and every tactical decision can catapult you to fame. See where you stand among the world's best, strive for improvement, and etch your name in the annals of Eldorado FPS history.

A Community of Passionate Gamers:
Eldorado FPS is more than a game – it's a community. Join players from around the globe in a vibrant, supportive environment. Share strategies, form teams, or simply enjoy the camaraderie that comes with shared battles and victories.



Regular Updates and Engaging Events:
We're committed to keeping Eldorado FPS fresh and exciting. Regular updates bring new content, features, and tweaks based on community feedback. Engaging events offer unique challenges and rewards, keeping the gameplay experience dynamic and rewarding.

Are you ready to embark on this adrenaline-fueled adventure? Eldorado FPS is not just a game; it’s a battle, a community, a test of skill and strategy. Join us in this ever-evolving journey and carve your path to glory.

1831700.name: Tin Hearts
1831700.about_the_game:
Embark on a series of lemmings-like puzzles to relive the captivating and emotional story of a genius inventor, Albert J. Butterworth, whilst guiding a troop of tin soldiers to reach their goal. Critically acclaimed for its moving narrative, refined puzzle design, and immersive atmosphere, Tin Hearts is a narrative puzzle adventure where the ghosts of the past emerge to tell a resonating tale of family, love, and compromise.

Spanning across four distinctive acts with 50+ puzzles masterfully woven throughout a grand Victorian home, steadily uncover a variety of whimsical inventions with unique abilities to provide a safe route of passage for the tin soldiers to travel. From the meticulous garden, where the soldiers can bounce, glide and soar to their goal, or the inventor’s basement filled with the heights of innovation and technology, each location has an abundance of treasured memories, whilst there are some that would rather be forgotten.

In a tragic fable which will see Albert overwhelmed by sorrow and heartache, discover what brilliant minds do when the love for life, and the love for invention, are threatened by life itself.

Set out on an immersive adventure through 50+ lemmings-like puzzles which constantly evolve as you progress. Uncover new routes to your destination each time you play, with multiple ways to solve the intricate puzzles.

In a multi-layered and heartfelt narrative, told through treasured memories, photographs and hand-written letters, there is much to be uncovered in Tin Hearts. Witness the delicate balance of family with the persistence of work and the exploitative nature of the Guild of Toy Makers as you wander through Alberts life.

Explore the world through the perspective of the independent and fully controllable Mr Soldier, a Tin Soldier who is able to break rank and scout out the best way to progress, whilst bringing with him an additional layer of discovery throughout the adventure.

Unlock the power to control a variety of ground-breaking inventions steadily introduced throughout the game. Manoeuvre toy cannons, trampoline drums, and balloon inflating machines before taking on the electrifying vigour of the power glove, a visionary invention which is truly ahead of its time.

Pause, fast-forward and rewind time to observe and change the outcome of your actions. With the offer of hints readily available, Tin Hearts provides an accessible and relaxing puzzle-solving experience to complement your journey.

Take your time working through the relaxing puzzles whilst indulging in the poignant soundtrack from award-winning composer Matthew Chastney, whose credits include trailers for ‘JOKER’, 'Chernobyl', and 'Bridgerton'.

Tin Hearts is brought to life by former members of the exceptionally talented Lionhead Studios development team, responsible for the critically acclaimed Fable series.

Experience the VR version of the game, designed exclusively from the ground up for virtual reality platforms, where players can fully immerse themselves in the beautiful world of Tin Hearts. Directly control, touch and feel the game’s mechanics, or physically move closer to take a look at the stunning environments and charming toys.

1831800.name: Grief like a stray dog
1831800.about_the_game:
«Grief like a stray dog» is a short interactive play about a young postwoman in a tight-knit rural community. In the outside world, WW2 rages at its apex. Nadia is thirteen. She delivers papers, letters. And death notifications to families of those killed in action.

Nadia’s character is based on the author’s grandmother. Inspired by tales of a childhood spent in a village near Rzhev, not far from one of the most brutal battlefields of the Eastern Front, most of the character arcs and plot points are based on war stories told by older relatives and locals; many letters are real.

The main visual inspirations for the game were kid’s drawings, neo-expressionism, Russian lubok art and Soviet book illustration

«Grief like a stray dog» is a meditation on war, community and human fate — part documentary, part Russian folk tale.

You are expected:

  • A visual novel with elements of an adventure game.

  • A rich and touching story based on memories and Russian folk tales.

Many Chess Worlds for You to Explore!

Take a look at some of the Chessarama games:

In Dragon Slayer, you need to push your pawn to the end of a path in order to kill the mighty dragon. But it will not be that easy! The dragon attacks the board every time the pawn moves and every undefended piece will die.



In Lady Ronin, Chess meets Sokoban. You play with a Ronin (a chess queen) and you
need to eliminate the other pieces in order to get close to the Shogun and kill it. Pieces move like in chess, but push each other like in sokoban.

1831870.name: The Hotel
1831870.about_the_game:
The Hotel - is a psychological horror thriller in which the player will have to face the evil living in a lonely hotel. But more importantly, you will have to decide what this evil is to you. Maybe it is just something to run and hide from, or maybe the nature of this evil is deeper than it seems at first glance.

Synopsis
The darkness.. the hopeless darkness seemed like an eternity to him. But now it was dissipating.The man was in a room in an unknown hotel. The room had no windows, and the closed door of the room separated him from the rest of the world.Why is he here, how long has he been here? Millions of questions create billions of assumptions. But the man whose prison has become a small hotel room doesn't need to know the answers. Because even knowing the answer to each of his questions, he can't change anything. A lonely man was waiting, not knowing what, in an unknown hotel room... suddenly there was a knock on the door.

About gameplay:
- Stress and Health
Your character can go insane. A character's mental health depends on the stress he experiences. A character is stressed every time something paranormal happens. The more stressed the character is, the faster the character will go insane. Don't let this happen.
- Every failure carries consequences
Each of your failures, makes the inhabitant of the hotel stronger, and eventually, they can lead to permanent death.
- The Hotel
The hotel is constantly changing. Any action or movement of the camera, can cause the door through which you came to turn into a wall, and the place where a moment ago was a dead end, becomes a new path.
- A questionnaire for each hotel guest
Each guest of our hotel is invited to take a short questionnaire, in order to find an individual approach to everyone. Throughout the game, you will be asked to take a short survey. Should your answers be answered by the hotel, will your answers be honest, or should you refuse to answer? Everyone will have to make a decision.
- The One Who Leads You
An enigmatic observer, will communicate and comment on the player's actions with messages. Who is he, is he worth trusting, and what does he want?

- Message from the author:
Hello, my name is Konstantin and I'm the developer of The Hotel game. I want to say thank you to each of you for taking the time to play this game, this is my first experience and for me it is a very important project. Your opinions on it are very important to me too, each one of you. This is the only way for me to understand how good the project is and whether I need to do it further, and it will allow me to consider mistakes and become a better writer of games. For this reason, I would like to ask you to leave your feedback, even a small one, I really want to know your opinion. Thank you :)

1832050.name: All Quiet Roads
1832050.about_the_game:
Build roads between various neighborhoods. Congested roads turn amber and then red as traffic slows down. Build more roads. Add cloverleafs, ferries, bridges, and tunnels, getting all your vehicular traffic to where it needs to go.

The game begins in London. At the commencement of each city there are only a few neighborhoods on the map. You get to decide where to place roads to connect the neighborhoods. Periodically, each neighborhood will spawn vehicles that need to travel to other neighborhoods. As you connect roads between unique neighborhoods the vehicles will transit along your roads to reach their destinations. Vehicles will remain parked in their original neighborhood until a route exists to their desired destination.

Over time more neighborhoods will automatically appear on the map. Each neighborhood has an associated type of vehicle that it attracts. Vehicles spawning in other neighborhoods will seek the neighborhood of their destination type. You must add roads to keep the neighborhoods connected. Vehicles will use the roads autonomously when they are available. Roads that have too much traffic will slow down, and visually change to red when the traffic stops. Vehicles will try to route around traffic jams. It often makes sense for you to build multiple roadways so that vehicles can find their ways around traffic jams.

Cloverleafs can be used to upgrade intersections. A clover leaf allows traffic on one road to pass over traffic on another road instead of getting stuck waiting for the intersection to become empty. Various other upgrades are useful as well.

  • Cloverleaf -- reduces the congestion at an intersection.

  • Bridge -- allows a road to cross over water.

  • Tunnel -- allows a road to go through a hill.

  • Ferry -- connects two remote shorelines along a shared waterway without the need for a bridge.

A vehicle trip is completed when a vehicle reaches its desired destination. Each completed trip adds to your raw score. The raw score is the count of the number of vehicle trips completed. Additionally, your All Quiet Roads score ( AQR ) updates to your current raw score only if there are no roads currently in a red warning state. Your raw score will continue accumulating but it will not become an AQR score until the moment when no roads are red. Red roads can be noisy as motorists honk their horns. All the roads are all quiet only when no roads are red.

When each city begins you have a limited number of roads, and maybe some bridges or other items as your initial inventory for that particular city. As your raw score increases you will be given additional inventory of roads. Sometimes you are given freeway pieces, which function just like roads but allow the traffic to move at a faster speed. Should you run out of inventory then you can erase that item from the map to reclaim inventory items. However, you will need to wait for any vehicles that plan to traverse the road before it is removed from the map.

A progress bar keeps track of your raw score. The progress bar fills up, and then starts over again as the raw score increases. Each time that your progress bar fills up you are given a choice between a selection of upgrades. Choose wisely based on the needs of your city. You won't get another choice until you fill the progress bar again.

While the raw score controls when you get additional inventory your real goal is to increase your AQR. The AQR is the raw score only when no roads are red. Three different achievements are possible in each city based on your AQR score.

  • AQR 527 -- this is the minimum AQR necessary for each city's Quiet Roads achievement. If no road is in a red warning state and your raw score is at least 527 you will earn this achievement. AQR 527 is also the threshold for unlocking any following city that was locked when the game first began.

  • AQR 1581 -- this is the mid level AQR for each city and unlock's the City Flourishes achievement.

  • AQR 4743 -- this is the goal achievement for each city. Once you accomplish AQR 4743 for a city your AQR score for that city will be added to the leaderboard. Each time you replay a city is another chance for you to post a higher AQR score for that city.

  • AQR 14229 -- You are truly a champion of the city and receive the highest award.

You can continue playing each city for as long as you like, or until a neighborhood runs out of parking lot space. Each neighborhood has a limit of how many vehicles can be waiting to leave the neighborhood. Vehicles will continue spawning even though other vehicles are waiting. When too many vehicles are waiting in a neighborhood it will turn amber, then red, and finally purple. Purple neighborhoods have maxed-out their parking lot space and cause the game to end. You can try again, but you'll have to start over from a zero score and a fresh city map.

From time to time tow trucks are added to your inventory. You can use a tow truck to eliminate individual vehicles on roads. Each tow truck removes one vehicle. This can be handy to temporarily unstick traffic jams and momentarily quiet the roads. Vehicles that are removed by tow truck do not add to your raw score nor your AQR.

If the next city was locked when your game began and you received the Quiet Roads achievement by having an AQR of at least 527 then you will have unlocked another city. Initially, only London is unlocked, and all other cities are locked. Here is the list of cities represented in All Quiet Roads:

  • London -- Get on the leaderboard with the "Domine Dirige Nos" achievement. (Lord guide us.)

  • New York -- The AQR 4743 goal achievement in New York is "Excelsior!"

  • Paris -- If you achieve AQR 4743 in Paris then, très bien, you have received the "Fluctuat Nec Mergitur" achievement. (Rocked by the waves but does not sink.)

  • Rio de Janeiro -- "Recte Rem Publicam Gerere" is your goal achievement. (Conduct the affairs of the public with righteousness.)

  • Seattle -- The achievement "City of Flowers" puts you on Seattle's leaderboard.

  • St Louis -- The "Gateway to the West" achievement is awarded for and AQR score of 4743.

  • Sydney -- Completing this city with AQR 4743 unlocks "I take but I surrender."

  • Tokyo -- When you reach the goal of AQR 4743 you know that in Tokyo, "Old meets new."

  • Toronto -- In the newest city your AQR 4743 achieves the city motto of "Diversity: Our Strength."

All Quiet Roads is somewhat unique in allowing players to manage traffic on roads that turn red, just like realtime maps we use on real world roads. Red roads are dangerous, because as traffic backs up it will eventually cause neighborhoods to become jammed. When the neighborhood can no longer hold any more newly spawning vehicles the game is over.

To revive the desolate Earth after a nuclear war, humans created the Poro through genetic engineering. However, despite leaving the Poro on Earth, the planet did not recover, so humanity embarked into space to find a new world.
One day, 700 years after humans had left, Rick the frog woke up from his slumber and immediately started searching for insects to satisfy his hunger.

1832170.name: RoRX
1832170.about_the_game:
Wishlist the game to help us getting visibility!

Join the official game's Discord and Social Networks.

  • Discover Rise of the Robots X, meet other Strategists and develop the community.

  • Contribute and follow the development of the game and be informed when new improvements are made.

  • Share your ideas, give your opinion, and vote for artistic and gameplay elements.

  • Participate in contests and design with the team content that we will add to the game.

About this game

Rise of the Robots X combines elements from deck builders, hex-based board games, 4X, strategy and tactical video games, to create a truly innovative experience in synchronous turn-based strategy game.

Immerse yourself in Robot battles in Rise of the Robots X.

  • Collect over 90 powerful Robots.

  • Build your army adapted to your playstyle, and execute your strategy to be victorious.

  • Fight against players from around the world, solo or with friends, and show your tactical superiority by destroying the enemy base.

You're a Strategist, a war commander with sharp skills and unrivaled tactics, leading your Faction and its army of Robots on the Arena.

Four Factions in a merciless fight: the Verbas, the Wyrns, the Khrals and the Farngs.

Each Faction has their strengths and own « Elite » Robot Archetype that will define your playstyle.

Build your Robot army

With over 290 cards to collect and millions of possible combinations, Rise of the Robots X give the possibility to customize your own Army to your playstyle.

Assemble your Robots to build your army, according to the strategy you want to adopt.

Your army must be able to be adapted to different situations, your opponents and Arenas.

Experiment different combinations and synergies to find the strategy that suits you best.

Unlock Elite Robots

Each Faction has their own benefits and gives you access to an exclusive « Elite » Robot Archetype.

Your Faction's « Elite » Robots will define your gameplay, with the 6 other common Robots Archetypes.

You will get granted of a permanent resource generation bonus plus a special ability that will help you to be victorious.

Competitive PvP game modes

Battle in hexagonal tiles Arenas.

Each Arena offers a variety of terrain types and Infrastructures that are critical to control.

Discover a variety of game modes that give players a variety of ways to compete and test their skills:

￭ Competitive « Ranked » mode (1v1, 2v2, 3v3).

￭ « Unranked » mode (1v1, 2v2, 3v3).

￭ « Free-For-All » mode (1v1v1).

Whether you prefer to battle with your teammates or the adrenaline of a 1v1 (one-versus-one), our matchmaking system had been developed to find players with a similar army of your strength.

Be creative and combine your talents to defeat your opponents.

Unique Gameplay splitted by Rounds

Each matches are defined with a system of dynamic and rhythmic "Rounds" that follow one another until you destroy your opponent Base.

This innovative system introduces the effect of surprise and tension, by synchronizing analysis Phases and simultaneous actions.

Victory is based on choices you made by anticipating the movements of your opponents, adapting your assault to the terrain of the Arena and composing an effective army according to the situations. Rise of the Robots X offers an opportunity to create complex and personalized plans, adapted to your playstyle and the events during the battle.

Collect Robots and develop your Base

Each Robot has its own characteristics and skills. Unlock new Robot cards and level them up, transform them into a powerful and strong weapon for your battles.

Find your Robots in your Base, see their details and customize them. In order to bring you additional elements to the gameplay, cosmetics will allow you to enhance your Base and your Robots: such as skins, animations, or sound elements.

Competitive esports game

Our ambition is to allow every player to participate in competitive ladders without any limits.

Join our tournaments by a single click and try to climb the PvP (Player versus Player) ranking to get a chance to win customization for your nickname, icons and other new cosmetics.

Compete against other players, solo or in a team, where your tactical choices will lead to recognition from your peers.

Updates and support

As game as a service, Rise of the Robots X will delivers continuous development and proximity to the community.

In order to give a captivating experience, some updates will be added to the game, such as:

￭ New Robots

￭ New game modes

￭ Organization of competitions and special events (online & IRL)

￭ Implementation of exclusive cosmetics

￭ Development of the Lore (in-game and website)

Economy

Rise of the Robots X is a Free-to-play game, all its content is unlockable by playing.

Our game currency (Credits) as the premium currency (Xenoshards) offer the possibility to unlock new Robots and access to cosmetics less or more quickly, without blocking the progression of players or the acquisition of in-game advantages.

Join the Rise of the Robots X community

  • Tiktok

– Mental, and Vaillance, Strategist.

1832220.name: Blind Fate: Edo no Yami — Dojo
1832220.about_the_game:
The Dojo awaits...

Follow the way of the Cyber-Samurai and join our Discord community!

Blind Fate: Edo no Yami — Dojo is a free introduction to the game's world, offering a better taste of its plot, levels, and boss fights, as well as a glimpse into Yami's past.

It’s a new, dark and machine-filled Edo period, and the Shogunate rules over Japan with its just, but pitiless hand: you.

You follow orders. You obey. You kill... Until they kill you.

The prologue finds you at the City of Ghosts, a once glittering Japanese metropolis, where the tide of battle has clearly turned against you: defeated by an overwhelmingly powerful opponent, you plunge into the darkness below the derelict skyscrapers, only to reawaken and see the familiar reality in a “different light”... But just how real is the world around you?

Learn to survive, relying solely on damaged sensors and the advice of your Tengu mentor. Grow stronger and follow the path of blind rage in the insane and fantastical world of cybernetics and ancient mythology.

— A world of data and lies

The Mask of the Oni creates a simulation of the world around you, but tread carefully: old data will only show you the deceiving echoes of the past.

— Swords sing unseen

Even blind, you are unstoppable. Use different sensors to detect your enemies and identify their weak spots, then crush them with lightning speed.

— Robotic folktales of Japan

Discover the story of dozens of robotic versions of Japanese folktale creatures! Find their weaknesses and destroy each one with a devastating finisher!

— Long-lost mechanical lore

Your sensors pierce the curtain of the past. Use sound, smell, and heat to explore the world, uncovering centuries of lore and guiding Yami on his vengeful, story-driven journey.

Color Flash is an endless runner 2d game based on colors. The player has to pass through a series of obstable bars (divided into four tiles) by matching the tile with the same color as the player. Each time the player successfully pass through an obstacle bar, the score will increase by one point. When player hit the wrong tile, the player dies and game ends.

Guidelines:

Move player to the left or right side by side.
Enter tiles that matches the player color or white tiles to pass an obstacle bar
Avoid spiky tiles even if they match your player’s color.
Player color may change when it passes through the level entry bar
Score increases each time you successfully pass an obstacle bar.

1832250.name: Christmas Stories: Yulemen Collector's Edition
1832250.about_the_game:
Elephant Games returns with another yuletide tale that’s sure to spread the Christmas spirit with Christmas Stories: Yulemen – Collector’s Edition!

When the holiday season rolls around each year, the Yulemen bring their unique brand of Christmas cheer to Iceland. But this year, a cold-hearted monster with a nasty grudge named Hans Trapp has kidnapped them all, and even worse, he’s also targeted Asdis and her little brother Yonas! With Yonas in Hans’s clutches, it’s up to Asdis to set out on a journey that will take her into the very memories of her new nemesis to discover what makes him tick and hopefully rescue her brother and all thirteen of the missing Yulemen! Can you help Asdis save them all in time for Christmas? Grab a hot chocolate, a comfortable blanket, and settle in for holiday cheer in this magical Hidden-Object Puzzle Adventure!

This is a special Collector’s Edition release full of exclusive extras you won’t find in the standard version. The Collector’s Edition includes:

• The Christmas festivities continue in the bonus game, so grab your eggnog and enjoy performing a true Christmas miracle!

1832260.name: Chromarena
1832260.about_the_game:
Chromarena is a 2D top-down twin-stick arena shooter combining defense and offense. The game has five distinct enemies which are all themed around a different color. While each enemy alone might be a pushover, in combination they form a formidable threat. Enemy attacks layer over each other, so you'll have to be precise with both movement and shooting if you want to survive. If you can make it through all this, there's a massive boss fight that combines everything you've learned.

WARNING: This game is challenging. You will die. A lot. But with <5 minute runs you can get back into the action quickly.

Features:

  • Enemies: face five different enemies with different attack patterns and personalities, from the aggressive red enemy to the timid blue enemy to the mysterious purple enemy. These enemies are designed to work in tandem with each other, so each combination of enemies presents its own strategies and challenges. The color theme of the enemies makes them easily recognizable when scanning the screen.

  • Powerups: get a powerup based on every fifth enemy you kill. These powerups give a variety of boons, from extra health to more speed and infinite dashes to a temporary weapon upgrade. Powerups also add another layer of strategy, as the savvy player plans their attacks to not only take out certain enemies, but also to get the right powerup for the situation.

  • Difficulties: play on any of the four main difficulties or use the three practice difficulties to learn the ropes. Harder difficulties have you face more enemies at once, from one enemy at a time to the beginning of easy mode to seven deep in endless mode. The boss's attack patterns and attack speed are also scaled from easy to normal to hard.

  • Boss Fight: if you get far enough in the game you'll encounter the boss. I won't give too much away about it here, but know that it will be a white knuckle fight that puts to test everything you've practiced to get to that stage. With two dedicated boss fight modes, there will be plenty of time to practice.

  • Weapons: choose from six unique weapons with dramatically different playstyles and strengths and weaknesses. Each weapon is strong against one specific enemy and weak against another; use this to supplement your own strengths and weaknesses. Different unlock requirements provide a sense of progression and another objective to work towards.

  • Score: strive for a higher score at every level of play with a scoring system that rewards both survival early on and completion speed once you can beat the game.

  • Graphics: while graphics aren't the focus of this game, enjoy the handmade pixel graphics I made.

Win.

Welcome to Seven Cities, the urban action RPG set in a near-future New York City. In a world divided by corporate greed and technological advancement, you, an Outsider, must rise to reclaim the city and restore unity among its inhabitants. Prepare to experience a dynamic blend of modern urban environments, intense combat, and deep character customization.

Key Features:

Customization and Gameplay:


  • Weapon Specializations: Choose from hundreds of weapon specializations to create a unique and devastating arsenal.
  • Tech Skills: Use technology-based skills to dominate your enemies, with holographic attacks and hacking abilities.
  • Robot Companion: Equip and customize your faithful robot with active and passive abilities to assist you in your mission.

Exploration and Immersion:


  • A Living World: Explore varied urban environments, from dark alleys to shimmering skyscrapers, each with its own challenges and secrets.
  • Quests and Missions: Take on epic challenges, battle imposing bosses, and uncover the truth behind the division of the Seven Cities.
  • Holograms and Digital Realities: Immerse yourself in a world where reality blends with simulation through stunning visual effects.

Prepare for an Epic Adventure:

  • Regular Updates: Enjoy frequent updates with new weapons, skills, missions, and more.
  • Early Access: Be among the first to play and shape the future of Seven Cities by participating in our early access in october.

Multiplayer and Community:

  • Seasonal Events: Participate in regular events and unlock exclusive content throughout the year.
  • Community Support: Join our Discord to share feedback, discuss strategies, and stay updated with the latest game news.

1832850.name: Anachroma
1832850.about_the_game:
⬡ A fun and relaxing adventure game with little puzzles to solve ⬡


Anachroma is a first-person adventure and puzzle game with a simple game mechanic : black-and-white elements are frozen in time, while colored ones can move and interact. Using a ball that brings color back to the world, the player must restore color to the black-and-white world around him to reactivate it and find his way through the levels.

⬡ Explore a black-and-white world ⬡


After stealing a mysterious artefact and fleeing her home, Ana finds the world outside devoid of colors, frozen and silent. By switching between both color and black-and-white, she must take advantage of every situation to solve the mysteries surrounding the royal family. What caused the world to be stripped of its colors?

⬡ Master the power of the Eye of Re, a powerful artefact ⬡


The Eye of Re, stolen by Ana, is a stange ball that can be thrown to restore color around it. But that's not its only power - it houses the spirit of an ancient inhabitant of the kingdom, who will help Ana through her travels.

⬡ Unscramble the functioning of ancient mechanisms ⬡


The deserted isles of Mag Mell were once occupied by Men, who left behind numerous relics of their presence. The young heroin will have to experiment and understand their logic to make her path through the world.

⬡ Discover the world through the eyes of a young girl ⬡


Between her father, King of a fallen kingdom, and her mother who went missing, Ana had a solitary and stifling childhood. Running away from the castle is her opportunity to shake the shackles of her overprotective father, gain her independance, grow up and lift the veil of King Re's secrets.

⬡ Uncover the mysteries of the world of Mag Mell ⬡


The absence of inhabitants or animals leaves Ana wanders alone through the relics of a world she knows nothing of. Through ancient murals fresco of stone, infused with the memories of a forgotten society, she must learn the events that plunged the world into its current state.

⬡ Solve puzzles to restore color ⬡


Restore the Eye of Re's fragments to these strange altars brings color and life back to its surroundings. But finding them is only half the battle - to reach them, Ana will have to listen to her artefact's advice and borrow its powers.

⬡ Development ⬡


Anachroma's development process is open to public. If you're interested in viewing the behind-the-scene process of video game creation, you can join our Twitch channel (where we stream our work several times a week), or check the team's Trello to follow our progress.

1833040.name: 晴末置雨
1833040.about_the_game:
有关恋爱的故事往往在两人开始交往后便戛然而止，在那之后的重重障碍总是无人言说。

这是一段着重表现女性细腻情感的故事，一段关于试探、倦怠和纠结的故事，一段关于成长的故事。

-Story-

又是一年夏天，回想最初的那次告白已然遥远。但好在身份的转化，并未使相爱的人分开。成为社会人的她，和仍是大学生的她，今夜也在一处同眠。
与看似并无间隙的相拥不同，心与心之间浮现出微妙的隔阂，某种揣度根植在无数杂乱的思绪之间，伺机生根，等待着破土而出。
那么，在盛夏被一场不期而至的暴雨宣告终结之时，两人看到的，究竟是朦胧的雨雾中对方逐渐消失的身影，还是下一个晴天，地上水洼倒映出的湛蓝？

-Character-

羽墨：
曾任社团社长，毕业后入职了一家互联网公司，职位是策划。
对她的初印象往往是冷漠且不善言辞，但深交之后就会发现她乐于助人的温柔一面，如果是有着更深的交情，说不定还会有更多发现？
言辞中带着过分的礼貌，把“辛苦了”称作口头禅也不为过。

芷晴：
计算机系在读大学生，成绩优异，对专业知识的掌握也相当牢靠，甚至能自己独立完成一些小游戏。目前的目标是在毕业后入职羽墨工作的互联网公司，以她现在的水平来看应该十拿九稳。
在厨艺方面也有着远超同龄人的造诣，不过对于其他家务事，却意外的不擅长。

婉茗：
社团的现任社长，有时候会被社员称作“妈妈”，是名副其实的善于照顾人，且爱操心。
据她本人所说，这样的性格是来自于对羽墨的观察，尽管两人在表现出来的言行上有着不小的差距，但本性说不定真的有许多相通之处？

-About-

·短小精悍的百合故事，一段略带苦味的辛酸经历；
·精美的CG与Q版情节，见证故事中的重要时刻；
·多分支多结局，走向何方并非定数；
·主角全程配音，体验声入人心的真情对白；

DuneCrawl is an open world action-adventure game where you and up to three friends explore the sandy seas atop a gigantic Crab Crawler.

Battle against the jar-headed Vassals, survive hordes of wild bugs, explore oasis islands and delve devious dungeons all to help your fellow Polloi pilgrims win their war against the Ceramicist’s invasion!

Key Features

  • COOP AND SOLO PLAY:

Adventure in local or online coop with up to 4 players, or take to the wastelands by yourself with a bit of help from a ghostly companion!

  • OPEN WORLD EXPLORATION:

Navigate your Dune Crawler through the desert and visit dozens of islands to complete quests, explore secret dungeons, and collect piles of loot!

  • UPGRADE YOUR ARSENAL:

Gain powerful new player abilities by collecting Masks, Tunics, and Talismans! Unlock weapons like the Buzzooka and Acid Harpoon! Deck out your Dune Crawler with upgrades like Spike Armoured legs and Guided Torpedoes (or just give her a new hat and sporty paintjob)!

  • CRUSTACEAN COMBAT:

Man the cannons and take the helm with your crew to fight against other crawlers, gigantic bosses, and island fortresses! Load cannonballs, repair damaged legs, and even launch yourself through the air for daring boarding actions!

  • BUG RIDING:

Giant crabs aren’t your only form of arthropodic locomotion! Team up with friends to ride multi-saddle Beetles, zip around on skittering Nymphs, or smash through any opposition with armoured Scorpions and Ball Bugs!

  • SWASHBUCKLING ACTION:

Sometimes fighting on two feet is best! Help your fellow Polloi fight off the Vassal invaders with a wide array of hand weapons and items, or make use of the deadly local wildlife with Bomb Flowers, Beehives, and Spider Eggs!

1833210.name: Astromine
1833210.about_the_game:
Astromine is a survival mining game set in a fully destructible solar system. Every planet, creature, and structure is made of voxels with real physics. Dig through worlds, collapse walls, burn bases, and carve into alien monsters.

Procedural Voxel Planets

Land on fully destructible, procedurally generated planets—each a spherical world with its own terrain, resources, and hazards. Dig through alien crusts, tunnel into the core, and strip planets for the raw materials you’ll need to survive and expand.

True Physics Survival

Every material has real physical properties. Wood burns and collapses under stress, iron supports towering structures, and electricity powers sprawling networks. Fires spread, bases crumble under weak foundations, and survival demands engineering as much as scavenging.

Robot vs. Robot Warfare

You are a machine in a war for the solar system. Rival robot factions control fortified bases across alien worlds. Each outpost is a challenge of planning and destruction: breach walls voxel by voxel, disable power sources, and tear down defenses piece by piece.

Living Alien Worlds

Alien life is voxel-based too. Blast through flesh and armor, carve into enemies to find their weak points, and watch as your weapons physically tear them apart

Build, Expand, Conquer

From survival shelters to orbital fortresses, construct bases and starships from voxel materials with full physics. Pilot your ships between planets, expand your territory, and fight for control of the solar system.

Explore a persistent, massive open world with thousands of other players and experience the freedom to pursue your own destiny.
