- No levels . Character's progress is what you enjoy to do - related skills are going to increase and provide more opportunities.
- No classes. You choose from the list of ~140 skills and decide what abilities you use and what stats to gain.
- Dynamic third-person combat system where the player's skill matter. Experienced non-geared player may defeat multiple geared but less skillful players.
- Non target combat matters! More than 12 different armor slots that provide unique protection for specific body areas only.
- Full loot. You can attack any single creature in the world and loot everything he got, including NPC in towns.
- Zero "pay-to-win" . There will be NO shop to buy any boost items.
- Smart NPCs and unique Bosses abilities.
- Ships and sea traveling.
- Housing system



And many many more....

1833560.name: Witchhazel Woods
1833560.about_the_game:
Witchhazel Woods is a story-heavy adventure game where you play as Dylan, a teenage girl on a mission to rescue her dog, Georgia. Georgia goes missing during a game of fetch, leaving you alone in the woods with nothing but the twig you had thrown for her.

As you journey deeper into the woods, you'll meet an array of animals and...creatures. Every critter has their own story and predicament. Can you find a creature who might have a use for your twig? If so, they might be willing to trade with you for something better.

By making the right series of trades, you can help many of the woods' creatures, and find the key to getting Georgia back in the process.

Featuring:


- 17 tradable characters
- A branching narrative
- Funny and emotive dialogue with choices that matter
- A mixture of hand-drawn pixel art and procedurally generated elements
- Original soundtrack
- And to answer the all-important question: yes, you can pet the dog.

1833570.name: Vampire Syndicate: Gangs of MoonFall
1833570.about_the_game:
Vampire Syndicate: Gangs of MoonFall is an old-school RPG set amidst the vampire-dominated gangs of a cyberpunk city. As a Familiar of one of the ancient vampire lineages, you have been tasked by your undead masters to expand their criminal empire.

A story of lust and blood - The vampires of MoonFall are different from the ones you may be used to. While all vampires are undead and must drink blood, how vampirism is spread, and the array of powers a new vampire gains, will vary depending on the lineage. Each lineage is, in effect, a different “species” of vampire and the lineage that the player chooses will alter story events, making each playthrough with a specific lineage have its own unique quirks.

Crime Pays - Conduct criminal activities for your vampire lineage. You are offered freedom in how you go about this, and can take on missions or contracts as they wish. Missions (such as heists or raids) take place on the overworld map.

Players can encounter a variety of different groups, such as corporate convoys, mercenaries, street-level gangers, rival familiars, etc. Or visit new locations and faction headquarters.

Encounters can be benign, or they can result in violence. The choice is yours.

Go and make a name for yourself as a hired thug, assassin, master thief, or even skilled lover!

  • Old-School cRPG: Featuring turn-based combat, character creation, classes, skill checks, etc!

  • Erotic Entertainment: Vampires are sexual creatures, expect opportunities for casual sex or long-term romances.

  • Choice and Consequence: Faction reputations, NPC loyalties, dynamic world states, multiple story routes.

  • Build Your Crew: Recruit cutthroats, thieves, hackers, flamboyantly-dressed thugs and more!

  • Optional Anime Style: Making a return from Memory of a Battle Brothel, anime-styled body sprites can be used in dialogue.

1833620.name: Mad Geometry
1833620.about_the_game:
In Mad Geometry you solve puzzles by reshaping your own shape between cube and sphere. On each level there is simple rule: You are what you collect. All the puzzles emerge from this rule, which come together to tell story about the transformations caused by life.

• Dynamic but simple music
• Procedurally generated boards
• 8 worlds with 5 levels each
• Inspired by classic puzzle games

1833650.name: Devil Should Die
1833650.about_the_game:
ABOUT THE GAME
3 IN 1 GAME (you can fight three type of enemies "zombie , robots , soldiers")
THIRD PERSON SHOOTER GAME (single player)
ARENA WITH UNLIMITED ENEMIES
ACTION AND ADVENTURE GAME
Weapons build system

FUTURE UPDATES
WE WILL INCREASE LEVELS AND ADD MUCH MORE ENEMIES TYPE
WE WILL ADD MULTIPLAYER TO OUR GAME

1833660.name: Evade The Taxman
1833660.about_the_game:
Evade The Taxman is a frightening singleplayer survival horror game where you have to pay your dues to the taxman.

The goal is to make it out alive. For that you have to find and collect a certain amount of bills spread randomly over specific areas.
Then once you have all the bills, you need to run to the exit.

The longer you wait, the more impatient the taxman gets.
You can throw him your bills. That will soothe him maybe. Don't ask how you will get out without the bills.

The more money you have, the more he will go after you.
(also he will come even if you have no money because of course he will).

You cannot hide - Don't even think about it.

Other Features :
- You can throw the bills away if you don't want them. You are a generous soul.
- It can be used to distract the taxman.
- It can be used to interact with certain objects. No guarantee it will work. No guarantee you'll get your money back.
- footsteps. You'll hear a lot of footsteps.
- the world is made of a variety of closed and open spaces. And yes there are toilets.

1833670.name: 2048 3D
1833670.about_the_game:
2048 3D is a casual digital game, adapted from the classic game 2048.
In 2048 3D, number cubes will fall from the air. Players need to use the ↑↓←→ or WASD keys on the keyboard to control the movement of all the cubes, and merge the same cubes to get larger number cubes.
Try not to let the big number cubes outside the box, otherwise you will suffer a heavy loss!
Try to get big cubes to win the game!

1833680.name: BeatRider
1833680.about_the_game:
【Story】

This is a world where humans and the conscious beings known as Kururu coexist.

The study of the essence and mechanisms of Kururu has not yet reached any conclusions that have achieved widespread consensus.

However, it is generally agreed that it is a form of life that exists in harmony and resonance with all human mental and physiological rhythms,

capable of interacting with humans during cognition, thought, or communication.

Humans must maintain a benign balance with Kururu to ensure the stability of their sanity and cognitive abilities.

However, only a very few humans can visually identify, physically perceive, and manipulate Kururu, and conduct systematic research on them.

We call these individuals "Tuners."

This summer, Mioi (barely) passed the professional exam and came to Baixiang City as an apprentice Tuner, along with Kasula and Syss.

This is a coastal city with nearly two centuries of history but not much communication with the outside world, which, however, has attracted the attention of the Tuners Association in the past decade.

As the routine tasks were carried out, this metropolis began to exhibit abnormalities, with phenomena of group dysregulation becoming increasingly common and severe.

At the same time, two mysterious Tuners who had received special commissions also arrived in Baixiang City...

【Exploration】

· Unravel the Secrets of Baixiang City

Gain unique encounters through random routes, with each successful patrol bringing you closer to the "truth."

· Card-based City Patrol

Flip through the perilous mission cards, respond carefully, and make the best adventurous decisions for your team.

【Combat】

· Magical Girls Forging Ahead

Execute splendid combos with a single click, block at the right moment, and engage in fast-paced combat that's simple in attack and defense but infinitely variable!
1833680.supported_languages: Simplified Chinese, English, Japanese, Traditional Chinese

1833710.name: My Museum: Treasure Hunter
1833710.about_the_game:
My Museum: Treasure Hunter is an educational First-Player View simulator designed for renovation fans, expeditioners, management and history enthusiasts. Restore the museum you inherited from your grandfather, revive its glory, and compete for the admiration of critics and visitors!

Restore your way to glory! With its amazing renovation mechanics, its numerous puzzles and historial facts, this groundbreaking cross genre title will let you become a star in the Museum industry.

──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

MANAGE YOUR OWN MUSEUM - Step into the role of museum owner, face tough managerial decisions and financial struggles on your road to becoming the largest art institution!

──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

MAINTAIN THE BUILDING - Clean and renovate your museum, remember that a beautiful place requires constant work.

──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

EXPLORE UNKNOWN PLACES - Go on Expeditions in remote world corners, solve the riddles, and find unique exhibits.



──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

RESTORE ARTIFACTS - Repair old or damaged artifacts in your own professional studio and make them regain their shine.



──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

ORGANIZE EXHIBITIONS - Showcase your exhibits and organize the best exhibitions.
1833710.supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Turkish, Portuguese - Portugal
*languages with full audio support

highlighted.localized_name: The first pancake is always spoiled
highlighted.name: The first pancake is always spoiled

1833730.name: Our Battle Has Just Begun! episode 2
1833730.about_the_game:
Introduction


This new country that awaits you is the forest country of Roseail, land of elves and beastmen!

Oma may have saved the realm from the Demon Lord,
but he has somehow overwritten all of these memories with memories of his past life.

This is your typical adventure visual novel filled with heroes and heroines...except it starts where games usually end. Episode 2 is here!


As you read through the story of the game, you'll find choices.
The choices you make in game drastically change the story,
and the Hero and his heroine's fate.

Avoid the challenges and happy endings with heroines in a new country to continue on your journey back to your homeland.


  • This new country that awaits you is the forest country of Roseail, land of elves and beastmen!
  • Enjoy a comical and slightly serious story with our still largely inexperienced protagonist!
  • Keep an eye out for the beautiful new heroines the Hero meets in this episode!

Story


Roseail, the forest country, consists of a vast woodland dotted with elven and beastmen towns.

After leaving Alard, the country of plenty, the Hero and his party visit Jarn, a Roseailian town with a booming dungeon business.

Since no national ceremonies are planned this time around,
the Hero looks forward to a leisurely stay.

That is until he meets the commander of the guard, an adventurer, and a visiting representative of Roseail.

What secrets dwell in the adventurers' coveted dungeons?
"Follow the Hero and his party as they face brand new challenges in a novel land!"

Character


Commander of the Guard, Mana


Mana is a wolf beastgirl and commander of Jarn's guard.

A prodigy who became the youngest commander in the history of the force, she works with the older members of her team to ensure the security of the town of Jarn.

As the town grows, the number of adventurer-induced problems increases rapidly. This is what Mana and the guard have been forced to deal with.

The Representative, Synsya


Synsya is an elven woman who serves as the representative of the forest country of Roseail.

By mediating the interactions between previously antagonistic races, she has become the driving force behind Roseail's national unification.

She is currently touring Roseail's many towns to enact important policies that address their many problems.

However, her harsh decision making is said to have turned many people against her.

The Adventurer, Taylor


Taylor is a former mercenary turned adventurer and fighter who wields a large sword.

She was a mercenary for the allied forces during the war against the Demon Lord's army. After the war, she stayed in Jarn and became an adventurer.

Although she isn't very sociable, she has an unusually good reputation among the townsfolk of Jarn.
1833730.supported_languages:
English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese*
*languages with full audio support

1833770.name: HELP ME!
1833770.about_the_game:
You are Maxim, an ordinary student from Pavlodar, who has been suffering from nightmares since childhood.

Lately they have been creeping into reality more and more often, driving you crazy!
The situation worsens when your own father disappears without leaving a trace.

Now it's up to you to look for him, unraveling the mystical secrets of your own past along the way.





Dashingly twisted detective plot will let you plunge into the mystical secrets of the past and the dark corners of the protagonist’s mind.
Your phone and other interactive objects encountered throughout the game will help you along the way!



In our psychological horror, you will encounter a lot of unexplained phenomena that will chill your bones.
Advanced graphics and photogrammetry will help you achieve great immersion.



While investigating the crimes, you will repeatably stumble upon puzzles.
Solving these will open locked doors and also shed light on the events happening around you.
Be careful, because some of them hide secrets not many are able to find!



Enemies never sleep! Hide in shelters and don't let them to see you, even those who don't have eyes!
Our game is full of different enemies! Can you outwit them all?

1833820.name: From Red to Green
1833820.about_the_game:
The goal of this game is to change all red objects to green, systematically clicking on them with the objective of solving the puzzle in the lowest number of moves possible. If you click on a green object, it becomes red, and the opposite is also true. Some levels have inverted controls, and others have moving objects

Solutions are available in the Steam Guide. Feel free to consult it if any level becomes too difficult.

Key features:
  • 24 main levels and 20 bonus levels with different layouts;
  • Random level generation (movable objects not available), in which you can specify the desired height and width of the level from 2 to 7 respectively (2x7 possible);
  • Create your own levels (without moving objects) with dimensions ranging from 2x2 to 7x7, and share them via clipboard code;
  • You can draw lines anywhere on-screen with the right mouse button and erase them with the middle mouse button;
  • Big buttons! Have you ever wondered how much time you lost by hovering over small buttons?;
  • 100% made by me. Any bugs you may encounter can be fixed. (That huge tree of blueprints in the trailer is a randomly generated level without loops :D);
  • Additionally, there are 2 minigames: the first is a memory game in which your goal is to remember the direction of a sequence of arrows, which will be infinitely generated. The second is hot seat competitive. Player 1 uses WASD keys and Player 2 uses arrows with the goal of changing as many on-screen objects to their color as possible in a limited amount of time.
  • Double protection for the achievements. If "wait for achievements" is enabled (see settings page), then the game will not save until the achievement is received. Achievements can be synchronized separately in individual menu. This will help prevent Steam crashes or glitches from bugging out achievements;
  • The plot of this game will definitely not disappoint you, because there is none;
  • No bugs. If you find a bug, I will immediately kick its ass and thank you for the report;
  • Easter egg. If you find it, you can confidently call yourself a detective. :)

More information is available in FAQs on the game's Steam forum.

Thanks for help with store page translation to Havik.

1833840.name: Lovely Girls
1833840.about_the_game:
Lovely Girls - is a puzzle game where you need to assemble a complete image from several pieces.
Assemble one big image from small images and you will be able to move to a new level as well as enjoy already assembled images in a special gallery.

Features:
  • Size range from 16 to 36 pieces
  • Simple mouse control
  • Traditional logical gameplay
  • Gallery
  • Steam Achievements
  • Press "F" to complete the level
Credits: The game was created using Clickteam Fusion 2.5! Music by Erwarda Savitnaag.
1833840.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Bulgarian, Portuguese - Brazil, Hungarian, Vietnamese, Greek, Danish, Spanish - Latin America, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Dutch, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Romanian, Russian, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian, Finnish, Czech, Swedish, Japanese

1833850.name: HelloWorld:ESCAPE
1833850.about_the_game:
Explain the game


Kill your enemies and find a way out!

"HelloWorld:ESCAPE" is a game created by high school students in Korea.

You're trapped.
What you see nearby in this surreal space is only white walls and enemies.

You have to escape from this space full of enemies.

"HelloWorld:ESCAPE" consists of two chapters, five stages per chapter, and offers a shooting range where players can play freely.

Game settings provide a variety of setting functions to make play easier. Language setting, basic mouse sensitivity and aiming mouse sensitivity, as well as aiming mouse sensitivity, scope mouse sensitivity, and various sound setting functions are included.

You can also check the names of the music used in the game on the Copyright tab, and you can also check the names of the people who created the game on the Director tab.

Let's get started right away!

1833860.name: Olympian Knights
1833860.about_the_game:
A Greek mythology-based 3D multiplayer dueling/fighting game where each character wields a unique weapon and possesses their own set of abilities.



Easy to learn and straight forward combat system, with some mechanics for more advanced players.



Game modes:
  • 1 vs 1 Duels
  • 2 vs 2 Duels
  • God game (Kill oppnenents to get the next character, win by reaching the last character first)
  • Team Deathmatch
  • Deathmatch Free for All

Playable Characters:
  • Zeus
  • Poseidon
  • Hades
  • Hecate

Maps






Characters Planned
  • Apollon
  • Hermes
  • Athena
1833860.supported_languages:
English*, German, Norwegian, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Vietnamese
*languages with full audio support

1833870.name: A Million Lightyears Beyond
1833870.about_the_game:
Hunted to the edge of extinction humanity goes through a mysterious ancient gate. Will you go beyond the mysterious gate to discover the secrets of our past and the hope for our future, as we begin our new life in a far off galaxy?

  • Interactive - Throw switches, touch screens, and manipulate controls.
  • Dynamic - Help humanity rebuild in a living dynamic open world.
  • Level Up - Develop your skills in a wide variety of professions.
  • Story - Immerse yourself in the riveting narrative of survival against all odds.

1833890.name: Fish Story: Gourmet Puzzle
1833890.about_the_game:
The new adventures of Lucian and his friend XO! This time the friends are traveling through mysterious planets in search of delicacies!



You have to collect groups of identical tokens to move on to the next planet and try all the delicacies! Destroy obstacles, use bonuses and score points!



Great graphics and addictive gameplay await you. Help your friends on their journey and show off your tactical skills!
1833890.supported_languages: English, Russian, Simplified Chinese, German, Ukrainian, French, Italian, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Portugal, Japanese, Bulgarian, Hungarian, Vietnamese, Greek, Danish, Korean, Dutch, Norwegian, Polish, Romanian, Thai, Turkish, Finnish, Czech, Swedish

1833900.name: Color Slots
1833900.about_the_game: Color Slots is a speed puzzle runner. You help the rolling ball pass through the colored blocks. By pressing the colored buttons at the right moment, you move the shapes upward of the corresponding color. Upon collision with a figure, the game will start over. Your task is to drive far and not collide with figures. Good luck with the game.

1833920.name: Space Balls
1833920.about_the_game:
Shoot yourself into space as high as you can in this arcade game with a retro soundtrack!

  • Hit the stars to be able to jump again!


  • Fly super fast to destroy the stars!


  • But don't touch the reds (they kill).

1833930.name: Primasia (Chapter One)
1833930.about_the_game:
Synopsis

Prime8, an ethereal spirit of evolutionary history, exists within Prime8 Cavern, deep inside Green Mountain. Green Mountain is located on Prime8 island. Prime8 has now called upon eight disciples to join him on the island. These creatures previously lived in the Land of Humans, being carefully chosen for their natural aptitudes towards the tasks that Prime8 wishes to address.

Features

- The Prime8 Gang consists of Little Gorilla, Amanda Panda, Sam Snake, Caterpillar, Hugi Hippo, Rhino, Wanda Whale and Tiny Tiger. Switch between characters to undertake tasks and challenges.

- All the southern region of Prime8 island (also known as Primopolis) may be explored. There are some areas that will hold important knowledge and information and others that exist purely for day-to-day activities.

- Eight pirates that are a splinter group of a larger organisation have been given the task of invading Primopolis to disrupt your progress. You must thwart their efforts!

- The southern region of Prime8 island also lends its name to the capital town. This was previously in the central region. You must develop it to encourage new citizens to live on the island as well as enabling trade with the other five islands of Primasia. You will need to use sustainable resources for building purposes.

- There are eight unique crops that grown on Prime8 island. These vary from a variety of carrot called cone carrots to the famous Primasia potato. Sell these crops to earn Darwiniams – the currency of money used in Primasia.

- There are five specific mini games that may be played where you will leave or enter another location. These are designed to assist greater understanding of the game mechanics and offer bonus rewards too.

- There are eight riddles that form part of the side-story. These vary in complexity and may be attempted whenever you feel in the mood!

- On your journey you will be asked to complete Q&A sections to maintain your average score indicator – which measures your answering accuracy. These questions will include useful general knowledge, as does the contents of the Prime8 handbook.

So where do you start…?

Join the Prime8 Gang as they arrive on Prime8 island in the first part of their journey. They will trade with the other five islands to gain other resources for crafting purposes. As they learn about the island's history, they will meet new characters and learn other useful information about Primasia AND the Land of Humans.

History

At the same time Pangea broke up 273 million years ago - so too did Primasia. Primasia's location is never static, but always somewhere in the Atlantic ocean. Prime8 island - is the largest island in Primasia. The time has come for Prime8 to interact fully with those in the Land of Humans, to share historic ecological data pertaining to global natural health. The secrets held inside Prime8 Cavern must be accessed and used to enhance the world at large, to sustain the six distinct climates of Primasia and ensure environmental betterment globally in partnership with those in the Land of Humans.

Who do we think should play this game?!

We wanted to create a game that engaged families to play together. Although Primasia may appear to target a younger audience – we can assure you that all the family will need to get involved to complete the game properly. There is nothing better than children learning through play and at the same time referring to their responsible adults for assistance from time to time!

Message from us

Here at Prime8 we strive to create fun and educational games and other interactive resources for children and their families. The environmental pressures globally are very close to our hearts and to this end we have included various references and features in our products to reflect this. We should all try and ‘protect our tomorrows’ when we have the opportunity, and we hope that this ethos resonates warmly in your gaming experience!

1833950.name: Time Reject
1833950.about_the_game:
Destroy the Past! Save the Future!

Time Reject is a no nonsense, no remorse, no dialogue adventure, set in a 90's B-movie format.

The ejected power core of a colossal derelict droid is posing an imminent & explosive threat to the planet, and you have to clear out anything & everything in its path. If the power core stops, then so does Earth!



The gameplay is simple, fun, and intense! You control a time travelling vehicle, equipped with a powerful energy bumper which you will need to smash everything in the path of the runaway power core before it's stopped in its tracks.

  • Everything above ground level is destructible. The more you destroy the faster & more powerful your ship becomes.

  • Different buildings have different structural strengths, some will collapse pretty quick, some not so much. With a brief touch most smaller items will be destroyed or propelled into the air (such as other vehicles).

  • If you fill up the 'destruction' meter then you can either keep that slot (one of three) filled or use it for a special attack, such as a short desolating speed burst.

  • To help find your way and make it clearer which buildings and objects need annihilating, there is a top-down 'satellite' view which can be activated at any time.

  • The game sees you travel through the ages, from Medieval landscapes to dark futures, and beyond.
1833950.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Bulgarian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, Finnish, Greek, Hungarian, Japanese, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Portuguese - Brazil, Romanian, Spanish - Latin America, Swedish, Ukrainian

1833960.name: Krai. Digital-poetry vol. 1
1833960.about_the_game:
The first collection of digital-poetry Krai. Created by variously gone-mad poets. 5 games.
Curator: Ilia Mazo.

1. «Metaphysical Trolleybus Simulator». A parable about the path to a dream. The dream role belongs to a Mountain.

You are a trolley. Rolling around the city through your trolley-life, you know. Passengers inside will get mad, if you get out of the way. But you will get out and get it. A dream. A Mountain. And then they will sing a song for the first time in their passenger life. A song about the journey and voices in our heads.

2. «A Silent Room» is an existential hokku. Don’t you go outside without a hat?

Come in. Wellcome. A room. The room is always warm. It is funny, sad, calm, loud, and quiet inside. All your stuff is here, isn’t it? Sure, it is. It is your room. Time passes by, things go away and leave marks in your head. The more you remember, the less air you have. Have you ever seen this place, these walls before? You have already been here. Come inside. Lie down. It is silent. It is always silent.

«The Flower» is a dating-madness simulator. A flower afflatus, post-modern and post-psycho poetry.

After a long-long working day on a Plantation, you are in high spirits. Happy, right! Today is the day, today is the date with your lovely beloved. Your heart is burning, your breathing is rapid, the urban landscape around blooms in a euphoric frenzy of colors. Something makes you think better, feel better, see better, bloom better. But something is missing…

Bouquet! It would be extremely unethical to show up for a date without a bunch of flowers. No problem, it has never been a problem for you. Look around. All you need is to pick a few flowers…

«ORG» is a futuristic shoot-a-fable about the censor routine of the nearest future.

Congratulations! You have just got a promotion. From now on you are responsible for the art transfer through CAD (Culture Assurance Department). Be careful, the cultural enrichment of our clients lies in your hands.

The future is CAD. CAD is the Future.

«Ticker» is a running-n-crying runner about the mind night, the utterance impossibility.

Shortly before going to bed, you uprise a few words in front of your eyes and write them down on a piece of paper. You will try to remember the words’ order through falling asleep…the words…the order…ords…woder…

Each pulsating beat of your sleepy mind brings you closer and closer to the non-verbalized world. There is nothing to say. Say no more. The night is still young, and you are on your way to the letter fugue.

1834000.name: KaRu
1834000.about_the_game:
KaRu is a short, horror experience where you play as a Parasite. He wakes up next to a young boy he never met in a place they shouldn't be. Now they have to trust each other and find a way out. The game is about an hour long, and it has four endings! This is meant as an introduction to many more insights to come, taking place within the same universe, so, please do enjoy this little world!
A.M.

Karu is a point & click, multiple-choice/ending, visual novel game.
Navigate around the areas with your cursor and pick the correct choices to reach a better outcome for the protagonist.
Find items that will help paint a clearer picture of where you are, and what happened to those who came before you.
Avoid unnecessary conflict with the characters.

M.A.
1834000.supported_languages:
English*, Arabic, Indonesian
*languages with full audio support

1834010.name: Desktop Hacker
1834010.about_the_game:
A narrative driven hacking game that takes you on a journey of an accidental hacker that is at the core of global conspiracies. Game is played from a perspective of a desktop and takes place in an alternative reality somewhat resembling early 2000s.

You can expect to be using the console to scan servers, ports, exploit those servers, download and upload critical information. You can also use graphical helpers for those functions, in the later stages of the game you will be in possession of the newly developed Pandora software which maps computer systems in a graphical manner allowing for more advanced hacks. Game features a news service sub-plot which has you influence the world on a global scale.

You are running from the law and take refuge at a friend's cottage, lucky for you your friend is well connected in online grey area dealings. Coincidentally it seems that the reason you are on the run is also the reason that the UN has recently started pushing for a global identification system for all Internet users.

1834110.name: Headland
1834110.about_the_game:
The imagination core from Nor’s Headland is shattered. With his robot friends he has to find the fragments & fight to regain his limitless creativity.


Headland is a fantastical imaginary world filled with vibrant colors and silly creatures. But a sinister outside force threatens to steal the wonder and color from the world. Journey through a story full of vivid characters and explore a beautiful imaginary world with lush meadows, deep caves and dark castles. Make friends along the way and confront your fears in a little adventure about a big imagination.

Here's what you can do in this game


- Explore the colourful world of Headland
- 4 hours of story-driven and action packed gameplay with a satisfying ending for all ages
- Fight against an imaginative cast of monsters and level up your powers
- Collect blueprints and expand your arsenal of unique weapons
- Spend resources and upgrade your weapons at the Living Forge
- Meet the habitants of Headland and help solve their problems
- Discover the meaning behind the sinister Pale Guard
- There's a dedicated DANCE button!
1834110.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Danish, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Portugal, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Traditional Chinese

1834120.name: Icemaze Cave: Skate Escape
1834120.about_the_game:
Skate through the icy and labyrinthine depths of Icemaze Cave. Can you find your way out?

Icemaze Cave: Skate Escape is a 2D logic puzzle game about path planning with exploration and collection elements, inspired by familiar retro adventure games.



Explore the increasingly complex cave rooms. Find your way across the icy floors to the exit. Along the way, you may find valuable minerals worthy of a detour. Or perhaps you'd rather avoid detours altogether, using your expert navigational skills to stay on the shortest path out.

Features

Christmas Sort Puzzle is the perfect game to unwind during the holiday season or any time you crave a festive challenge. Sharpen your mind, embrace the holiday spirit, and indulge in the satisfying puzzle-solving experience that awaits you.

Or overcomplicate your shot and use a portal to pull off the most ridiculous trickshot you can think of. The possibilities are endless when you have the power to cut a hole in reality itself.

Or try the 'lights out' levels where it might be a little more difficult to see what your objective might be. Use your flashlight to get your bearings. Level 2 - Ox

In this hidden object and puzzle assembly level, find objects and solve a mystery with Ox, a hardworking and dependable friend.

In this dating sim level, help find a wife for Little Dove. As the guardian of children, Tiger is a creative thinker, confident, and a little unpredictable – like turning an Ancient Chinese matchmaking situation into a game show.

1834430.name: Dots and Dashes
1834430.about_the_game:
This is a computer version of the classic pen and paper game that is known by many names, including "Dots and Dashes". Other names it is known by include: Dots and Boxes, Boxes, Dot to Dot Grid, and Pigs In A Pen. This version allows up to four human players plus one host computer (or five humans and no computer) to play the game. The board size is adjustable up to limits imposed by the screen resolution. The computer, even when not actively playing, can hint or play a dash for any player.

Basic play is that the game starts with a grid of dots, and no dashes. Players in turn place a dash between two horizontal or vertical dots. If by doing so the player places the fourth side of one or two squares, they immediately earn another go of placing a dash. Such completed squares are marked with initials, symbol or colour. The usual criteria for winning is the player with the most completed squares at the end of the game is the winner, however players are free to choose their own criteria for winning (e.g., a minimum number of squares). Note though, if the computer is playing, it always plays to maximize its completed squares.

There are seven computer playing levels, starting from a completely random play with no completing of squares (level 1), to a simple (level 5) or complex (level 6) implementation of the "Double Cross Strategy". The final top level strategy is a "Sacrifice Strategy" where the computer, if it determines it is losing, will tempt the player with sacrifices to hide its true plan. Note these higher level strategies really only work in a one player versus machine game. Multiplay between a number of human players allows collusion between the players to defeat the machine (or another human player)!

The games also comes with the computer being able to offer hints, or play the hint, or take back any number of moves for the players. These are offered as a three player difficulty levels: Level 1 allows both "play hint" and "take back moves", level 2 only allows "take back move", while level 3 allows neither "play hints" nor "taking back a move". For single player versus the program, the game has access to a number of leader boards at computer levels 3 to 7, HOWEVER, these boards are only accessible at player difficulty level 3, where the player is playing without help against the program.

1834700.name: Cultist Astronaut
1834700.about_the_game:
Music by TeknoAxe.

Unleash cosmic annihilation as a goat armed with a demon gun.

Cultist Astronaut is a 2D action-platformer set in a galaxy where cults wage apocalyptic wars. Invade planets, conquer rival cults, and absorb souls.

Core Features

  • Platforming with air control, wall slides, and double jumps

  • Fight cults in any order and unlock their weapons

  • Absorb souls to power up and unleash Soul Drain attacks

Cults of the Galaxy

  • Excoria: Home of the Flayed. Miners who flayed themselves to cure Rockskin disease now worship the Skinless One. Their weapons are razors; their cure is agony.

  • Sludge Haven: Infested by the Imposters. Worm-like mimics who steal corpses and personalities to feel whole. Fight Nobodies, Somebodies, Anybody, and Everybody.

  • More cults await: cyborg, radioactive corporations, mummified death cults, and spider angels.

1834710.name: Last Bastion
1834710.about_the_game:
Nonstop, fast paced castle defense shooting action against relentless armies of evil in a dark, brooding atmosphere.

SAVE THE WORLD


Demon Iacobus has invaded your world, and Last Bastion is the only safe haven left. An evil dust cloud is gathering on the horizon and fast approaching the castle. Everyone is cowering with fear within the walls, making their peace with the dark end that awaits them... Everyone except a single brave dwarf warrior, sworn to stop this evil madness for once and all. The fate of the good will be decided here and now and defense of the Last Bastion is your hands.

Climb into your giant ballista and mow down waves upon waves of dark forces. Defend the final dwarf fortress against brainwashed masses, creatures of nature controlled by an evil spell and even the undead. Face Demon Iacobus without a flinch and become the ultimate defender of the free world.

MOW DOWN ENEMIES THAT HAVE CHARACTER


Battle through 11 chapters of the Last Bastion saga to face and banish the ultimate evil in the end. In this struggle be ready to encounter germophobic goblins, fire breathing spiders, diffident archers, forgetful wizards, masochistic skeletons and many more! Laugh at their puny comments and pitiful quip attempts as you skewer them with your giant bolts.

USE AN ARSENAL OF BALLISTA AND BOLT COMBINATIONS


Use a huge arsenal of ballistae and magically enhanced bolts to wreak havoc and make evil think twice on extinguishing the last flickering light of hope. Freely browse, purchase and use any equipment during battle. Come up with your own strategy by experimenting with what weaponry works best against differing formations of enemies.

INTUITIVE CONTROLS


Get up to speed with your task of Last Bastion's defense using intuitive controls that went through endless iterations to provide the best possible experience.

REPLAYABILITY


Replay chapters to increase your treasury, and grind as much as you like to improve your destructive and defensive powers. Or don't! The game is balanced with care to not require any tedious grinding unless you want to.

ASPIRE TO ACHIEVE A STREAK, EARN IN-GAME PRIZES


Finish chapters one after another without failure and spin the Chapter Streak Prize Wheel to get rewards of increasing value at the end of each chapter.

UNLOCK THE ENDLESS MODE, BREAK THE LEADERBOARDS, COMPLETE THE ACHIEVEMENTS


Unlock the endless mode and continue punishing evil without limitations. Take your place on the leaderboards as the #1 defender in the world.

Work towards unlocking many achievements, including hidden ones.

1834720.name: Blossom, La Jirafa SAGA
1834720.about_the_game:
Blossom is a small Giraffe who lives in captivity inside the private Zoo of an unscrupulous and frivolous hunter who catches animals as a hobby.
Our heroine dreams of returning to her home, she suddenly manages to open her cage! she thus she begins her escape to Freedom. She helps her escape the Zoo in part 1 and through the City, by the Subway until she gets the Boat that will help her complete her journey in part 2.
With Graphics, Gameplay and Original Soundtrack tribute to the first home consoles, we invite you to be part of this very fun and wild adventure.

Blossom la Jirafa is a fun platform where we will guide our intrepid protagonist running and jumping obstacles on his way to freedom, along with a fun runner in his first part.
                    

A saga for the whole family.



Blossom la Jirafa collects the two games launched in one with the following characteristics

* Travel together with blossom through the urban landscapes of the city until her way home avoiding the enemies who will try to grab her

* Travel through the levels, in the city, subway and ship, find fruits to recover your lives.

* Play a runner with a retro aesthetic in the first Blossom installment and a horizontal action Platformer in its sequel.
1834720.supported_languages: Spanish - Spain, English, Spanish - Latin America, Japanese

1834740.name: HYPERBLADE
1834740.about_the_game:
HYPERBLADE is a gameplay-driven action game where you can only move by dashing.
Use your momentum to kick off walls and cut down your enemies.
Abilities like time manipulation and bullet deflection allow for limitless improvisational play.

Early Access

HYPERBLADE has entered early access to get feedback and improve the game. The final version will expand on the story/lore, and have more levels and gameplay elements.

Design Pillars

  • Gameplay first - HYPERBLADE prioritizes gameplay over story. No long unskippable cutscenes to interrupt the flow of gameplay.
  • Tough but fair - Players should feel challenged, but should never feel that they died unfairly.
  • A sense of mastery - A player's skill should improve over time. The satisfaction of mastering a mechanic can be extremely satisfying.

1834750.name: The Unlikely Prometheus
1834750.about_the_game:
The life of a mad scientist's servant is not a bad one, but when an angry mob shows up life gets a lot more complicated.
Can you keep the mob at bay, escape the mob, and save our hapless hero from their wrath?

Features:
A classic humorous 2D Point and Click adventure game, reminiscent of the classic Lucas-arts and Sierra games, all in a hand drawn silent movie inspired visual aesthetic.
Interact with a full cast of amusing characters, combine items in unlikely ways, and of course commit minor acts of larceny in order to escape to freedom!

A mixture of inventory, dialogue and character puzzles handled through a simple contextual verb coin.

Built up from the original (winning) entry of the $105 Adventure Game Challenge in 2021.

1834820.name: First Bite
1834820.about_the_game:
ONE NIGHT. THREE VAMPIRES.
MAKE A DEAL WITH DEATH OR DIE TRYING.

What would you do if you had the chance at a second life, after death?

Put your destiny in the hands of three centuries-old vampires in this LGBTQ+ dark comedy visual novel. Play as Noe, a normal human, fanfic writer, and lover of all things supernatural with a distinct lack of self-preservation, as they take a chance and enter the strange house on Dead End Drive with the hope that the rumors they’ve heard about its inhabitants are true. There they find Laurel, Ilyas, and Valeria, and they quickly discover that there’s no escape, but not all endings are fatal.
TREAD LIGHTLY, because there are over 25 ways to die in First Bite, and your journey to immortality won't be a smooth one. If you enjoyed What We Do In The Shadows but wanted it to be just a little bit gayer... this is the game for you. Please note that while the game is rated 18+ there is no full-frontal nudity if that's what you're here for.



CHARACTERS

Valeria Andrei (She/They)
“All I’m thinking about is shredding your throat like barbecue, so talk fast.”

She might be the youngest of our trio, but Valeria certainly believes she has the upper hand. But don't let her pretty face fool you, her bite is far worse than her bark. Though... both leave a pretty nasty sting. She's fucked Dracula, likes poetry, cheating at board games, internet shopping, and warm-blooded murder.

Laurel Portman (He/They)
"Is there something I can do for you? Yes. Is there something I will do for you? Quite unlikely, but it's worth a shot."

Laurel is pushing 300 and is a lover of Hot Topic, insincerity, and watching their victims bleed out on the floor while they watch TV. He's also a seasoned connoisseur of the backhanded compliment and a force to be reckoned with. Tread lightly. Or not...


Ilyas Al-Rai (He/Him)
“Desperation makes your blood sweeter, so... beg.”

Ilyas is the oldest but definitely not the wisest of the trio, coming in at a solid 2400 years old. Lover of athleisure, Eurodance, lifting weights, and thinking he's the smartest guy in the room. (Spoiler: he's not.) He's big, he's buff, and he's loveable as hell, but you don't want to be his prey. UNLESS...

​FEATURES​
  • Three vampires to romance
  • Partial voice acting with the talents of Alejandro Saab (Fire Emblem: Three Houses), Jalen Cassell (JoJo's Bizarre Adventure), and Marie Westbrook (Jujutsu Kaisen)
  • Approximately 4 hours playtime across all routes and endings
  • If romance isn't your thing, forge an (albeit cursed) friendship
  • Choose your pronouns and customize your characters name
  • Four collectible CGs
  • 26 potential 'Dead Ends.' Choose your words wisely, or find fangs at your throat
  • A Death Tally to keep track of your failures
  • Multiple potential 'positive' outcomes
1834820.reviews:
“The writers knew exactly why we’d want to play First Bite, so they gave us a protagonist who wants the same thing – and MC’s inner monologue perfectly suited the game’s dark sense of humour.”
Sweet and Spicy Otome Game Reviews

“First Bite is the game that will make you want to pursue death, over and over again.”
Stack Up

“First Bite is an intriguing LGBTQ+ friendly visual novel that isn’t afraid to horrify and tease its players both with its atmospheric writing and tantalizing cast of characters.”

1834870.name: Lily's Well
1834870.about_the_game:
It is a rainy night in the Spring of 2005.

Lily is left home alone after her Papa put her to bed.

She is awoken by a cry for help outside her window.

It is coming from the well.

Help Lily gather rope to go down the well and save the poor soul trapped down there.



Lily's Well is a pixel horror game where players control a little girl named Lily. After hearing a voice call for help from the bottom of her home's well, she musters up the courage to gather rope in order to save whoever is trapped below.

Players can explore Lily's home and the property surrounding it in order to find different objects that can be used for rope. There are many different possible fates for Lily that players can discover. Each one depends on the rope's length and the materials used to create it.

This game is meant to be played through multiple times in order to test out the different rope lengths and discover certain secrets hidden within Lily's household.



  • 10+ Main Endings
  • 3+ Hidden Endings
  • An Undisclosed Number of Puzzles
  • 3+ Alternate Names for the Toilet
  • Many things a child named Lily should not see



While Lily's Well is completely free on all platforms, the Lily's Well Bonus Pack is available as DLC for those who wish to directly support the developer. It contains the following:

  • Full Resolution PNG Files of All Cutscene Images
  • Behind the Scenes PDF Book
  • Official Wallpapers
  • Exclusive Art for Possible Future Steam Trading Cards

1834920.name: Countryball: Europe 1890
1834920.about_the_game:
Discover the 19th and 20th centuries with countryballs! Train your countryballs, teach them how to fight, buy them cool weapons, and join great battles with them.

Countryball: Europe 1890 is a strategy game mixed with a turn-based combat mechanic plus cards and stats involved. All of those mechanics make the game more exciting and fun!
You start the Countryball: Europe 1890 by selecting a campaign/conquest game mode and your character afterward. After that, you will try to complete your objectives by conquering territories and mastering diplomacies.
In Countryball: Europe 1890 you can declare war, send ally requests, puppet weakened countries, remove your allies/puppets and even annex your puppet states! You have all the freedom to choose your allies and enemies. Try to have strong allies on your side because there will be battles that you will have to fight against multiple enemies. Before each battle, you have the option to call your allies and puppets to make them join the battle on your side. While allies sometimes accept your call, your puppet states on the other hand always accept your battle calls.
To defeat your enemies in battles, you have to be a strong country. To do that, you should play minigames or you should increase your stats (attack, defense, health, and mana) manually by using star points. To earn star points you should simply win battles. Also, you should buy strong cards from the shop. Each card has different combat effects. You play those cards by simply dragging & dropping on the countryball during combat. Note that all weapons are considered as cards!

In Countryball: Europe 1890, your simple task is to complete the objectives by defeating your enemies. By completing campaigns you get new countryballs to your collection. Note that all 50+ countryballs are available to play. The only thing you need is to find them! Some of them are hidden in capital cities while some of them are acquired by completing campaigns or conquests.

If you have any questions or suggestions, feel free to drop a review or send me an e-mail.

It's time to explore history with countryballs!


Some Music Used In-game
Alexander Nakarada - the Crown
Kevin Macleod - Five Armies
Alexander Nakarada - the Vikings

1834930.name: Ion-Blade League
1834930.about_the_game:
Note:

If you have any feedback from playing the demo please post in the community forms or join me on Discord and drop me a line, I'm constantly polishing, tweaking and improving the game so please don't be shy :)




The Ion-Blade League is a high-speed rally-style racing arena shooter, where your accuracy, speed, quick decision-making and piloting skills matter.

It's All About The Challenge:

No aimless grind for meaningless upgrades, each region and track present its own challenges, obstacles and enemies.
Each unlocked weapon and auxiliary system is unique and features a new game changing mechanic, enhancing replayability.

Resource Management and Strategic Decision-Making:

To maximize your score, quick decisions and calculated sacrifices are essential in handling race resources (time, score, bonus, ammo, HP). This introduces varied strategies and tactics, imparting a unique quality to each race attempt.

Level Editor:

Unleash your creativity and build custom tracks to share with friends and the community.

Ghost Mode:

Record your runs, challenge friends to race against your offline ghost, and brag about your skills.

League Archives:

Compete against the best scores of other pilots around the world.
Champions live forever in the high-score records of the Ion-Blade League, see your position in the League with histograms and progression graphs.


Want a more relaxed experience, join the amateur Ion-Blade League, but remember, only the glorious will enter the eternal archives. Are you ready to leave your mark in the Ion-Blade Racing League?

1834940.name: Hen in the Foxhouse
1834940.about_the_game:
A Chicken rampage is about to sweep through Fox City!
Defeat the foxes of Fox City and destroy their infrastructure by throwing eggs. Originally made for a game jam with the theme 'egg', but updated with plenty of new features.
  • Be a Chicken!
  • Lay eggs!
  • Crush the political and economical structures that hold up Fox society!

1834950.name: Salaryman Shi
1834950.about_the_game:
Traverse colorful environments, battle strange animals and master the power of your suitcases to... get to work on time? Salaryman Shi is a 2D platformer where you play as salaryman Takeshi Shi as you hurry to catch the bus to the office! Twenty challenging levels stand between you and a paycheck, but fear not, as you have your trusty suitcases on your side.

- A dozen levels with unique visuals, songs, gimmicks and enemies
- Complete mission objectives which let you tackle levels in cool new ways
- Beat the best times in Time Attack and win a place in the leaderboards
- Try a much harder reworked adventure in Hard Mode
- Competitive multiplayer where you race your friend to win the game first
- Level the playing field with Assist Mode for less skilled players

1834960.name: Neko Secret - Homecoming
1834960.about_the_game:
When you were traveling around the world, someone told you about an anime factory located in some Neko Town. Now this is your way. Perhaps the anime begins here. Is this your place?

Gameplay

Explore Neko Town looking for hidden objects. Walk down the streets, find new places to get in. Try a variety of mini games like playing darts, picking locks, breaking safes! Try changing your style using character customization. Finally, find the way to get to the anime factory and hack all its computer's data!


Features

  • A short story;
  • 2D and 3D gameplay;
  • 12 arts to unlock;
  • Several mini games;
  • Character customization;

Don't forget to add to your wishlist! It's important for devs :)


Have a look at this DLC!

1834980.name: Ritual Night
1834980.about_the_game:
Hang out in 4-8 player online multiplayer lobbies with your friends or randoms who will soon become your friends. Join the party for one common goal: SUMMON CTHULHU.
At least… if you are a monster.

Deceive Your Friends


To the few human operatives out there: this is your time to shine. Be an absolute menace: lie, sabotage, do everything you can to cause chaos! Remember: friends are temporary, stealing ritual fluid to make magical spells for profit - that is forever.

Second Chances


“But guys, I’m terrible at social deduction games…”
Worry not, noob! Set your skill issue aside for there’s always a second chance in Ritual Night! Without early eliminations, the gameplay becomes more watchable and fun for everyone throughout!

Refined Chaos


Randomness and chaos being core, hidden roles are encouraged to create chaos and cause confusion instead of preventing information from leaking.

Nothing in the game is a direct tell or leak of key information on who the imposter may be. Even if one imposter gets found out early in the game, the tools at their disposal are designed around the potential for causing maximum chaos to muddle that information.

Roguelite, Upgrades, Emergence


Roguelite elements such as procedurally generated props that spawns into the map or additional abilities given to the players as a consequence of their actions.

He's coming...


Join the effort of dominating regions deeply connected to the unfathomable horror that is about to unfold. Uncover secrets, ciphers, and lore that will one day all make sense.

Until then? Enjoy the Party.

1835010.name: Blockies VR
1835010.about_the_game:
Blockies VR is a single player action-puzzle game where you knock down block buildings and protect friendly Blockies against the forces of evil. Launch a wide range of objects at enemies in this low-poly physics world. Travel to the Kingdom’s shop to expand your weapon arsenal to take on the most difficult puzzles in all the land.

Features

  • A dozen types of blocks that interact uniquely with the world
  • A dozen AI enemy types each with their own abilities
  • Levels where you must defend the Blockies from monster attacks
  • Levels with intricate block puzzles to solve
  • The Kingdom where cool new projectiles can be purchased
  • Beautifully designed low poly environments
  • At least 10 levels with block-based and enemy-based levels

Planned Features

  • Level Editor to create and share new levels
  • Co-op and Multiplayer Functionality
  • 40 more levels

Join the Discord to learn more about future updates, and provide your own feedback of what you want in the game!

1835020.name: BornWild • Versus S1 - Prologue
1835020.about_the_game:
Description
BornWild • Versus is an adult cinematic visual novel series set in a futuristic world where war is big money. It tells the adventures of two former child soldiers.
The Prologue offers the first episode of the Volume: "Episode 0: New Start" in a stand-alone version.
Episodes 1 to 8 can be downloaded all at once with the Full Access "BornWild • Versus Season 1, Vol.1".

Story
The events starts in 2053, on Earth where a fragile peace is maintained by international political alliances.

Before, it was about 50 years of territorial conflicts, political clashes fed by the growing scarcity of the raw material and orchestrate, behind closed doors, by a powerful conglomerate.

Raised in that chaotic world, Alexander “Dragon” Drayzaai and Lushian “Weed” Nicolier are two childhood friends, that started in the “War Zone” at a young age.

As former members of the military and spiritual program “Professional Assassins”,
Dragon and Weed have developed prized skills.

They are now working for the Common Army of Europe (UNECA), and chain “Die in Piece” missions, missions that no one wants.

Features
  • Wild Action
    Chases, close quarters, gunfights... Dragon and Weed take no break, so will you

  • Unique Visuals
    A cinematic adventure with an unique graphic style and dynamic staging

  • Audio Immersion
    Characters made alive by voice acting wrapped with a captivating and diverse soundtrack

1835030.name: Traveler Bird
1835030.about_the_game:
Use your mouse to control the bird, left click to flap its wings or right click to stop the flight. Avoid the obstacles on your way and try to find the end of your journey.

Every moment you find a new difficulty, but remember not to give up, in the end there will be a reward of great value.

There will be 50 different levels in which the bird will encounter various obstacles that hindered him to reach his final destination.

Each level will have a difficulty progression.

1835040.name: Pangaroids
1835040.about_the_game:
Pangaroids is a small retro arcade shooter with simple mechanics, designed for the high score chaser in all of us.

Endless survival score chasing gameplay inspired by some of our favourite arcade classics like Asteroids and Pang!

  • Command your ship to clear the screen of waves of enemy metal orbs.
  • Easy to learn, simple controls to turn your ship, boost, and brake. Keyboard controls – arrow keys for moving, spacebar for shooting.
  • Your ship can’t stop. Turn it left and right and use your thrust and brake to keep from crashing into enemies.
  • Shooting big orbs will cause them to split into smaller orbs. Sometimes they will release a power-up.
  • Pick up a wide variety of awesome power-ups to help you survive longer. But beware bad power-ups that speed up enemies, enlarge or slow your ship down, annoyingly reverse your controls, or encase your ship in a block of ice... making survival even more challenging. So why pick up bad power-ups? They're worth a lot more points! No risk, no reward.
  • Don't like a spawned power-up? Shoot it until it changes to something you like. That is, if you think you have enough time to pick it up...
  • Get the high score.
  • Enjoy the chip tunes.

1835060.name: Christmas Celebration With Sakuya Izayoi
1835060.about_the_game:
This is a unofficial fangame of the Touhou Project series. It is permitted under the Touhou Project Derivative Work Guidelines. Please support the official releases, some of which are available on Steam!

FEATURES

  • Beautiful artwork, several gorgeous and stunning scenes with colourful expressions throughout the game!
  • Engaging dialogue! Including several references to the official Touhou Project games print works and manga!
  • Casual visual novel gameplay to relax and unwind with!

STORY

The Hakurei Shrine Maiden had this brilliant idea to host a Christmas themed festival in the human village, and it immediately caught on! All of the residents of Gensokyo, human or youkai are invited to celebrate Christmas and have fun in any way they can!
You're out on a date with Sakuya and you're there to have fun with her as you explore the various sights and attractions going around in the festival!
1835060.supported_languages: English, Korean, Russian, Japanese, Spanish - Latin America

1835070.name: Gem Raider 2
1835070.about_the_game:
Overview
After 15 years of battling the sentient Gems on our turf, we have finally figured out how to teleport our Raider ships into their home dimension. It's time to take the fight there!

We found their primary military headquarters and determined their weakness. Destroy all of the Power Gems within the 20 rooms in the HQ and they should be leaving us alone for a good long time!

Remember that you only get 1 Raider to use and when its shield has been used up, the next hit will destroy it. Let's see how many rooms you can clear!

Objective
In each room, destroy all Power Gems and then return to the teleport pad to exit.

For bonus points, destroy all Gems in the room. For even more bonus points, do this as quickly as possible.

Complete all 20 rooms without letting your Raider be destroyed for ultimate glory.

1835080.name: Taste Of Heaven
1835080.about_the_game:
Embark on a relaxing, wholesome, flavorful trip and cook up an unforgettable journey through the very birthplace of the Universe

Engulf yourself in a colorful after world

Taste of Heaven encapsulates a delicate blend between a cooking game and an RPG, in which creativity and strategy are interwoven within a world of flavors. Along your celestial journey, you will get to craft unique dishes for gods, but you will also have to satiate every hungry soul out there. Who knows? You might even be able to charm some of the divine spirits wandering in this scrumptious and vibrant land of eternal dreams.

Cook within the divine

Discover our unique and seamless recipe system that invites you to use every ingredient and tools at your disposal to satisfy waves of hungry, demanding customers. Be careful, though, as each of them has their own distinctive personality and unique challenges!


Mingle with gods and godlings

In Taste of Heaven, you'll encounter an eccentric cast of characters, intriguing creatures, and souls with some… unresolved issues. Be prepared to wine and dine some lonely souls in order to deepen bonds, because there might also be a pinch of romance on the menu.

Shape each run into a unique journey

Discover a plethora of items, perks, hidden secrets and unique events, which will turn each run into a one-of-a-kind adventure.

Make a home in the void

Gather resources and build your own hotel within the belly of a giant fish. Along the way, travelers will stop by, each bringing a helping hand and a story to share as you blossom your own peaceful oasis for them to unwind and relax.
1835080.supported_languages: English, French, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Spain, Spanish - Latin America, Traditional Chinese

1835090.name: Flipped
1835090.about_the_game:
Come join us on Ethan Klein's journey through meme-land to get to the bottom of the contention regarding the app which is flipped (or inverted to use the technical term).

The unofficial fan game for the H3H3Productions Thriller controversy.



Traverse through meme-land from beginning to end that tells a unique fictional story about H3Podcast's interactions with big name influencers, and fight them mano a mano to progress the protagonist and his friends to new heights in the narrative. What awaits Ethan and Co. might surprise you, it certainly surprised us.

Gameplay is a mix between Platformer and Fight Game genres, with some cut-scenes. Make your way through each level to meet the next fighter!

This game is free, and was created by a solo developer in three months to bring awareness about the similarities between Ryan Weinsten and Harvey Kavanaugh, of which was accused by ex-partner of running a ponzi scheme according to Variety Magazine; a well established and respectable weekly newspaper. This game seeks to clarify whom of the two is who, but we aren't quite sure you'll walk away with a clearer picture after playing this game as its very hard to tell them apart. But we'll do our best.

Features big names like;

  • Ethan Klein
  • Hasan Piker
  • Sam Seder
  • And Many More!

1835120.name: Pirate Dragons
1835120.about_the_game:
Pirate Dragons is a third-person, action RPG where you play a dragon in a world filled with sailing ships, islands, trade routes, pirates, and much more.

Battle against other sailing ships from different factions, grow your dragon's power, learn new breath weapons, build your own sailing fleet, and make your mark!



Features
  • Play a dragon!
  • Third-person, high flying, action combat.
  • Explore an open world of islands, sailing ships, and piracy.
  • Use power-ups to increase your fire damage, heal you, and recharge your breath weapons.
  • Level up to learn new breath weapons and other skills.
  • Build a fleet of ships to help you trade goods and battle against other factions.
  • Upgrade your ships with better crews, sails, cannons, and hulls.
  • Complete missions, become a merchant, or engage in piracy!
  • An economy that changes based on your actions.

  • Grow your hoard to become the richest and most powerful dragon ever!

1835190.name: One Last Breath
1835190.about_the_game:
One Last Breath tells a story about despair but also about hope. Even if the post-apocalyptic world of this 2.5D adventure is withered, Gaia’s powers might be enough to restore life. That won’t be easy, though. Lots of fearsome mutants will hunt her mercilessly






Born from mother nature’s very last breath, Gaia has the ability to control the environment. Create paths using trunks, summon vines to hang between gaps, and solve puzzles using your powers to save our planet.






Humanity doesn’t exist anymore. Decades of pollution and greed have driven it to absolute extinction. However, its echo still can be heard. Along her journey, Gaia will visit abandoned factories filled with hazardous, human-made obstacles. How are they still working?






Gaia’s adventure is all about balance. She will find both brutality and tenderness while trying to survive strange creatures and protect the defenceless ones. Only our world can be as ruthless as charming.






● Use your supernatural powers to solve all kinds of environmental-based puzzles.
● Discover what happened to mankind while exploring a gorgeous but sorrowful world.
● Escape from lethal mutants and save the helpless wildlife.
● Enjoy an immersive experience thanks to a carefully crafted sound design.
● Don’t forget to take care of our planet in real-life!

1835200.name: Titanic: Fall Of A Legend
1835200.about_the_game:
The RMS Titanic was called the ship of dreams and said to be unsinkable


Step aboard the most famous ocean liner that ever set sail and experience the RMS Titanic in all of its glory. You take on the role of a first-class passenger on the Titanic, witnessing the tragic iceberg collision and the sinking of the largest and most luxurious ocean liner to have ever been built. Immerse yourself in this simulation and discover what happened on that dark cold night of April 14th, 1912. You are able to explore select interiors and the whole exterior of the Titanic as it slips beneath the waves. Discover what it was like on the lower decks of the Titanic as freezing ocean water poured into the cabins.

NOTE: This is a simulation experience not a story game.



Titanic was referred to as the unsinkable ship, however on its maiden voyage to New York it struck an iceberg and sunk in just 2 hours and 40 minutes. This simulation accurately depicts Titanic’s last moments from the iceberg collision to the ship splitting in half.

The experience contains breathtaking visuals and sound effects, providing an immersive environment.

The simulation has a duration of approximately 30 minutes.

1835210.name: Roadworks 2
1835210.about_the_game:
City building real time strategy economy simulation game. Efficiently manage your city by setting up industries and houses.
Produce and transport enough resources in time while building a carefully planned road network.

Play against opponents online through Steam matchmaking by simultaneously building your cities and influencing each others' production power.

Includes 5 unlockable campaign levels where the game mechanics are explained.

1835220.name: ILLUMI-NAUGHTY ;) - Remastered
1835220.about_the_game:
Hello, and welcome!
to my magnum opus! I was commissioned from god to bring you all this masterpiece of art. I sincerely hope you treat it with the reverence and respect such an important piece of media deserves

you have been tasked with infiltrating illuminati head
quarters, and messing them up big time!

as you could probably guess from the title, this is a
remastered version of my first ever interactive software
project! but y'know, hopefully much better.


What is illumi-naughty?
Using a revolutionary new science technique, scientists can extract the raw extract from memes and meme related sub cultures. Then, our very talented engineers can take it and imbue it into entertainment interactive software based products! this is our first real test, any and all feedback to our research staff is appreciated!

ok, what does this mean for me?
Glad you asked! all this will manifest to your senses like a pixelart top-down shooter game. You will kill a wide variety of enemies, and collect a large assortment of firearms. You'll be tasked with exploring the massive illuminati headquarters and taking out their line of command, and saving the world.png

All this will have a skin on top that might look to you like meme culture from around 2015 or so, we had to use older memes for our experiments as they were more stable than newer ones, but still had the energy needed for this project that even older memes would have lacked

Gameplay
Click the left mouse button to shoot a bullet(x1) this newly formed bullet will travel away from you toward the ms paint made crosshair on your screen, which coincidentally is also controlled by moving your mouse around (i know this is complicated, so bare with me)

You can ALSO use the w, a, s and d keys on your keyboard to move around! this was originally a $50 add on for the game, but I was feeling especially generous and decided to package it into the main game for free, I hope you enjoy! (but don't get used to getting freebies in the future)

Over the course of your adventure, you will pickup different weapon types! you can use the 'tab' key or the scroll wheel on your mouse to switch out what weapon you are using to murderize with

The 'escape' key pauses the game. I don't know why it does this, I've tried all I could to remove it but every time the game is built, it re-introduces itself. Just letting you know to ignore it completely and the intended experience for this game means no pausing - ever - for any reason.

By now, that bullet you fired in the first part of this section should be making contact with an enemy, if you're good (how exciting!) or a wall if you're not (not so exciting) when this bullet thing interacts with an enemy, some of the health, well being, hopes and dreams, etc of the enemy will be depleted, shoot them with enough of those bullet things to make the idea of living unbearable for them, to the point where they decide to spontaneously combust where they stand. Congrats! all your hard work is beginning to pay off, right before your eyes!

Now, some of these enemies are tougher than others, and you might not remember what every gun does, but not to worry! I have implemented an 'About' screen, where you can keep track of every badguy you shoot, every gun you hoard and even what Achievements you've unlocked (insert ooo and ahhh sfx here) so if you ever forget somehow, take a gander over there to read and study :)

Okay so, to progress in the game you simply have to move forward, hurray! At the end of each chapter is a boss fight - whoever was in charge of that section of the Denver airport will notice your presence and try to stop you, so you'll have to use logic and facts to beat them in a 1 v 1 argument. Or you can shoot them, whichever you find easier. Killing them unlocks the next part and creates a checkpoint so you don't lose any progress.

When the game ends and your life has been enriched due to this experience, I hope you will consider forcing all your friends and family to also play :D
if you liked it, than I applaud your excellent taste! if you didn't, well that's ok, were all wrong sometimes.

If you still don't know what this game is, or what it's about, then I suggest repeating grades 1-5 and trying again, I'll still be here when you return, so don't worry :)

you can call me punk, and I hope you enjoy your stay here


tl;dr
1.shoot badguys
2.explore area
3.profit

1835240.name: Spiritfall

Spiritfall combines tight Platform Fighter combat, smooth movement, and Roguelite mechanics into one! Trek across dangerous lands, string together deadly combos to fend off swarms of enemies, and harness an ever-changing set of powers through a randomly generated map.

The divine spirits offer powerful blessings that enhance your abilities in combat. Discover your favorite abilities, and experiment with different builds. With over 150+ blessings to choose from, these gifts allow for a range of tactical approaches that encourage you to find synergies that fit your playstyle.

Death is but a temporary setback. Reawaken stronger than before at the Sanctum and continue your adventure. Use the resources you gathered to upgrade your skills, unlock unique powers, and awaken mighty weapons with unique movesets.

A heartfelt thank you to our Early Access community! Your feedback has been invaluable during Spiritfall's development, helping make the game what it is today. We invite you to keep shaping our world together. Connect with fellow players on Discord and get the latest news by joining our newsletter.

1835260.name: Brewmastery: Tavern Simulator
1835260.about_the_game:
Build your own medieval brewery with a full set of realistic equipment and get the most out of all the intricacies of making drinks. From harvesting to malting, from brewing to aging, fermentation, filtration, and finally serving your drinks to Tavern guests. Immerse yourself in the entertaining process of brewing through all the stages.

As you play, you'll have to develop the old Tavern, which you inherited from your uncle, and turn it into the best place in this magical land! You have two floors and dozens of functional rooms that can be upgraded and changed to your liking. An authentic brewery on two floors will not leave anyone indifferent. Upgrade your equipment and keep an eye on its wear and tear, because the quality of your drinks depends on it!

From your own vegetable garden on the adjoining grounds where you can grow ingredients, to the noisy and fun Tavern Hall, where music plays and beer pours like a river. From the impressive two-story brewery filled with all sorts of brewing equipment to the cozy player's bedroom, which houses a secret study that opens up as the building evolves.

But that's not all. The story-oriented simulator allows you to plunge into the vibey atmosphere of the fantasy world, where the guests of the Tavern will share their stories with the player, tell the latest gossip of the local lands, as well as give tasks, by completing which you can improve your reputation and make the Tavern a well-known place. Entertaining quests will give you freedom of choice, where every decision you make will be reflected in the course of events. Accidentally (not really) dropped a fly amanita into the vat with the Governor's favorite beer, a local regular, or overheated the malt? Get ready for the consequences – both fun and not so fun! The player writes the history of the Tavern with his decisions.
