1837700.about_the_game:
Test your brain and your reflexes. Try to combine bubbles before they reach the top and match the target before time runs out. Earn powerups along the way to help you survive longer.

With every level the bubbles appear and move faster. Chose from Beginner, Easy, Medium and Difficult Settings. Each one makes it harder by increasing spawn rate, bubble speed and reducing perks – so you’ll always be challenged.
1837700.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Dutch, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Vietnamese, Czech, Greek, Hungarian, Romanian, Swedish, Thai, Ukrainian, Bulgarian, Danish, Finnish, Norwegian, Filipino, Hebrew

1837730.name: Loot List: Thief Sim
1837730.about_the_game:
Loot List is a thief simulator and action game about robbery. There's one difference though - here, every heist has to have a list...
LIST ▶ Steal everything on it! The list can have anything on it — play it by ear.

WORLD ▶ Empty bank vaults, sneak into government buildings, look for gang caches and don't forget the other areas. Every place is an opportunity to hit it rich here.

PHYSICS ▶ Build a pyramid of junk to climb into a hard-to-access area, or just trash everything around. Why not?

INTERACTIVITY ▶ Do you want to steal access codes and carefully disarm security systems, or take a bomb on the job and show the cops a good time? Your call.

LEVELING UP ▶ Become a master thief — unlock the toughest robberies and pull them off using incredible equipment. And don't forget to buy a house!

CO-OP (2-4) ▶ The more the merrier! Steal people blind with your buddies, or do the opposite — be a cop and stop them from taking anything.
1837730.supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Turkish
*languages with full audio support

1837780.name: Spellcaster
1837780.about_the_game:
Gameplay

In Spellcaster you control a mage who has to defend his hut from hordes of monsters. Lots of bullets and spells to choose from which you can buy from local store. Choose your build before the next level and face the creatures in this top-down, tower defence, shoot 'em up, action game.

Story

You lived peacefully in the middle of a dark forest. Gathering herbs, creating potions, and studying magic were your daily activities. It was like that until terrifying monsters started haunting you. Who ordered them to disturb your peace?
Plunge yourself in the fantasy world by following the story of the old wizard and reading the rich descriptions in the bestiary.

Modes

Two modes available: campaign and freeplay. The campaign include structured levels with epic boss fights that end in fighting the main villain.
Freeplay is an endless gameplay with randomly generated levels. Check yourself how far you can go!

Atmosphere

Beautiful, warm colors. Bright, cartoon, fantasy graphics. Atmospheric music.

1837800.name: Beyond the Board - DTDA Games
1837800.about_the_game:
Beyond the Board is a set of several board games that you can try out on your own or with others players. By moving around with your character, you can to sit at different tables and play board games:
- Pyrophora: Amokye & Xolotl are mini-games by DTDA Games
- Apogee: Apogee is a card management game that takes you to discover the objectives and challenges of the new space.
- Light Hunters: Light Hunters is a Heroic Fantasy card game, for two players, form your battalions, choose your heroes and crush the opposite team !
- Resonance: Resonance is a maleficient card game. Use the 8 Ritual Objects needed to summon your demon you may have won the game.
- Orion Duel: Try to connect your tiles smartly while not giving too much opportunities, by Matagot.
- Ephios by DistoStudio
- Pantareï by Cosmoludo

Explore this strange land, meet other explorers, and battle them around a game table or in an arena!
Join the entire Beyond The Board community while enjoying a game!
- Explore and interact with a unique fantasy world
- Play Board Games in Solo or with friends
- Challenge the community in mini-Games
- Collect the different character and reward hidden in the game

1837810.name: Blue Chips: economic multiplayer board game
1837810.about_the_game:
Blue Chips is a turn-based strategy board game where you have to survive and attain success in a severe economic world. Try to earn money from trading cryptocurrency, gold, stock exchange and real estate to buy and upgrade your business. Make your opponents bankrupt to become the best.



The map contains cells of businesses and assets. If you stand up in the business cell you are able to buy this cell. That means if another player stands up on this cell they have to pay you. Payment depends on business size and level. Business size is permanent for each business cell but level is upgradable and hold IPO. Each upgrade becomes available only if you cross this cell again.



If you stand up in an asset cell you are able to buy an asset. There are some types of assets and each type works in a different way. Use assets to earn money and manipulate the market. For example you can buy a lot of gold and all business becomes more expensive for all players including you. It's a good idea if you already have a business and you don't need to buy it.



Currency - Rises if you buy it and falls if you sell it. Rising and falling are pretty stable.
Cryptocurrency - Rises if you buy it and falls if you sell it. Rising and falling are not stable.
Stocks - Changes if any player stands up on this type of asset cell. Rising and falling are very unstable.
Gold - Rises if you buy it and doesn't fall if you sell. Affects the other assets.
Real estate - Gives you income every time you cross the start cell.
Stocks of players - Price depends on the player's total capital.

1837820.name: Faded Stories: Greenberg
1837820.about_the_game:
The sad truth about a place of endless possibilities is... It's hard to tell a real story from a fairy tale. If everything can happen, then how do you know anything is true? And if you fail to record your history... it's like you never existed. The city of Greenberg has no beginning, but its end is near.

Here in the city of Greenberg time is meaningless, and space is infinite. The city has endless history and yet... The whole place is fading away. True, verified stories are rare, spread over time. If you are interested, you can experience them for yourself. More people learn about this city, the longer it will stay on the map.

Play the abstract point & click game and experience the amazing atmosphere of this place. The game is divided into a series of short stories, where each chapter has its own unique theme. Find alternative paths and discover as many secrets as possible.

Game Features:

  • An original, abstract world full of creative concepts and ideas
  • Minimalist art style
  • Atmospheric ambient
  • Alternative paths and secrets

1837840.name: CatMxn: Chapter 1
1837840.about_the_game:
There have been reports of cat murders in South-East Portland. No one knows if its a person or animal mutilating the cats.

Play as CatMxn a random guy who goes to sleep and enters a dream with new found abilities and is called to action by Cat Deities. When he wakes up his life is forever changed and something different is in the air. Why can he now understand what the cats are telling him. Is that a meow or a "help me"?

In this game you will:
  • Harness the primal power of cats.
  • Navigate the 2-D world as you try to go to work on time.
  • Punch and transform into a cat to ultimately hunt down and attack BucketHead cat abuser.

This is a story based 2-D platformer video game adaptation of an original YouTube Film "CatMxn". The story was inspired by events that happened in Portland, Oregon between 2009-2020.

1837870.name: Downroll
1837870.about_the_game: This is a miniature arcade platformer in which you have to control the ball. The ball descends from top to bottom along the rising platforms. Your task is to move the ball left and right in order to manage to go down the platforms and not be squeezed at the top. The game features three difficulty modes. On the hardest, all your finger dexterity and reaction speed will be required as the platforms will rise quickly enough. With the passage of each platform, you are awarded record points. Collect as many as possible and good luck with the game.

1837890.name: The Gummiest Bear Challenge
1837890.about_the_game:
Are you ready to accept The Gummiest Bear Challenge ?

It is a physics based 3D platformer where you race against time.
Try to get the best time possible by completing various fun/challenging levels.
You control a jelly-like bear (that is part of the challenge) and you have to roll & jump to get you through the levels that are filled with some obstacles.

You can play the game as single player or with your friend using local multiplayer mode (split screen).

The game is intended to be like "easy to pickup, but hard to master" kind of game so it has some light precision platforming elements to it.

This game utilizes 3D spatial audio elements to give more immersion so headphones are recommended but not required.

Key Features:

  • For fans of 3D platformers and people who likes fun racing games and wants some new challenge
  • No racing cars only gummy bears
  • 1 - 2 player time challenge
  • Multiple levels (new levels are unlocked after previous levels are completed)
  • 3D spatial audio to add some immersion
  • Easy to pickup but hard to master
  • Light precision platforming
  • Challenging controls (can be learnt pretty quickly)
  • Keyboard + mouse and most gamepads (similar to XBOX-360) are supported

1837900.name: sol 3000
1837900.about_the_game: SOL 3000 is based on a future Earth timeline were humanity has been fighting against a rouge mother AI system in a great war. In this science fiction action shooter you play St. Karen, a Soldier of Light armed with an advanced spiritual suit of armor and weapons. Your mission is to destroy the remaining rouge AI robot forces and strongholds, with the main objective of reaching the central hub and defeating the mother AI. Explore barren landscapes, industrial compounds, battle robotic hordes and uncover the history of Earth in the year 3000.

1837910.name: BridgeTeam: Ship Simulator
1837910.about_the_game:
BridgeTeam: Ship Simulator

Sail the open ocean or test your skills in docking at busy harbours. Use the radar to show trails and prevent collisions. Bridge Team: Ship Simulator is a ship simulator built from the ground up, and aiming to build on the legacy of the previous ship simulator series (note: we are not affiliated with the previous ship sim devs in any way).

Instead of a user manual, we've decided to make a video on basic simulator operations. You can find the link at the bottom of this description.

Bridge Team contains:
- Highly realistic ships
- A fully functioning RADAR with True & Relevant Motion Trails.
- Planned features coming soon: EBL, VRM, and Parallel Index lines.
- Basic conning screen
- Basic autopilot system
- NMEA support via TCP/IP protocol - connect to real world ECDIS and other NMEA equipment
- NMEA currently supports $GPRMC format. We plan to add other formats too. We can also satisfy any NMEA formats by request.
- NMEA currently is via TCP/IP only.
- Ocean system with bow and stern wakes
- AI ships
- Realistic wind/tide effects
- Accurate simulation models
- ... and much more!

YouTube link to user manual replacement video:

1837920.name: Mining Cats
1837920.about_the_game:
Now the kittens are working in gemstone mines. Every time a mine cart unloads at the end of the railway track, they go down the stairs to collect the gems.

Each level has a grid of squares with colored gems occupying some of the squares. The objective is to connect gem mines of the same color by drawing 'gunpowder trail' between them such that when it explodes, the entire grid is occupied by railway tracks. However, railway tracks may not intersect. Difficulty is primarily determined by the size of the grid, ranging from 4x4 to 7x7 squares.

1 - Click on a gemstone mine and drag the mouse towards another gemstone mine of the same color:

2 - All barrels must be destroyed:

3 - Railway tracks may not intersect:

4 - The kittens go down the stairs to collect the gems:


Features:

  • Solve 200 puzzles carefully selected;
  • Enjoy four different types of environments;
  • Soundtrack to help you keep your focus and concentration;
  • Everything in the game was made with a lot of love and craftsmanship.
1837920.supported_languages: English, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian

1837980.name: Our Elusive Suffering
1837980.about_the_game:
Our Elusive Suffering is a cryptic horror game where you take part in a mysterious blood ritual in an ancient city whose walls are dripping with madness.
Consumed with fear and facing monsters that blur the concept of reality, you will have to find your way in the stuffy fog to finally find a purpose.

Nothing will be explained.
Nothing will be given.
Everything will be figured out, eventually.

1838030.name: Possession Obsession
1838030.about_the_game:
Possession Obsession is a 2-4 player local multiplayer party game. As interns, you and your friends will compete for a coveted position at the infamous HELLC. Utilize your demonic powers and possess mortals to complete the boss's tasks in any way possible.

MOUNDS OF MORTALS TO POSSESS!

Possess mortals at any time! Gain special abilities from whomever you possess to help you complete the HELLC's tasks and impede the progress of your fellow interns.

4 DIFFERENT DEMONIC CLASSES

Make use of 4 unique classes to crush the competition. Each class has access to 2 abilities in demon form and another when possession a mortal.

FRIENDSHIP RUINING TASKS TO FIGHT OVER!

Fight over the many tasks the HELLC assigns to be the intern that gets the job!

1838070.name: BOK
1838070.about_the_game:
BOK: The Irrational adventure with poorly drawn characters. Ever wondered what it's like to be a chicken that's always at the brink of death? No? Why not? Okay, well then how about we make the art style absolutely terrible and up the difficulty by about 22. Still no? Well, you might be out of luck.

The very extraordinary adventure includes:

- 15 unique levels with five different areas to suffer through

- Alternative difficulty game modes

- Extra end-game content

- Cosmetic options with 10 different hats to choose from

- Crabs???

- And more to come, I guess.

Be prepared to be frustrated unless you are an epic gamer, as after countless tests from only an elite selection of gamers (my parents) have tried and failed to complete the game without complaints about difficulty. If you find it too hard, you can try easy mode in the extras menu, and if you find it too easy, there's always hard mode to try. And then limited lives mode. But don't try to do limited lives mode. Seriously.

BOK is a 2D Indie-Platformer made over the span of about a year by a 13-year-old kid with no experience of coding and learned it along the way. So while that feat. may seem impressive, it may prove to not be after install, mainly proven by the minimalistic and simplistic art style. However, the cartoony feel should make it a more laid-back experience that many can enjoy, as long as you disregard any rage you feel along the way. Have fun!!...

1838080.name: Agent Stilus
1838080.about_the_game:
Agent Stilus is a 2D side-scrolling platformer shooter.
Omega Corp creates implants and chips for implantation into people. The bandits have stolen a batch of chips and are going to change the encoding and implant these chips in everyone in order to enslave free people and make them their puppets. You are a special agent who was sent to take the prototype chips back before the villains put production on stream.

Cyberpunk setting.
Several types of weapons.
Enemies are armed with different weapons.

1838100.name: Conveyance
1838100.about_the_game:
Your 3D conveyor transportation and machine processing sandbox construction kit.

Using conveyors, machines and logic modules you will create inter-connected logistics that produce and store all manner of objects from the basic raw blue ore through to the fabled golden cube. Conveyance rewards progress with faster conveyors, faster machines, and smarter logic modules. The end game though isn't necessarily to strive to unlock all these things (although that is super fun), rather, it is to explore, construct and improve your small table-sized world of creation to look and behave exactly how you think it should.

Streamlined, compact and efficient...or ridiculously over-engineered...it's up to you!

Key Features


Your construction toolkit includes 12 machines and 5 logic modules, as well as a uniquely powerful conveyor system to join all of the inputs and outputs together. Conveyance is also fully 3D which means you can go up in the world and create various "levels" of machinery, connections and componentry. All machines, except for the ground-based Miner, can operate as high above your humble creation as need be.

The casual gameplay of Conveyance is underpinned by a sandbox play style with zero time limits. Within this core design, the following features are available:

  • Multiple machine types including Miners, Splitters, Factories, Containers and Vaults
  • Powerful 3D node-based conveyor system allowing complete flexibility with belt layout
  • Configurable Factory recipes to create the needed production line items
  • Freeform layout or grid-snapping when in Construction mode
  • Efficiency driven rewards including faster conveyors and quicker recipe creation
  • Logic modules that enhance behaviour and awareness including the speed radar, warning strobe and power switch
  • Intuitive and powerful camera controls including saved presets
  • Sophisticated editing tools including drag, drop, multi-select, clone and extrude
  • Design helpers when editing in 3D above ground level including conveyor alignment legs and unique "Level Masking" tool
  • Collection of static props for those extra visual touches including witches hats, barriers and signs
  • Built in mini-tutorial and quick-help
  • Chill background sound tracks, no stress here...

Future Roadmap


We're excited by our first release of Conveyance, but also, equally excited by our short-term future roadmap. It might sound a bit strange to be discussing future plans when we've just released our 1.0 version, but it is important for us to convey (no pun intended) our genuine commitment to this product. The confirmed additional features, which unfortunately didn't make the first drop in time, include

  • Automated switching logic
  • Lighting
  • More machine types
  • Additional items and recipes
  • Feature requests from community feedback

Please join us in our journey this year to deliver and enhance what we hope will be a unique (and most importantly, fun) experience within the genre. We're truly focused on making Conveyance the best it can be.

Best wishes to all from the teeny-tiny team here in Australia...

1838120.name: SIMULSAGA: DATA_BREAK
1838120.about_the_game:
SIMULSAGA: DATA_BREAK is a darkly humorous horror RPG. You play as an office drone who lives a seemingly ordinary life, but something isn't right... A mysterious stranger will soon set into motion a series of events that gradually reveal the horrifying truth...

Inspirations include Earthbound, Undertale, One Shot and LISA: The Painful.

Features

  • Experience a mundane existence in game, as well as in real life!

  • Get showered, go to work, eat, sleep!

  • A PLAYABLE TOILET!

  • Beat or befriend foes like spiders, the elderly, teens, someone that definitely isn't Mickey Mouse, your boss, and more.

  • Lots of choices, and some that will bite you in the *** later!

  • Care for your cat. Or not because you are heartless POS.

  • An awesome original and authentic 8-bit soundtrack

  • Lots of jokes, references and Easter eggs

  • Short but sweet, with several endings - Expect the length of a long movie for an average playthough. For 100% completion up to 10 hours

  • Learn the meaning of life*

*you might not learn the meaning of life.
1838120.reviews:
“Shaping up to be a great game with a fun blend of charm and fourth wall breaking creepiness.”


“Any game that requires you to get points by kissing your cat is an automatic 11/10 for me. Game of the Year!”
11/10 –

1838130.name: Hellscape
1838130.about_the_game:
What is Hellscape?

Hellscape is a text-based adventure game, full of puzzles, a little bit of combat, and a lot of terrible jokes. You play Hellscape using only a keyboard, by typing the actions you want to perform.

What Awaits Me in Hell?

  • Puzzles, some designed by Satan himself
  • A bunch of monsters. Demons, Skeletons, Goblins and more.
  • Literally not one real graphic
  • A terrible narrator
  • Diet Paint?
  • An endless stairway (Or is it?)
  • A sick pair of shades that you can't see through...
  • You can kiss the rat
  • Other cool... stuff...
  • Actually I think kissing the rat is the only good feature in the game

1838140.name: Snowman Adventure
1838140.about_the_game:
Snowman Adventure is a third-person platformer. In this cool game you play as John the snowman. You have to get through all the obstacles to complete this game. This game will give you unforgettable emotions of joy and fun. Play it with cheerful and perky music!

Would you like to feel like a snowman? If yes, then do not pass by this game. Plunge into the world of fun! Play this third person adventure game! Get real pleasure, passing incredibly difficult and truly dangerous tests. It will be incredibly Lego to die in this game, but it will not be easy to win and reach the end !!! Enjoy playing this game with funny music that will definitely not let you get bored!

Features of the game:
Fun music and cool atmosphere!
Catchy, intuitive gameplay!
Incredibly cool levels!
Very beautiful graphics!
Great music!

1838200.name: Rettungssimulator
1838200.about_the_game:
Im Rettungssimulator (kurz: ReSi) sitzt du in der Leitstelle und koordinierst die Kräfte von Feuerwehr, Polizei und Rettungsdienst.



Über 120 verschiedene Einsätze warten auf dich! Diese haben jeweils unterschiedliche Varianten und eine Vielzahl an dynamischen Anrufen.
So entdeckts du immer etwas neues und bist bei jedem Notruf aufs neue gefordert.



Auf einer echten Karte kannst du deine eigenen Wachen planen und bauen. Im Anschluss musst du dort passende Fahrzeuge stationieren, um dein Einsatzgebiet perfekt abzudecken.



Trete einem Verband bei und schließe dich mit anderen Spielenden zusammen. Tauscht euch im gemeinsamen Chat aus und bewältigt gemeinsam komplexe Einsatzlagen. Im Rettungsdienst könnt ihr euch gegenseitig mit freigegebenen Krankenhäusern unterstützen, um eure Patienten dort einzuliefern.
Für die Zukunft sind viele weitere Funktionen für Verbände geplant.



Wir versorgen euch regelmäßig mit neuen Funktionen, Einsätzen und Fehlerbehebungen.
Werfe am besten einen Blick auf den Abschnitt Early-Access weiter oben auf der Seite

1838220.name: Wave Jumper
1838220.about_the_game:
Wave Jumper is a 80's Synthwave platformer aimed at keeping momentum high and decisions quick. Use Bounce pads to preserve momentum and portals to switch momentum quickly. Beware the Synthspikes, Synthbeams, and Synthdiamonds.

If you get tired you can always try out the pong by inputting the super secret code on the bottom of the settings screen at the main menu, but you have to do it in the level select to get it work.

1838240.name: Smipat and the Lost Bones
1838240.about_the_game:
Description

Smipat and the Lost Bones ​is a 2D Action RPG with leveling, Hack & Slash elements and puzzles. The game is greatly inspired by the old Legend of Zelda games.

WARNING

This game is in early stages of develeopment. The playtest might contain some bugs. Keep in mind there will be a lot of changes in the future.

Current Playtest content

  • 7 (temporary) test levels
  • 4 Playable items: The Bone, Bonehamer, Bonebomb and Bone & Arrow.
  • 3 Types of enemies: Basic slime, Mouse and Spider.
  • 1 Boss: the Slime King, King Slime "Yes very orginal"
  • 2 Environments: Graveyard and Dungeon
  • A few interactable objects. Like pressure plates, levers and doors.
  • Built-in Bugreportsystem
  • Built-in Feedbacksystem

Discord

Join our Discord to keep up to date with versions and be part of the development.
Link:

Roadmap

Graveyard -> Dungeon -> Cave -> Natures Sanctuary -> Sky Tower -> Sand Temple ->Ice and Fire Temple -> Swamp -> Dark Temple -> End Temple

Future Content

  • A total of 10 unique items with each it's own use for puzzles
  • A progressive leveling system
  • Gear that makes you stronger and more resistant
  • Talents to change your way of playing
  • A total of 10 epic boss battles
  • More than 30 enemies with each its own small mechanics
  • A total of 12 environment types

1838250.name: Lost Contact
1838250.about_the_game:
I have always been alarmed by the J87 quadrant of the planeseeker by planet Costo. It would seem that space libertians, free and independent warriors, prowling in the vastness of the universe for a chance to snatch their lucky jackpot, had to penetrate into the more hellish parallels of neutrino star clusters. But this small shining point of INTELLIGENT K87 station, hovering at the edge of the event horizon, its weak nitric trickles, for a moment shuddering and disappearing into the huge all-embracing void of the Black Hole, made even the Costarian turn yellow with horror.
Our INFILTRA has passed more than 5 light years, filtering signals from malfunctioning systems of ships, stations and artificial planets. Why INTELLIGENT K87! I do not believe in bad signs, forebodings and other nonsense. But here my brain began desperately to send out calls not to receive the faulty signal. Maybe these are just flashbacks of typical space stories about INTELLIGENT K87 - all these stories about cracks and hybrogembs, techno-hybrids explicated by a black hole into our planar life projections.

The docking of INFILTRA with INTELLIGENT K87 went surprisingly smoothly. No station system has blocked our LOCKER. It was as if the station was waiting for us. The launch of the station's biocomponent sniffer-analyzers revealed the standard level of live presence of the space shuttle. We have already passed the third block of the living compartment, but no one contacted us. Such emptiness is alarming.

A presence is detected at the station, but the sensors are not detecting movement. All living things of the station froze. “And apparently it also dematerialized,” states our First, entering the 4th empty compartment of the station. “We must leave the station and return to INFILTRA. From our ship we will be able to thoroughly scan the insides of this damn empty shell”. This decision was fatal. As soon as we deactivated the weapon and turned towards the docking socket, sensors from all points of the station began to record movement. The station's system instantly worked on the principle of sectional blocking in case of a threat. We are trapped.

Any libertian knows that only the headleader system can unlock the section stopper. And it is on the captain's IntraPod. Apparently, it's time for us to meet the captain of the INTELLIGENT K87 station. If such exists.

////////After all, we are here to re-establish LOST CONTACT////////

LOST CONTACT is a thrilling virtual reality shooter.
The game visuals represent realistically designed interiors of space stations.
As the main character within a game you will be transported on the research station INTELLIGENT K8 that has been captured by the hybrid monsters.
You will be faced to fight horrifying deep space creatures in a close proximity of a Black Hole.
Your dexterity is the only means to increase the chance of your survival in this world occupied by ruthless mutants.
Every encounter with another sinister inhabitant of the space station reveals the true hidden goals of the INTELLIGENT K8 research team.
If luck is on your side, you'll be able to interrupt the LOST CONTACT mode and send a SOS signal. But will it help you?
Frightening black void outside the station, flashbacks of the glowing silhouettes of monsters, eerie sounds of rustles and beastly breathing - create an atmosphere of a blood curdling hostile space world.
Immerse yourself in an intense game full of adrenaline!
Try and choose all kinds of space weapons and up-to-date novelty gadgets for the bloody massacre of abominable space creatures.

With time the game will continue its development and you will have more and more opportunities to express yourself even further!

1838290.name: LOUD: My Road to Fame
1838290.about_the_game:
LOUD: My Road to Fame is a music arcade rhythm game in which a teenage girl embarks on a heartwarming journey of self-discovery through music.

Grab your gamepad and get ready to rock with new approachable and immersive arcade guitar controls. Keep your eyes sharp and fingers primed as each note has a good way to play it and a perfect one that requires additional input.

Every track in LOUD has been produced by Hyperstrange’s own band. Each out of the 21 tunes crafted with care for your auditory pleasure.

Growing up generally sucks and it certainly isn’t easy for the main protagonist - Astrid. Embark with her on a wholesome and heartwarming journey of self-discovery through music - from pretend play on an air guitar to a real stage!

Master the songs to unlock cool new outfits and guitars. Get decked out and rock on with class and style!

There is only one road to fame: Go LOUD or Go Home!
1838290.supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese
*languages with full audio support

highlighted.localized_name: And That's How The Story Goes
highlighted.name: And That's How The Story Goes

1838340.name: Unwelcome
1838340.about_the_game:
The rules are simple: one, whoever draws the shortest straw enters first. Two, no lights except your jar of fireflies. And three, whoever finds the complete collection of cards hidden in the house becomes the gang leader. Do you accept the challenge?

There’s only one problem: a presence roams the place, turning your search into hell.

Be quick. Hide. Don’t make a noise. And above all...don’t get caught!

What begins as a game turns into a race for survival.

From Octavi Navarro (Thimbleweed Park, Photographs...) and Susanna Granell, creators of the critically acclaimed games The Supper, The Librarian, and the Midnight Scenes series,  comes this weird and peculiar horror game for fans of the genre.

  • Immersive horror experience that will keep you on your toes.

  • Gorgeous combination of 3D environments and pixel art.

  • Eerie soundtrack.

  • Atmospheric sound effects.

  • Interact with dozens of objects in a house full of secrets, and discover the truth about its late inhabitants.

  • Your only light source is a jar of fireflies.

  • Find all the cards hidden in the house before the presence gets you.

Good luck!!!

1838380.name: Radiotelegraphist
1838380.about_the_game:
Radiotelegraphist is a game with static scene and action. Communicate with other stations by using morse code. Break the code "Dielegat" from 1919.

Became a radio telegraphist, communicate with others by using Morse code and codebook. Spy on your enemies by using their station frequency and decrypt their’s codes using ciphers of the enemy.

You have to get through 6 days, each one is different from another and every day there is a different way to communicate with allies stations. Be careful, as days pass by this game is getting harder and harder.

WARNING! This game requires using Morse code, but we provided tutorial featuring everything you need to know about Morse alphabet.

More types of enigmas are coming soon...

1838480.about_the_game:
Embark on an exciting Point & Click adventure with Travel to GolemPark , a game that follows the journey of a boy named Mick who wins tickets to a robot festival and sets out on a trip with his friends. Explore diverse regions of a futuristic city where robots perform crucial tasks, as the main character navigates through a host of challenges, from a stern father figure to transportation breakdowns.

1838490.name: Bullet Casters
1838490.about_the_game:
DODGE HUNDREDS OF BULLETS AND VANQUISH MIGHTY FOES

A unique Bullet Hell adventure!


Bullet Casters is an unconventional wave-based shoot ‘em up where you will face more than 50 hand-crafted levels on your quest to solve a mystery that threatens the lands of Silveris.
Each stage is bite-sized and packed with unique monsters and intricate shooting patterns that will test both your skills and wits. Not getting hit and clearing under a certain time will improve your evaluation!

Create your own Bullet Hell


Bullet Casters also features a never-before seen local PvP mode where one player has to conquer a castle by shooting down its gate while the opponent has to stop them by summoning an army of monsters. Each creature has different traits that can be altered and combined with those of other units to create your own Bullet Hell!

FEATURES


- More than 50 short but intense stages, including many fierce boss battles.
- 4 playable characters, each with their own play style.
- A whimsical story that can be experienced from the perspective of any of the characters.
- Unlockable companions that allow for different approaches to each challenge.
- A unique PvP mode where you can create your Bullet Hell on the fly.
- Many monsters, each with unique shooting patterns and abilities.
- A rich soundtrack composed by Dominic Ninmark, inspired by Arcade classics.

1838530.name: 5G VR Football
1838530.about_the_game: Did you ever want to score penalties with your friends from all over the world? Then this game is the right choice. "5G VR Football" is a multiplayer penalty simulator in Virtual Reality. 1838540.name: Stealth Kart
1838540.about_the_game:
In Stealth Kart, we mix Real-Time Tactics and Fun Racing. Sneak past the policemen's eyes or get into hot pursuits.
The green friend has a fast car and needs to get to the goal. One friendly kid might put the enemy into cardboard boxes or hide in one. Another friendly kid has a ramp car, allowing crazy jumps. The third kid has his dad's donut food truck, avoiding suspicion by selling donuts.

  • Real-Time Tactics meets Racing gameplay: Pick up and play, beat a level in minutes
  • Later levels are old-school challenging
  • Four playable characters, all with unique abilities
  • Local coop option: real-time tactical teamwork
  • Hide in cardboard boxes, jump over ramps, drive the ramp car, swim, distract policemen with donuts
  • Cameraderie between a green alien and friendly kids
  • Vist gramps for a few tips
  • Longtime motivation: Replay levels with different approaches for medals
  • Choose your playstyle: Hot pursuits! Or stealthy sneaking. Or making the policemen swim.

1838550.name: Mother Machine: Co-Op Gremlin Tours
1838550.about_the_game:
Take control of a cute naughty gremlin and do the bidding of your loving mechanical Mother!

In Co-Op Gremlin Tours, you and your Gremlin friends are on a trip to the (newly terraformed) surface of the planet, using the drilling machines left behind by the Creators. Each Tour will take you through a number of small caves, each with its own distinct theme and goal. At the end of each cave, you will find another drill taking you to the next cave: but first, you and your Gremlin pals will need to decide which cave to explore next with a vote!

This is a roguelike spin-off in the Mother Machine universe. Existing Mother Machine owners will receive this free if it's fully developed.

Features

Varied Gameplay- In a Gremlin Tour you encounter small caves, each with a different theme and biome. Some caves will be all about platforming with ropes and acid pools to dodge; another might have swarms of critters hunting you in the dark; or perhaps you’ll be trying to smash as many crystals as you can before the Drill departs.

Progression System- When you start a Tour, you don’t have any mutations or perks yet. Different caves will give you opportunities to equip a mutation or get a perk as you progress through the ascension path, so you’ll become more powerful and get to try different abilities as you keep drilling up. You will also start the game with a base level of health, stamina, and respawns, and there will be ways to unlock permanent upgrades, cave-types, and abilities that persist between each Tour.

Replayability -You will be experiencing a different “Ascension” map layout each time, with decisions about which path to take after each cave changing what options you have later in the Tour. And as you equip different mutations on each Tour, you will experience different “builds” of your team (with your unlocks all pooled together to choose from).

You woke up in the dungeon unconscious. There was nothing left of the memories. There are only hordes of undead around, who want to kill you and eat you with giblets. It wasn't there. Upgrade your weapons before each level to improve your weapons.

Drink: Restores your health units.
Staff: Shoots a shot of fireballs. Deals good damage. (Spends a lot of mana).


- many types of weapons

- mechanics of dungeon levels

1838580.name: Raven's Journey
1838580.about_the_game:
Raven’s Journey is a realistic 3D story driven action-adventure RPG with archery, magic, tons of guns and difficult moral choices which shape your destiny.

Embark on a journey across a vast, desolate landscape filled with hidden secrets and enigmatic characters. Trust your instincts to guide you to your journey’s end while you learn your own secrets cleverly hidden by your own tormented mind. Your choices weave a complex tapestry of chaos or harmony, shaping not only your journey but the fate of the world itself

Explore your deepest beliefs & greatest fears as you journey through this gorgeous open world full of adventure, challenges, combat and quests.

Examine the brightest & darkest sides of human nature as you encounter great good & face ultimate evil.

Battle hordes of demons, mutants and other nasty things as you struggle to discover what went wrong with the world. Discover the identity of your true enemy & uncover their evil agenda. Master your mysterious powers and confront the ultimate evil who is responsible for bringing chaos to the world.  Can you restore balance to the world? Do you even want to?

Remember: Broken by an excruciatingly painful, now forgotten, past, will you remember who you are before an unknown enemy destroys you again? How do you even fight what you cannot remember? How can you trust your future when you are unsure of your past?

Struggle to understand your nightmares and remember your past. Can you remember in time to survive?

Discover relics and locations that resonate with your true self, begin to unravel your haunting memories and unlock primeval skills. Recover your memories so you can uncover the truth.

Survive encounters with mysterious creatures and a harsh chaotic world as you unravel your broken memories and try to master your mysterious powers.

Learn how your identity shapes the very fabric of reality as you remember a forgotten past and unlock powerful abilities which can influence the balance of light and darkness; harmony and chaos. Learn to survive long enough to confront the ultimate evil in Raven’s Journey.

1838600.name: Moshcave
1838600.about_the_game:
Moshcave is a action roguelite game with infinite and procedurally generated dungeons, where enemies gets progressively stronger as you advance into the caves. Help Murphy by powering him up to get to the lowest floor possible of the Cave of Dr. Mosh!

Main features:
> Infinite, procedurally generated dungeons;
> Powerups;
> Different hats, weapons and pets with various stats;
> Dozens of possible builds;
> Enemies and floor count.

1838650.name: Miss Agatha's Palace
1838650.about_the_game:
The princesses of Miss Agatha's Palace, the Hornby town brothel, have been abducted! It's up to you and your team of adventuring friends (with benefits) to save them.
Anne - your bubbly, awkward childhood friend reunited after several years apart.
Elizabeth - your dark, smart best friend from adventuring college.

Will they get along? No chance. Along the way confront eccentric characters, monsters, and your feelings for each other. Your choices matter, you can wind up with eight girls if you play your cards right. From sexy brothels to romantic nights under the stars, the adventure is in your hands.

Features:
  • Turn based combat
  • New Game Plus
  • Multiple endings
  • Animated, hand drawn art
  • Voice acted cutscenes

1838660.name: Item synthesis and dungeon exploration
1838660.about_the_game:
Collect, synthesize, fight!　Win with the items you produce!

This is a game created for people who don't have time on a daily basis, but like to "collect, synthesize, and fight".

It provides smooth game progress and crunchy combat.

Total play time is about 15 hours.


Collecting.
First, save up money to expand your farm.


Synthesis.
Once you've saved up enough money to buy a recipe, you can combine it with items you've collected in the farm, field, or dungeon!
Create your own items.


Combat.
There are no normal attacks in this game. You attack with synthesized items. Items are also used to recover. Special moves are also used to heal and give buffs and debuffs.


The enemy attacks are very severe, and if you do nothing for three turns after the battle begins, you will lose. Each of the items you synthesize has a unique ability, such as status adjustment and abnormalities, so make full use of them in your fight.
Spikes
　Increases physical attack and decreases physical defense.
Fire
　Increases magic attack and decreases magic defense.
Water
　Reduces physical attack and increases physical defense.
Ice
　Reduces magic attack and increases magic attack
Earth
　Increases agility or decreases agility
Wind
　Slows down the opponent's turn order while giving agility reduction.
Cooking
　Gives state abnormality recovery, special attack gauge recovery, and HP recovery every turn

Battles will be Active-time battles, with turns based on agility speed.
There are many items that adjust your agility speed, so please adjust your agility to advance the battle to your advantage.

Please enjoy the one-on-one combat, not one-on-many.

Dungeon Exploration.
There are seven dungeons in total, with twelve levels, and the bosses are powerful enemies.
Items are limited, so if you use only the strongest items, the endgame will be difficult.
Pick up and produce items in the dungeon, while sometimes running away from the dungeon to get to the next level.


Story.
There isn't much of a story, but the protagonist must conquer a total of seven dungeons in order to reach the Demon King's Castle.
The items you can get are gradually getting better as the story progresses.

1838730.name: Warp Lab
1838730.about_the_game:
Experience Portals In A Whole New Dimension

Warp Lab brings seamless 3D portal mechanics to VR for the very first time. The game uses a unique system that allows for player controlled portals that have true immersive depth. This system allows players to interact with portals in ways that were never before possible. Reach through to interact with objects, or peak in to get the drop on enemies from behind cover, then jump all the way through once the coast is clear. These types of groundbreaking interactions make for a truly unique and exhilarating gameplay experience.


The game's 10 diverse and detailed levels are designed specifically to take full advantage of the portal system. They require a combination of puzzle solving, combat, and physics experimentation to complete. Objectives can be approached in a number of different ways, giving you the freedom to play the way you want. Each level also holds a number of secrets to be discovered, which culminate in extra content at the end of the game.

Key Features

  • Immersive 3D player controlled portals
  • 10 unique puzzle & combat levels
  • Physics sandbox mode allows for unlimited experimentation
  • Arena mode lets your take full advantage of portals in combat situations
  • Compete for spots on the global leaderboards

1838740.name: Doxxed
1838740.about_the_game: After a botched face-lift, Gin, a movie star, confines herself to her luxury apartment to recover. Under the influence of strong pain medications she makes the mistake of taking to the online blogs - discovering her once adoring fans may have turned against her. A first-person puzzle thriller, you play as Gin as you try to figure out whose responsible for the cryptic messages and strange deliveries arriving at Gin’s apartment. You’ll have to follow clues to discover how Gin’s threatening fans are getting their information, and whether your apartment is really the safest place. Will you escape the constant threat of danger from the fans whose obsession with Gin has turned fatal?

1838770.name: Shape TD
1838770.about_the_game:
A Tower Defense game, where geometric shapes face each other, and you, the Leader of the Order, must carefully plan your time and money to defeat enemies. With a minimalist design, this is the game for those looking to relax and at the same time train their agility and logical thinking.

In this Tower Defense, you will be the leader of the Symmetrical Order, a group of geometric shapes that seek simplicity and cohesion in their layouts, and for that, they will defend their way of thinking fighting the Asymmetric Gang.

  • Towers with different abilities.
  • Tower upgrades.
  • Attacks in waves.
  • Assorted maps.
  • New level, new challenges.
  • Strategy, agility, and time management will be your best allies.

1838780.name: Ghost Puncher
1838780.about_the_game:
This is a beat'em up with influences from Guardian Heroes and Little Fighters 2. In its gameplay, there will be lanes to divide the fight and sequential attacks to use the characters' powers.



In Story Mode, you'll control Daiko, a boy who discovers a totally different world and ends up getting into trouble with supernatural beings and not-so-friendly people.

What you'll find in the full version:


  • Story Mode divided into chapters, in addition to other modes such as Soccer, Survival and minigames.
  • Map with events and sidequests, in addition to the main quests and minigames for Story Mode, for training and improving the character's skills.
  • Over 40 playable characters in the full version (each enemy in Story Mode will be unlockable to play in other modes).
  • More than 10 fight scenarios with unique elements such as natural traps, pedestrians who flee or enter the fight, etc.
  • Characters animated frame by frame, created and designed for a fun and unique style of animation.
  • Musical compositions exclusive for the game, including heavy metal and electronic music.
  • Character transformations and fusions, included in the story and unlockable also in Story Mode.





DISCORD SERVER

1838820.name: Life of a Space Force Captain
1838820.about_the_game:
Have you ever wanted to be the captain of a faster-than-light starship? You will live a full life starting as a young child of the future.

Play as human, various species of alien, or even a robot in this 350,000 word text adventure. With the help of your friends and your loyal, upgradable robo-pet, you will go to school to learn skills of your own choosing before taking a position as a lowly cadet.

You’ll choose which department to join and rise within as the Solar System trembles in fear when a powerful foe threatens its very existence.
Will you master the psionic arts or use technology to enhance yourself with cybernetics? Will you follow the rules or will you do whatever is necessary? The choice is yours in Life of a Space Force Captain!

  • A new look at the Lucidverse. After the Lost Heir, Life of a Wizard, and the Last Wizard, there was New Daria (home of Life of a Mobster and Paradox Factor.) This story takes place a few hundred years after that.
  • 6 Friends with full back stories, character arcs, and possible romances, if you wish.
  • Cybernetic Implants vs Psionic Skills
  • An upgradeable faithful robo-pet companion.
  • 5 distinct departments to join (Engineering, Medical, Science, Navigation, and Security)
  • 7 Traits: Strength, Agility, Endurance, Perception, Willpower, Charm, and Intelligence.
  • 9 Skills: Combat, Computers, Ranged Weapons, Leadership, Mechanics, Medicine, Pilot, Science, Streetwise
  • 6 Fully Playable Species: Aurellian (beautiful bio-luminescent alien), Linnera (giant cockroach with hive mind), Orrok (strong four-armed alien), Reticulan (traditional bald, grey-skinned, black-eyed alien), Solarian (human), Synthetic Humanoid (robot)
  • 21 exciting and unique endings.

1838830.name: Paradox Factor
1838830.about_the_game:
Alter your past and future in this thought-provoking and edgy time travel game. Are you willing to live with the effects that your changes may cause?

A 30,000 word time-traveling text adventure without graphics or sound effects.

  • Play as male, female, or nonbinary.
  • Change the past, see the future.

1838860.name: 79 Pompeii
1838860.about_the_game:
79 Pompeii is an adventure style game set in the ancient city of Pompeii, during the volcanic eruption that destroyed it in year 79.

The objective is to escape before everything is destroyed. The place is in chaos, paths are all blocked and there are many perils. Any mistake could be fatal.

In order to advance and win, the player must:


  • Explore the city
  • Colect important items
  • Avoid atacks from bandits and animals
  • Avoid dangerous situations
  • Use items correctly
  • Make intelligent choices
  • Observe the earthquakes
  • Find an exit
  • Run!

Inicially developed for the Atari 2600, the game now can overcome the limitations and be enhanced. The idea is to offer improvements and new content gradually, such as: modern graphics, soundtrack, special levels, etc.

Interface




The Special Button works as "using the hand" to pull or push something.

The Active Item Button reveals the name of the selected item.

Controls



How to play?


In order to be able to escape, the player must find and use certain items throughout the city.

Finding the items requires moving in a specific direction over a stylized visual reference present in the scene. In a few cases, the player must collide with the item to collect it.

Using an item requires placing it as the active item in the inventory, and moving in a specific direction over the target of the action in the scene.

Certain NPCs collect specific items from the player when both collide, instead of killing the player.

Its a game of survival and adventure.

1838900.name: Apocalypse: Floodgates
1838900.about_the_game:
Herd 'em up, Mow 'em Down!
Mindless Carnage, fast-paced action. Apocalypse: Floodgates is a Third-Person Zombie Horde Shooter featuring post-apocalyptic weapons and deadly manmade traps. Play online with up to four friends or simply play alone and see how many zombie horde waves you can take down. Activate the planted traps set on each level to make it easier to shred through zombies. Plant explosives or toss a Molotov Cocktail to cause ultimate damage. How many infected zombie waves can you take down?

Features Include:
  • Non-Stop, Fast-Paced Action that will Constantly keep you Moving and Shooting.
  • Use over 14 Different Military Style Guns to Mow Down Hordes of Zombies.
  • Throw or Plant over 10 Types of Explosives to Blow up Groups of Zombies.
  • Two Game Modes: Capped Wave Count or Unlimited Waves.
  • Play as 6 Different Warriors during your Fight.
  • Use over 6 Post-Apocalyptic Style Melee Weapons to beat down Zombies at Close Range.
  • Use In-Game Silver Currency to Activate Planted Traps and Shred up Zombies.
  • Features 4 Post-Apocalyptic Style Environments.
  • Heal Yourself or Take Less Damage by Using Medicine in Battle.
  • Shoot Down Hundreds of Different Zombies including Large Experimental Monsters.
  • Team Up Online with up to Four Friends (LAN Available).
  • Scoring System with Leaderboard.
  • In-Game Chat Communication System.
  • Partial Controller Support.

1838980.name: Polyion
1838980.about_the_game:
Polyion is a world management game.

Your job is to collect resources, place buildings and earn money to grow and build your world further. Maintain a steady flow of resources and finances and population sentiment so that your world can thrive.

DEVELOPER NOTE:

The game is being re-released into 0.1 Early Access so while there is still a bit to do in the game from world building and maintaining your population sentiment and resources, there is still a lot that needs to be added and updated so there are many buildings and features yet to be implemented and there may be issues or bugs within some of the games features.

World Management

Harvest resources from the world, place buildings that bring in money and resources and maintain a good sentiment with your population. Placing buildings that your population does not want (i.e. overcrowding your world with one type of building) could cause them to become unhappy and leave your world. With no people in your world working or providing taxes could cause you to lose money and buildings will not provide resources or money if no humans are working.

Resources

You can harvest wood, stone and metal from the trees and rocks in the world.

Other resources such as money, power and water will be gained from placing buildings and maintaining them and keeping your population sentiment high. You will also receive money from taxes and humans working.

Winning or Losing?

There is no winning or losing and there is no way to lose the game, and while you can recover from a major loss of resources or population, once you lose enough people or resources it is basically impossible to recover and you will most likely have to restart.

1839010.name: Chomp Hero
1839010.about_the_game:
Chomp Hero offers a strategic mix between a dungeon crawler and a puzzle, where enemies move at the same time you do, each with their own unique behaviors and move patterns. Whenever two entities collide, whether it is you and an enemy, or two enemies, the higher level will "chomp" up the lower level, consuming them and leveling up.

Your goal is to complete each dungeon's objectives, such as reaching a specific level, rescuing villagers or completing quests as you try navigating the dungeon and plan your route ahead as one careless move could be your last one, putting you in a deadlock position with no way out. But don't worry, while challenging to figure out, the levels are short and restarting is easy, allowing you to quickly get back to where you were within a minute and try out a different tactic!

  • Special monsters with unique behaviors. Try to corner a ghost that can move through walls, or outrun the hobgoblin, who moves faster than you.

  • Powerful bosses. Try and outmaneuver them to win while avoiding their attacks.

  • Hand-crafted levels. Thoughtfully crafted levels to provide you with a puzzling challenge as you try to survive the next move.

  • Cute pixel graphics mixed with modern visual effects. We are mixing old-school pixel graphics with the latest powerful shaders creating an immersive world.

1839020.name: O.U.T.T.
1839020.about_the_game:
Sao Paulo, 22nd century, technology has merged with concepts that would be considered magic in our time. This breakthrough could greatly increase quality of life and the lifespan of the population. However, after starting the human trials a few people starting developing strange and severe side effects from an unknown source that can even be responsible for their deaths. Is there someone behind it? What is their agenda? Will you be able to uncover what is behind this? Can you stop it?

O.U.T.T. is a 3D turn-based puzzle-adventure game with a deep narrative, multiple endings, challenging puzzles with a retro futuristic cyber soulpunk aesthetic in a pre-dystopic future.

Beware the enemies

Defeat or escape several enemies with different behaviors including extra planar entities.

Challenging puzzles

Use lever, buttons, light emitters, mirrors and sensor, and even hack computers with a 3D tetris-like game to get your way around the levels.

Deep narrative with multiple endings

All interactions are meaningful and can change a future outcome in the game that unfolds each level and on the comic-style cutscenes. 

Key features:

  • Multilayered puzzle for challenging yet fair levels;,

  • Rich narrative with multiple endings;,

  • Several kinds of enemies, including extra planar entities;,

  • Highlight mode to help the player understand the puzzle easier that que be tuned on and off with one button.,

  • Play at your own pace.
1839020.supported_languages:
English, Portuguese - Brazil*
*languages with full audio support

1839040.name: Deep Base
1839040.about_the_game: There are 25 different levels to conquer, with nine turrets to protect the challenging enemies from your base.

1839050.name: HatMania
1839050.about_the_game:
HatMania is a retro top down multitasking platformer with a twist. Two companions are trapped in a dungeon by a mysterious foe. In order to escape they must take different routes, but their fates remain bound to each other. To succesfully guide them through the treacherous dungeon, you must split your attention and navigate both at the same time.



In 50 fun bite-sized levels our unfortunate companions must dodge dangerous traps, sneak past wicked foes, and solve cryptic puzzles in order to get back home.

1839060.name: Polylithic
1839060.about_the_game:
Polylithic is a survival game unlike any other, set in the Stone Age. Humans are not yet apex predators but one of many species living on Earth. You can be part of the change as a tribe leader, taking your people from Paleolithic hunting and gathering to building the first permanent settlements of the Neolithic age, paving the way for future civilizations.

But before that can happen, you will have to discover a world, craft the first proper tools and items in mankind’s history, research the first technologies that separated humans from other species, and build many villages for your tribe– helping them grow, prosper, and eventually settle down to let prehistory turn into history.

A Low-Poly World of Opportunity

The Polylithic universe is a vibrant place, with a world only barely touched by human presence. Search for resources in tall forests, snow-covered hills, and raging river rapids. Hunt all manner of animals to feed yourself and your tribe. A hint of sci-fi mystery lingers in this ancient world. Search for other human tribes (or what's left of them), learn from their mistakes, and build monuments in their memory, all set against a backdrop of vibrant colors and beautiful low-poly landscapes.

Prehistoric Survival

You will have to gather, craft, and hunt your way to survival in these colorful environments. Every animal is a challenge to track down, from the smallest rabbit to the tallest mammoth, as is finding the right resources. After all, this is the first time humanity has attempted it. How well would you fare in the wilderness?

Lay the Foundations of Civilization

You can experience Polylithic trying to survive on your own - or you can do what our ancestors did and form tribes. There's strength in numbers, and as the village leader, it will be your goal to look after your fellow tribesmen, take care of their needs and keep them happy. In return, they will work under your leadership, further growing the tribe, becoming Elders, and paving the way for the Neolithic Revolution.

Survive Together
Experience the prehistoric world with friends in the new multiplayer mode, supporting up to 10 players. Form your own tribe, share resources, and work together to hunt, build, and explore. Whether you coordinate as a group or strike out on your own path, multiplayer makes every survival story unique and unpredictable.
1839060.supported_languages: English, Czech, French, German, Russian, Japanese

1839070.name: BARK
1839070.about_the_game:
Bark, chase, run, and hide your way to freedom in this psychological/survival, stealth, horror experience.

WARNING: This game is difficult.
This game focusses heavily on invoking emotion rather than excessively exploring gameplay elements. Seeing the world through the eyes of a dog is what drives this experience through its story. Be warned, however, that this game is quite challenging. This difficulty level is made to better simulate the realistic horrors that some pets are sadly forced to endure. Keep in mind that every aspect of this game is possible, but may take some serious thought, planning, and emotional involvement to succeed.

If you are not prepared for an extremely challenging experience that focuses on a realistic--albeit sad and unfortunate--take on an abused dog's life, this game is not for you.

The Story


Have you ever wondered what it would be like to be a dog? Their lives seem great from the outside! Sleep in, play with toys, chase squirrels, and bark at cats while never having to work a day or pay a penny of tax in their entire life! But have you ever wondered why they tremble in fear at the shock of loud booms and crashes, force their hackles up and yelp uncontrollably at unsuspected visitors, or cower in utter terror when reprimanded by their owner? Not all dogs live the lives we see on the outside.

Play from the perspective of a small, innocent Jack-Russel Terrier living in an abusive household. Maintain your needs and desires to bark, sniff, chase, and find treats, as you try desperately to escape the house in which you have been forced to call home.

The Abilities

Barking
Take full, careful control of your barking and loudly--but cautiously--scare the pesky cats in your near surroundings. Be warned, however, your owner doesn't much care for your woof-ing ways. Barking awards points. You make significant noise when barking. Barking causes your owner and other surrounding threats to become agitated over time.

Sensing
Tap into your special sixth sense and see the aura of all things you could possibly need. Use 'Sense' to view the aura of guidance and danger. You will automatically start chasing after anyone or anything runs away from your presence; And who doesn't love a good chase? Be warned though, sensing takes a lot of effort. Chasing and marking your territory award points. You cannot bark when sensing. You cannot sense indefinitely.

Running and Hiding
Your are not a fighter, just a poor little pound pup in a very unsafe environment. Hiding is always the safest solution to danger. You may run fast, but the threats in your life are very smart. Stay low and stay quiet. If they can't hear or see you, you might just get away. You make more noise when running. Threats will often stop to listen for easily detectable sounds such as movement. When a threat stops moving, be still; The slightest movement can give away your location. As threats roam the environment, some hiding places may become too dangerous.

Points
You are awarded points when barking at cats, holding chases with cats or squirrels, marking your territory, and collecting treats. At the end of each chapter, the points you have collected will result in various boosts to improve your abilities, making the terrors of the world around you a little easier to manage.

The Threats

Your Owner
Your owner doesn't treat you very well. His abuse has led you to escape at the next opportunity you can find, but you know it won't be easy. Until you finally catch your big break, be cautious. Your owner becomes agitated easily by your barking in the night, and if you bark too loud or too often, he will come find you. He has a good ear and an even better eye. Stay quiet and stay hidden as necessary to avoid the abuse and trauma that is yet to come.

Neighboring Dogs
You may be mighty and fierce, but the bigger dogs around the neighborhood will tear you apart without a second thought. These dogs aren't evoked by your presence, but getting too close or engaging in any act they may deem as challenging will only lead to your demise. Tread carefully when encountering the beasts of nature wandering your near surroundings.

Noise
Although not a physical threat, sounds may be your worst enemy. Caused by great anxiety and fear, be prepared to fight your conscience as you endure hallucinations and random bursts of involuntary actions. You cannot control how you react to noises in your near surroundings, but the way you handle them can save your life.

The Environment

The House
Trapped in your owner's house without any means of escape, you must try your best to survive three days and three nights. Have as much fun during the day and make as little noise at night as possible or these days will be your last.

The Neighborhood
The final night, if you manage to survive that long, you can make your escape out into the neighborhood. You are free to roam and explore, but be aware not everywhere is safe. There are dangers unknown to you outside of the environments you are used to. The world out of the cage, you will come to learn, is a horror of its own.

Your Choices, Your Story

Make your way to one of three endings based on the way you play. Only one is true.

(The way you progress through the final chapter will define two of the endings. The third ending may require you to revisit select chapters and find what you have missed.)

More Info

  • Main Campaign ~ 2-3 Hours
  • Main Campaign + All endings ~ 3-4 Hours
  • Main Campaign + All endings + All extras ~ 5-10+ Hours

1839080.name: The Pointless Car Chase: Refueled
1839080.about_the_game:
Unlike most games, The Pointless Car Chase: Refueled, is a new experience never seen before. It's a game... without a point.



Drive over 30 vehicles. Customize with nearly 16,777,215 colors and 253 world flags. Speed through a world over 400km² in size, from the depths of the Forest, to the plains of the Grassland, out to the heat of the Desert, and the cold of the Snow.

You need to earn new cars. The longer you survive and the more vehicles you destroy, the further you'll stray from sanity... but, you'll unlock newer, faster and stronger vehicles in the process.

Listen to 3 extensive radio stations, and add your favorite music with custom radio stations.

Download and upload custom vehicles and radio stations using the Steam Workshop.

Although it's The Pointless Car Chase, that doesn't mean you can't have points; that'd be unreasonable. With Steam Cloud integration, keep all your saved progress no matter which device you're on.

The chase won't stop, and neither will you... How long will you survive?

1839090.name: Putty Putter
1839090.about_the_game:
In Putty Putter, the objective is simple, get the ball in the hole. To achieve that, you control a putty-like creature that can expand and use its surroundings to form different shapes required to solve the various challenging golf putting green themed puzzles.



Features:
  • Grid based movement
  • Unique mechanic of being able to expand in 4 directions to form specific shapes required to solve the puzzles
  • New mechanics introduced throughout the game, such as spikes that are hazardous to the player, unique blocks that can only be pushed when you are a certain size and blocks that remove chunks off the player to form new shapes
  • Different themed courses with non-linear paths through the levels
  • Unlimited undo allows you to experiment with different solutions without needing to restart the level from scratch if mistakes are made

1839150.name: Adult Aura
1839150.about_the_game:
Is this just a dream? Find yourself in the hands of the beautiful Goddess Diana. Surround yourself with gorgeous women willing to please you. Choose a path to find your Goddess. More than 50 different outfits to dress your girls in. Make your dreams come true with Adult Aura.

Play on VR or PC. Adult Aura is a fantasy simulation. With many woman to choose from. You will be able to change the girls clothes, play with her goods, and pose them in various positions.

1839180.name: Curtain Call
1839180.about_the_game:
A wholesome, lighthearted visual novel where you play as a college student that meets students and helps them become their true selves. Who you are and the kinds of people you vibe with are completely up to you in this cute, choice-heavy experience.

We all have issues or insecurities that weigh us down. To fit in with the rest of the world, we hide them from others. But what if the best way to connect with people, while simultaneously overcoming these challenges, was to help each other through them?

"Curtain Call" is about discovering who we really are and sharing it with the world. Chill out with new friends in this low stakes, stress-free environment. At the same time, help them through their daily struggles so they can get the most out of life. It's an experience that's full of whimsical charm and emotional moments with a focus on engaging, relatable lived experiences. Combined with a unique day/night mechanic, trust meter, and locations system, the fun to be had in this college experience is completely up to you!


  • 5 different endings across 4 characters (including 1 secret ending/character).
  • Replay to discover tons of branching narratives and unlock new art in the gallery menu. 6 save slots are available to make replayability a breeze. 1 to 1.5 hours per playthrough.
  • Be your genuine self: choose your name/major and imagine yourself to be whatever gender, orientation, or personality you want. The main character has been designed for you to fill in.
  • 3 distinct characters, with personalities ranging from infectious positivity to quirky social awkwardness. Some of them might even be open to something more romantic...
  • Featuring a cast with relatable struggles, from dealing with academic burnout to trust issues from past bullying experiences.
  • Build relationships using layered choices (how often/where/when to hang out with who) and conversation skills to improve your trust meter with characters. The higher it is, the closer you are to cracking through their mask.
  • Novel gameplay mechanics: trust meter, day/night cycle, locations system.
  • LGBTQ+, BIPOC representation included!


You have a gift: the ability to see the social masks people hide their real personalities behind. As you grow closer, they start to crack, eventually shattering to reveal the beautiful person underneath each one.

You've just arrived to college as a transfer student. Since many people made friends during freshman year, you're having a hard time socializing with others. Barely making it to the end of your first class, you find a seat next to JODIE (she/her, 20). She acknowledges your presence, but that's about it. It seems she has a tough shell, but you can tell that there's a softer person underneath it all. On the way out of class, you (literally) run into a frazzled ARJUN (he/him, 20) who is rushing to office hours. He seems sweet, though caught up in his own head. Finally, you make it back to your dorm, where you meet BILLIE (they/them, 21). They excitedly knock on your door to meet the new neighbor, talking at about 1,000 words per second. Its a lot to handle, but you can tell that they mean well and would be a ton of fun to hang out with.

The best part: on your first day, you've been invited to hang out by all three of them! What these interactions turn into depends on the choices you make. Any which way, you'll come out of this experience with meaningful relationships.

1839190.name: House Flipper Pets VR
1839190.about_the_game:
Time spent with our four-legged friends is fun and precious - no doubt. Apartment renovation and cleaning the mess made by unruly puppy on the other hand… not so much. Luckily as soon as you dive into the world of House Flipper Pets VR all of these activities become entertaining!



Experience the unique game mechanic of Furniballs which turns the process of apartment renovation and furnishing into a joyful play as simple as tossing a ball. Customize walls, floors, and furniture, make apartments nice and cozy and enjoy them together with your four-legged companions. The more you progress the more apartments, furniture, wallpapers, upholsteries, and other materials become available.



Take responsibility for pets and the trouble they may cause. Clean, collect garbage, remove stains, fix damaged pieces of furniture, and change wallpapers. Also, don’t forget about the needs of those lovely creatures. Feed them & clean up after them.



Spend a great time together with pets. Toss them balls, pull the rope with them, pet them, teach them retrieving, and all sorts of new tricks. Make them happy!



Is there anything that could make a virtual pet happier than your love and attention? One thing - love and attention from you and your friend! Enjoy all of the game aspects together in online cooperative mode. Give these apartments new life, train pets and play with them together.

1839230.name: MetaX
1839230.about_the_game:
重要提示：这是一款演示虚幻引擎游戏示例及元宇宙概念的教材，请选择性购买

单元特点：

【跳跃俱乐部（Endless Runner）】
