1842280.name: Grid:Locked
1842280.about_the_game:
Grid:Locked is a city building puzzle game, with an interactive world, varied optional game mechanics - like driving, platforming, collectible hunting - and an engaging narrative.

Build the city


Build cities block by block, making smart decisions, when limited by either the number of construction elements, or a stingy budget. Optimize for the best possible layouts for top prestige points and bragging rights.

Watch the traffic


Take care to optimize not just for building placement, but making sure to have a clean road network, where traffic can flow freely. Many kinds of road vehicles, trains and pedestrians need to be able to get to their destinations.

Explore


Take to the streets (many of which you'll have built yourself), and explore around the city block. Look for secrets, find unique interactions, or platform up to some of the most hard to reach areas if you are truly curious and up for the challange.

Drive cars


If you don't fancy walking, you can also take one of the many available cars for a spin. Look for hidden events, like races or time trials. You may have to reconsider your street designs, if you want to give yourself the best possible chance at the top times.

Find collectibles


Don't just explore aimlessly, go hunting for collectibles. They may contain extra credits or new buildings, to enable you to go above and beyond the level goals. They could also contain hidden lore details, if you want to really dig deep. Don't worry if you're a completionist, we will keep track of your collection's progress.

Discover Pete's story


Get to know Pete "Hard Hat" Peterson, as he guides you through your city building journey, while making sure everything is up to code. Try engaging in conversation with him when you get the chance, who knows, he may let you in on some industry secrets.

Devlog

If you are interested in the development of Grid:Locked, check out the ongoing devlog / devblog on Youtube.

1842300.name: Uncolored Bob II
1842300.about_the_game:
Once upon a time there was a colored Bob. And his life was full of bright colors and joys.
One day two color thieves stole a color from Bob's color.
Bob's life instantly lost its colors, became gloomy and boring.
Because of grief, Bob collapsed to the very bottom. And he has to go even lower.
Along the way, he will have to overcome thousands of traps and destroy billions of enemies.
And it is you who will help him in this adventure.

1842320.name: Slayer : the Demon Haunted World
1842320.about_the_game:
A Brief story

  • They thought the era of ash and dust had ended. Yet shadows have stirred again, and prophecy unfolds. Born under the moonlight, the white-haired girl Elia alone can stand against the fallen star. Awakened atop the tower, she takes up the flame to stop the nightmare overtaking the world. Now, darkness threatens once more. You hold the blade of destiny.

  • Overview

    Slayer is a strategic action game built around a finely tuned combat system and dark narrative. Survival demands more than quick reflexes—you must consider movement direction, positioning, attack angles, parrying, dodging timing, and map structure.

    New Mode Added!

    Try out the newly added Boss Challenge Mode.

    Face a series of powerful bosses and shape your own combat style.

Three Modes

- Action Mode: Full directional attacks and combo-driven, exhilarating gameplay.

1842470.name: DeathOmen
1842470.about_the_game:
DeathOmen is more than just a psychological horror game, it's a deeply personal expression of my own emotional journey.

After dedicating myself intensely to my first game, Horror Story: Hallowseed, I found myself mentally exhausted and plunged into depression. In that dark period of 2022, I wrote a short yet profound story, something meant to invite reflection on life, death, and our fleeting existence. My goal wasn't to create a game that explicitly explained itself, but rather one where players could intuitively grasp the hidden meaning behind the narrative.

However, shortly after starting, I lost all motivation and abandoned the project completely. It felt like the story was destined never to be told. Then, after almost three long years, something within me reignited, a newfound desire to finish what I'd begun. Although the game's development was restarted, the story I so passionately wanted to share remained intact.

DeathOmen is intentionally brief, a psychological horror experience designed to immerse you in the disoriented mind of someone struggling to differentiate reality from illusion. My hope is that through playing, you'll not only feel immersed in tension and mystery but also connect with the deeper emotional truths that inspired this game's creation.

I share this openly, hoping that by understanding my personal journey, you might better appreciate the vision behind DeathOmen.

🚫 Important: I do NOT use AI to generate my games. I code and develop everything myself.

KEY FEATURES

  • A Journey of Mystery and Madness: Expect the unexpected at every turn.

  • Jump-Scares and Microscares: From heart-stopping moments to subtle, creeping horrors, DeathOmen keeps you on edge with relentless psychological scares.

  • Play as Yourself: Step into the shoes of your psyche. The fears your character faces mirror your own. Are you brave enough to face them?

  • Nightmarish Survival Mechanics:
    - Spend some nights in a house filled with unknown horrors.
    Dive into an atmospheric first-person experience where every shadow holds a secret, and every sound hints at your doom. DeathOmen isn’t just a game—it’s a test of courage, endurance, and the human spirit. Will you survive the night?

1842900.name: Hell of Sins: soul
1842900.about_the_game:
Hell of Sins: soul is a Cthulhu-style horror adventure game (AVG).

The story happened in the legendary hell. The male leading role Qin Xuan died and fell into hell, and found that the so-called hell was not the reincarnation place of souls as people said, but a horrible prison with evil ghosts--Hell of Sins.

When the souls of the human dead fall into Hell of Sins, it will show its ferocious face. Conspiracy and killing, desire and plunder, struggle and hesitation, darkness and evil are all in it!

Facing the horrible evil ghosts everywhere and the human souls that are mad and fallen in Hell of Sins, those souls who have yet been swallowed by the darkness start a difficult journey to survive...


=Art Style=

In Hell of Sins: soul, we have applied the black-and-white hand-painted style. In our opinion, hell should be a hopeless and desperate dark world. Therefore, the black-and-white painted style is the best interpretation of it. Meanwhile, the deep darkness will stimulate people's fear of the unknown.

In aspects of characters, scenes and monsters, we have also learned the style of Mr. Junji Ito, a master of horror, and referred to elements of Cthulhu in the setting of monsters. The combination of these two factors can perfectly show the indescribable horror, and bring you a feast of fear that impact both your eyes and heart.


=Features=

To make sure that you can completely immerse yourself in Hell of Sins, we have jumped out of the traditional AVG way of telling the story with only scenes and stand drawings, but displayed most of the story with lots of beautiful CG. In some plots, we even have inserted wonderful animations and videos.

So when experiencing Hell of Sins: soul, you will find that you are not just playing an AVG, but reading a comic book and watching a movie, too.


=Gameplay=

As a text AVG, we certainly won't forget the importance of choices. When experiencing Hell of Sins: soul, you will face many choices. Remember, choose it carefully! Because every choice you make will possibly determine your fate, even others’.

Besides choices that determine the storyline and trigger different endings, we also have lots of interesting QTE gameplay. Intense, time-limited QTE gameplay will make your journey more exciting.


= Gallery System=

The gallery system is also one of the unique and important gameplay of Hell of Sins: soul. There are lots of characters, monsters, scenes, etc. in Hell of Sins, and each one has its metaphor, waiting for you to explore.

This information can not only help you better understand the whole story, but also open the door to a new world of horror.

1843100.name: Civil War: Atlanta 1864
1843100.about_the_game:
May 1864 three Union armies have been assembled by General Sherman for the march into Georgia. The Army of the Cumberland was the largest command by Major General George H. Thomas. The Army of the Tennessee was the second largest commanded by Major General James B. McPherson. Major General John M. Schofield commanded the Army of the Ohio which was the smallest of the assembled armies.

Facing Sherman was General Joseph E. Johnston and his Army of Tennessee who was outnumbered by 2 to 1 but forces from Mississippi, Mobile and the Atlantic coast were on the way to swell his ranks. Rocky Face Ridge near Dalton, Georgia was Sherman’s first major obstacle. The next was the Etowah River. By June 18th Johnston had taken up his strongest position at the Kennesaw Mountain Line.

By early July Sherman had pushed Johnston back through north Georgia and the next goal was Atlanta. Destroying the railroads and capturing factories around the city would provide a political boost to President Abraham Lincoln and impair the southern war effort.

Atlanta 1864 consists of:

7 mission ‘Tutorial’ campaign, played as Union.
4 mission ‘Rebel Yell’ Campaign. Key events from May 9th – May 15th.
5 mission ‘Bayonets and Shells’ Campaign. Key events from May 27th – June 20th.
6 mission ‘Yankee Hurrah’ Campaign. Key events from June 20th – July 21st.
6 mission ‘The Battle of Atlanta’ Campaign. Key events from the battle of Atlanta.

With the exception of the tutorial all missions can be played as either side.

1843270.name: Reef Rivals
1843270.about_the_game:
Reef Rivals is an upcoming couch coop party game!

With Reef Rivals, we want to put the couch back into coop gaming! This game is supposed to be a simple yet fun local party game to enjoy with friends, not more, not less.

GAMEPLAY


In Reef Rivals, you will compete against your friends in so-called "Cups". Cups can be played either as duos, trios, or squads and consist of a random selection of 3 minigames. You can score in each game based on your placement. In the end, the player with the highest score will win the cup!

The game focuses on short, fast-paced minigames that usually don't take more than 3-4 minutes or less to finish. After finishing just pass the controllers around and dive back into the action! No long wait times for that one friend that never gets to play first.

At launch, the game will come with around 10 different minigames which are randomly chosen for each cup.

With each completed cup, you will collect points! Points are the in-game currency that is used to unlock new characters. Reef Rivals will feature at least 10 different characters at launch. There are mermaids, divers, a sausage, and many more. Every player will find his or her favorite.

ONLINE COOP


Thanks to Steam-Remote-Play, you can play together with up to 3 friends without leaving the comforts of your home! Only one of you needs a copy of the game to invite friends and play together just like you would on your couch (Without the couch).

PLAY YOUR WAY


Some games are best played using controllers, but not anyone has a bunch of gamepads lying around. In REEF RIVALS, up to two players can play using one keyboard! Furthermore, the game supports PC-Gamepads, Xbox, and Playstation controllers.

Don't like playing random games because that one game you always end up in is getting really on your nerves? Don't worry! With the CUSTOMIZE CUP feature, you can create a playlist to your liking! Add or remove as many games as you want. Just ball games? No problem! You're really into Puzzles? Dive right in!

OUR PHILOSOPHY


Reef Rivals is a collaboration of two game-loving friends that don't believe in season passes, loot boxes, and paid DLCs. We want to go back to the roots of gaming: Having fun with friends and unlocking every last piece of in-game content by playing.

「RUKIMIN's Disappointing Adventure!」

"RUKIMIN's Disappointing Adventure!" series is a 2D side-scrolling action game in which you control Shobomi, a cute cat character, and aim for the goal!



Unpredictable traps everywhere! A lot of unpredictable traps that will make you shout, "How is this possible!!?" were prepared.
For example, when you try to pick up a coin, you are trapped in iron bars, and when you are stuck, spikes fall on you, or when you pick up a key, you are crushed because you cannot bear the weight of the key. The game is full of traps that you cannot even imagine.

1843400.name: The Last Disease Z
1843400.about_the_game:
Overview

The Last Disease Z is a harsh open-world survival experience where every step can be your last. The abandoned island hides not only traces of civilization but also threats lurking in the shadows. Fight, build, and explore to survive amidst chaos, where the living can be just as dangerous as the dead.

The island looks peaceful only at first glance. An abandoned city, deserted villages, a ruined military base - all of it reminds you of a time when humans still controlled what was happening. Now chaos reigns: zombies roam the streets, mutants hide in the forests, and armed bandits set up ambushes at the most valuable points of interest.

You’ll start from scratch: gather resources, craft tools, build a shelter, and defend it from raids by other players and hostile factions. Every trip beyond your base is a test. Every item you find is a chance to survive a little longer.

Develop your character’s skills, explore the island, hunt, and fight - only the toughest will endure.

Key Features

Open island world with a city, villages, a military base, and diverse points of interest

Explore various locations - from abandoned city streets to quiet villages and a deserted military base, each offering unique loot and hidden dangers.

Sandbox with no story limitations

Play your way: survive alone, join factions, build fortresses, or hunt for loot - no scripted boundaries.

Crafting weapons, tools, medicine, and resources

Create everything you need to survive - from basic tools to firearms and medical supplies.

Base building and construction of your own stronghold

Build a house or a fortified base with multi-layered defenses - walls, traps, barricades, and smart layouts will help you stay alive.

1843450.name: Link: The Unleashed Nexus RH
1843450.about_the_game:
■ About
"Link: The Unleashed Nexus RH" is a fast-paced platformer and 3D action game. Players traverse the world of "HAVEN," which is controlled by the mysterious object known as the "Nexus," utilizing various actions. The game features fantastic parkour that emphasizes a sense of speed and floating, allowing players to glide through the air, kick off walls, and leap over enemies.

The game boasts over 15 diverse stages, including underwater gardens, ruined floating cities, and levitating temples.

Glide, leap over enemies, and kick off walls to forge your own path. Observe the characteristics of the numerous gimmicks present in each stage to construct the optimal route. The goal is to destroy the "Realm Nexus" located at the deepest part of each stage. Progress through the stages and reach the "World's Exit" at the edge of the sky.

With leaderboard support, players can discover hidden routes and original techniques to challenge the fastest records.

The game caters to a wide range of players, with assist systems for beginners and advanced equipment for experienced players to achieve even greater speeds. Collect scattered memory fragments throughout the world to access new skills and forgotten memories, and unravel the mystery of the Nexus.

Face off against multiple powerful and unique bosses.

Stand against the world's gigantic defense mechanisms and other ability users (Linkers). Precisely dodge enemy attacks and launch counterattacks as you pass by to prevail in these intense battles.


■ Restructured Heaven
This version is a complete remake of the indie game released in 2014-2015, only in Japan.

While the storyline and concept are the same, the player experience has completely evolved from the past version, and the playtime is four to five times bigger.



■ Gameplay
Use the "Thruster" ability to glide through the air at high speed as your main weapon, run through, and step on various enemies and mechanisms to reach your goal.

More actions will unlock as you progress in the game: discover hidden items, polish your technique, look for shortcuts, and best routes for speed runs.


■ Story
HAVEN is a multi-layered world ruled by the mysterious crystal Nexus.
You wake up on the lowest level of this realm with no memories and as your sole clue: "Aim for the sky" engraved in your arm.
As you try to run off to find the "World’s Exit", many entities known as "Linkers" will defy and fight you using their abilities, based on various grounds.
What awaits you beyond the "World’s Exit"..?

Welcome to the "Reconstructed" fake paradise.

New content and an engaging trip out of Kalmaruss worth hours of gameplay :)

1843690.name: Darkion
1843690.about_the_game:
Experience unique and thrilling competitive PvP battles with your friends in Darkion, a free-to-play fantasy game that combines skill-based combat with summoning powerful creatures to fight alongside you. Work together with other players to complete the campaign and earn legendary items, which you can then trade with other players for profit.

ABOUT THE CHARACTERS

Darkion's universe is filled with diverse and fascinating characters from different cultures and time periods, all brought together in the same battlefield due to the absence of the angel guardian responsible for maintaining the linear flow of time.

Players can choose to play as a variety of historical warriors, each with their own unique abilities and strengths. For example, you can become a fierce samurai warrior from 15th century Japan, wielding a katana and mastering the art of combat with incredible precision. Alternatively, you can embody a Redcoat musketeer from the British Empire of the year 1780, equipped with a musket and ready to defend your kingdom with honor and bravery.

These are just a few examples of the many characters available in Darkion, each with their own backstory and abilities. Whether you prefer the agility of a ninja, the strength of a Viking warrior, or the cunning of a pirate, there is a character in Darkion that will suit your playstyle and preferences.

Choose your character wisely, master their unique abilities, and team up with other players to dominate the battlefield and emerge victorious in Darkion's epic battles.

ABOUT THE ENTITIES

In Darkion, players have the ability to summon powerful entities to fight alongside them in battle. These entities can be summoned mid-battle and are controlled through a radial menu that allows players to issue a variety of commands.

Entities vary in their abilities and intelligence levels, and each has a unique set of commands available to them. Some entities possess a high level of intelligence, allowing players to command them to focus on specific enemies or set up deadly ambushes in certain areas of the map. However, entities with lower intelligence levels can be less discerning and may attack indiscriminately, including friendly players, unless commanded otherwise.

Environmental factors can also affect the strength and effectiveness of entities. Some entities are stronger near water or fire sources, while others are more effective during certain times of day or under specific weather conditions. For example, entities that can fly can be commanded to perform aerial attacks on the enemy team, providing players with a strategic advantage in battle.

Overall, the ability to summon and command entities adds a new level of strategy and depth to Darkion's gameplay, allowing players to customize their approach to battle and adapt to changing circumstances on the battlefield.

ABOUT THE TECH

Darkion is built with cutting-edge technology, including the latest version of Unreal Engine 5 and features like Nanite, Lumen, and MetaHumans from Epic Games.

GAME SOUNDS

Our use of Microsoft's Project Acoustics technology allows for physics sound wave simulations that create immersive game audio never heard before.
In addition, Darkion features proximity voice chat that simulates realistic sound wave absorption in different environments.

This means that the location of your player within the game environment affects how other players hear your voice, creating an incredibly immersive experience.

Darkion is a game like no other, combining innovative technology with thrilling gameplay for an unforgettable experience.

1843760.name: Rogue Tower
1843760.about_the_game:
Rogue Tower is a tower defense game with roguelike elements and a continuously expanding path which you can influence. Unlock new towers and buildings, build up your defenses, upgrade your towers through card draws and cash, expand the path tactically to control how enemies move and defend your tower.


Where you build your towers is the most important aspect to any tower defense game. In rogue tower, the path the enemies must travel continuously extends and grows to much greater lengths than your average tower defense game making tower placement even more important in this game. Not only do you need to carefully consider what kind of coverage they will have, but towers also get a bonus to damage based on their elevation. This means that there are spots which are better than others, but they are limited; which towers do you place on these spots? do you save them for a tower you haven't unlocked yet? or do you put everything you have there now? are the good spots even in a good location or are they too far off the path? These are all strategical questions you will have to answer every game.


Every level of the game you must choose a direction to expand the path. The path will randomly twist turn and split often. Wrangle what control you can over it to influence the shape of the level and how far enemies must travel down each path to get to the tower. Do you want enemies from all the paths to come one at a time as to not over saturate your defenses? Or do you want all of the enemies to merge together for your AOE damaging towers?


During each game you will be able to choose random upgrade and unlock cards. These cards will let you build new towers or upgrade existing towers giving them better damage, range or new abilities.

After each game you will gain experience which can be used to unlock further towers and upgrades to appear in game. You can also unlock permanent upgrades which will persist through every game you play giving you a small boost to the start of your next game.

With over 400 unique cards and upgrades there is nearly endless replayability!


Your tower will be attacked by several different types of monsters. As the game progresses you will encounter more complex and dangerous enemies. They can heal, sprint, launch attacks or even spawn more enemies themselves. Many of the abilities that monsters have will apply to nearby monsters making enemies dangerous in large packs depending on the enemies you are facing; even a weak monster can buff up a stronger one to dangerous levels.

Each tower deals with certain types of enemies better than others. So every game you may have to consider whether to build up defenses in advance or to wait for the new threats to emerge and adapt on the fly.

1843840.name: Rogue Point
1843840.about_the_game:
From the creators of Black Mesa: When the richest CEO on Earth dies, cutthroat conglomerates seek to carve up his kingdom. Using the MERX app, rival tycoons can order private mercenary armies as easily as takeout, making them perfect soldiers for the corporate war! Only Rogue Point, an elite vigilante squad, dares to fight back.

Dive into an adrenaline-fueled campaign where explosive co-op firefights meet strategic planning. Team up, gather intel, complete objectives, and battle through dynamic missions. Earn skills and upgrade weapons to confront the 5 Star Mercenary, a lethal contractor who will test the limits of your team.

Fight and maneuver your way through missions spread across 4 diverse locations:

  • The Airport

  • The Mall

  • The Office

  • The Oilrig

Each sprawling map is reshaped by the game's Parametric Design System, offering new strategies and challenges with every play. The constantly evolving gameplay ensures every mission feels as thrilling and unique as your first, keeping the excitement alive in every campaign.

Each MERX class has their own AI playstyle that packs a punch in their own unique way.

Soldier

Not to be underestimated, the soldier is the workhorse of the MERX squads. Soldiers will utilize their environment and work with other squad units to challenge Rogue Point head on.

Berserker

Juiced up on substances and with no regard for their own life, the Berserker's singular goal is to close the distance and slice your whole team with a machete. They are agents of chaos and will wreck your carefully crafted game plan.

Sniper

Heavily fortified in the far distance, snipers will pin your team down and deny you entry into important areas. Their only tell is the laser beam from their gun, and your teammate’s head exploding next to you.

Lookout

Quick-footed and fast-talking, the Lookout disrupts your squad with flashbangs and relentless hit-and-run tactics.

Heavy

Heavies are big, slow brutes that don’t take cover and eat bullets. You can dump all your ammo into them with no effect. Run the other way, or find their one weakness.

5-Star Mercenary

These legendary MERX have received the top-tier 5-star rating in the app. They should be approached with caution, and treated as extremely dangerous to you and your team. Intel on these MERX is sketchy, but we know that these endgame encounters will require your team’s full strength to have a chance to take them down.

Rogue Point is easy to learn, hard to master, perfect for both fresh recruits and seasoned veterans. Crave fast-paced action? How about slow, methodical, skill-driven gameplay? Rogue Point kicks open the door to both those worlds and invites players to choose their own playstyle.

Earn your keep on the frontlines to purchase new hardware for your arsenal. Start with nothing more than a pistol and an armored vest, then earn an elite arsenal through successful missions and strategic teamplay. Upgrade your loadout with an assortment of attachments and gear to get out alive. Own the battlefield on your terms.

Work together to battle against the MERX threat. Rogue Point is purpose-built to reinforce teamplay and pull players into combat. Plan, Adapt, and Overcome the odds by building your unique Rogue.

Earn money to buy weapons and gear. Buy the exact loadout you want or put your cash on the line for a chance at rare items only available through the Dead Drop system.

  • 40+ Tactical Items and Attachments for your arsenal

  • 60+ Cosmetic Items, with multiple skins

  • 40+ Mission Layouts, across 4 locations

  • Perform an exorcism on a woman possessed by a demon.Find demonic spirits lurking within a house. Use items to banish these spirits and cleanse the house to weaken the grip on a possessed woman.

1844080.name: Starwisp Hyperdrive
1844080.about_the_game:
Starwisp Hyperdrive is in early access - you might encounter bugs, and sections still being completed. Let us know in the Steam forums or our discord server about bugs and feedback! To check out what other features are coming soon, see the early access section above.

You've inherited a spaceship! But there's one or two teeny tiny little problems.... It's a bit of a fixer upper. It has a bad reputation. Government agents seem to take a strange interest. Also, it appears to be haunted. Aside from that, it's your cozy new home!

Starwisp Hyperdrive is a space RPG adventure that's more about the journey than the destination.


  • Choose your destination! Hopefully you have enough fuel to get where you want to go.
  • If not you might want to visit a trader... before you leave port, of course.
  • Name and create your character.
  • Travel through space and explore the system.
  • Take on jobs at various spaceports.
  • Fix your ship and try not to die alone in space.
  • Grow alien plants in the botany room.
  • Experience space depression!
  • Fly to asteroids and mine stuff.
  • Conduct inadvisable experiments.
  • Bond with your robot buddies. As in, you can bond... but the robot is an unfeeling machine.
  • Fix your broken machine parts and robots! Or scrap them, if you want. You monster.
  • Rearrange your cargo bay.
  • Talk to random space weirdos.
And many more!

Currently in Early Access, Wishlist or join our discord server! (It's listed over in the developer info.)

1844100.name: SPEARHEAD
1844100.about_the_game:
Spearhead is the story of agents who join secret organizations in a chaotic world surrounded by infectious diseases.

Simple shooting game that's easy to play

Anyone can enjoy it for free.

Six agents, Six stories

From the start of the game to the epilogue, experience six stories with pixel CG.
I'm not an expert, but I tried hard one by one.

The unique skills of the agents

It doesn't matter to complete the game, but it's better to use it.

1844110.name: The Legend of the War Axe
1844110.about_the_game:
A fantasy world in which battles never cease. Humans, elves and the damned are constantly at war with each other. A sword or an ax, arrows or buckshot or can blow them all up? When choosing a hero class, you choose the style of play and its strengths and weaknesses. Or maybe you want to become one of the three bosses and let other players arrange raids on you.
The Legend of the War Ax is a fast-paced, real-time, third-person PvP battle. Currently, 10 characters are available for which you can play. The game will be constantly evolving and supplemented with new characters, bosses and territories.

1844120.name: Garenburg Penitence: The Riflebird
1844120.about_the_game:
Garenburg Penitence is an action-puzzle arcade game and visual novel about matching sphere colors and exploring the collapsing psyche that destroyed the world.

With over 70 unique level maps, additional game modes, a level editor, and a tragic tale spanning across eight databases, learn the story of a fragile girl and her regretful actions.

If everything has a cost, then how much would it be to make the world a better place?

  • Fast, dynamic arcade gameplay. Fire spheres and match colors before they reach the end, and speed up or slow down to retain accuracy!

  • Story Mode: Clear a campaign of 130 levels with three difficulty options and unlock files to understand the truth of the world

  • File System: Spanning eight databases and consisting of around 80,000 words, read the pieces that make up a tragedy. If her story is not your interest, it is not necessary to read to experience the gameplay

  • Six different worlds with unique themes and 12 unique level maps each for a total of 72 levels

  • Five different gameplay modes, including Classic, No Mistakes, GREEN, Wave (difficulty increases over time), and Unwind (relaxing mode)

  • Custom Level Editor: Full support for player-made levels via both the Steam Workshop and local level loading

  • Multiplayer Versus: Grab an enemy or friend and battle to see who can get the most score or survive the longest

  • An original, dynamic soundtrack that changes as danger increases

  • Numerous configurable accessibility settings to change effects and visuals

This game relies on color matching and has fast movement and imagery. While some fast visual effects can be toggled off, distinguishing colors apart from each other is a key component of gameplay. There are multiple accessibility options for custom colors and other settings to help aid in this, but please keep this in mind if you have colorblindness.

1844130.name: Stellar Orphans
1844130.about_the_game:
"Stellar Orphans" offers an immersive dive into a thrilling intergalactic odyssey. In this deck-building game, every decision shapes the fate of your crew lost in the cosmic expanse. Drifting aimlessly in the darkness of space, your mission is to solve emerging crises to ensure the survival of your "Stellar Orphans."

The game stands out for its strategic aspect, challenging players to build an optimal deck to face cosmic challenges. Forge unexpected alliances, take calculated risks, and wisely use the limited resources at your disposal. Each chosen card impacts the course of the adventure, creating a dynamic and captivating gaming experience.

The game's universe provides narrative depth, blending science fiction elements with tense survival situations. Players face moral dilemmas, heart-wrenching choices, and unexpected twists as they explore the mysterious corners of infinite space.


The central theme of the game, survival in cosmic unknowns, creates an immersive atmosphere. Players feel the weight of decisions, as each crisis resolved or failure suffered influences the trajectory of the story. The game mechanics are designed to encourage adaptability and creativity, offering a rich and renewable experience with each playthrough.

Breathtaking visuals and evocative illustrations (AI-generated) transport players to stunning stellar landscapes, reinforcing immersion in this futuristic universe. Meticulous details in the cards and game components contribute to creating a consistent and captivating aesthetic.

"Stellar Orphans" thus offers a comprehensive gaming experience, combining strategy, immersive storytelling, and polished visual components. Whether you are a fan of deck-building games or a science fiction enthusiast, this game promises a unique interstellar journey, where the survival of your crew depends on your choices and ingenuity in the mysterious depths of space. Are you ready to embark on this epic adventure?

1844140.name: Jester`s Theater Museum
1844140.about_the_game:
This game containing adventure and horror elemts is intended for adult players only.

This story is a part of the Witch Chronicles series launched on Halloween. After Chelsea's disappearance, her siter Melissa decides to go on a searching mission. The search leads her to the mysterious Jester's Museum: theater that has opened in the town. The invitation seems intriguing and Melissa decides to seize the chance to find out what happened to Chelsea.

To get the adult ending, players should free all creatures from the time loop by bringing them to our world. As usual, you will be faced with a choice – to free them and let the Jester win or to seal the exhibits forever in the prisons of their own.
The adult part of the game is just an element of it, but not an option that you must choose. It all depends on the main character's choice. Upon finding herself in the museum, Melissa will have to decide whether to continue searching for her sister or to seal the cursed place.

1844170.name: Galactic Wars EX
1844170.about_the_game:
PIXEL PERFECT CO-OP RETRO ARCADE SHMUP



A new arcade shoot em up developed in pure pixel art & chiptune music.
Inspired by shmups like Galaga, Gradius or R-Type, where classic and new
mechanics convive to create a really original and addictive title.

A game with a high replayability value. Through its little procedural systems,
enemies and scenarios seem to be alive and your games will never be the same.

A totally awesome combination of amazing retro classics, to create a complete
new arcade experience.






A NEW RETROGAMING EXPERIENCE FOR MODERN PCS



Features:

- 1 or 2 Players Co-op Pixel perfect gameplay
- Smooth 60FPS Classic Shmup action
- 3 different ships to fight against evil with different capabilities.
- late 80s / early 90s Arcade look & feel / Scanlines & CRT fx
- New Bosses, mini Bosses and more than 15 different new enemies
- More weapons & power ups

1844240.name: Dinosaur Park – Primeval Zoo
1844240.about_the_game:
It’s a sensation: A real t-rex has just hatched from an egg – in YOUR dino zoo game! Create a fantastic animal world teeming with prehistoric creatures and wow your visitors. In this dino game, you’re the proud owner of a dino zoo with numerous attractions.





These are some of the challenges you’ll face in this dino simulation:

  • Provide and decorate enclosures for your dinosaurs
  • Breed brontisauri, t-rexes, and other prehistoric animals
  • Supply your dinosaurs with food, water, and play equipment
  • Equip your dino zoo with snack shacks and souvenir shops for your guests
  • Create a breathtaking dinosaur park experience

Dinosaur Park – Primeval Zoo is one of the most entertaining dinosaur games in the world of apps. The cute prehistoric animals make this tycoon simulation a thrilling hit all dinosaur lovers! If you grew up with the hit movie Jurassic Park and its sequels, this dino game will let you see the prehistoric world with new eyes.

Dinos to Cuddle and Play With





The best part of this dino game? Your dinos react to everything you do! Fill their food troughs and watch them delight in their fodder. Set up play equipment and watch them play with it!

Put your business acumen to the test in this dino zoo game – after all, Dinosaur Park – Primeval Park is also a thrilling tycoon game.

  • which Dinos Will Attract the Most visitors?
  • Where do I best set up my shops for the park guests?
  • How can I most shrewdly invest my profits to keep the registers ringing?
  • When is it worth hiring staff for my dino park?

Which strategies you pursue and how effectively you run your dino zoo game is all up to you! Play Dinosaur Park – Primeval Zoo and experience the most captivating dinosaur game of all time!




Dinosaur Park: Primeval Zoo is co-funded by the German Federal Ministry of Transport and Digital Infrastructure as part of the German federal government's computer game funding program.

  • Manage the work of the investigation team, appoint expert examinations;

Features

  • The documents use realistic terminology and descriptions;

1844340.name: 超越海盗
1844340.about_the_game:
《超越海盗》
一款策略类冒险游戏，玩家通过管理船员，探索岛屿，挖掘宝藏，击败敌人，解开众多谜团。

自由的搭配不同的设备

可以自由的搭配不同的设备，拥有众多选择方案，强化自己的舰船的强度，获得强有力的战斗力。

各种有趣有用的装备

有人问大海中航行什么最重要，也许是海盗刀，也许是望远镜，也可能是茶叶。

自由未知的冒险故事

拥有100多个不同的事件，3条完全不同的主线，提供不一样的冒险旅途，解开最终的故事。

招募合适的船员

招募自己合适的船员，为舰船作战提供保障，登陆对方，或者直接大火力招呼。

一个奇怪的世界

有人说，这个世界充满了魔法，也有人说没有什么魔法全是科技，也许高等科技就是魔法，那么这个世界的背后又是什么呢？

制作人对此游戏简单评价

综合评级：6.5/10
个人非常喜欢《FTL》，其实...我也是个死宅玩家，然后就满腔热血开发了《超越海盗》，对游戏前辈表达崇高的敬意。
这是我第二部作品，非常感谢各位玩家的反馈与支持！
经历过《不充钱还想过关的坦克大战》游戏的开发，稳定性有很大的进步了，不会再卡顿与占用过多内存了，写了大约2万字的文本，想给玩家带来比较愉快的游戏体验，但是仍然有很多经验不足的地方，我会努力完善全部内容，听取各位的朋友的意见。
2021年已经过去，2022年刚刚到来，希望你我都可以心想事成。

----------------------------------
首先，很抱歉。本游戏因为还有很多BUG没有修复，但是原来的公司已经解散了，开发相关程序员也走了，总之就是很对不起大家，这个游戏从2023年11月3日回到了我个人开发账号，但是我没有能力维护，尽留作我个人的纪念。

1844380.name: Warhammer Age of Sigmar: Realms of Ruin
1844380.about_the_game:
A real-time strategy game from Frontier, set in the iconic Warhammer universe. Become a warlord and lead four unique factions to conquer the wild and savage Realm of Ghur in tense and tactical battles:

• Cinematic campaign – Enjoy a rich, character driven story of desperate conflict in a savage realm, co-written by acclaimed Black Library writer Gav Thorpe.

• Comprehensive multiplayer – Dive into 1v1 and 2v2 cross platform multiplayer matches with any mix of human and AI teammates/opponents, and climb a 1v1 competitive ladder.

• Eternal conquest – Battle across procedurally generated wildlands in a single player experience, as you fight towards the final enemy.

• Endless creativity – Build, share and compete on your own maps or other people’s, paint your own armies, create beautiful dioramas to show them off.




Explore the nature of war from the perspectives of righteous champions and villainous warlords. Battle for survival and dominance across a campaign featuring four major factions, including Stormcast Eternals, Orruk Kruleboyz, Nighthaunt and the Disciples of Tzeentch! Experience a cinematic plot, penned in conjunction with acclaimed Black Library author, Gavin Thorpe.




Challenge warlords from around the world in online cross-platform multiplayer modes. Build your honour in casual play or put your strategy to the test and crown yourself as the one true ruler of Ghur in ranked, competitive play. Compete 1v1, or 2v2 with up to three AI – or play co-op with a friend.




A single player challenge mode played over a procedurally generated campaign, that pits players against a series of unpredictable combat scenarios and maps. Featuring rule-breaking twists that transform the conditions of conflict. Strike forth directly to victory or take on more battles to craft a high score the choice is yours. No two Conquest campaigns will ever be the same. 




Become one with the Realms and construct battle maps with a revolutionary Map Editor, which utilises the same tools used to create existing maps in the game.

Leave a personal mark in your path of conquest with the Army Livery, a system that allows you to personalise your forces with paint from the Games Workshop's Citadel collection

Create spellbinding scenes to share with the community with the Scene Editor, an additional tool that allows you to place and pose characters and props in creatively curated and sharable scenes.

● 神秘的五行魂石，不同的组合效果随意搭配

【轻松的探险愉快的刷】

● 不同的选择，千变万化的战斗体验

1844400.name: Rasetsu Fumaden
1844400.about_the_game:
This is an action RPG set in the Edo period, in a world where demons, humans, and gods exist together. The player controls Rasetsu Raki, a princess of the demon tribe who possesses great sealing powers and defeats the enemies by skillfully using various 'sword techniques' and 'barrier techniques' that destroy enemies in a wide area.

Tips

Press F1 to change input method
Press alt+s to skip the prologue

More than 20 actions are available to Rasetsu Raki!

"Dash" for instantaneous, swift movement
"Bang" that pushes the enemy out of the way to get an upper hand
"Slashing" and "Rebounding" long-range attacks used by the enemy
Also, the normal attacks can be used as consecutive attacks four times in a row.

The sword techniques

You can use the "windy longsword" that creates a whirlpool of wind in front of you, knocking back the enemies;
the "groundbreaking slash" that causes the ground to rise and create a wall of rock when you swing your sword;
the "red demon slash" that invokes the power of the demons and buffs you when surrounded by enemies;
the "flaming sword" that creates flames in all directions and delivers multiple hits;
and many other such sword techniques to defeat the enemies.

There's more!!

Actions like the "fiery circle" which creates a huge explosion that engulfs enemies inside the range of the circle;
the "windstorm circle" which creates a tornado above the range of the circle and gathers all enemies in one place;
the "lightning strike" which creates a lightning storm above the range of the circle and continuously damages the enemies;
have an even wider impact than the sword techniques.

You can freely combine the different operations like the normal techniques, the sword techniques, and the barrier techniques to create your own unique fighting style.

1844410.name: Fear of the Dark
1844410.about_the_game:
At first you ask yourself, “Where am I? What am I doing here?” But very quickly the only question that bothers you is, “How to get out of here and survive?!” Twisted catacombs of a quite familiar place disorientate you, and darkness together with dreadful findings strike terror.

Who lived here? What curse fell on the lonely father? What happened to his son? Whose dreadful presence you’re constantly feeling? The abandoned building is full of mystical things, riddles and inscriptions that resemble something of Southern Gothic and macabre rituals.

About the game:

  • Be aware, for the death may come unexpectedly and quickly
  • Use light to save your life
  • Restore the full story by finding its elements and putting them together
  • Open ending

1844460.name: Termina
1844460.about_the_game:
Termina is an intense, adrenaline-fueled, survival shooter set in a post-apocalyptic world overrun by zombies. 1844650.name: Krampus Kills
1844650.about_the_game:
THE NIGHTMARE ON CHRISTMAS

Krampus Kills is a horror shooter that tells the story of a little brat named Finley, age 10, who lives with his parents in a northern town called Oakville. On Christmas Eve, Fin patiently waits for Santa, but little does he know that the ancient demon known as Krampus, the anti-Santa, has come for his soul! The game features extreme heart-pounding jumpscares, multiple locations, and intense Christmas-themed Horror as Krampus will track the player down, follow footsteps in the snow, and smash through walls to bring his new soul to the underworld!

Who is Krampus?


Krampus is the shadow of Santa Claus, and he takes naughty children's souls to the underworld. Krampus is one of the most powerful underworld demons. During your adventure into terror, you will discover the ancient scrolls of Krampus, which are filled with lore.

The definitive game made for horror streamers.


Krampus Kills was made after watching hours of online streamers and analyzing what viewers enjoy most. The game is filled with jump scares, challenging puzzles, and horrifying monsters as well as hidden memes and jokes to give players a laugh along with a scare. Players are encouraged to post gameplay online!

Fight the Elves of Darkness!


A large cast of hideous monsters awaits you in Krampus Kills. The Christmas demon raises the dead on the night of his arrival. His demonic elves will run at you as cannon fodder, while snowmen rain down icy artillery from afar. Zombies lurk around every corner, ready to swarm. Finally, we have Krampus himself, who pursues the player in a Mr.X fashion through the sleepy town.

Gameplay and features

Gameplay ranges from sneaking through tight corridors of your parent's 5000 square foot New England home to running and gunning in the sewers beneath, and exploring the vast haunted forest in the little town of Oakville. The gameplay focuses on jumpscares and story lore elements explaining the myth of Krampus. The game gunplay is based around your double-barrel shotgun, which is your primary weapon. Krampus AI is highly aggressive and challenging for players to learn to avoid. At its core, the game is a "pursuer" horror game. With this purchase, you will get the main story game of Krampus Kills. Total game playtime is about 2-3 hours for casual gamers. Gameplay can be set to different difficulties and the game features achievements along with ending rankings and time for speed runners.

The game features a survival mode that can be unlocked! Play for Achievements and have a blast. Krampus features a dynamic difficulty AI that will get harder or easier based on how well you play.

Game modes!


Nightmare Mode
The game features a Nightmare Mode that is unlocked once you beat the game. Nightmare mode allows players to challenge themselves with a version of the game that has completely new enemy spawns and a secret ending!

Survival Mode
When you beat the game you can unlock the Survival Mode. Survival mode (also commonly referenced as horde) is a mode where you must survive as long as you can against endless waves of enemies! Test your skills and unlock the 15-minute survival achievement!

Hide and Seek Mode
Hide and Seek is unlocked by default and features an open map where players must sneak around a giant forest with Krampus on the loose! Krampus has put a spell on you and you need to destroy 3 grandfather clocks to escape the forest. The game mode randomized item locations when you play and features an achievement if beaten.

Dynamic Difficulty
The game features 4 difficulties. Nice, Normal, Naughty, and Nightmare. However, there is also a hidden dynamic difficulty that will adjust the game difficulty based on how well you are playing.

Replay Factor
The game features different paths the player can take and a secret ending as well as unlockable cheats to offer replay value.

Technical

Krampus Kills also includes full controller support.
The game features beautiful 4k textures and targets a frame rate of 60 FPS. Levels are designed to run smoothly on both high and low-end computers. The game features an extremely detailed options menu for graphic settings so players can adjust the graphics to work with their machines.

Players are encouraged to post their best time and screenshots in the forums.

Happy Holidays Everyone!

1844660.name: Daily Dungeon Club
1844660.about_the_game:
Daily Dungeon Club is what it says on the tin: crawl a new shared dungeon every day and compete against the world, using strategy and tactics to score the most points possible. Share your results with friends and challenge them to do better!

The rule set is simple but the learning curve is steep. At its core, you are trying to collect loot before the mobs do -- with a Warrior, Thief and Mage at your disposal. Each has unique and game-changing weapons to discover and upgrade.

Features


  • There's a new, shared dungeon every day; procedurally generated with hand-crafted rooms and challenges.
  • Each run starts with a Warrior, Thief and Mage, but quickly branches into unlimited combinations of weapons and upgrades.
  • Equip and Upgrade your party through a shop/roll/combine-3 system popular in Auto-Chess games.
  • Careful! As you progress through the dungeon you choose the "Curse" that makes mobs stronger.

1844680.name: Satama Puzzle
1844680.about_the_game:
Satama Puzzle is a relaxing building and puzzle game where you place containers in a Port of Unloading. Each level has three random variable scoring conditions that get harder the further you go, so it will be a new experience each time. The challenge of the game is to beat your best high score!

Gameplay


You will start each level with three random container groups. When you put all of them on the map, you will draw three more. Your objective is to fulfill your three score conditions. When there are not more container groups to draw or the possibility to place them on the map, that level ends. If you score enough points, you go to the next level!

Features

  • High replayability, as each level has three random scoring conditions from a huge array.
  • Easy to learn, hard to master.
  • Relaxing gameplay, no timers.
  • Great for casual gameplay and trying to beat your high score.

1844790.name: Dungeon Divers
1844790.about_the_game:
It's your first day on the job as the newest employee of Dungeon Divers Incorporated. You are tasked with clearing out derelict dungeons to make it safe for adventurers. Armed with your wits and some trusty items clear out all of the booby traps in this roguelike Minesweeper inspired puzzle game.

Test Your Wits

With nearly a dozen different types of rooms to disarm each with their own conditions, quirks, and logic to solve what starts off as a simple task will become increasingly complex and difficult to decipher. Choose carefully as you only have a finite number of tries before your mission is deemed a failure.

An Arsenal At Your Disposal

As you progress through the dungeon you're clearing, objects of power may be uncovered to assist in your journey. Some simply help you survive mistakes, other may grant you the ability to uncover vital clues for your efforts, and some grant you extra riches. Choose wisely as you can only carry so many artifacts at once.

Every Dungeon Is Different

No two dungeons share the same layout. Procedural generation means that every delve is different providing countless hours of entertainment as you clear level after level.

1844890.name: Res Publica
1844890.about_the_game:
IMPORTANT: The game is far from being finished and is developed by myself as a single guy. Many graphics are just placeholders and more features will be added during the development.

Embark on an epic journey through ancient Rome in RES PUBLICA - Citizens of Rome. Begin as a humble plebeian and rise through the ranks to become a respected patrician. In RES PUBLICA, players take on the roles of powerful Roman families, competing to build the greatest city and achieve the most glory and influence. Each player starts with a unique character, representing their family's particular strengths and weaknesses, and an individual home that can be upgraded over time.

Players will use action points, gold and spend resources to construct buildings, hire workers, and gather more resources. As players build up their cities together, they will unlock new abilities and gain access to more powerful options. Upgrading your personal home is crucial, as it provides additional benefits and reflects your rising status in Roman society.

Players must carefully manage their resources, balancing their desire for more powerful structures with the need to keep their workers fed and their finances stable. They must also keep an eye on their opponents, sabotaging their plans and disrupting their progress.

Produce over 50 different goods in a variety of buildings, each with its own unique benefits. Trade with diverse cities, form caravans, and establish lucrative trade routes to grow your influence and wealth in the Roman world.

As the game progresses, players will build their own unique version of a Roman city, with districts, buildings, and structures that reflect their strategic vision.

Your home will evolve from a simple dwelling to a grand villa, showcasing your success and offering new gameplay advantages. Upgrade various rooms and features to enhance your living space, improve your family's status, and unlock unique bonuses. Customize and expand your domus, turning it into a luxurious haven that reflects your achievements and strategic prowess in ancient Rome.

The ultimate goal is to amass the most influence and power, cementing your family's place as one of the most powerful in all of Rome.

Experience the thrill of the gladiator games in ancient Rome. As a player, you can visit and host spectacular gladiator battles, placing bets on your favorite fighters and watching the intense action unfold in the arena. Engage with the games through interactive choices, influencing the outcome and enhancing the excitement of the spectacle.

Current Features

  • Innovative mix of a board game, classic city-builder and life simulation.

  • Build and design your City, based on a beautiful Hex-Tile Map.

  • Unique 3D Interiors for all buildings.

  • Over 30 Resources to produce and trade.

  • Deep Population System with 4 social classes. Each with its own needs, demands and professions.

  • Manage your workspace and workers.

  • Seasons with different effects on production and your population.

  • Create and manage your own Character. Unlock new Traits and Actions.

  • Innovative Patronus System (your personal gods) to unlock new technologies, professions and more.

  • Build and Upgrade your personal home, assign servants, host events and explore your home in first person.

  • Interactive tutorial that will teach you how to play.

Enhance your streaming experience with our planned Twitch integration. Streamers can engage their viewers and followers in real-time by involving them in political elections, special events, and more, creating a dynamic and interactive gameplay experience.

  • Military: In times of war, you can join the legion. Fight in the legion and rise in rank. This is the first step in starting your political career.

  • Roman Politics: Take part in the Cursus Honorum and gain a powerful political office.

  • Gods & Religion: Praise the gods and gain their support.

  • Multiplayer: Challenge other players around the globe. Online & Hotseat!

  • Map Editor: Design your own maps and share them with others.

1845180.about_the_game: 因个人技术原因，所以只能推出"精简版"，本游戏没有练级系统，收集系统，主角开局便能使用所有技能，主角的实力与玩家挂钩，难度中下水准，并不会很受苦，大部分素材均来自Unity商城，如有雷同纯属巧合(都是购入过的素材)，游戏并没有随时保存的系统，所以请务必不要随意退出，否则可能会导致的Boss明明打过了却又要再受苦一次的情况。游戏共有四大区域，每个区域都有各个区域的传送点。本游戏共有五个Boss，击败Boss后可在出生点位置重新挑战该Boss。玩家能够使用三种不同的剑技，可以使用剑技弹开敌人攻击，或击毁敌人飞行道具。玩家可以选择格挡或是使用滑铲躲避敌人攻击，但都需要消耗精力。

1845200.name: Pixacrea: Adventure
1845200.about_the_game:
Pixacrea is a retro-inspired adventure RPG with a fresh twist on the monster-taming genre. Unlike most creature-collecting games, losing has real consequences—if you’re defeated in battle, you lose your Battler's License. Without it, you can no longer participate as a Pixa Battler, forcing you into a mundane life with an ordinary job (Also known as the Game-Over Screen). This system keeps society running; after all, if everyone pursued battling, who would clean, cook, or make deliveries?

You'll explore a pixel-art world brimming with possibilities—crafting, farming, battling, and making choices that shape your journey. Your decisions matter, from something as small as no longer being able to receive a free fishing rod to something as massive as wiping an entire city off the map. Actions can have permanent consequences, closing off quests and shaping how the world perceives you, or even causing a Legendary Pixacrea to show up in the midst of it all.

At the heart of Pixacrea’s story lies Team Anarchy, a rogue faction trying to hack the Deck System—the very system that grants Battler’s Licenses. Their goal? To bend the rules, seize control, and reshape the world in their image. It's up to you and your adorable yet powerful Pixa companions to stop them before it's too late.

Lighthearted yet impactful, Pixacrea is packed with references and secrets for the sharp-eyed player. From subtle nods to classic games and anime to hidden mechanics waiting to be uncovered, there’s always something new to discover.

Are you ready to take on the Pixa League, face Team Anarchy, and carve out your own path in a world where every battle could be your last?

- Firema - Waterma - Earthma - Billy

Pixacrea – A Monster-Taming RPG Where Every Battle Counts

Welcome to Pixacrea, the ultimate retro-inspired monster-taming RPG where every choice matters, every battle has real stakes, and your journey is truly your own. Unlike traditional creature-collecting games, losing isn’t just a setback—it’s game over. If you lose a battle, you lose your Battler’s License, and without it, your dream of being a legendary Pixa Battler is over. No retries. No second chances. Just a normal life with a normal job… unless you fight to stay at the top.

- Slitha

Choices That Reacts to YOU

Every action you take in Pixacrea can change the world around you.

  • Help or hinder others, shaping the fate of NPCs. (Being rude to NPCs can have affects such as not receiving free items from them)

  • Make a devastating choice, from the destruction of a city, casualties, and so much more can be the affect of a simple choice.

- Skeptishell

Tame, Train, and Battle Adorable Yet Powerful Pixa

Build your dream team of Pixa, unique creatures that grow, evolve, and fight alongside you. Train them, strategize, and take on Team Anarchy in intense turn-based combat where one mistake could cost you everything.

- Sebacrab

 - Blueangel

Stop Team Anarchy Before They Break the System

A dangerous group, Team Anarchy, is working to hack the Deck System—the very system that grants Battlers their licenses. If they succeed, they’ll rewrite the rules and could seize control of the entire country. It’s up to you and your team of Pixa to stop them before it's too late.


The game is also very serious, and absolutely has ZERO references to anything else, nor does it have any Easter Eggs, whatsoever.

- Koz

- Gex

- Stror

An Adventure Like No Other – Immerse yourself in a retro-inspired monster-taming RPG where losing isn’t just a setback, it’s game over. Every decision matters, shaping the world, your story, and your fate.

Core Gameplay Features

  • High-Stakes Monster Taming – If you lose a battle, you lose your Battler’s License and can no longer fight.

  • Turn-Based Strategy Combat – Master deep, tactical battles with unique abilities, elemental strengths, and powerful Pixacreas.

  • Reactive Choices – Every choice you make can have real consequences, from simple decisions to game-changing events. You might miss side quests, shape NPC interactions, or So Much Worse, all based on your actions.

  • Stop Team Anarchy’s Plan – Battle against Team Anarchy, a rogue group trying to hack the Deck System and take control of the country.

Monster-Taming & Customization

  • 185 Unique Pixacrea – Discover, battle, and tame a vast collection of adorable yet powerful creatures to fight alongside you.

  • Customization & Skins – Unlock free, non-paid skins and outfits for both your character and Pixa.

  • Player-Owned House & Decorating – Own and customize your own home with furniture, decorations, and upgrades.

  • Crafting & Farming – Grow crops, gather resources, and craft essential gear to improve your adventure.

  • Fishing & Mini-Games – Enjoy relaxing fishing spots and fun mini-games scattered throughout the world.

  • NO MICROTRANSACTIONS - With a retro game, as well as our belief system, we believe if you pay for a product you should get access to the entire product without having to pay to unlock more. We have skins, and other unlockable content in the game, and they are all UNLOCKABLE in game only. Sorry to those who are CC warriors but we believe you should earn everything in a game.

Story & Exploration

  • A Gripping Questline – Follow an engaging main story from start to finish without excessive branching, keeping you immersed in the unfolding adventure.

  • Impactful Side Quests – Engage in optional quests that can change based on your past choices.

  • Retro-Style Graphics & Nostalgic Charm – Beautiful pixel art brings the world of Pixacrea to life with vibrant locations, lively towns, and hidden secrets.

  • Tons of Secrets & Easter Eggs – References to classic games, anime, and pop culture are waiting for those who pay attention.

  • Retro Inspired Storyline - Play a simple, and easy to follow along storyline that isn't going to take you hundreds of hours to beat. The game is kept simple by having a retro inspired storyline. You go throughout towns, battle, and try to stop an organization from taking over.

1845250.about_the_game:
"Rubinite" is a dark fantasy boss rush action game that utilizes the unique mechanic "Focus" to pinpoint enemies' weaknesses and execute thrust attacks.
Follow Ruby a princess who has escaped from the Scarlet Kingdom, embarking on a journey of revenge to reclaim her kingdom.

Battling the Blood Recipients

Ruby's blade cannot easily harm them; only by finding their weaknesses and delivering critical attacks can she carve a way out.

Pure Blood: Blessing or Curse

In her quest to reclaim the Scarlet Kingdom, Ruby will confront various blood recipients – ancient enigmatic cults, undead possession entities, and the source of the plague. She challenges one perilous existence after another.

Exquisite Pixel Environments

With each blood recipient defeated, Ruby absorbs their power, enhancing her abilities for the upcoming fights. Crafting diverse talismans allows you to shape your unique combat style.

1845290.about_the_game:

Drug Lords is a strategy game, where you must move from location to location, find the best price to buy and then move to another location till you find the best price to sell your "merchandise".
While you move from one place to another, you will find yourself against random encounters that will help you get more "merchandise", make you lose it, or challenge you even more, by making you defend your life for it.

1845670.name: Islands of the Caliph
1845670.about_the_game:
Features KEYBOARD ONLY input and other classic limitations to invoke that 1980s vibe. Please play the free demo to see if this is something you are interested in playing. Designed by solo developer Schmidt Workshops.

Islands of the Caliph imagines an ancient, seafaring civilization based on Middle Eastern folklore and Islamic spiritual traditions.

It is an action RPG inspired by classics like Might & Magic, Questron, Alternate Reality and more. It incorporates some of the gameplay elements of those older games, like grid based movement, and combines them with real-time combat to create a more immediate hybrid gameplay.



Numerous mythical and dangerous beasts lurk in waiting as you explore and discover new lands. From giant spiders and scorpions, to more supernatural beings like ghouls and jinn, Islands of the Caliph will introduce players to some of the creatures of folklore of Arab, Persian and African cultures among others.



Weapons include some familiar items along with those particular to the Middle East like scimitars, shamshirs and jambiyah among others.



As you explore, your map with be updated automatically. Use it to keep track of your location and to discover new routes of exploration. A small mini map appears in the corner of the screen while exploring, but you can open it to view the whole area when needed. There is also a world map that will help orient the player and assist in finding quest locations.

The player must explore this open world and discover the game's primary quest(s) for themselves. The game seeks to capture some of the open-endedness of some classic, RPGs allowing the player take a number of different possible paths to the end. Choices the player makes will set them on a course of action suited to their style of play. Some of these may allow players to reach new heights of spiritual awakening, while others may bring disaster down upon themselves or on all the Islands of the Caliph, it is your choice!
1845670.reviews:
“To put it briefly, Islands of the Caliph is simply a very comfy game. It’s pretty, it’s creative, and most importantly it’s just plain fun.”

Gamezebo

“Want a dungeon crawler that offers something other than your usual western fantasy trappings? Islands of the Caliph, out now, is inspired by Middle Eastern folklore and Islamic tradition and, based on what we’ve seen of it, it’s rather fun.”

1845700.name: The Collar
1845700.about_the_game:
The Collar welcomes you.

Each of you have been hand picked from your normal life to participate in the experiment. You should be very honored The Collar has chosen you.

You have all been fitted with an identical collar. Each collar has a timer. Each of you have random times set on your timer. Once the trial begins, each collar will start to countdown to zero.

The collar lights glow indicating how much time you have left. The collar glowing green means it has the most time. The collar glowing red means it has the least time. The collars glowing yellow are in-between.

If your collar reaches zero, you will die.

If you die before your collar reaches zero, the closest person to you will receive your remaining time.

If you give up, The Collar will kill you.

Only one will survive.
Kill or be killed. Your choice.
The Collar doesn't care.

A Different Experience

The Collar is a physics based first person game that pits you against strangers in a realistic way. This is not your typical "fighting" or "first person" game. You are not a ninja, or have magic, or some mythical creature with special powers. You are a regular human being. You fight like a regular human being. You can be hurt like a regular human being. There are things that are difficult as they would be in the real world. Choose to fight or be stealthy or come up with a different gameplay strategy all on your own. This game is a simulation of an experience.

All items to be included in Update 1 coming March 21, 2025

Abilities

  • Crouch/Walk/Run

  • Climb/Slide

  • Swim/Dive

Secondary Weapons

There are items that can be picked up and used as weapons. The item varies based on the trial. Be warned, they are not very strong, but they keep you farther away from your target. And they hit harder than you can punch. Be warned, not every weapon lasts forever.

  • The Branch: A branch given by the trees to whip whoever comes near you.

  • The Dowel: A rounded rod of wood to whack those who dare.

  • The Energy Drink: A can dispensed from drink machines with explosive power.

  • The Rock: A hard broken piece of earth ready to smash anyone.

Weapons

Each trial contains strong weapons that are more difficult to find. Finding one makes you extremely deadly though. If you have not found a weapon, start looking...or run.

  • The Axe: A sharpened steel blade affixed a strong wooden handle that will cut down anyone in its path.

  • The Baseball Bat: A deadly hard piece of spun wood that will crack the head of even the strongest.

  • The Crowbar: A curved, hardened, piece of steel, although small, can break a bone or a back in a single swing.


Environment Weapons

Environments can contain items that can be used to your advantage. Some items are one time use. Others can be used over and over again. All of these items will hurt everyone. Even you. Plan how you use them wisely.

  • The Bear Trap

  • The Fire Extinguisher

  • The Gas Tank & The Radioactive Oxygen Tank

  • The Generator and Electrified Metal

Environment

From hot and cold to falling and drowning, the environment can cause some big problems. Even death.

  • Cold climates will cause Hypothermia.

  • Hot climates can cause Heatstroke.

And do not even try to escape during the experiment. The Collar knows.

MESSAGE FROM THE DEV

The Collar is being designed in order to provide a different online multiplayer experience. From sound, realism, emersion, and minimalistic design, my game development process is designed to allow the player to enter worlds like they were a part of a movie you would normally watch, but now get to be the main character.

The Collar development is going strong and will continue to grow. With each update I keep delivering more and more features and ways to make the game more enjoyable. I am committed to continuing this journey for as long as you crave it. The game is not perfect and I understand that, which is why I have a roadmap of things I want to improve and iterate on to make this game experience better over time. The community has always helped shape and mold the game as it stands today and will definitely continue to do so as the community grows.

I am sure we will have plenty more interactions and I cannot wait to see where this journey takes us together. I enjoy playing my own game especially with friends and soon with new friends I am sure I will meet along the way. If you see me in a match, jump in and say hi! It is fun to hear additional impressions of the game and play style. Until then, The Collar is waiting.

WARNING

The Collar contains flashing lights, patterns, and images which may not be suitable for photosensitive epilepsy. If you experience any of the following symptoms while playing The Collar, dizziness, altered vision, eye or muscle twitches, loss of awareness, disorientation, any involuntary movement, or convulsions, IMMEDIATELY discontinue use and consult your physician before resuming playing The Collar.

The Collar contains scenes of realistic graphic violence and gore and may be disturbing to some. Under no circumstances should you attempt to do any of the things that happen in this game in real life. If you are easily offended or have a hard time separating fantasy from reality, this game is probably not for you.

1845720.name: Cyra and the Beacon Path

1845740.name: Blood Souls
1845740.about_the_game:
Description:

2,847 days have passed since the Collapse. The signal persists.

Wasteland is a melancholic point-and-click adventure where you traverse 15 levels of a desolate world, following a mysterious transmission. This is more than just a journey toward a flickering hope—it is a test of your humanity in a world where everything has become a commodity.

You awaken on the edge of a dead world. Ahead lies a path through highways, bunkers, and forgotten laboratories. To move forward, you must open "Gates" by sacrificing resources: scrap, fuel, water, and food.

Key Features:

  • Trust Tier Mechanics: Your honesty directly impacts the game's economy. The more gates you pass honestly, the higher your Trust Tier becomes, making future resources cheaper.

  • Tough Moral Choices: When resources run low, you face a choice: practice patience or steal. Stealing allows for immediate progress but instantly resets your trust to zero, making all future resources exponentially expensive.

  • Deep Philosophical Narrative: Your every action is observed and commented on by the mysterious Whisperer, while found notes and "Citations of Wisdom" prompt reflection on the nature of reality and the value of choice.

  • Two Endings: Who you become by the end of the journey determines the outcome. Will you return to "Common Sense" or descend into "The Void"?

1845750.name: Tundralia: The Frigid Frontier
1845750.about_the_game:
In 'Tundralia: The Frigid Frontier' you play as a novice adventurer who has come to the frozen wasteland, known as Tundralia, to find fame and fortune. Tundralia is a place steeped in danger and history, and the hardy folk that make it home need all the help they can get. Partake in quests in an stylized open world. Equip yourself with an array of armour, weapons and accessories. Delve into dungeons for exotic rewards and find hidden collectables through the world to unlock rare minipets, weapons and armour.

Main Features:

  • Fight enemies using classic tab target combat inspired by old school MMORPG's and RPGs.

  • Play as either the marauder, witch or ranger and utilise an array of different abilities.

  • Adventure through a stylized open world known as Tundralia and discover interesting locales such a dense pine forests, frozen ice canyons and frigid snow fields.

  • Uncover a rising darkness seeking to destroy Tundralia and the people that call it home in a series of story-driven quests.

Other Features:

  • Delve into challenging dungeons to fight bosses for exotic rewards used to increase your power or alter your appearance.

  • Learn and craft an array of recipes, from a simple potion used to return your health to accessories that improve your stats.

  • Collect a plethora of equipment and items such as armour, accessories, weapons, minipets, and potions.

  • Buy a house and decorate it with range of furniture.

  • Find collectables hidden throughout the world.

  • Destroy rifts that dynamically open across the landscape and spew out demons from the unseen realm.

  • Build up your reputation with various factions for unique rewards.

1845790.name: Nanook's Revenge

Nanook's revenge is a Vampirism and Troll & Elves like game.

Nanook is a deity seeking revenge against the A.I. that killed all humans. As inevitable as the human fate was, Nanook was not happy to lose the humanity he cared for. While humans were alive, it was believed that this deity decided if a hunter deserved to find and hunt bears to survive. Nanook then punished those who violated his codes. For thousands of years, Nanook received sacrifices from humans and offerings like weapon, hunting tools and maybe the most important, knowledge. Learning from observing humans, Nanook now can steal and use the technology created by this new type of life: the robots.

Since the A.I. were too preoccupied and focused on how to exterminate the human race, they never stopped to pay attention to other supernatural beings that could exist. With the human race now extinct, it is now the time for the robots to focus on gathering resources and becoming a better civilization that humans only dreamed for. However, for the machine big surprise, they did not anticipate the problem that Nanook could pose to all that they achieved after exterminating all humans. In order for they to continue to prevail, they need to exterminate this sorry excuse of a bear.

GAMEPLAY

It is now your time to choose if you are siding with the Robots and trying to kill this bear god, or if you are taking Nanook's role and destroying all those sad excuse of metal.

Nanook's ability include a set of skills that allow him to track and immobilize the robots. With every successful hit from his claws, he can gather resources to upgrade his suit and modify all aspects of his power.

Robots have the ability to build walls, towers and other constructions that allows them to gather resources from the earth. Although these robots are very weak and cannot fight alone, they excel at building structures.

Nanook's Revenge is a multiplayer game, and a minimum of 4 players is recommended to play.
