==========================================================================

游戏改编自好友的短篇科幻小说，《瑞云、炊烟与麦浪》，取材自家里姥爷的亲身经历，是一位老共产党员的平淡故事。
我承认它不是个很好玩的东西，更像是一部用游戏制作的互动电影。
我本人也是一名科幻小说作者，为好友的原作续写了另一位姥爷的故事，《海风、流星与家乡》。




我们决定把这些老人的故事用更棒的方法讲出去，两个肥宅想了想，开始学习策划、制作游戏。
原本希望能赶在建党一百周年之际上线发布，也算是对九十多岁高龄的姥爷留下一份独特的记忆。

但制作游戏远比我们预计的困难多得多。
更加遗憾的是——其实这是我最最遗憾的事情——我们的游戏甚至没能赶上姥爷在人间的最后时日。

我曾饮着白酒对好友信誓旦旦：今年之内必定做完，我会带着游戏去你家里探望姥爷。
每念及此，只觉自己一事无成，难思其反。

最让我无奈的是，我的游戏眼看着要制作完成了，而我只是个臭写小说的、臭打游戏的、臭做饭的，我根本不知道发行工作究竟是怎样一回事。
只好把它就放在这里了，希望你们喜欢我的游戏。

谢谢你能参与我的游戏！
publishers: 河南火马文化传媒有限公司

1852140.name: Mathletix
1852140.about_the_game:
Complex mathematical puzzles built on a foundation of simple mathematical principles

Players must use addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division to take a given set of numbers and create balanced equations while carefully placing numbers and operators to be shared with other equations just like a crossword puzzle.

What looks simple on the surface will soon have you racking your brain to find the solution as you arrange the math to "make it all work".

If you're a fan of Sudoku, if you're the parent of a child who's learning algebra, or if you're just someone who likes a good "thinking" game, try Mathletix!

1852150.name: Cyber Lounge Tycoon
1852150.about_the_game:
Cyber Lounge Tycoon is a sandbox management game where you get to build and customize your own gaming club. Serve each customer or get a staff to do that for you. Upgrade and maintain your existing services. Expand and unlock new options. Decide what kind of club you want to run!

Welcome Players, to the safe haven of gamers.
Design and manage a cyber lounge for customers who come to relax and play video games.


Manage your resources to create the environment you see fit for your lounge. upgrade your environment to attract more customers and ease the workload of your staff.



Managing the way a lounge looks is important. Customize with resources to create the environment you see fit for playing customers.



Satisfying your customers requires a keen eye in management. Provide the services for your customer’s needs and keep them happy



Running out of space is not an option, expand and reallocate to newer and bigger lounges with larger areas that provide room for upgrades.



Let your creativity take over in sandbox mode. The building space is yours to experiment with from the very start.

1852180.name: Undercraft
1852180.about_the_game:
Undercraft is a sandbox game set in a procedurally generated world. Have different experiences every time you play the game. Explore this vast world.

Game Features:
- Travel through this medieval fantasy world
- Generate your world procedurally
- Fight against Goblins and Skeletons of different types
- Craft various items to survive
- Build your own house to survive
- Take care with the passing of day to night
- Swim and dive in ocean waters for survival
- Collect various resources across the map
- Make different types of weapons to survive
- Dig a hole anywhere in the ground and create houses inside it to survive
- Help Villagers in case they need help
- Punitive combat system, block, attack. Use your creativity to fight the enemy
- Wander through the biomes and find different resources, enemies, and people.
- Manage your stats if you want to survive, don't go hungry or dehydrated.
- And many more updates to come. Stay Tuned!

1852220.name: The Phoenix
1852220.about_the_game:
The Phoenix is a classic 2D action-platformer. This game is inspired by Capcom's Mega Man games from the late 1980s and early 1990s, with 8-bit art, a soundtrack inspired by chiptune music, and simple yet challenging gameplay.

Play as the Phoenix as you traverse 5 difficult levels, fight through hordes of henchmen, and fight powerful supervillains in an attempt to save the city from an evil mob boss!

1852240.name: Samurai Pig : The Way of the Rooster
1852240.about_the_game:
Samurai Pig: The Way of the Rooster is a brutal Action RPG. Tragedy has thrown the Zodiac and the very world into disarray. You are an exiled pig, who must return to the blade to protect the world. Crush rogue deities. Protect your chickens. Save your bacon.

STORY:
A darkness has overtaken and hurled the Zodiac into misalignment. You a simple pig farmer who follows the path the Rooster, exiled for you beliefs and ways. You live in a modest farm and practice the way of the chicken. Swearing off the use of blades due to a tragic past, you must must journey to face the deities that control the fate of his land.
As the last disciple of the way of the Rooster, you possess the skills and mastery to battle your way through countless hordes of brainwashed non believers, gods and demons. Embark on the journey of your life to save the chicken farm, the planet and The Way of the Rooster.



KEY FEATURES:
• Combat
Samurai Pig has deep, engaging, and enriching combat. Your skill alone is enough to defeat any peril that stands before you. A complex risk and reward system of combat with learning, mastering and accomplishment. Slash, crush, and demolish your foes with Samurai Pig-Based Combat.

• Weapons
Each upgradable weapon has its own skill set, abilities and unique characteristics that you can adapt to your desired playstyle. Defeat your foes for resources or scour the vast landscapes for upgrades.

• Armor
Samurai Pig: The Way of the Rooster universe is inhabited by gods, demons, and the animal tribes who serve them. Each armor is imbued with the power of each tribe, with unique attributes, and abilities.

• World
Fight, climb, swim, and explore the breathtaking and mysterious worlds of the god and demon animal tribes as you honor the way of the Rooster.
